speak;Ephraim;Lyon is my friend.|No matter what has happened, that one fact will not change.|I know this.|I will not falter in my resolve.|Lyon, because I'm your friend, I will strike you down.

name: Outro
_source: speak;Eirika;Yes, we did it somehow.|I wonder if everyone else is OK.
speak;Eirika;Yes.|Thank you, L'Arachel.|Your words guided me.
speak;Larachel;My-my words?|It was nothing... |Come, we should find the Sacred Stone.|If anything were to happen to it...
speak;Eirika;L'Arachel?|Your face is flushed.|Is anything amiss?
speak;Larachel;I'm holding it in my very hand!|The Stone of Rausten!|Its glorious radiance suits my complexion, wouldn't you say?
speak;Ephraim;This is it.|The last one.|The last remaining Sacred Stone.
speak;Larachel;It is.|And the time to defeat the Demon King draws near.
speak;Eirika;We should be leaving.|We have to act before those creatures gain more momentum.
speak;Myrrh;Yes.|We should make haste.|The poison spreads.|It is growing ever stronger.
speak;Myrrh;Darkling Woods...|Where the Demon King fell...
speak;Mansel;L'Arachel, must you leave so soon?|You've only just returned, and you have to leave?
speak;Larachel;Uncle, defeating evil is the highest calling I can perform.
speak;Mansel;Of course, my dear.|It is a divine calling, but...
speak;Larachel;You needn't worry, Uncle.|After all, I'm not on my own.|I have my friends.
speak;Mansel;I see.|You've been blessed, L'Arachel.|Blessed with many good friends.
speak;Larachel;I am indeed, Uncle.|And they, in turn, are blessed with me!|Farewell, Uncle.|I shall return.|Once evil has been vanquished, we'll all return safe and sound.
speak;Mansel;Hold on.|Not so fast now.|I have something I wish to present to Princess Eirika.
speak;Mansel;Yes, Princess.|I'd like you to accept this gift.
speak;Larachel;Oh!|Aren't those...|Aren't those the Sacred Twins of Rausten?

speak;Mansel;That's right, dear niece.|These are the weapons of Saint Latona, most holy father of Rausten.|Here, we have glorious Ivaldi, and its twin, the divine Staff of Latona.|I will also spare some funding to feed and arm your forces.|After all, there is much that you must do before you leave these halls.
speak;Larachel;So they are the blessed Latona's most sacred relics...|Is this allowed?

speak;Mansel;I know the law, L'Arachel.|The relics must never leave the temple, with the sole exception of the occasional ascension ceremony, but I think that, when the world needs saving, we can make the odd exception.
speak;Mansel;You will return them, of course...|once you've finished your task.|Princess Eirika, I would have your oath on this.
speak;Eirika;Of course.|You have my word.|We shall return safely, and we shall restore your relics.
speak;Larachel;Darkling Woods is home to naught but demons now.|Indeed, I hear tell that none who enter its borders ever leave again.|We ought to stock up on supplies in town before we set out.
speak;Eirika;Yes, we must be as prepared as possible before we set out.|I don't want to take any reckless chances with our lives.
speak;Larachel;My beloved countrymen!|The combat was fierce, but you protected the palace honorably.|The valorous Knights of Rausten shall live on in story and song!
speak;SoldierGreen;Thank you, my lady.|As always, it is our honor to serve.|Princess Eirika, before you leave, please take this tome.|We pray for your swift and safe return!
speak;Eirika;I appreciate your gift.|I swear I will not allow your valor to be wasted!
speak;Larachel;As long as the righteousness of justice fills our hearts, how can we lose?|Men, I ask that you watch after my dear uncle.
speak;SoldierGreen;You have our world, my lady.|In the twin names of justice and order!

name: OnLevelSelect_20A
_source: speak;Narrator;According to legend, the Sacred Stones have sealed evil away from the world.|Four of the fives stones have been destroyed, leaving only the last stone intact.|The last stone must be protected to stave off the Demon King's restoration.;;;narration
speak;Narrator;Eirika and company challenge the demons of Darkling Woods.;;;narration

speak;Narrator;According to legend. the original possessors of the Sacred Stones defeated the Demon King in Darkling Woods. His foul blood seeped into the land, corrupting every seed and every root. The once-pristine forest was transformed by the flood of disease and venom. Legend says the Demon King's corpse lies there still, not dead but dreaming. Dreaming of when the last stone is crushed, and he will rise from his bed of rocks and worms and return to the surface. Within Darkling Woods, hideous fiends roam in increasing numbers, as if responding to some unheard call...;;;narration

name: OnLevelSelect_20B
_source: speak;Narrator;According to legend.|The original possessors of the Sacred Stones defeated the Demon King in Darkling Woods.|His foul blood seeped into the land, corrupting every seed and every root.|The once-pristine forest was transformed by the flood of disease and venom.|Legend says the Demon King's corpse lies there still, not dead but dreaming.|Dreaming of when the last stone is crushed, and he will rise from his bed of rocks and worms and return to the surface.|Within Darkling Woods, hideous fiends roam in increasing numbers, as if responding to some unheard call...;;;narration

name: Intro
_source: speak;Lyon Evil;Mm...|Hah hah.|A moment more, and my rebirth will be unstoppable-irreversible.|None remain who can stop me now.;;;noir;;white
speak;Morva;You can clothe yourself in human flesh, but you cannot hide your foul mien.|Eight hundred years wasn't long enough, Demon King.

speak;Lyon Evil;One of the dragonkin, hm...|Ah.|I've seen your face before, lizard.|Yes, during that accursed battle so long ago.|When those wretched men bound me in their fetters.|They fought with an ally from the dragonkin at their side...|I believe his name was Morva.;;;noir;;white

speak;Morva;The protection of the blessed stones is lost.|The dark is rising.|Malevolence given will and form now walks these lands unopposed.|Ancient king of shadows...|they appear to be waiting for you.

speak;Lyon Evil;Very perceptive.|And now I am here.|I must tell them their wait is over.|I must tell them I have been reborn.|Begone, dragon.|I am changed.|I can no longer be stopped by the likes of you.;;;noir;;white
speak;Morva;I live and breathe to protect mankind.|I cannot abandon them to you.|Now, as it once did so long ago, these woods will witness your defeat.

speak;Lyon Evil;So, your dragon blood still runs so hot that you would dare to try to stop me... Dragons.|That reminds me...|Not long back, I fought a rabble of men who traveled with a dragon child.|Tell me, Morva, was that your daughter...;;;noir;;white
speak;Morva;Myrrh left this place long ago to test the limits of your influence.|Could she have...
speak;Lyon Evil;Could she have what...|Pray, continue.;;;noir;;white
speak;Morva;You will answer me.|Your reply will determine...

speak;Lyon Evil;Ha ha ha ha ha...|Such information had no use to you now.|You have dared to challenge me.|You have no time for joy or sorrow.|No, best to focus now on this, the moment of your death.|I would hate for you to miss it.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;I know...|I can feel it too.

speak;Seth;This is Darkling Woods...|It was here the heroes met the Demon King and with the Sacred Stones defeated him.|I've heard the lingering energies of that battle are the source of the monster.|But I never imagined it would be as bad as this...
speak;Myrrh;It's worse than before...|It's grown so much stronger.|Simply standing here is a struggle...|But we don't need to worry.|My father is here.|He'll take care of everything.
speak;Myrrh;Over there.|On the other side of that swamp is the Black Temple of the Demon King.|My father stands guard near it.|This is where my father and I have lived for as long as I can remember.
speak;Ephraim;I see.|So this forest is like a home to you.

speak;Myrrh;Uh-huh...|I get to see Father again.|I'm so happy.|My foster father leads the dragon tribe.|In the last great war...|both of my true parents were killed.|Morva took me in and raised me as though I were his own child.
speak;Eirika;So that's how you came to live here...
speak;Myrrh;My father holds back the monsters that are born in Darkling Woods.|He's so strong, and so very gentle.|One day, I hope to be like him...|......Oh!
speak;Seth;Princess Eirika, Prince Ephraim, we're under attack.|A horde of those foul beasts is headed straight for us.
speak;Eirika;Myrrh, are you well...|If you're ill, we should get you to-
speak;Myrrh;No, no...|It's nothing.|I'll fight with you.|I'll fight, and we'll drive back the dark children.
speak;Lyon Evil;Ha ha ha ha...|Riev...|I'm leaving this to you.;;;noir;;white
speak;Riev;Heh heh heh...|As you wish.|Please proceed with the rites of resurrection, sire.

name: Intro
_source: speak;Morva;What are you doing here, human?|You should return to your own kind.|This is no place for you to tread.|This is darkness's domain...|This is desecrated land.
speak;Lyon;That's why I've come.|I have the power of the Demon King.|I will save us all.
speak;Morva;You...|Evil grips your heart...|No-you've given your heart to evil.

speak;Morva;What a tragedy...|Human flesh cannot contain the demon.|It cannot control him.|You think yourself safe, but already, your control slips.|I see the madness eating at you.|I see the beginning of the end.
speak;Lyon;You're wrong.|This...|Ah...urg...|I do this of my own will...|I will save Grado's people.

speak;Lyon;I had a vision...|I saw my life traveling two roads.|Down one, the Demon King conquers both my body and soul.|Down the other, I master the Demon King, and with that power...urg...|With that power, I avert disaster.|I gave the people a better future...|I resist the Demon King's attempts to wrest away my will...|I saw this, and I made my decision.|I walk the second road.

speak;Morva;You fool...|The Demon King has blinded you to his true wish.|How can you not see it?|He's had you since the moment you first held the Dark Stone.|He has been hiding within you, luring you deeper into the shadows of his heart.|He commands you and remakes you to suit his dark design.
speak;Morva;You think yourself unchanged?|You think yourself the master?|I see only more evidence that the Demon King commands you now.|Can you not sense-
speak;Lyon;It's not true!|I...|I will save everyone.

speak;Morva;Think back!|Remember!|Are you truly the man you used to be?|Would you justify war and murder to bring about peace and justice?|Remember who you were, and tell me if you are still yourself!
speak;Lyon;All of this matters not.|I know the Demon King has claimed me.|It is not important...|Not if I can save the world.|My own soul is irrelevant.

speak;Morva;...It is as I feared.|You will not give up this madness.|I am Morva, the dragonkin who guards the entrance to these woods.|I do not have the ability to save you.|All I can do is destroy the demon that coils around your heart.|To prevent the further damnation of your soul...|I can only grant you eternal sleep.
speak;Lyon;I cannot sleep.|I have not yet-|There is no taboo I will not break, no sacrifice.|I will not make...|I...
speak;Morva;...You are beyond reason.|Therefore I, too, must do what I was born to do.|As it was in that ancient battle...|You will die here, Demon King.
speak;Eirika;I know...|I can feel it too.

speak;Seth;This is Darkling Woods...|It was here the heroes met the Demon King and with the Sacred Stones defeated him.|I've heard the lingering energies of that battle are the source of the monster.|But I never imagined it would be as bad as this...
speak;Myrrh;It's worse than before...|It's grown so much stronger.|Simply standing here is a struggle...|But we don't need to worry.|My father is here.|He'll take care of everything.
speak;Myrrh;Over there.|On the other side of that swamp is the Black Temple of the Demon King.|My father stands guard near it.|This is where my father and I have lived for as long as I can remember.
speak;Ephraim;I see.|So this forest is like a home to you.

speak;Myrrh;Uh-huh...|I get to see Father again.|I'm so happy.|My foster father leads the dragon tribe.|In the last great war...|both of my true parents were killed.|Morva took me in and raised me as though I were his own child.
speak;Eirika;So that's how you came to live here...
speak;Myrrh;My father holds back the monsters that are born in Darkling Woods.|He's so strong, and so very gentle.|One day, I hope to be like him...|......Oh!
speak;Seth;Princess Eirika, Prince Ephraim, we're under attack.|A horde of those foul beasts is headed straight for us.
speak;Eirika;Myrrh, are you well...|If you're ill, we should get you to-
speak;Myrrh;No, no...|It's nothing.|I'll fight with you.|I'll fight, and we'll drive back the dark children.
speak;Lyon Evil;Ha ha ha ha...|Riev...|I'm leaving this to you.;;;noir;;white
speak;Riev;Heh heh heh...|As you wish.|Please proceed with the rites of resurrection, sire.

name: EnemyT1Talk
_source: speak;Riev;Heh heh heh...|Soon...soon...|It happens soon!|The Demon King will be restored to all his former glory!|And I, his faithful servant, will bask in his radiant power...|Then, oh, then I will have my revenge on those who scorned me!|The Demon King has created for me a fine weapon–a draco zombie!|This fierce beast and I will guard the Black Temple's entrance.|As long as we stand watch, no one will interrupt his rituals.|We will drown all who dare approach in this virulent mud!|Heh heh heh...|Heh heh heh heh heh!

name: Outro
_source: speak;Ephraim;So this is the Black Temple...|The Demon King is here.
speak;Eirika;We have to stop him before he can begin the ritual.|Let's waste no time, Brother.
speak;Myrrh;Um...|I...|I just met with my father.|I had not seen or spoken with him for quite a while.
speak;Eirika;You saw your father...|Then we must speak with him-
speak;Myrrh;No...|He told me he couldn't see you.|He said it wasn't a good idea for him to meet so many people.|As the tribal chieftain, he feels he should maintain his distance.
speak;Myrrh;But he offered me words of encouragement and praised my efforts thus far.|He told me in his kindly voice to come home to him safely.|I will do my best to honor his faith in me.
speak;Eirika;He sounds like a good father.
speak;Myrrh;He is...|Mistress Eirika...|I'll do all I can.|For my father-and for all of you as well.|I will help you, and we will defeat the Demon King.
speak;Eirika;Are you sure you want to go with us, Myrrh...|You had so wanted to be with your father
speak;Myrrh;Yes...|I'm sure.|Once we are finished dealing with this evil, I will have time then.|Let's hurry, Mistress Eirika.
speak;Eirika;Myrrh...|I understand.|Let's get moving.|The faster we can end this nightmare, the better.
speak;Myrrh;From this building...|a repulsive energy oozes.|The Demon King...|He's here.
speak;Lyon;Lyon...|It's almost time.|Your beloved Eirika is on her way.;;;noir;;white

speak;Lyon;Ha ha...|Lyon, prince of frailty.|To believe that a weak man like you thought to oppose me...|You're an arrogant little insect, nothing more.|And now, you're dead.|I will devour you, and you will be lost forever.;;;noir;;white

speak;Lyon;Ha ha.|Does it hurt...|Are you suffering...|Oh, but it does not end for you yet.|Oh, no.|I've left you this one shard of awareness for a reason.|I want you to watch yourself as you crush Eirika.|You should thank me!|Ha ha hah hah hah!;;;noir;;white

name: Outro
_source: speak;Ephraim;So this is the Black Temple...|The Demon King is here.
speak;Eirika;We have to stop him before he can begin the ritual.|Let's waste no time, Brother.
speak;Ephraim;Here you are.|Myrrh, we were worried...|Myrrh?|Are you...crying?
speak;Myrrh;N-no...|It's nothing.|The poison in these woods is thick.|It burns my eyes.
speak;Ephraim;What a minute...|That dragon...|Could he have been-
speak;Myrrh;O-of course not...|There's nothing wrong.|After everything you all have suffered, this is-|I can't...|This is nothing...
speak;Ephraim;I'm so sorry.|You kept silent this whole time so as not to trouble us.
speak;Myrrh;...E-everything's fine, Ephraim...|I'm fine.|See?|I'm ready to...to...
speak;Ephraim;Myrrh.|Let yourself cry.|These are dark times.|There's no reason to hide your sorrow.
speak;VigardeF;Lyon...|This is...|the end for me.|From now on...|you...
speak;VigardeF;You must concern yourself...|with Grado...|The people...|our people must be saved...|Lyon...|tell me again.|What will happen to Grado?

speak;LyonF;I have seen it many times now, as have the court mages.|It's the same every time, Father.|It's always the same.|Sometime in the coming years, the southern continent will collapse.|Countless people will die instantly.|Those who don't will likely starve.
speak;LyonF;None but the mages and I know of the vision, as you ordered.|But...|if we don't do something, all of those people will die.|Please tell me, Father.|What should I do?|What...
speak;VigardeF;Lyon...|When I die...|You will be emperor...|The emperor...|must protect his country.|There is nothing more...|that I can do.|It's you...|You must protect our people.
speak;LyonF;B-but, Father...|I don't have the power...|Ah!|R-Renais...|If I ask Eirika and Ephraim for help, I'm sure they would-

speak;VigardeF;You would ask Renais to rescue us from...|a natural disaster?|They would not help us...|Grado's borders would overflow with starving refugees by the thousands.|Renais would close her borders to us.|It's only natural...|Renais has a duty to protect herself.
speak;VigardeF;Lyon...|You are the one...|who must...|save our people.|You must take my place...|The citizens of Grado...|are counting on...you...
speak;LyonF;Father?!|No...wait!|I cannot do anything without you, Father!
speak;LyonF;I am...weak.|Because I am weak...|people will die.|I...
speak;LyonF;Knoll...|I...|Open the seal on the Sacred Stone of Grado.

speak;LyonF;You've seen the scrolls.|You know there is a way to stop the coming disaster.|If those scrolls are correct, the rites they describe can save all of Grado.|But it will require a staggering amount of dark energy-and a sacrifice as well.|The human body cannot contain the powers these rites demand...|And yet...|Of the five Sacred Stones, Grado's alone possesses a greater power...|It is the very prison housing the soul of the ancient Demon King.|If we could harness its power, well...|If we can do that, we can avert disaster and save countless lives.
speak;LyonF;I forget nothing!|I know I am too weak.|Because of me, all of Grado will be destroyed.|I need...|I need the Sacred Stone.|I must become stronger.|I will become stronger.

speak;Lyon;Everything is in readiness.|The Stones have been destroyed.|The Demon King's power swells.|The Black Temple possesses all the demonic power I will need.|The rites can begin.|All that remains is for me to sacrifice my life...|The disaster will be averted.|My people will be saved...

name: Intro
_source: speak;LyonF;When tomorrow comes...|you have to go home, don't you...
speak;EirikaSepia;Yes...|Thank you for everything, Lyon.|I'll never forget the time I spent here.
speak;LyonF;Do you think we'll see each other again...
speak;EirikaSepia;Yes, of course.|My brother and you and me.|We are friends, after all.|Aren't we...
speak;EirikaSepia;I hope your study of the Sacred Stones is fruitful.|I know you'll use the wisdom you glean to make your people happy.

speak;LyonF;Thank you, Eirika.|You know, you're the only reason I was able to save that girl.|There were times when I wanted to give up, to admit failure.|But you were always there.|You were always encouraging me to succeed.|That's what kept me going.|I just thought of you.
speak;LyonF;Eirika...|I...I've always...|I'm sorry...|Forget what I was saying.|I could never be like Ephraim...

speak;LyonF;I guess this is it, Eirika.|Hope to see you again someday.|I'm going to focus on my work and do my best until that day.|My research will progress, and my discoveries will benefit us all.|One day, I will be a prince worthy of you, and I will see you again.
speak;Eirika;Lyon...|It is you, isn't it, Lyon...!
speak;Lyon;Yes...|But I'm...|I'm almost completely gone.|Before I'm lost entirely, I want to apologize.|I'm sorry, Eirika.|This is all my fault.|I was too weak...
speak;Eirika;You're not to blame, Lyon.|It was the Demon King.|He was controlling you...

speak;Lyon;No, that's not true, Eirika.|When the Demon King reached into me from inside the Dark Stone...|When he whispered he would see all my dreams and desires made true...|I...I did not reject him.|In the shadows of my heart, he saw jealousy...vanity...|It was my weakness that put these emotions there, allowed them to thrive.
speak;Eirika;Everyone has weaknesses, Lyon.|You're not the only one.|I do.|I'm sure my brother does...|Don't hate yourself for having these feelings, please.

speak;Lyon;Thank you, Eirika.|You were always...so kind.|The Demon King will claim my flesh as a vessel for his resurrection.|Before that can happen...|I want you to kill me.|I'm sorry, Eirika.|I'm already-

speak;Lyon Evil;Oh, please...|Are you done turning your failings into some sad epic of personal tragedy...|It's time we started then.|I have a ritual to complete...and some nuisances to kill.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Shut your mouth.|I won't allow you to desecrate Lyon's body any further.|You will not return to this world.|I will stop you myself if I must.
speak;Lyon Evil;Ah, is that so...|And do you honestly think yourself capable, wench...|You once prayed for this fool's salvation.|Can you bring yourself to kill him...;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;I can and I will.|I made a promise to Lyon, and I intend to honor it.

name: Intro
_source: speak;EphraimSepia;Don't make that face.|We'll see each other again.|All three of us-you, me, and Eirika.
speak;LyonF;Yeah...|I know.|But when we get older, when we each take the reigns of our nations, we probably won't meet again...|Not like this, I mean.|Not as friends.
speak;EphraimSepia;What's that got to do with anything?|Kings are humans, too.|Emperors need not be friendless, you know.

speak;LyonF;I suppose you're right.|You have a knack for cutting to the heart of things.|But becoming a king or an emperor is not something you can take lightly.|I really don't think we'll be the same people we are right now...|What if Renais and Grado went to war?|What if we were forced to fight?
speak;EphraimSepia;Don't be ridiculous.|That would never happen.
speak;LyonF;If...|If it did...|We'd still be friends, wouldn't we?
speak;EphraimSepia;Even if that happens, yes.|We're friends forever.|Nothing can change that.|You'll see.
speak;LyonF;Hm...|All right, Ephraim.|Then I will see you again.
speak;Lyon;You came after all, Ephraim.|I'm glad.
speak;Ephraim;Lyon.|Is this...|Is this my fault?|Am I responsible for how much you've changed?|I haven't seen you for two years now...|Have you..hated me that entire time?

speak;Lyon;No, Ephraim.|I was never dishonest.|I liked you both.|I still do.|But I was envious of you, too.|That's why I...desired this.|You may not believe me when I tell you this, but...|Even now, after all this, I still consider you a friend.
speak;Ephraim;Lyon...|You know that I do, too.|I spoke the truth to you...|I truly thought that we would always be friends.|That's why I...|I have to stop you.

speak;Lyon;Of course. I know...|You are Ephraim, after all.|You could do no less, my friend.|Well, come then, Ephraim.|Try and stop me.|I will defeat you, and then I will save the people of Grado.|No one...|No one will stand in my way.

_source: speak;Lyon;I guess that proves it.|You're too strong, Ephraim...|I've always...|admired...

speak;Ephraim;Don't be ridiculous, Lyon.|Who was it that taught me history?|Who covered for me when I stumbled?|Didn't you see how I looked up to you?|I admired your compassion, your wisdom, your thoughtfulness....
speak;Lyon;Oh, yeah...|That seems so long ago...|I did keep you out of trouble, didn't I?|Thanks for remembering.|See?|You're thoughtful, too...
speak;Ephraim;Lyon...|Wait!|Don't close your eyes!|I'm going to save you!|I'll find a way!|I...

speak;???;The time has come...|My resurrection is at hand...

speak;Tana;Yes.|I'm sure Father will be most pleased.|Brother!|This means peace will be restored, doesn't it...|Shall I fly back to Frelia and let him know...
speak;Innes;There's no need to rush.|I'm sure he knows.|After all, we were together, and that ensured our victory.
speak;Moulder;Hmmm...|Looks like we're on the outside looking in, eh...|Even so, the fighting's over.|And that's something to be happy about.
speak;Gerik;Well that took some doing, but we finally finished the job.
speak;Tethys;We certainly earned our pay...|Please tell me we're going to enjoy it.
speak;Gerik;Let's see now...|Shall we head back to Jehanna...|I guess we could stop in at the guild and get our next contract, eh...
speak;Tethys;But the queen's gone...|I wonder what Jehanna will do now.
speak;Gerik;I'm sure it'll all work out.|After all's said and done, it's our home.|C'mon. It's time for Gerik's band to ride.
speak;Joshua;...Hm...|Heads.|Looks like I should be getting back as well.|Homecoming time...
speak;Natasha;It's over, isn't it...|The demon that drove Grado to madness is dead and gone.
speak;Amelia;I-I can't believe that I was part of this whole thing...
speak;Cormag;The war is over.|But so much remains to be done.|Our country lost this war.|The road ahead will be long and hard.
speak;Duessel;That's true.|And yet...|It's a road we must travel.|That's the burden survivors must shoulder.
speak;Knoll;Yes.|And we must fulfill the dreams of Emperor Vigarde and Prince Lyon.
speak;Dozla;Gwaa ha ha!|And a job well done it was, Princess L'Arachel.
speak;Rennac;Whew...|It's finally over.|So it's about time for me to...
speak;Larachel;Hold it!|I gave you no orders to leave!|I am the princess of Rausten, lest you forget.|I have many missions yet to fulfill.|Come, Dozla, Rennac.|It's time to go!
speak;Dozla;Gwaa ha ha!|Wait up!|Let's move, Rennac!
speak;Saleh;Let's return home, Lady Myrrh.|Our friends and family will be worrying about us...
speak;Ewan;What...|Hey, Teacher!|Where are you going...|Wait up.|I'm coming with you.
speak;Garcia;You did well, Ross.|You're a true warrior, my pride and joy.
speak;Ross;But you're still the best, Father!|That's right!|My father's the best warrior in all of Magvel!
speak;Colm;Bah, I'm glad everyone's so happy, but...|They'd better not forget that they won only with our help.|Right, Neimi...
speak;Artur;O glorious light, were you witness to our victory...|The foul demon has been purged from the earth.
speak;Lute;The ancient Demon King was as powerful as the scrolls described.|And yet, in the end, we were able to defeat him!|After all, there's no one better than us.
speak;Seth;Your continued safety is all that matters to me, Princess Eirika.
speak;Franz;General!|Princess Eirika!|We can finally return to Renais, can't we...
speak;Eirika;Yes, we can go home.|All of us unharmed...
speak;Forde;Ah, I'm exhausted.|I'd like nothing more than to laze about a while...|Alas, we're not going to have that opportunity, are we, Prince Ephraim...
speak;Ephraim;No.|The reconstruction of Renais is going to keep us busy.|Keep your strength up.|I'm going to need you in the days ahead.
speak;Kyle;We'll be beside you through it all!
speak;Eirika;All right, let's go home.|Let's go back to the people who are waiting for us...

name: Intro
_source: speak;Larachel;It is time for me to be on my way, my friends.|As the princess of Rausten, I still have many duties to perform.|Oh, Princess Eirika...|If it pleases you, I would be ever so delighted if you joined my tea club.|I insist that you come.|Oh, say you will, won't you?
speak;Joshua;I've much to do here in Jehanna.|I'll start with what can be done and keep going from there.|First, I must talk to Mother.|She should know that we've won, so that she can rest easily.

speak;Innes;We of Frelia will do what we can to aid in the restoration of Renais.|If you have need of our assistance, you have but to ask.|I seldom trust people who act from purely altruistic motives...|But I'll grant you that friendships are a worthy exception to my distrust.
speak;Eirika;We've finally made it home, haven't we?
speak;Ephraim;Aaah.|You must be exhausted after the journey.|Shall we rest, Eirika?

speak;Eirika;That would be nice...|But first we must seal this away...|This stone banished the Demon King.|With such power...|Do you suppose we could bring back Father and Lyon...|That everyone who died in this dreadful war could be-

speak;Eirika;I know, I know.|Such things would be-|I cannot wish for such things.|No matter how it hurts, or rather because it hurts, we must learn to accept sorrow.|We must take it into our hearts and tame our grief...
speak;Ephraim;Eirika...|Tell me, Sister...|If Lyon were here with us, what do you think he would want?

speak;Ephraim;Yes.|You see, I think I know.|It was the reason for his studies.|It's why he wanted to know about the Sacred Stones-or rather the Fire Emblem.|Let's take Lyon's dreams and fulfill them in his stead.|We can do that, can't we?|Without relying on any mystic power?
speak;Eirika;You're right, Brother, we can.|Let us fulfill his dreams.|As Lyon wanted, as we all want...|So we may live in peace and joy.
music;68- Fly With the Breeze Orchestral Cover;500

speak;Lyon;Oh, are you...|I'm...|My name is Lyon.|Uh-huh.|That's me...|The son of the emperor.|You're Prince Ephraim and Princess Eirika from Renais, aren't you?|I heard you were coming, and I've been waiting here all day.|I've always wanted...|I don't have any friends my own age...|So, Prince Ephraim...|Princess Eirika...|What do you say?|From now on, let's be friends...
if;game.check_alive('Seth') and game.game_vars['EirikaAndSeth'] != True and game.game_vars['SethAndNatasha'] != True

ending;Seth;Seth, the Silver Knight;Seth returned to Renais with Ephraim and his fellow knights. His dedicated service made him the most trusted of the new king and queen's guardsmen, as well as the most famous of knights in all of Renais.
ending;Franz;Franz the Faithful;He continued to serve Renais with the same devotion that he had during the War of the Stones. His generous nature and easy smile made him a favorite among the people.

ending;Gilliam;Silent Gilliam;Gilliam returned to his home of Frelia, where he continued to serve the crown as a faithful knight. His imposing countenance was said to strike fear in the hearts of even the most arrogant and brash of Frelia's new recruits.

ending;Moulder;Moulder, Wise Counselor;After the War of the Stones, Moulder continued to serve the royal family of Frelia. His wisdom served to guide  King Innes as it had served King Hayden before him.
if;game.check_alive('Vanessa') and game.game_vars['SyreneAndVanessa'] != True and game.game_vars['FordeAndVanessa'] != True and game.game_vars['InnesAndVanessa'] != True
ending;Vanessa;Vanessa, Dutiful Rider;She remained on active duty as an airborne knight in Frelia's army. Her beauty and determination became the standard to which her fellow knights aspired.
if;game.check_alive('Ross') and game.game_vars['GarciaAndRoss'] != True and game.game_vars['RossAndAmelia'] != True

ending;Ross;Ross, His Father's Son;He returned to Ide, village of his youth, and helped rebuild it after the bandit attack that brought it to ruin. Years later, he set out on his own to perfect his fighting skill and hone both body and spirit.
if;game.check_alive('Garcia') and game.check_alive('Ross') and game.game_vars['GarciaAndRoss'] == True

paired_ending;Garcia;Ross;Garcia, the Warrior Reborn;Ross, His Father's Son;Father and son returned to Ide, where they toiled together to rebuild their village. Ross grew to become a greater warrior than even his father. When he himself had a son, that child continued his family's legacy.

ending;Garcia;Garcia, the Warrior Reborn;He returned to Ide to help with its reconstruction after the bandit attack. Afterward, he reenlisted in the army, serving Renais as a troop leader. His strength, valor, and experience inspired many.

ending;Colm;Colm, Good-Natured Thief;He politely refused an invitation to become a spy for Renais, returning instead to his hometown. He spent the rest of his days as a chivalrous rogue helping those in need from the shadows.
if;game.check_alive('Neimi') and and game.check_alive('Colm') and game.game_vars['ColmAndNeimi'] == True

paired_ending;Colm;Neimi;Colm, Good-Natured Thief;Neimi, the Tearful Archer;The childhood friends became lovers first, then husband and wife. Worried for Neimi's well-being, Colm gave up his adventurer's ways. Neimi passed on her grandfather's skill in archery to her own son and daughter.

ending;Neimi;Neimi, the Tearful Archer;She returned to her village and passed her days in peace and quiet. Years later, she traveled to the capital of Renais as an archery instructor for their military. She never could resist a good cry.

ending;Artur;Artur, Saint of Light;Artur moved to Renais to help rebuild the shattered country. He worked without rest to ease the pain and grief of those who suffered during the war. His self-sacrifice made him into a folk hero among the peasantry.
if;game.check_alive('Lute') and game.check_alive('Artur') and game.game_vars['ArturAndLute'] == True

paired_ending;Artur;Lute;Artur, Saint of Light;Lute, Prodigy;Artur and Lute were married upon their return. Artur handled the housework, but otherwise, their lives were unchanged. When they had a son, Lute's interests shifted from studying Artur to studying her son's baffling habits.
elif;game.check_alive('Lute') and game.game_vars['ArturAndLute'] != True and game.game_vars['KyleAndLute'] != True

ending;Lute;Lute, Prodigy;After the War of the Stones, Lute returned to  Renais to continue her arcane studies. She  spent far less time locked in her library, preferring now to explore the outside world. She grew into a great and well-traveled sage.
if;game.check_alive('Natasha') and game.check_alive('Seth') and game.game_vars['SethAndNatasha'] == True

paired_ending;Seth;Natasha;Seth, the Silver Knight;Natasha, Sacred Healer;Natasha returned to Renais with Seth, where the two were wed. The reconstruction of Renais kept them busy, but when all the work was done, they settled down to live their days in peace and happiness.
elif;game.check_alive('Natasha') and game.game_vars['SethAndNatasha'] != True and game.game_vars['JoshuaAndNatasha'] != True

ending;Natasha;Natasha, Sacred Healer;Once the war was over, Natasha returned to Grado to help rebuild the empire. She dedicated herself to easing the grief of those families that lost soldiers during the war.
if;game.check_alive('Joshua') and game.check_alive('Natasha') and game.game_vars['JoshuaAndNatasha'] == True

paired_ending;Joshua;Natasha;Joshua, the Tempest King;Natasha, Sacred Healer;When Joshua returned to Jehanna, he took Natasha as his bride and claimed the throne as its rightful heir. Natasha was the perfect companion, and together, they carried the mighty desert nation to great glory.
elif;game.check_alive('Joshua') and game.game_vars['JoshuaAndNatasha'] != True and game.game_vars['JoshuaAndMarisa'] != True and game.game_vars['GerikAndJoshua'] != True

ending;Joshua;Joshua, the Tempest King;Joshua returned to Jehanna and ruled over it as king. His skills as a leader had grown great, and Jehanna flourished as never before. He never outgrew his love of travel and games of chance.
if;game.check_alive('Forde') and game.check_alive('Vanessa') and game.game_vars['FordeAndVanessa'] == True

paired_ending;Forde;Vanessa;Forde, the Wild Knight;Vanessa, Dutiful Rider;Forde's love for Vanessa grew after the war, and although she loved him as well, she placed her duty to Frelia first. Undeterred, Forde moved to Frelia himself. Over time, the two were wed.
elif;game.check_alive('Forde') and game.game_vars['FordeAndVanessa'] != True and game.game_vars['KyleAndForde'] != True and game.game_vars['EirikaAndForde'] != True

ending;Forde;Forde, the Wild Knight;Upon Forde's return to Renais, his secret hobby of painting was discovered. He was commissioned as a court artist. His work grew popular, and his days became so busy that he often regretted his career change.
if;game.check_alive('Kyle') and game.check_alive('Lute') and game.game_vars['KyleAndLute'] == True

paired_ending;Kyle;Lute;Kyle, Ardent Knight;Lute, Prodigy;After the war, Kyle and Lute were married in Renais. Kyle's friends were disturbed by his choice of brides, but they could not deny his happiness. Before long, they had a son, and Kyle dedicated himself to his upbringing.
elif;game.check_alive('Kyle') and game.check_alive('Forde') and game.game_vars['KyleAndForde'] == True

paired_ending;Kyle;Forde;Kyle, Ardent Knight;Forde, the Wild Knight;Sometimes, the greatest friends also differ greatly in personality. When Kyle and Forde returned home, they were celebrated in song and story. They lived their days in happiness, as dearest friends and toughest rivals.
elif;game.check_alive('Kyle') and game.game_vars['KyleAndLute'] != True and game.game_vars['KyleAndForde'] != True and game.game_vars['KyleAndSyrene'] != True
ending;Kyle;Kyle, Ardent Knight;His service to the royal family of Renais continued without change. He became a battalion commander and gained much trust and responsibility for training new recruits.
if;game.check_alive('Tana') and game.game_vars['EirikaAndTana'] != True and game.game_vars['EphraimAndTana'] != True and game.game_vars['CormagAndTana'] != True
ending;Tana;Tana, Winged Queen;Tana lived happily in the prosperous post- war Frelia. She flew to Renais often to visit her dear friend Eirika.
if;game.check_alive('Innes') and game.check_alive('Vanessa') and game.game_vars['InnesAndVanessa'] == True

paired_ending;Innes;Vanessa;Innes, King and Strategician;Vanessa, Dutiful Rider;At Innes's request, Vanessa moved into Castle Frelia where she continued her duties as a knight of the realm. Thereafter, they had a child and lived happily with the blessing of all around them.
elif;game.check_alive('Innes') and game.game_vars['InnesAndVanessa'] != True and game.game_vars['InnesAndEirika'] != True and game.game_vars['LarachelAndInnes'] != True

ending;Innes;Innes, King and Strategician;As time went on, he succeeded his father, Hayden, as king of Frelia. His resourcefulness and tactical prowess helped him build a court of loyal vassals that served to lead the country to greater prosperity.
if;game.check_alive('Syrene') and game.check_alive('Gilliam') and game.game_vars['GilliamAndSyrene'] == True

paired_ending;Gilliam;Syrene;Silent Gilliam;Graceful Syrene;Gilliam and Syrene returned to Frelia, where they were married. All agreed they were a perfect match, and their union was blessed by the crown and the order of knights. The two continued their unwavering service together.
elif;game.check_alive('Syrene') and game.check_alive('Vanessa') and game.game_vars['SyreneAndVanessa'] == True

paired_ending;Syrene;Vanessa;Graceful Syrene;Vanessa, Dutiful Rider;Sisters Syrene and Vanessa returned to Frelia after the war for a long-overdue talk. They talked of love and war, of friends now gone. Together, they renewed their bond as siblings and vowed never to let that bond fail.
elif;game.check_alive('Syrene') and game.check_alive('Kyle') and game.game_vars['KyleAndSyrene'] == True

paired_ending;Kyle;Syrene;Kyle, Ardent Knight;Graceful Syrene;After the war, Kyle visited Frelia, where he was greeted with a warm reception by Syrene. After the two retired, they were wed. They raised a daughter whose skill in martial arts and etiquette excelled.
elif;game.check_alive('Syrene') and game.game_vars['KyleAndSyrene'] != True and game.game_vars['SyreneAndVanessa'] != True and game.game_vars['GilliamAndSyrene'] != True
ending;Syrene;Graceful Syrene;Syrene continued as commander of Frelia's pegasus knights. Her grace and beauty in flight were the subject of many songs and paintings, and her popularity soared.
if;game.check_alive('Amelia') and game.check_alive('Franz') and game.game_vars['FranzAndAmelia'] == True

paired_ending;Franz;Amelia;Franz the Faithful;Amelia, Rose of the War;Franz brought Amelia home with him to Renais. Amelia spent a short time in Renais's army, but once she and Franz were married, she retired her commission. The two had a daughter who grew to be a great knight herself.
elif;game.check_alive('Amelia') and game.check_alive('Ross') and game.game_vars['RossAndAmelia'] == True

paired_ending;Ross;Amelia;Ross, His Father's Son;Amelia, Rose of the War;Amelia traveled to Ross's hometown, where she decided to remain. Over time, the two fell in love and were wed. Years later they had a son who grew into a warrior. As he grew in skill and strength, he surpassed even his father.

elif;game.check_alive('Amelia') and game.game_vars['RossAndAmelia'] != True and game.game_vars['FranzAndAmelia'] != True and game.game_vars['EwanAndAmelia'] != True and game.game_vars['DuesselAndAmelia'] != True

ending;Amelia;Amelia, Rose of the War;Following the war, she returned to Grado to assist in her country's reconstruction. She surrounded herself with new friends and used the strength she found on the battlefield to live her life in happiness.
if;game.check_alive('Duessel') and game.check_alive('Ameila') and game.game_vars['DuesselAndAmelia'] == True

paired_ending;Duessel;Amelia;Duessel, Obsidian General;Amelia, Rose of the War;Upon their return to Grado, Duessel reunited Amelia with her mother. The two wept with joy, giving thanks to Duessel. Afterward, Amelia became the most trusted companion of the man once known as Obsidian.

ending;Duessel;Duessel, Obsidian General;Following the war, Duessel returned to Grado, where he was instrumental in its rebuilding. He spent his remaining years watching over Grado and sharing his wisdom with other nations as an expert combat instructor.

ending;Knoll;Knoll, Watcher of Darkness;Knoll returned to Grado, where he dedicated himself to rebuilding it and fulfilling Lyon's vision. When the country was restored to its former glory, he disappeared without a trace, never to be seen again.
if;game.check_alive('Cormag') and game.check_alive('Tana') and game.game_vars['CormagAndTana'] == True

paired_ending;Cormag;Tana;Cormag, Aloof Lanceman;Tana, Winged Queen;Cormag returned to Grado to assist in the reconstruction of his country. Shortly after, he left to wander on his own. Tana spent years looking for him. In time, she found him and knighted him in Frelia's service.

ending;Cormag;Cormag, Aloof Lanceman;Cormag returned to Grado to assist in the reconstruction of his country. Shortly after, he left to wander on his own. When he reappeared, he rejoined the army not as a knight but as a common soldier.
if;game.check_alive('Larachel') and game.check_alive('Innes') and game.game_vars['LarachelAndInnes'] == True

paired_ending;L'arachel;Innes;L'Arachel, Queen of Light;Innes, King and Strategician;Stories tell of the sparks that flew between L'Arachel and Innes when they first met. As the love between them flourished, so too did the bond that united their two nations.
elif;game.check_alive('Larachel') and game.game_vars['LarachelAndDozla'] != True and game.game_vars['EphraimAndLarachel'] != True and game.game_vars['LarachelAndInnes'] != True

ending;Larachel;L'Arachel, Queen of Light;She succeeded her uncle as ruler of the Rausten Theocracy several years after the war ended. She never lost her...unique perspective on life. She spent much of her rule visiting the neighboring countries.
if;game.check_alive('Dozla') and game.check_alive('Larachel') and game.game_vars['LarachelAndDozla'] == True

paired_ending;L'arachel;Dozla;L'Arachel, Queen of Light;Dozla of the Steady Axe;L'Arachel was, in time, made queen of Rausten, with Dozla at her side, as always. Later, Dozla wept like a baby when L'Arachel was wed. His emotional outburst is remembered as much as, if not more than, the ceremony itself.
ending;Dozla;Dozla of the Steady Axe;As L'Arachel rose to become queen, he remained by her side. Watching L'Arachel grow to become the queen she was destined to be was Dozla's greatest joy in life.

ending;Rennac;Rennac, Rich "Merchant";L'Arachel summoned Rennac back to Rausten, and he was forced to return. He was never able to escape his service to the self- centered princess who became queen. Admittedly, he didn't try very hard.
if;game.check_alive('Gerik') and game.check_alive('Joshua') and game.game_vars['GerikAndJoshua'] == True

paired_ending;Gerik;Joshua;Gerik, the Desert Tiger;Joshua, the Tempest King;After the war, Joshua challenged Gerik to a duel in hopes of pressing him to move to Jehanna. The match ended in a tie, but Gerik was impressed by Joshua's swagger. From that day forward, Gerik never left Joshua's side.
elif;game.check_alive('Gerik') and game.game_vars['GerikAndJoshua'] != True and game.game_vars['GerikAndTethys'] != True and game.game_vars['GerikAndMarisa'] != True

ending;Gerik;Gerik, the Desert Tiger;Gerik continued as a mercenary. Over the years, his reputation grew so great that he had more job offers than he could handle. One day, without warning, he left, never to return.
if;game.check_alive('Tethys') and game.check_alive('Gerik') and game.game_vars['GerikAndTethys'] == True

paired_ending;Gerik;Tethys;Gerik, the Desert Tiger;Tethys, Beloved Dancer;Gerik and Tethys remained bound to no nation and beholden to no authority. They bought themselves a leisurely retirement. Gerik taught fencing to city youths, and Tethys found many stages on which to dance.
ending;Tethys;Tethys, Beloved Dancer;She danced from city to city, and the entire continent became her stage. Her fame grew and grew, and large crowds gathered wherever she performed.
if;game.check_alive('Ewan') and game.check_alive('Amelia') and game.game_vars['EwanAndAmelia'] == True

paired_ending;Ewan;Amelia;Ewan, Enthusiastic Student;Amelia, Rose of the War;After the war, Ewan and Amelia set out, as promised, on a trip around the world. Their deeds along the way made small legends in the regions they visited. In time, Amelia gave birth to a daughter, and they settled down.
elif;game.check_alive('Ewan') and  game.game_vars['SalehAndEwan'] != True and game.game_vars['EwanAndAmelia'] != True

ending;Ewan;Ewan, Enthusiastic Student;Ewan continued his studies, modeling his life after the teachings of Saleh. Eventually, his education branched off into different paths. His insatiable curiosity led him on a trip to explore the world.
if;game.check_alive('Marisa') and game.check_alive('Joshua') and game.game_vars['JoshuaAndMarisa'] == True

paired_ending;Joshua;Marisa;Joshua, the Tempest King;Marisa, the Crimson Flash;Joshua returned to Jehanna with Marisa, where she pledged service to the crown and became the top swordfighter in the land. Joshua still loved games of chance, but when it came to Marisa, she was ever the winner.
elif;game.check_alive('Marisa') and game.check_alive('Gerik') and game.game_vars['GerikAndMarisa'] == True

paired_ending;Eirika;Ephraim;Eirika, Restoration Queen;Ephraim, Restoration King;Busy days awaited Eirika and Ephraim as they struggled to rebuild Renais. Their work gave new hope to those ravaged by the war, and with Eirika's constant help, Ephraim grew to be a trusted and honorable king.

paired_ending;Eirika;Seth;Eirika, Restoration Queen;Seth, the Silver Knight;Upon their return to Renais, Eirika and Seth were wed, with the blessings of Ephraim and all of the Knights of Renais. paired_ending;Eirika;Tana;Eirika, Restoration Queen;Tana, Winged Queen;Following the war, Tana and Eirika remained the best of friends. They visited one another when time permitted, and as they grew older, their children shared a bond of friendship as close as Eirika and Tana themselves did.

paired_ending;Innes;Eirika;Innes, King and Strategician;Eirika, Restoration Queen;After the reconstruction of Renais, Innes challenged Ephraim to a duel. The match ended in a tie. After the fight, Eirika acknowledged her love for Innes, and the two were wed with Ephraim's blessings.

paired_ending;Eirika;Forde;Eirika, Restoration Queen;Forde, the Wild Knight;After the war, Eirika and Forde returned to Renais. Eirika spent her days toiling in the reconstruction of Renais, and he was her faithful supporter. His portrait of Eirika captured the smile he had thought lost forever.

paired_ending;Eirika;Saleh;Eirika, Restoration Queen;Saleh, the Well of Wisdom;After the war, Eirika and Saleh returned to their respective homes. Eirika visited Caer Pelyn when she could. ending;Eirika;Eirika, Restoration Queen;Eirika returned to Renais and began the reconstruction effort with her brother, Ephraim. Seeing peace return to the lives of her people filled her with happiness. Her smile became a symbol of her people's joy.

name: Intro
_source: speak;Larachel;Ephraim...|It is time I must be going.|I am still princess of Rausten, after all.|There is much to which I must attend.|Renais and Rausten are far apart, but that distance can be managed somehow.|If you and I were to be betrothed, that is...|I wonder if I appear too forward...|No, how silly of me!
speak;MyrrhD;Ephraim...|I must return to Darkling Woods.|With my father gone, much responsibility falls on my shoulders.|Yet I would ask...|May I come and visit you from time to time?

speak;Innes;We of Frelia will do what we can to aid in the restoration of Renais.|If you have need of our assistance, you can come to me at any time.|And another thing...|It...wasn't such a bad thing, fighting on the same side as you.|That's all.|The day will come, though.|One day, we will see who is the better.
speak;Eirika;Where are you going, Brother?|We've endured so much to get home, and now...
speak;Ephraim;I'm sorry, Eirika.|I must journey to Grado.|I just received word from Seth.|In the south, within the empire, there has been an enormous landslide.
speak;Ephraim;Yes.|Word is it was so great that whole cities were destroyed.|They say the damage is so severe, the empire itself is in danger...

speak;Ephraim;That's why I must go to Grado.|The people are saying this is Grado's divine punishment...|But these are the same citizens Lyon wanted nothing more than to protect.|I cannot ignore their plight.
speak;Eirika;Yes, of course not.|I will ride with you.
speak;Ephraim;No, you must remain in Renais.|Our country is recovering, but we cannot rest easy.|Someone must stay to protect the realm.
speak;Eirika;Ephraim...|I understand.|I will take your place until you return.|I will wait for you in Renais, Brother.

speak;Ephraim;I can always depend on you, Eirika.|Lyon...|I will be king.|The type of king we often spoke of...|Strong and kind in measure:|an ideal king.|The people of Renais and Grado are under my protection, and I won't fail them.|Watch and see...
music;68- Fly With the Breeze Orchestral Cover;500

speak;Lyon;Oh, are you...|I'm...|My name is Lyon.|Uh-huh.|That's me...|The son of the emperor.|You're Prince Ephraim and Princess Eirika from Renais, aren't you?|I heard you were coming, and I've been waiting here all day.|I've always wanted...|I don't have any friends my own age...|So, Prince Ephraim...|Princess Eirika...|What do you say?|From now on, let's be friends...

paired_ending;Innes;Eirika;Innes, King and Strategician;Eirika, Restoration Queen;After the reconstruction of Renais, Innes challenged Ephraim to a duel. The match ended in a tie. After the fight, Eirika acknowledged her love for Innes, and the two were wed with Ephraim's blessings.

paired_ending;Eirika;Forde;Eirika, Restoration Queen;Forde, the Wild Knight;After the war, Eirika and Forde returned to Renais. Eirika spent her days toiling in the reconstruction of Renais, and he was her faithful supporter. His portrait of Eirika captured the smile he had thought lost forever.

paired_ending;Eirika;Saleh;Eirika, Restoration Queen;Saleh, the Well of Wisdom;After the war, Eirika and Saleh returned to their respective homes. Eirika visited Caer Pelyn when she could. Eventually, she left Renais in the care of her brother and wed Saleh. Their daughter resembles the legendary Nada Kuya.

elif;game.game_vars['EirikaAndSaleh'] != True and game.game_vars['EirikaAndSeth'] != True and game.game_vars['EirikaAndForde'] != True and game.game_vars['EirikaAndTana'] != True and game.game_vars['InnesAndEirika'] != True

ending;Eirika;Eirika, Restoration Queen;Eirika returned to Renais and began the reconstruction effort with her brother, Ephraim. Seeing peace return to the lives of her people filled her with happiness. Her smile became a symbol of her people's joy.

paired_ending;Eirika;Ephraim;Eirika, Restoration Queen;Ephraim, Restoration King;Busy days awaited Eirika and Ephraim as they struggled to rebuild Renais. Their work gave new hope to those ravaged by the war, and with Eirika's constant help, Ephraim grew to be a trusted and honorable king.

paired_ending;Ephraim;Myrrh;Ephraim, Restoration King;Myrrh, the Great Dragon;After the war, Ephraim returned to Renais and Myrrh to Darkling Woods. They both turned their attention to their respective duties but never forgot one another. Though Myrrh never again left Darkling Woods, Ephraim often visited her.

paired_ending;Ephraim;Larachel;Ephraim, Restoration King;L'Arachel, Queen of Light;Ephraim and L'Arachel each returned home after the war, but L'Arachel visited Renais often. Over time, the two were wed. Their marriage threw Rausten into turmoil, but L'Arachel's self-centeredness carried the day.

paired_ending;Ephraim;Tana;Ephraim, Restoration King;Tana, Winged Queen;Once Renais was stable again, Ephraim and Tana were wed. Innes protested vocally, but when he saw how happy Tana was, he gave the marriage his blessings. Renais and Frelia are now bound by blood as well as friendship.

ending;Ephraim;Ephraim, Restoration King;Busy days awaited him upon his return to Renais. He oversaw the rebuilding not only of his own country but also of the entire continent of Magvel. His work was difficult, but his success made him a legend.

name: Ch.4BaseConvo1
_source: speak;Eirika;Pardon me? I'm...not sure we have ever met before?
speak;Anna;Oh, dear.|Didn't my sister tell you about me coming?
speak;Eirika;I'm sorry, but you must have mistaken me with someone else.
speak;Anna;You're Princess Eirika correct?|My sister told me how much of a help you were in Elyos!
speak;Eirika;... How do you know who I am?
speak;Eirika;You're not with Grado, are you?|Or an assassin!

speak;Anna;Ack!|I'm no assassin, and I'm certainly no soldier!|There must have been some misunderstanding...|I'm a traveling merchant that was hoping to set up shop in Magvel.|But I guess I must be in the wrong Magvel...

speak;Anna;Er...Umm...|Forget I said that.|Here, take this and just... forget this whole conversation happened.|For some reason, it's just never worked for me.|But maybe it works for this world's inhabitants?|If so, maybe I can actually sell this junk.
speak;Anna;Er...|Ok, I better go now!|Bye bye!

name: Ch.5BaseConvo1
_source: speak;Artur;Alright, Father Moulder.|I believe we have gathered everything the Princess has asked of us.
speak;Moulder;I believe so too, young Artur. Thank you for your help.|It soothes my soul, knowing there's a good lad like you out there.
speak;Artur;No, no, I should be thanking you!|I'm happy to have this opportunity to learn from such a wise priest.
speak;Moulder;Oh ho ho!|You humor me, young one!|I am but a meager priest, doing what is right.
speak;Bandit1;Hold it right there, you two!|Your gold, or your lives, what'll it be?
speak;Artur;Father, look out!|He has some dangerous looking brass knuckles!|Should I use my light magic to apprehend him?
speak;Bandit1;Are you gonna give me the money or not, old man?!
speak;Moulder;... hit me with your best shot.
speak;Bandit1;You asked for it, old man!
speak;Moulder;... is that all?|Let me show you a real punch.
speak;Moulder;Of course, young Artur.|He will need a lot of training before he can cause any real damage.
speak;Artur;You took that hit like a boulder!|And look how far he flew!|Are you sure that was alright to do?
speak;Moulder;Sometimes, the Divines know that it takes a hard hit to teach someone a lesson.|You just need to have faith, young Artur.|I'll go patch him up and straighten him out.|Wait here for me.
alert;Artur's STR Growth has increased by 20!
alert;Artur's DEF Growth has increased by 20!
alert;Moulder's STR Growth has increased by 20!
alert;Moulder's DEF Growth has increased by 20!
alert;Moulder's RES Growth has increased by 20!

name: Ch.5BaseConvo2
_source: speak;Lute;Don't tell me you're actually still going to hold the winter festival, are you?
speak;Artur;I was selected this year to be the representative, so I want to do my best.|I cannot back out now.
speak;Lute;So... What do you need my help for, then?

speak;Artur;I need you to judge my light magic.|It needs to be good enough for the festival.|I'm think I'm going to try to make glowing snowflakes.|They should illuminate the area, and make it sparkle.|I want to make it feel very magical for the participants, you know?.
speak;Lute;I see.|Very well, I'll tell you what I think, then.
speak;Artur;Perfect! Thank you, Lute.|I appreciate your honest feedback.
speak;Lute;Your stance is all wrong.|If you're going to be casting this spell for that long, you need a stance more like this.
speak;Lute;... I suppose we'll be here a while.
speak;Lute;Ok, I think this is good enough for now...
speak;Artur;...Finally...|I think I'm about to fall over...
speak;Lute;... my apologies, Artur.|You did a good job, though! I think you hit your mark!|The winter festival... It'll be nice to have, won't it?
speak;Artur;That it will, Lute...|That it will...
alert;Lute and Artur have gotten closer!
alert;Artur gained WEXP in light magic!

name: Ch.5BaseConvo3
_source: speak;Garcia;Looking for a new weapon there, Vanessa?
speak;Vanessa;Oh, yes.|I've looked at a couple of stores, but I'm not sure what I should buy...
speak;Garcia;You are a Pegasus Knight, right?|You're most familiar with a lance, then, correct?
speak;Vanessa;Correct, it is the weapon I feel the most comfortable with.
speak;Garcia;So you probably have the hardest time against axe fighters, then.|If that's the case, you should try this.
speak;Vanessa;An Ice Lance!|Where did you find this?!

speak;Garcia;Let's just say, in my line of work...|You tend to get a lot of experience, haggling with armories.|Either way, I think this should help you get an edge against axes.|<red>This has a special property.|Enemies can't counterattack against Ice weapons like these.</>
speak;Vanessa;Thank you, General Garcia!|I appreciate it!
speak;Garcia;Please, just call me Garcia.|No need to be formal with me.
speak;Garcia;Yes, now go ahead and take that lance.|I'll take care of things here.
speak;Vanessa;Thank you!|You have my respect Gene-, er, Garcia!

name: Ch.5BaseConvo4
_source: speak;Ross;Wow!|Look at this town!|It's so big!|There are so many shops here!
speak;Colm;Don't get too excited there, kid.|This isn't that big of a town!
speak;Ross;Hey!|I'm not a kid!|You don't even look that much older than me!|You're that Colm guy, right?|I heard you've been stealing stuff!
speak;Colm;Hey!|I've been stealing stuff from the bad guys!|No need to get mad at me!|I'm on your side!
speak;Ross;Really, now?|How can you steal while on the battlefield?
speak;Colm;Now that's a great question, friend!|You see, you've got to be quick, smart, and light!|Most importantly:|don't let them see you.|Ever.
speak;Colm;It's fine, Neimi!|I was going to get you some jerky with the money I'll make from all this stuff!
speak;Ross;Ooh, jerky!|Now you're speaking my language!|Let me get in on that!
speak;Colm;Alright, you've got a deal, kid!|I'll teach you the best tricks I know!

name: Ch.5BaseConvo5
_source: speak;Seth;Gilliam, I am aware it's your turn to count our supplies for this month.
speak;Gilliam;Correct.|I was just going through our war treasury right now.
speak;Seth;Excellent, how many bags of gold do we have remaining?
speak;Gilliam;It should be 5 bags, all right here.
speak;Seth;Why am I counting 6 bags instead of 5?
speak;Gilliam;...Please don't tell the princess about this...

name: Ch.5XBaseConvo1
_source: speak;Ephraim;Well, Kyle, we're running thin on supplies.|We're going to have to make this next battle count.
speak;Kyle;Agreed, my Prince.|I hope we can manage.
speak;Anna;I'm Anna, a traveling merchant!|I'm here to make a deal with you.
speak;Kyle;Prince Ephraim, this may be a good chance to resupply!
speak;Ephraim;What a lucky break!.|What wares do you have available?|We are in need of food, and weapons.
speak;Anna;He he he, perfect!|I'm glad my sister's information was correct!|Now I can finally start making a profit!
speak;Ephraim;Kyle, I will let you handle managing the food.
speak;Anna;I also have some potential allies for you, if you're interested!
speak;Anna;Oh yes!|Alright, you two!|Come on out!
speak;HorseyBoy;Indeed, though we don't think we were always this way.
speak;HorseyBoy;Indeed I did, though my sister here cannot speak.|So... Please don't consider her rude.
speak;HorseyBoy;I don't believe we're related by blood.|You see, we were experimented on by some dark-robed men.|Fortunately, a different dark-robed man set us free.
speak;HorseyBoy;For what, I don't know.|My mind is all scrambled.|So there isn't much I can tell you...
speak;HorseyBoy;What I do know is that we have a friend in Renvall that we want to rescue.|Anna told us you were going there.|We want to join you.
speak;Ephraim;A friend...|I see...|I guess if you're willing to help us, it's fine.|But...
speak;Ephraim;Alright, you two are in.|Keep a low profile, though.|It's harder to lead a larger group for this operation.
speak;HorseyBoy;Well...|We don't really remember our names...|And the robed men just gave us numbers.|If you need names, feel free to call us whatever you like.
speak;Ephraim;In that case, your names will be...
speak;Ephraim;Our operation needs a low body count.|I'm sorry, but we can't risk it.
speak;HorseyBoy;I see...|While it saddens me to hear that, I understand.|We will see if we can find our friend another way...

name: Ch.5XBaseConvo2
_source: speak;Mercenary1;I saw you talk with that merchant...
speak;Ephraim;And who are you?|Speak carefully or meet your end by my lance.
speak;Mercenary1;Woah, woah, woah.|No need to get violent.|I just really want you to introduce me to that merchant...|I want to purchase some wares from her...
speak;Ephraim;Sorry there, but I don't know you.|Now I would recommend that you get out of here.|We've got other things to worry about than someone's shady requests.
speak;Mercenary1;All right, all right.|I'll make it worth your while then...|I think you will find this information useful.
speak;Ephraim;Ok, ok.|I'll introduce her to you.

speak;Mercenary1;Good....|Ok, here is the info.|<red>There is a secret lever by the southernmost pillar in the castle of Renvall.</>|<red>Pull on the lever and it will drain the water throughout the castle.</>|<red>Only the person on the throne will be able to survive the flood.</>|<red>You should be fine if you hide behind the pillars</>.|All right, I'll be waiting for you to introduce me to her.
speak;Ephraim;A secret lever?...|This might work well for us...
speak;Mercenary1;That's a shame...|I'll meet with her one way or another...

name: Ch.6BaseConvo1
_source: speak;Franz;Miss Lute!|May we have a minute of your time, please?
speak;Lute;Oh?|What would you two have need of me for?
speak;Franz;We saw all the awesome magic you were using out there!|And, uh, we wondered if you could teach us some!|We've never seen such magic this close until now.
speak;Lute;Oh, this magic?|It's beginner material. Trival stuff, really!|If you just study, it should be as easy as breathing.
speak;Neimi;We were really hoping you could teach us!
speak;Lute;...Hmmm...|I'm not sure it would be worthy of my time...
speak;Artur;I think you should help them, Lute.|You could also benefit from teaching them.
speak;Lute;What could I possibly learn that I haven't read?!
speak;Franz;I could show you some of the Renais knights' training regiments.|It's guaranteed to make you stronger!
speak;Lute;...How dull!|Why would I want that?
speak;Artur;...How about I let you have this tome I bought if you help them out?
speak;Artur;I think this will benefit you all.
speak;Lute;It better be worth that book...
alert;Franz's MAG growth has increased by 25!
alert;Neimi's MAG growth has increased by 25!
alert;Lute's STR growth has increased by 30!

name: Ch.6BaseConvo2
_source: speak;Moulder;Good morning, lad.|Is there something I can do for you?
speak;Joshua;Yeah, word is you know a thing or two about using magic.|I've also heard you're good at taking hits from magic, too.
speak;Moulder;I don't know where you got such ideas from.|Though, you do learn a thing or two once you're my age.
speak;Joshua;That's what I like to hear!|Alright, magic and taking magic hits, teach me. C'mon!
speak;Moulder;Impatient, aren't you?|What is with the rush?
speak;Joshua;Let's just say I've got some...|Dealings coming in soon. I'd like to be prepared.
speak;Moulder;I see.|Unfortunately, I don't have time to teach you both.
speak;Joshua;I see...|Well, how about we make a little wager of it?
speak;Joshua;It's simple!|We'll flip a coin. If it lands on heads, you teach me magic.|If it's tails, you teach me how to defend against magic.|Deal?
speak;Moulder;I'm usually not one for chance...|But it doesn't matter to me in this case.|Go ahead.
speak;Joshua;All right, then!|Let's see what lady luck has in store!
speak;Joshua;Looks like it was heads.|All right, old man, teach me some magic.
speak;Moulder;I'm not that old, but I'll teach you a thing or two.|Now, repeat after me...
alert;Joshua's MAG growth has increased by 50!
speak;Joshua;Looks like it was tails.|All right, old man, teach me how to take a magical blow.
speak;Moulder;I'm not that old, but I'll teach you a thing or two.|Now, here I come!
alert;Joshua's RES growth has increased by 50!

name: Ch.6BaseConvo3
_source: speak;Ross;Hey, I finally found you, pretty lady!
speak;Natasha;Pre-, pretty?!|Are you talking about me?!
speak;Ross;Of course!|You're the pretty lady I was looking for!
speak;Natasha;Oh, oh my!...|I'm not that pretty...
speak;Ross;Ha ha ha!|You're funny!|Of course you're pretty!
speak;Natasha;Why thank you, he he.|I'm just a simple cleric.|I've never thought myself as pretty...
speak;Ross;Darn right you're pretty!|Though, speakin' of pretty, you also look pretty tiny...|Maybe I can help bulk you up!
speak;Natasha;Bulk me up?|What do you mean by that?
speak;Ross;I can help you train!|Put some muscle on you!
speak;Natasha;Oh...|I don't know about that.|I don't really want muscles...|I just want to help others with my magic.
speak;Ross;Oh!|You're good with magic?|Maybe you could teach me some then?|I don't mind learning from such a pretty lady!
speak;Natasha;Maybe?...|I don't know if I'm a good teacher...
speak;Natasha;Hmmmm...|Train Ross in magic or train my muscles?...
choice;NatashaRossTrain;Train Ross in magic, or train Natasha's muscles?;Train Ross,Train Natasha
speak;Natasha;I guess I can train you in some magic...
speak;Ross;Wow!|Thank you so much!|Let's get at it then, lady!
alert;Ross's MAG growth has increased by 40!
speak;Ross;You're taking too long, lady!|Come on!|Let's go train!
alert;Natasha's STR growth has increased by 60!

name: Ch.6BaseConvo4
_source: speak;Garcia;...All right, come out, boy.|I know you're there.
speak;Colm;How did you know I was there?!|I didn't move at all!
speak;Garcia;I've raised Ross all these years, boy.|I can tell when a boy wants to cause trouble.
speak;Colm;Come on!|All I wanted was a little food!
speak;Garcia;...You know you could have just asked for food, right?
speak;Colm;Where's the fun with that?!|I've got to keep my skills sharp, you know!
speak;Garcia;Don't lie to me, boy.|You wanted to give the food to someone else, didn't you?
speak;Colm;I... Ugh...|Don't know what you're talking about...|I'm just a hungry boy, that's all!
speak;Garcia;Here, just take this bread and go, boy.|Try to do better next time.
speak;Colm;Um...|Thank you, I guess.|I'll work on it...

name: Ch.6BaseConvo5
_source: speak;Vanessa;Seems it's our turn to guard the supply tent.
speak;Gilliam;Yeah, glad to have you here with me.
speak;Vanessa;Thank you, I'm glad to work with you.
speak;Vanessa;...Sorry, Gilliam, I don't have much for conversation today...
speak;Gilliam;That's alright. I enjoy our time together.|Even the quiet times.

name: Arena_Mini_Boss
_source: speak;Arena Guy;I hate to break the news to you, but we're closed here too.|That scumbag Pablo has extorted everything from us.|You're always welcome to challenge the champ if you want though.

name: Intro
_source: speak;Larachel;Thank you so much for agreeing to help, Eirika, Ephraim!
speak;Eirika;We're happy to be of service to our friends, L'Arachel.|It's strange that these ruins just appeared out nowhere though.
speak;Ephraim;Indeed, I have never seen these kinds of ruins before.|What in the world happened here?

speak;Larachel;It's been a mystery to us too!|I've never seen or heard of these ruins in my whole life!|Our guards tried to investigate the ruins, but they were chased out by all the monsters lurking within.
speak;Seth;This could prove to be problematic for the neighboring countries.|The monsters could start migrating to unsuspecting villages.
speak;Ephraim;We must purge these ruins before it starts getting out of hand.
speak;Eirika;Agreed, but don't push yourself too hard brother...
speak;Larachel;Fear not!|As long as I am here, evil will cower in fear!|Ha ha ha!
speak;Seth;My lance is yours my liege.
speak;Ephraim;Alright everyone, prepare your weapons!|We march forward once I give the order!

name: Outro
_source: speak;Eirika;Brother...|These ruins seem to go on forever...|Is there no end?
speak;Ephraim;I'm not sure if it ends either.|However, we have a duty to clear out all these monsters.
speak;Eirika;You're right brother.|We must stop this evil from coming into the world.
speak;Eirika;Where did that voice come from?
speak;???;Your bravery is needed, oh Twins of Fate...;top
speak;Ephraim;Are we needed to clear out this evil?
speak;???;You two have proven to destroy great evil, and we believe you can do it again.;top
speak;???;We are the spirits of those who tried to protect these ruins.|There is an ancient power here, but it will fall into the hands of evil soon if they aren't stopped.;top
speak;Ephraim;Is that so?|They must be stopped indeed if that is the case.|Can you tell us what evil has fallen upon these ruins?
speak;???;It is unclear to us, but they are aligned with some malevolent force and they have immense power.;top
speak;Eirika;How are we to stop such a force?
speak;???;Reach the bottom of the ruins and clear out the monsters.|You may take the treasure that is there. You have proven yourselves trustworthy.;top
speak;Ephraim;Understood, we will purge all evil from this land for good.
speak;???;We give our eternal thanks.|We will give you the remainder of our power to aid you in this trial.;top
speak;Ephraim;I feel like I can take on anything.
speak;???;Please, Sacred Twins, purge the ruins.....;top
speak;Eirika;Yes, we will put your souls to rest.
