speak;Syrene;Why are they staring at me on the battlefield, though?|We've far more important things to focus on!
speak;Cucara;I gotta help people out!|I must become a true hero to protect the innocent!
speak;Cucara;I'm feeling stronger!|I've definitely made some improvements!|The way of the warrior is hard, yet rewarding!
speak;Cucara;Alright!|A true lumberjack is what I'll become!|Strong and swift is my style!
speak;Cucara;A vanguard huh?|A master of heroics, able to save anyone.|I hope I make you proud N.
speak;Cucara;Flying through the air, a terror on wings.|Not quite a pegasus, but it's the thought that counts, right B?
speak;Cucara;I feel fearsome in this armor.|No one can stop me in this right?|Let's see how fearful our enemies will be!
speak;Cucara;A true warrior is what I am!|No enemy shall be unbeatable while I'm around!|Just like you R.
speak;Cucara;Invincible armor, a juggernaut of combat.|Not quite my style, but I'll do it justice for you, L.
speak;Cucara;A true lumberjack, master of chopping.|You wanted me to fight comfortably, my own way right K?
speak;Cucara;A sturdy and swift master of arms, being equipped to handle anyone on the battlefield!|I can handle any situation!
speak;Cucara;A sturdy and swift master of arms, being equipped to handle anyone on the battlefield!|I can handle any situation!
speak;Cucara;Woah! Who gave me this horse?|And this armor?|I'm not sure I'm the best to handle this, but I'll try my best!
speak;Lindsey;I did it!|I can now summon deathgoyles to do my bidding!|This is the start of my summoning saga!
speak;Lindsey;Easy there girl...|Finally! I have tamed a black pegasus on my own!|I can now soar through the skies and rain down magic onto my foes.
speak;Lindsey;I feel sssooo sssstrange...|My goodnesssss!|When did I become a gorgon!?
speak;Lindsey;I have mastered the art of summoning fiends!|Now to see my new summons...|Oh mama... that's one sexy succubus!
speak;Lindsey;After picking up a mystical axe, I feel great strenght coming out of me.|Now then, time to cave some unfortunate soul's head in, shall we?
speak;Lindsey;I shouldn't have bought that sword from a shady Anna!|Now I am filled with thoughts of slicing my enemies up!|As if I am possessed by this blade...
speak;Lindsey;I somehow tamed a mighty wyvern.|Not only that, but this mystical axe boosts my strength.|Haha, now nothing can contest me in the skies!
speak;Lindsey;Ahahahaha!|This magical broom gives me unparalleled speed!|I also learned some lockpicking skills.|Now I can easily cause havoc on some poor fellas!
speak;Lindsey;Darn it!|That vial has a succubus transforming curse in it.|Now I am stuck in this form forever.|Well at least I became an exceedingly hot woman.
speak;Lindsey;Getting an opera singer to tutor me was worth it!|Not only do I have a lovely singing voice but it also rejuvinates my allies too!|I will become popular with this!
speak;Lindsey;I see...|I had an adaptation that allows me to breathe underwater and swim well.|This will give me some new approaches in battles.
speak;Lindsey;Is this the power of becoming a priestess of Ouroborus?|I feel divine power surging through me.|I can support my allies better than ever before!
speak;Suu;After a long arduous training, I have finally achieved a perfect human form!|Not only that but my strength is uncomparable to any other slime in history!|I' am the best!
speak;Suu;I have ascended as a queen of slimes!|With my master's orders, I can proliferate an army of slimes to decimate our adversaries!
speak;Tyrande;I have finally found the courage to leave the abode of my plant.|Now I can help my allies more through the ritual dances of my people.
speak;Tyrande;I can feel the blessings of mother nature flowing through me.|I have been given authority to use the full might of nature.|I will support my allies and people better than ever before!
speak;Jonathan;Finally, im Strong enough to use this armor again...

speak;Jonathan;My king, I was not able to help you in your most desperate hour...|That is something I cannot ask forgiveness for.|But I swear, i will lead both your children to greatness.|Even if it cost my life.
speak;Jonathan;WHERE ARE THEY?|WHERE ARE MY ENEMIES?!|I WILL DESTROY THEM ALL, IN THE NAME OF MY LORD, MY KING, MY COUNTRY!|THEY WILL PAY FOR THE LIVES THEY TOOK, AND THAT I SWEAR!
speak;Jonathan;Huh, the young lords are asking me to use a horse instead of running.|Something about "giving you more levarage agaisnt our enemies"...
speak;Jonathan;I dont get it, I'm much faster on foot, but I guess I can do it.
speak;Jonathan;Hey boy, guess im your new owner.|Let's go into the battlefield and stomp some poor souls!
speak;Eterna;A-alright!|More bulk and armor!|I'll fight without f-fear now!
speak;Eterna;O-oh!|A horse!|You must be tough to carry me around!|I think I'll name you...|Nara!
speak;Eterna;This way of fighting...|To block and parry like this feels...|familiar...
speak;Eterna;I'm near invincible now!|I c-can take any blow and dish it right back!
speak;Eterna;F-fear me!|I am the terror of the knight!|Hehe!|Was I intimidating?
speak;Eterna;I feel a p-presence in this armor...|I feel more dangerous now...|Hope I don't scare my allies...
speak;Eterna;Woah!|H-hello friend!|You're quite big aren't you?|Let's ride off into victory!|No one can stop us!
speak;Eterna;Haha!|I can cast magic now!|I feel like I can handle a-any opponent!
speak;Eterna;This new steed just appeared here!|But...It feels right to ride into battle with them.|I have a feeling I know what your name is.|It’s Torrent, isn’t it?
speak;Eterna;I've become so much m-more resistant now!|Thank you Nara!|Let all mages fear as their spells bounce off our armor!
speak;Eterna;We sure have come a long way, eh Nara?|We've both become much stronger together!|Now let the enemy see how tough it’ll be to defeat us!
speak;Moze;I haven't used my dragonstone in a while.|Let's hope I remember how to control it!
speak;Moze;I hope to wield Mother's lance as well as she did back then.|Let's do this!
speak;Moze;Kind of interesting to ride upon a wyvern despite being a dragon myself.|I shall name you after my father.|Let's go, Kilgharrah!
speak;Moze;Choosing to follow in Father's footsteps feels kind of right.|I just hope to live up to his legacy.
speak;Moze;My true form once again.|Allow me to unleash my full power upon our enemies!
speak;Moze;So this is why we never let our anger consume us.|It's intoxicating...|Let's make some carnage.
speak;Moze;This armor reminds me of my friends from my world.|I want to fight just as hard as they did back then!
speak;Moze;I can hear Mother's lance calling to me.|Very well then, I'm done holding back.
speak;Moze;The armor of warriors of old fill me with great pride.|I am honored to get the chance to fight like them!
speak;Moze;I'm gonna combine what my parents taught me and add my own twist to it.|I hope to make them proud!
speak;Moze;So even wyverns can change when needed.|I can get used to this.|To the skies, Kilgharrah!
speak;Moze;I think our bond has grown quite strong, don't you think so, Kilgharrah?|Let's show them what we're made of!
speak;Vespera;Behold!|I am light bound by flesh, fear my wrath!
speak;Vespera;My true form revealed.|I am glad to share this strength with such worthy allies!
speak;Vespera;To ride upon a Pegasus again brings back memories of the Valkyries.|If I recall, Valkyries in this world ride horses rather than pegasi.
speak;Vespera;This power...yes...|Allow me show you why they called me The Divine Blade in my world.
speak;Vespera;You didn't think I was all might and no skill did you?|I am full of many surprises.
speak;Vespera;My might now emboldened by the arcane and divine magicks will be our enemies' undoing!
speak;Vespera;My full power finally realized.|I feel as though I can take on the enemy on my own!
speak;Vespera;I learned that there is balance in life long ago.|Despite my domain, I am no stranger to the arcane arts.
speak;Vespera;With this power I can fight as if the spirits are at my side.|Through this, the fallen will always be with me.
speak;Vespera;This was the form I took when I first appeared to humanity.|Some called me angel but in truth I am Vespera, The Goddess of Light.|I am at your side til the end!
speak;Vespera;This was the form I took when I aided humanity through their struggles during a horrible plague in my world.|I will support you all with my divine power.
speak;Vespera;My form from when I was young, not many get to see it.|But it gives me a chance to refine the power of this form.
speak;Fajar;He he!|Look a these arms!|I can carry a much bigger sword now!|I am Thorkell!|And oh wow!|This is a very pretty necklace!|It reminds me of him...
speak;Fajar;These clothes are so comfortable and flowy.|I feel like a royal heir.|A master of swords and spears to boot!|I love my tailor...that liite bug!|He he!
speak;Claude;Would you look at that!|An Almyran Wyvern!|I have dreamed of flying one since I was little.
speak;Claude;I can feel that my archery skills have improved a lot!|Maybe Grandfather will let me borrow his Heroes' Relic now?
speak;Claude;It's a lot easier to fight when your enemies never see you coming.
speak;Claude;My wyvern has become such a majestic creature.|I guess it's time for me to act like a king now too.
speak;Claude;Not quite as majestic as a wyvern but I can't complain.|They'll never catch me on this horse, haha.
speak;Claude;I never play fair.|I want to win after all.| They are not ready for the tricks I have up my sleeve.
speak;Esperanza;Woo! I feel so skilled!|No one is gonna be better at swords than me when I'm done!
speak;Esperanza;A mercenary!|I've always wanted to be tough and practical!|I'll be able to handle any problem now!
speak;Esperanza;I've thinking about what would be practical for this army...
speak;Esperanza;I figured it would help everyone if I took the weapons hurting us...|And give them to our allies!
speak;Esperanza;I feel so heroic!|I 've gotten alot stronger and I even learned how to use an axe!|Everyone is gonna be impressed with me now!
speak;Esperanza;Wow...|I really became someone people look up to!|I hope you'll be proud of me, now that I'm a guild leader!|Let's do some heavy lifting!
speak;Esperanza;Hello there!|I think we're gonna be good friends together!|With sword on my side and bow on my back, I can handle any range of combat with you!|I'll name you... Isabella!
speak;Esperanza;I must become a stronger swordswoman.
speak;Esperanza;I've gotten far, but there's more I've got to do before I perfect my use of the blade!",
speak;Esperanza;This outfit...|It's definitely gonna take some getting used to.|But I'm determined to grow stronger.
speak;Esperanza;Even in a silent killer way...
speak;Esperanza;I feel so sneaky!|I'll run around and open chests for you all!|We'll need everything piece of gear we can get!
speak;Esperanza;Woah!|Hello there wolf friend!|Aren't you a good boy?|Let's go out and take everything from our enemies!|Together we ride, Richard!
speak;Esperanza;Woah!|Hello there wolf friend!|Aren't you a good boy?|Let's rush to the frontlines and take out everyone we're fighting!|Together we ride, Richard!
speak;Esperanza;Now you are certainly a creature to be reckoned with!|No one could call me a weakling when I'm riding atop of you!|Let's go together, Claus!
speak;Esperanza;A powerful sword and axeswoman huh?|A warrior of justice is my path now!|Nobody worry anymore!
speak;Esperanza;I feel strong and fast!|Swords aren't the only weapon that I can wield!|I can handle any oppenent now!
speak;Esperanza;Alright, Isabella...|We both have come a long way for a couple of braves...| Now with offical authorization of Renais...
speak;Esperanza;We're true knights of the realm!
speak;Esperanza;Look how strong I am!|These giant weapons weigh nothing to me!|I can still outspeed and outskill everyone of yall!
speak;Esperanza;Yipes!|This blade I dropped just chopped that tree in half!
speak;Esperanza;Everyone needs money right?|I think I have an idea to fix that!|I'll just become a gladiator!
speak;Esperanza;I can feel the waves rushing throughout every ocean...|No one will hear our enemies drown when I'm done with them...
speak;Esperanza;Wahoo!|We surely gotten so much tougher, right Richard?|With weapons in hand and you with me, we'll crush everyone in our way!
speak;Ross;A salamander!|Ain't you a cute lil fella|I'm gonna call you Susie!|Let's go!
speak;Esperanza;Hey, what's up spiderling?|How you doing?|You want to help me sell stuff?
speak;Esperanza;Woah!|I didn't know that you could do this, Isabella!|It's amazing!|Let's fly through the sky, and guard our friends!
speak;Esperanza;Ooooooo!|I'm so high up in the sky!|You're so tall and strong elephant friend!|I think I'll call you Donphan!|Let's trample the bad guys!
speak;Esperanza;*Cough, cough*!|Ugh, what happened?|I just wished to be able to help everyone!|
speak;Esperanza;I guess I got some phenomenal cosmic powers now!
speak;Esperanza;I did it...|I have finally become a master swordswoman!|May thy blade chip and shatter against mine...
speak;Esperanza;Wow!|Now this is a cool weapon!|And I can still use swords by just using them as arrows!|We got this together, Isabella!
speak;Esperanza;I do what I must for our army|As required, I'll become the ultimate killer...|Our enemies will never see me coming...
speak;Esperanza;A ninja huh?|A sneaky master combatant, able to infiltrate anywhere...|Not being seen until it's too late...
speak;Esperanza;I feel so strong now!|I mastered the blade along with magic as well!|No one can beat me now!
speak;Esperanza;Hehehe!|Look at me go!|Steal a weapon, heal an ally, stab an enemy!|I can do it all now!
speak;Camilla;Ah, back to my normal clothes.|I wanted to wear that outfit for a litte longer though...|Oh well, let's show these peons the might of Nohr!
speak;Camilla;Ah, back on my beautiful wyvern.|I missed you so much sweetie.|I'll have to catch you up on the adventure I have been on so far.|I feel stronger than ever, dear!

speak;Seth;Is that so?|I've barely had the time to think about it, I suppose.
speak;Natasha;Well, please take care of yourself.
speak;Natasha;I would hate to see any more people hurt...
speak;Seth;This is war...|But I will do my best to end it quickly.

name: Tutorial_Enable
_source: speak;Anna;Welcome, and thank you for playing Fire Emblem 8R!|I am your guide, the beautiful merchant Anna!|If you don't recognize me, don't worry!|I'm a mascot of the Fire Emblem games!|And if you're new to Fire Emblem games, don't worry!|I'll catch you up to speed!|You can also use the <red>"C"</> key anytime while navigating menus to get a description!|Oh, one more thing.|FE8R has some new mechanics!|I've got a bit more tutorial for them.|If you don't want those, just say no, okay?;;;;6
speak;Anna;Alright, thanks a bunch!|Then I'll have an extra spicy tutorial for ya!|Just pick Eirika or Seth, and we'll get started!;;;;6
speak;Anna;He he!|So, you just want the basics, do you?|I can work with that!|Just pick Eirika or Seth, and we'll get started!

speak;Anna;Welcome, and thank you for playing Fire Emblem 8R!|You know me! The brilliant, beautiful Anna!|At least, I'm guessing so, because you know your FE basics!|But the new mechanics of FE8R elude you...|Don't worry! That's why I'm here!|Go ahead, pick either Eirika or Seth!|Once you do, we can get down to business!;;;;6

textbox;FeatTextbox;Enabling this will give all your units access to Feat skills. Feats are special multiclass skills that you can pick from a random list at level 5 and 15. These skills stack ontop of your normal class skills. <red>Warning these will make your units very OP, so note that if you chose this mode.</>;bottom;235;6

name: Tutorial_Select_Seth
_source: speak;Anna;Now, Eirika and her ally Seth are equipped with some <red>weapons</>.|As any warrior of our age would be!|If you can master weapons, you can master anything!|Weapons are divided into eight categories.|<red>Swords</><icon>Sword</>, <red>Lances</><icon>Lance</>, <red>Axes</><icon>Axe</>, <red>Bows</><icon>Bow</>...|<red>Anima magic</><icon>Anima</>, <red>Dark magic</><icon>Dark</>, <red>Light magic</><icon>Light</>, and <red>Staves</><icon>Staff</>.|Each have their own strengths and weaknesses.|<red>Swords</><icon>Sword</> and <red>Light magic</><icon>Light</> are easier to hit and deal <red>Critical Hits</> with.|<red>Lances</><icon>Lance</> reduce damage taken directly.|<red>Anima magic</><icon>Anima</> deals <red>Splash damage</> in an area.|<red>Axes</><icon>Axe</> and <red>Dark magic</><icon>Dark</> are not as accurate...|But deal more damage, and <red>reduce the enemy's DEF/RES, respectively</>.|<red>Bows</><icon>Bow</> attack enemies from a distance, but cannot attack from short distances.|<red>Staves</><icon>Staff</> can either heal allies, provide buffs...|Or even debuff foes!|There are also <red>Combat Staves</> that can attack an enemy with perfect accuracy!|But they <red>cannot Critical Hit</>.|Critical Hits deal 3 times the damage a unit would normally deal, by the way.|Now, don't worry about getting it all at once.|You'll have time to get used to it!|Weapons also have what's called a <red>Weapon Triangle</>.|Certain weapons have an advantage over other weapon types.|If you can master this, you'll thrive on the battlefield!|The <red>Weapon Triangle</> goes like this.|<red>Swords</><icon>Sword</> are strong against <red>Axes</><icon>Axe</>...|Which are strong against <red>Lances</><icon>Lance</>...|Which are weak against <red>Swords</><icon>Sword</>.|Notice the little cycle, there?|That's why it's called the Weapon <red>Triangle</>!|Not to mention, it goes both ways!|If your foe has the advantage, you have a disadvantage!|And magic has its own little triangle, too!|<red>Light magic</><icon>Light</> beats <red>Dark magic</><icon>Dark</>...|Beats <red>Anima magic</><icon>Anima</>...|Beats <red>Light magic</><icon>Light</>!|Once again, it goes both ways.|Then, the other two are a bit different!|<red>Bows</><icon>Bow</> beat all forms of magic...|And have no weaknesses!|Meanwhile, <red>Staves</><icon>Staff</> are neutral against everything.|Yet again, don't feel bad if you don't have it all memorized now.|You'll get the hang of it!|For now, all the enemies on the field use axes.|So, Eirika will have the advantage against them!|Now, Seth's a lance-wielder, so normally, he'd struggle here...|But he's got a trick up his sleeve!|His lance ignores the Weapon Triangle!|So, if you wanna use him to fight axe-wielders, go nuts!|But don't get cocky around swordies!

speak;Anna;Normally, in Fire Emblem games, you have to make do with what you have.|But in FE8R, every unit has their own personal weapons!|These are all neatly stored in their <red>Arsenal</>.|They've got quite quirky abilities, too!|Unlike other weapons, though, these can <red>evolve</>!|It typically happens when you get better when your weapons.|Each unit tends to have a main weapon, and some secondaries.|You can check which they have by typing the <red>"C"</> key over the unit's Arsenal.|Whilst you're in the Items menu, I mean!|Eirika, for example, has a proficiency in Swords<icon>Sword</>.|Once she gets a C rank in swords, her Aegis Rapier will evolve!|Most main weapons evolve at C, A, then SSS rank.|Most secondary weapons evolve at B, then SS rank.|Some don't unlock until certain things have happened, like Seth's personal lances...|So remember to keep an eye out!

name: Tutorial_Select_Eirika
_source: speak;Anna;Now, I hope you were paying attention to the story!|If you were, you'd know our trusty hero is <red>Eirika</>.|We will be referring her to as our <red>"Lord"</> from now on.|<red>"Lord"</> is the common term used for the main character in Fire Emblem games!|They tend to be royals, so... it tracks.|<red>If your Lord's HP is reduced to 0, you're done for!</>|You will then have to start the chapter over!|You'll want to do your best to keep your Lord alive!|Now, to win, you must complete the goal of each chapter.|In this case, it is to defeat or <red>"Rout"</> all the enemies on the map.

speak;Anna;In this version of FE8, if you get unlucky and Eirika dies, there is still hope!|You have a timewheel with 3 charges that you can use!|Though, for this chapter, I'll cut you a deal and give you unlimited charges!|So feel free to use it as much as you like!|Oh, I should explain what it is, shouldn't I?|When you activate your timewheel...|It lets you freely turn back time!|You can go back to any point during the previous turns.|When Eirika dies, it'll activate automatically, too!|So, you can swoop right in, and fix your error!|If Eirika dies while you have no charges, though...|Game over!|However, this IS the prologue.|So, y'know, unlimited charges!|But don't get too spoiled...|It's a good idea to keep Eirika safe regardless!

name: Tutorial_T2
_source: speak;Anna;Keep your eye out for terrain like forests, or forts!

speak;Anna;They will give you bonuses like more <red>DEF</> and/or more <red>Avoid</> to dodge enemy attacks!|Forts will even restore some HP each turn!|Use them to your advantage!|Though, watch out! Enemies can take advantage of them, too!|Oh, and something to clear up for later...|<red>Flying</> units don't get bonuses from the terrain!|They're FLYING, after all!|Now, time to explain some stats!|You can find them on a unit's status screen, typically by selecting a unit with the <red>"C"</> key.|Strength, or <red>"STR"</>, affects how much damage a unit will deal with physical weapons.|Magic, or <red>"MAG"</>, affects how much damage a unit deals with magical weapons.|Skill, or <red>"SKL"</>, affects how easy it is to hit enemies or certain skills/weapons.|It also boosts the Crit rate a bit!|Speed, or <red>"SPD"</>, affects if you can follow-up on an enemy...|Letting you attack them again!|It also helps keep your foe from doing the same to you!|It even helps improve your chance to dodge foes' attacks!|<red>Luck</>, affects various things such as Hit, Crit rate, or Crit avoid.|Defense, or <red>"DEF"</>, affects how much physical damage a unit will prevent.|Resistance, or <red>"RES"</>, affects how much magical damage a unit will prevent.|Constitution, or <red>"CON"</>, determines if a unit will be slowed down by a weapon's weight|If a weapon's weight is higher than a unit's CON...|Then the unit's Spd will be reduced by that difference.|Movement, or <red>"MOV"</>, will determine how many spaces a unit can normally move.|Terrain will affect how much far you can move.|It's harder for horsebound units to move through Forests or Deserts...|But it'd be easier for a flier!|Another thing to note!|It'll be a while, but some weapons attack off of different stats!For instance, a sword that works off of Str and Skl!|Weapons will say if they do, but it's good to keep in mind!|Now, when you get 100 EXP, you <red>Level Up</>!|Stats have a chance to increase each time you do.|To see those chances, hit the <red>"A"</> key on the unit's status page.|Items and events can influence these chances, so keep an eye out for those!|Most units will automatically promote to a higher tier class at level 21.|You may get an item to let you promote earlier, too...|You will have 3 choices to promote into, so have fun trying new combinations!;;;;6

speak;Anna;Now, I've got an FE8R original mechanic for you!|<red>Elemental Combos</>!|A lot of weapons have elements, and they can swing the tide of battle!|For example, Eirika's weapon has a <red>Thunder</><icon>Thunder</> element.|This means if she attacks any enemies that are <red>Drenched</><icon>Drenched</> with that weapon...|She'll deal bonus damage!|And hey, you're in luck!|Seth's personal weapon has the <red>Water</><icon>Water</> element!|Seth's lance will cause adjacent enemies to become drenched...|And that'll let Eirika zap them to death!|Keep an eye on weapon elements, and <red>Effective</> icons!|Here are all the elements in FE8R.|<red>Fire</><icon>Fire</>, <red>Wind</><icon>Wind</>, <red>Water</><icon>Water</>, <red>Thunder</><icon>Thunder</>, <red>Dark</><icon>Dark</>, <red>Light</><icon>Light</>,<red>Earth</><icon>Earth</>, and <red>Ice</><icon>Ice</>.|Here are all the elemental combos as well!|<red>Fire</><icon>Fire</>, then <red>Wind</><icon>Wind</>.|<red>Water</><icon>Water</>, then <red>Thunder</><icon>Thunder</>.|<red>Dark</><icon>Dark</>, then <red>Light</><icon>Light</>.|Then for <red>Ice</><icon>Ice</>...|It's not really an ELEMENTAL combo, but...|If you hit a frozen enemy with a <red>Heavy weapon</>, you'll deal big damage!|But be careful, the statuses are limited!|The Elemental Combo statuses last for two turns, or until the foe's next combat!|So, take advantage while you can!|And see what you can do with the Elemental Combos!;;;;6

name: Tutorial_First_Battle
_source: speak;Anna;Okay!|Your first battle!|I believe in you!|I'll teach you some things before you get started, though!|Can you see that box over there?|Near your weapon!|It's got some useful info in it!|<red>HIT</> shows what percent chance your attack has to land.|<red>DMG</> shows how much that attack'll hurt when it lands!|<red>CRIT</> is another percentage!|This time, how likely it is your attack will do triple damage!|This is called a critical hit!|Certain skills work off of them!|And they make you look cool when performed...|If you have animations on, that is.|He he!

speak;Anna;Y'know, there's a cool new system you should know about!|It's called <red>Pair-Up!</>|It lets your units team up in nifty ways, and has a few different flavors!|There's <red>Attack Stance</>, <red>Defense Stance</>, and the all-new <red>Affinity Strike!</>|<red>Attack Stance</> happens when two allies are adjacent.|Say, for instance, Units A and B are next to each other.|And a foe initiates against Unit A!|They'll be the primary combatant, sure...|But after their first attack, Unit B will pitch in, and strike the foe!|They'll only strike once per combat, however...|And the damage they deal is halved from what it'd be otherwise.|But it sure is handy for winning a fight!|Oh, and before I forget...|<red>Attack Stance</> won't happen while the enemy is in <red>Defense Stance</>.|<red>Defense Stance</> is a lot less incidental!|When you use <red>Pair-Up</> on two units, merging them into one team...|They automatically enter it during combat!|See that gauge down there?|While in <red>Defense Stance</>, every time they attack, or are attacked...|They gain 2 points! Up to a max of 10!|Once you hit 10, the next attack they take gets completely negated.|All thanks to the timely intervention of the main unit's pal, of course!|A couple of units paired up can also do something quite special...|It's called <red>Affinity Strike!</>|You can't just get it passively! Usually.|Instead, you have to manually activate it before entering combat!|You can't use it with a <red>Combat Art</>.|So be careful!|<red>Affinity Strike</> makes it so that, if you kill your foe...|You get to move again!|But it tires you out, so it's better to switch to your partner!|It also inflicts an affinity-based debuff to the foe after combat!|For example, if Seth was paired up with Eirika...|He'd inflict the Light Affinity debuff after combat!|You can tell what affinity strike you have based on your ally's Affinity.|Here's what each Affinity's status is...|And don't worry about memorizing it! You can always check later!|<red>Light</><icon>LightA</> reduces enemies' Hit by 60 for 2 turns.|This status is called Reduced Vision!|<red>Thunder</><icon>Thunder</> stuns the enemy for a turn.|This status is called...|Well, Stun.|<red>Dark</><icon>DarkA</> reduces the foe's Luck by 25%, their Crit Avoid by 10...|And makes Light weapons effective against them.|This lasts until their next combat, or for two turns: whatever comes first!|This status is called Shadowblight. But that's not all!|It also reduces their Res by 8 for one turn! Handy, eh?|That's a different status effect, called Cursed.|<red>Fire</><icon>Fire</>reduces the foe's Strength and Skill by 25%...|And makes Wind attacks effective against them!|This, too, lasts until their next combat or for two turns.|<red>Ice</><icon>Ice</> reduces the foe's Move and Speed by 25%...|And makes Heavy weapons effective against them!|Until, you guessed it, their next combat or two turns.|This status is called Frozen!|<red>Wind</><icon>Wind</> lowers their defense by 8 for a turn. Simple, huh?|That status is Breached. It's the Defense version of Cursed!|<red>Anima</><icon>Anima</> is a little special. It gives a random debuff!|This can include Seared, Cursed and Shadowblight, or Frozen...|But it also includes two more statuses!|Drenched, which is like Seared or Frozen...|Reducing Magic and Res by 25%, making Thunder attacks effective...|And lasting 2 turns or until the next combat, of course.|But the other one, Rock Punctures, is a bit trickier!|It reduces their Avoid by 60, their Def and Con by 25%...|And makes them take 25% of the damage they deal! Ow!|For the next combat or until two turns have passed, naturally.|And that's all of them!|Again, don't sweat memorizing it!|Just check the Guide later if you need!|Oh, one last thing.|Paired-up foes also have Affinity Strike...|But it's a bit different!|They get 50% bonus damage while paired up!|So be very careful against paired up enemies!|Remember!|If you're confused about Affinity Strike...|Check the Guide, or the unit's Skills tab!|You can access it by pressing <red>C</> over them, and scrolling a bit.|I hope that wasn't too much, he he!|Just experiment a bit. You'll find what works for you!

name: Item_Select_And_Ambush
_source: speak;Eirika;Oh, look at this sword!|Someone must have dropped it!|I can make use of it, I suppose.
speak;Valter;There you are, Princess!|I'm not done with you yet....|How about you entertain me more?
speak;Eirika;Oh no!|That wyvern rider!|They found us!
speak;SoldierRed;The Princess has been found!|After her!
speak;Seth;They have us surrounded!|We have no choice to but break through!

speak;Anna;Whoopsies!|Looks like you're in a pickle!|I believe in you, though!|All you have to do is <red>escape!</>|Have either Eirika or Seth reach this spot...|And they can easily <red>"Escape"</> to saftey!|It doesn't matter who reaches it.|Once one of them is safe, both of them will be.

name: Training_DG

name: Franz_Select_Tutorial
_source: speak;Anna;Fire Emblem has had unit types for a while, but it has been expanded in FE8R!|There are <red>Horse units</><icon>Horse</> like Seth.;;;;6
speak;Anna;Then there are <red>Armored units</><icon>Armor</> like Gilliam.;;;;6
speak;Anna;Then units that are not on any mount are called <red>Infantry</><icon>Infantry</>.|So Eirika is considered an <red>Infantry</><icon>Infantry</> unit.;;;;6

speak;Anna;Here are the rest of the unit types that you will encounter throughout the game.|<red>Flying units</><icon>Flying</>.|<red>Dragon units</><icon>Dragon</>.|<red>Magical units</><icon>Magic</>.|<red>Monster units</><icon>Monster</>.|<red>Pirate or Brigand units</><icon>Pirate</>.|Finally <red>Support units</><icon>Staff</>.|Keep note, for <red>Support units</><icon>Staff</>, this allows them to use healing/support staves such as <red>Heal</> or <red>Warp</>.|So a class that can use staves, but are not <red>Support units</><icon>Staff</> can only use combat staves.|For example, Sages can only use combat staves.|Ok, keep an eye out for unit types, since certain weapons deal extra damage against certain unit types!|You can check a unit's type anytime by hitting the <red>"C"</> key in the unit's status menu and hovering over their class!|Best of luck!;;;;6

name: Gilliam_Select_Tutorial
_source: speak;Anna;There are weapons in FE8R that are considered <red>Heavy Weapons</>.|There are four types of heavy weapons, <red>Blades</>, <red>Greatlances</>, <red>Warhammers</>, and <red>Greatbows</>.|They are very strong, but the enemy will always attack first when using them, and you <red>normally</> cannot multi-attack with them.|Certain skills will allow them to multi-attack, though.|They will also knock back the enemy one space after they are hit.

speak;Anna;Gilliam also has a blade as a personal weapon so take advantage of that!|Greatlances allow units to counterattack an additional 2 spaces away when defending!|Gilliam's other personal lance is a Greatlance, so Gilliam is a great unit to test heavy weapons!|Warhammers allow units to <red>Stun</><icon>Stun</> to enemies around the target!|These are powerful effects, but be careful since these can be used against you as well!|Last thing to note is that heavy weapons can deal effective damage against <red>Frozen</><icon>Frozen</> units, so try to combo those together!|All right, now go deal some massive damage!

name: Talk_Civ1
_source: speak;Man1;So you got rid of those Grado soldiers, did you?|It was quite the ruckus.|You guys must be pretty strong if even those defenses didn't help them win.
speak;Eirika;I suppose...|We had to rescue Princess Tana, so we couldn't fall to them with her life on the line!
speak;Man1;The Princess, huh?|She is a sweet girl...|Thank you for your good deeds, then!|I will be wishing you luck!

name: Talk_Civ2
_source: speak;Man2;It looks like that Rapier of yours proved pretty effective against that knight fellow.
speak;Eirika;Yes, I'm glad I learned how to wield it.|It has been proven to be very useful.
speak;Man2;I believe it.|Us country folk don't have much use for weapons, but we are lucky.|King Hayden has been good at protecting us.
speak;Eirika;Indeed, King Hayden is a wonderful man.
speak;Man2;Yes... now see what else you can do about those Grado guys, yeah?

name: Talk_Lute
_source: speak;Eirika;Thank you again for your help this battle.|I was surprised to see you join us, but you did good work.
speak;Lute;Of course!|I am a prodigy!|My first battle was destined to be excellent!
speak;Eirika;I see...|Well, your magic power is very much appreciated.
speak;Lute;Was that the best those Grado soldiers can do?|If so, this war should be over soon with me in it now!
speak;Eirika;I hope so.|I want the fighting to end as soon as possible...
speak;Lute;Leave it to me.|My books on the strategies of war will bring us victory!
speak;Eirika;Do your books say anything about those mountain spiders?

speak;Lute;Of course.|They are actually called Bael.|They have very tough hides and can run as fast as horses.|It says that back then, some drunken merchants mistook their horses for them.|They rode the Baels for miles until they realized their mistake.
speak;Eirika;Oh dear...|How did they get so far without being eaten?
speak;Lute;Apparently the Baels ate their horses, so they weren't hungry.|That is why they didn't attack the merchants.
speak;Eirika;Lute, I didn't know you were helping the villagers too.
speak;Lute;One of the villagers promised to give me a book if I helped.
speak;Lute;It was a book on 1000 ways to cook a zombie.
speak;Lute;I disagree. It just needs a little spice.
speak;Eirika;I'm surprised to see you near a chest, Lute.
speak;Lute;Yes, there was a strange accessory in here.|Its feathers were unlike anything I have seen before.
speak;Lute;Yeah, so I have this theory that if I-
speak;Eirika;Um, sorry Lute, I don't think I have time for a long lecture...
speak;Eirika;Anything good in this store, Lute?
speak;Lute;Hmmm....|Still looking through their collection...|Might be some new spells in there.
speak;Eirika;I see.|I hope you find something worthwhile.
speak;Eirika;Why are you hiding all the way over here?
speak;Lute;I'm not hiding.|I'm practicing my new spell.
speak;Lute;It is an invisibility spell.|It stops working if a human sees you though.
speak;Lute;You don't understand.|It's great if you're hiding from predators or monsters.
speak;Eirika;I guess if you put it that way...
speak;Eirika;I've been informed you're in charge of researching the monsters.|Is there anything to report from your studies?
speak;Lute;Yes.|It looks like these monsters have gained power from dark magic.|It's similar to necromancy, but this magic is not like normal dark magic.|It's more primal.|More organic.
speak;Lute;Like the power comes from the earth but corrupted.|These monsters have something close to life, but something is missing.|I feel like I'm close to something big...
speak;Eirika;I see...|Well, let me know if you find anything important...
speak;Lute;Princess.|I have some news to report.
speak;Lute;This monster attack seemed different...|More organized.|Like an army.|Like they were being controlled.
speak;Eirika;They did seem to be more precise in their attack.
speak;Lute;I could sense a faint of dark magic trailing off somewhere.|But it was too thin to trace.|I'll see if I can find anything else.|I'll continue experimenting.
speak;Eirika;Thank you Lute...|Please let me know if find anything else.|I'm starting to worry...
speak;Eirika;Why do you look so sad Lute?
speak;Lute;I'm disappointed that we didn't fight any monsters today...
speak;Lute;No!|I was close to a breakthrough, but I need more monster parts!|Ugh!|Why did they have to not show up now?!
speak;Lute;I'm testing to see if I can use some hellhound blood to track her down.
speak;Lute;Of course.|This book says that this ritual can help track down someone.|I just need this blood and dark magic to get it to work.
speak;Eirika;How long will it take until the ritual is ready?
speak;Eirika;We'll use that as a last resort I suppose then...
speak;Eirika;Are you examining the bones here, Lute?
speak;Lute;Yes, it seems to be a monster from long past.|I am examining my notes to see what it could be.
speak;Eirika;What do you think it may be?
speak;Lute;I'm thinking it might be a long dead Water Dragon.|This might have been part of the ocean at some point.
speak;Eirika;Really?|That would be surprising if it were true.
speak;Lute;I've got 26 books about it!|Let me show you the one with the closest theory in my opinion!
speak;Eirika;Ummm...|That's ok, Lute...|Not right now please...
speak;Eirika;Why do you look so serious, Lute?
speak;Lute;There is some really foul dark magic here...|It's disgusting, even to me...
speak;Eirika;...That's worrisome...|Should I ask what it is?
speak;Lute;I think you'll see for yourself...|But steel yourself...|I need to go lay down...|These people are real monsters...
speak;Eirika;Lute, please tell me you can track down Lyon with your magic?...
speak;Lute;No, I don't have the kind of materials for that.|I need a lot of ingredients for a tracking ritual to work.
speak;Eirika;What kind of ingredients?|Is it something we can purchase?
speak;Lute;Not unless you can buy something like the person's hair.
speak;Eirika;Oh...|I see why that would be a problem then...
speak;Lute;Indeed.|If you do get his hair, let me know and I can do the ritual.
speak;Eirika;I don't think I'll be able to get that anytime soon if we are still tracking him...
speak;Eirika;Lute, why do you look so disappointed?
speak;Lute;All of these gorgon eggs...|Such a waste...
speak;Eirika;Lute...|Were you thinking of taking one with you?...
speak;Lute;If there was one surviving, yes.|Gorgon eggs still have a lot of mysteries behind them.|I could have done a lot of research.
speak;Eirika;I see...|I guess that is unfortunate then.
speak;Eirika;Lute, it's your turn to take a break.|Thank you for your hard work, Lute.
speak;Lute;Finally...|This has been one long night.|I wouldn't mind if I got to finish reading my book.|But all these battle interruptions have been a major pain.
speak;Eirika;I see...|Well, I hope you can finish your book soon.|I bet it must be...interesting...
speak;Lute;Yes, it is about how a cyclops eye might contain a dark core.|I can go into more detail if you want?
speak;Eirika;That's ok, Lute...|I feel sleepy just hearing about that...
speak;Lute;Princess, look at all of the research material laying around here.|I've got enough to fill up a whole library!|I'll never regret my decision to come with you for the rest of my life.
speak;Eirika;I'm glad you found a lot to study.|Your research has been a major help.|I'm thankful, even with your...eccentric methods.
speak;Lute;They may be eccentric, but no one can deny my genius!|It will go down in history for centuries!|Now, let me gather my resources.|History is about to happen!
speak;Ephraim;Yes?|I am Prince Ephraim. May I ask who you are?
speak;Lute;I've been trying to find you all day!|I have reports to give to you!
speak;Ephraim;Ah, you must be Lute.|Eirika mentioned you to me.
speak;Lute;Good!|She must have told you how lucky you and your sister are to have a prodigy like me!
speak;Ephraim;She said something about your...eccentric knowledge.
speak;Lute;Of course my knowledge is eccentric!|Who else but me can know all of the mystic arts and monster anatomy!
speak;Lute;Now then!|Here are my reports! I expect you to read them very thoroughly!
speak;Ephraim;I will.|And it looks like I have a lot of reading ahead of me...
speak;Ephraim;Lute, I have a request for you.
speak;Ephraim;We will be traveling by boat soon.|Some of the men don't do well on the water.|I heard you know how to help with sea sickness.
speak;Lute;Well of course!|I know a tonic just for that!|Leave it to me!|First I will need the hair of a hellhound.|Then I need the eye drops of a Mogall.
speak;Ephraim;Oh no...|I fear for the souls that will have to drink this tonic...
speak;Ephraim;I've been informed you're in charge of researching the monsters.|Is there anything to report from your studies?
speak;Lute;Yes.|It looks like these monsters have gained power from dark magic.|It's similar to necromancy, but this magic is not like normal dark magic.|It's more primal.|More organic.
speak;Lute;Like the power comes from the earth but corrupted.|These monsters have something close to life, but something is missing.|I feel like I'm close to something big...
speak;Ephraim;I see...|Well, let me know if you find anything important...
speak;Ephraim;Why do you look angry, Lute?
speak;Lute;The men on the ship tossed out my tonic!|I worked so hard to make that!|They said that they felt more sick drinking it!|Don't they know quality when they see it?!
speak;Lute;That woman was very adapt at magic.|Even I am impressed at her strength.
speak;Ephraim;She was strong indeed.|She was a match for even your magic.
speak;Lute;Hey!|Let's not get carried away.|She was good, but not as good as me.|I am the greatest mage in all of Magvel after all.
speak;Ephraim;The greatest in all of Magvel, huh?|Well, I'll hold you up to that then.
speak;Lute;Good, you'll see just what I'm capable of.
speak;Ephraim;Have you seen King Vigarde, Lute?|He just...disappeared.
speak;Lute;There is some dark magic at work, that much I am sure of.|What and where it originates from, I am unsure.
speak;Ephraim;I see...|If you find anything though, let me know as soon as you can.
speak;Ephraim;Are you examining the bones here, Lute?
speak;Lute;Yes, it seems to be a monster from long past.|I am examining my notes to see what it could be.
speak;Ephraim;What do you think it may be?
speak;Lute;I'm thinking it might be a long dead Water Dragon.|This might have been part of the ocean at some point.
speak;Ephraim;Really?|That would be surprising if it were true.
speak;Lute;I've got 26 books about it!|Let me show you the one with the closest theory in my opinion!
speak;Ephraim;Ummm...|That's ok, Lute...|Not right now please...
speak;Ephraim;Why do you look so serious, Lute?
speak;Lute;There is some really foul dark magic here...|It's disgusting, even to me...
speak;Ephraim;...That's worrisome...|Should I ask what it is?
speak;Lute;I think you'll see for yourself...|But steel yourself...|I need to go lay down...|These people are real monsters...
speak;Ephraim;Lute, please tell me you can track down Lyon with your magic?...
speak;Lute;No, I don't have the kind of materials for that.|I need a lot of ingredients for a tracking ritual to work.
speak;Ephraim;What kind of ingredients?|Is it something we can purchase?
speak;Lute;Not unless you can buy something like the person's hair.
speak;Ephraim;Oh...|I see why that would be a problem then.
speak;Lute;Indeed.|If you do get his hair, let me know and I can do the ritual.
speak;Ephraim;I don't think I'll be able to get that anytime soon if we are still tracking him.
speak;Ephraim;Lute, why do you look so disappointed?
speak;Lute;All of these gorgon eggs...|Such a waste...
speak;Ephraim;Lute...|Were you thinking of taking one with you?...
speak;Lute;If there was one surviving, yes.|Gorgon eggs still have a lot of mysteries behind them.|I could have done a lot of research.
speak;Ephraim;I see...|I guess that is unfortunate then.
speak;Ephraim;Lute, it's your turn to take a break.|Thank you for your hard work, Lute.
speak;Lute;Finally...|This has been one long night.|I wouldn't mind if I got to finish reading my book.|But all these battle interruptions have been a major pain.
speak;Ephraim;I see.|Well, I hope you can finish your book soon.|I bet it must be...interesting...
speak;Lute;Yes, it is about how a cyclops eye might contain a dark core.|I can go into more detail if you want?
speak;Ephraim;That's ok, Lute...|I feel sleepy just hearing about that...
speak;Lute;Prince Ephraim, look at all of the research material laying around here.|I've got enough to fill up a whole library!|I'll never regret my decision to come with you for the rest of my life.
speak;Ephraim;I'm glad you found a lot to study.|Your research has been a major help.|I'm thankful, even with your...eccentric methods.
speak;Lute;They may be eccentric, but no one can deny my genius!|It will go down in history for centuries!|Now, let me gather my resources.|History is about to happen!

name: Talk_Tethys
_source: speak;Eirika;Oh thank you!|You are too!|You were with Innes' party, correct?
speak;Tethys;Correct!|It was part of our latest job.
speak;Tethys;Kind of.|I'm a dancer!|I help motivate those on the battlefield!|You should watch sometime, dear!
speak;Eirika;Wow!|A dancer!|Our army will be excited to have you along then!
speak;Tethys;Yes, sleep is important for your skin!|I've got to keep my skin nice and beautiful!
speak;Eirika;That's true.|I suppose that would be important for a dancer.
speak;Tethys;It is!|It's hard upkeep for us beautiful women, isn't it?
speak;Eirika;I do wish it was easier...
speak;Eirika;You look so beautiful dancing near the fire, Tethys.
speak;Tethys;He he!|Why thank you, Princess!|I hope this motivates everyone who is collecting bones!
speak;Eirika;I think it will, he he!|Just make sure they don't stare for too long!
speak;Tethys;He he!|Let them stare!|I don't mind!
speak;Eirika;Tethys...|I'm so sorry about your brother...
speak;Tethys;.....It is a dance for the dead...|I hope Ewan will find his way in the next world...|This dance will hopefully keep the dark rider away from him...
speak;Tethys;Yes...|I've been dancing for so long, that my feet are starting to get sore...
speak;Eirika;I see...|Get plenty of rest, Tethys.|Our troops would be sad if you worked yourself too hard.
speak;Tethys;He he!|Indeed!|I can't disappoint my fans!
speak;Eirika;Are you not too hot, Tethys?
speak;Tethys;Of course not!|Look how I'm dressed!|I'm used to the desert!
speak;Eirika;I guess if you put it that way...
speak;Tethys;Don't worry, Princess!|I'll do what I can to keep the tension low.|Don't want morale to go down!
speak;Eirika;Thank you Tethys.|You sure do know how to keep morale high.
speak;Eirika;Tethys...|It looks like there are five of you dancing!
speak;Tethys;He he!|Yes!|This is my special desert dance!|The desert mirages make this dance extra mysterious.
speak;Tethys;He he!|Thank you!|The desert is where I truly shine!
speak;Eirika;Why are you still outside Tethys?
speak;Tethys;I'm trying to see where the closest tavern is!|It's so cold here compared to the desert that I want to warm up by dancing!
speak;Eirika;I see...|I believe there should be a tavern that way.
speak;Tethys;Thank you, Princess!|Now, let's get a good dance workout and warm up!
speak;Eirika;Tethys...|My spirits are down...|I think I could use one of your dances...
speak;Tethys;Oh, Princess...|I understand!|Let me raise your spirits with my dance!|I've got a special one I can do by these waters!|Just you watch!
speak;Tethys;Oh!|I can't stand all of this smoke!|It cannot be good for my skin!
speak;Eirika;I know it's hot and the smoke is troublesome, so would you prefer a different outfit in the meantime?|I imagine a dancer outfit is not the best protection from the smoke.
speak;Tethys;This outfit is part of my job!|Do you not say the same thing to the knights?!
speak;Eirika;Well, when you put it that way...
speak;Tethys;I want to help everyone too!|Now I just need to get out of this smoke!|Got to keep my skin young and smooth!
speak;Eirika;Tethys, you may go and rest now.|I understand staying up late is bad for your skin.
speak;Tethys;Oh!|Thank you so much for understanding!|I need at least ten hours of sleep to keep my skin looking young.
speak;Eirika;Ten hours?|That's quite a long time.
speak;Tethys;I know it can be very inconvenient.|A dancer has a very strict diet and sleep regiment though.

speak;Eirika;Tethys, I wanted to thank you for the service you have done for us.|I have learned just how valuable having high troop morale can truly bring.|When you're around, the troops are so much happier and outgoing.
speak;Tethys;I'm glad to be of service!|I just hope everyone will still come to see me dance when this is over.
speak;Eirika;I bet they will.|I think you've made quite the impression on them.
speak;Ephraim;Excuse me, young lady.|I noticed you were fighting alongside that mercenary.
speak;Tethys;Why, hello handsome!|You must be the prince of Renais I've heard about!|I am Tethys of the Gerik mercenaries.|Happy to be of service!
speak;Ephraim;Well, that explains the outfit and why you were dancing.|You are a good dancer, I will admit.
speak;Tethys;He he!|I hope you come see me dance again soon!
speak;Ephraim;Excuse me, young lady.|Are you ok?|Why are you crying?
speak;Tethys;I...|Just lost my brother...|Can you please let me grieve in peace?...
speak;Tethys;Yes?|I'll be happy to answer any question!
speak;Ephraim;The servants here have been through a troubling time.|They look like they were suffering.|Is there anything you would be able do to lift their spirits?
speak;Tethys;I have just the thing!|There's a special, gentle song and dance I know!|It should hopefully bring them joy.
speak;Ephraim;That's good to hear.|I'll leave it to you then.
speak;Ephraim;Tethys...|It looks like there are five of you dancing!
speak;Tethys;He he!|Yes!|This is my special desert dance!|The desert mirages make this dance extra mysterious.
speak;Tethys;He he!|Thank you!|The desert is where I truly shine!
speak;Ephraim;Why are you still outside Tethys?
speak;Tethys;I'm trying to see where the closest tavern is!|It's so cold here compared to the desert that I want to warm up by dancing!
speak;Ephraim;I see.|I believe there should be a tavern that way.
speak;Tethys;Thank you, handsome Prince!|Now, let's get a good dance workout and warm up!
speak;Tethys;Now that is quite the serious expression for a handsome man.|What is troubling you?
speak;Ephraim;Tethys, sorry.|I have a lot on my mind right now.
speak;Tethys;I understand.|Would you like a special dance then?|That might ease your mind a little bit.
speak;Ephraim;Sorry, but not right now.|I appreciate the gesture though.
speak;Tethys;This must be very serious then...
speak;Tethys;Oh!|I can't stand all of this smoke!|It cannot be good for my skin!

name: Talk_Saleh
_source: speak;Eirika;Thank you for your help this battle Saleh.
speak;Saleh;No, I should be thanking you for helping the village.|There are not many people, so any help is significant.
speak;Eirika;Glad to help those in need.|The people's needs must be met.
speak;Saleh;I see you are wise as you are kind.|Thank you.
speak;Saleh;No, the blame is on me...
speak;Saleh;I should have been a better master.|His blood is on my hands...
speak;Saleh;As his master, I will be the one to bury him.|It will be my final duty as master for him...|I'm sorry I have failed you...
speak;Eirika;Sorry Saleh, did I interrupt something?|Your eyes were closed until I came up to you.
speak;Saleh;It's ok, Princess.|I was just finishing up something over here.|Did you need something?
speak;Eirika;I was wondering if you could look over the medical supplies for a while.|The troops are about to rotate shifts.
speak;Eirika;Thank you.|I hope you can tell me what what you were doing sometime, Saleh.|It looked interesting.
speak;Saleh;Yes, we can talk about it another time.
speak;Saleh;Not yet.|I'm gathering my thoughts.|This place was a quiet place for me to think.
speak;Eirika;Ok.|Please let me know if you find anything.
speak;Eirika;Anything special about these bones, Saleh?
speak;Saleh;Yes...|I believe these might be the bones of the ancestors of dragons...

speak;Saleh;That just might be a theory I have.|Something has to come before legends, and these might be a part of the answer.|These bones don't match what current dragons look like.|So they changed form, either by magic or time.
speak;Eirika;They changed form?|I'd imagine that must take a lot of magic to do that...

speak;Saleh;Possibly, this is just a theory.|Another theory is that other dragons came from other lands.|The magic of Magvel then changed them to match the environment over time.|But there are still many unanswered questions...
speak;Eirika;Saleh, I wanted to thank you for your help this last battle.
speak;Saleh;Think nothing of it.|As long as Myrrh is safe, you have my strength.
speak;Eirika;I promise that Myrrh's safety will be a top priority.
speak;Saleh;That brings me ease.|I know she isn't weak and insists on fighting, but it still is a concern.|Anything can happen in war.|It would be a disaster if anything happened to her.
speak;Eirika;I understand.|Ephraim holds her in high esteem, so I will do the same.
speak;Saleh;Princess, I wish to speak to you.
speak;Saleh;That aura coming from Prince Lyon...|It was most foul...
speak;Eirika;Do you think it could be a fake?|Someone impersonating Lyon with dark magic?
speak;Saleh;...I cannot say for sure yet...|It is a possibility.
speak;Saleh;I'm managing just fine.|Thank you for your concern, Princess.|This area has been known to be the death of many travelers.
speak;Eirika;Being unprepared would be a very deadly situation here.
speak;Saleh;Indeed.|Fortunately, we are wise in our preparations.
speak;Eirika;Saleh, are you able to perform guard duty tonight?
speak;Eirika;You seem hesitant, Saleh.|Is something wrong?
speak;Saleh;....I have some bad memories of guard duty.
speak;Eirika;Oh really?|I'm sorry for bringing up bad memories...
speak;Saleh;It's ok, Eirika.|As with life, we try to heal with time.
speak;Eirika;Saleh, do you have any information on that temple there?
speak;Saleh;Darkwood Forest has a long record of historic battles.|It's believed to be the location of a major battle.|Some have even said that's where the final battle of the Demon King took place.
speak;Eirika;The final battle with the Demon King?|If that's the case, why would Lyon be going there?
speak;Saleh;I do not know.|This place was supposed to be guarded...|I don't like the sound of this...
speak;Ephraim;Pardon me, but I noticed you were traveling with my sister.|I don't recognize you. Have we met before?

speak;Saleh;Ah, you must be Prince Ephraim.|Princess Eirika told me about you.|I can see the resemblance.|Let me introduce myself.|I am Saleh.|I'm actually glad to meet you.|I understand Myrhh is traveling with you, correct?
speak;Saleh;Good.|I have been searching for her for some time.|During my search I have made acquaintance with your sister.|I was informed you were traveling with her.
speak;Ephraim;I see.|Yes, I have taken her under my protection.|I have made sure no harm comes to her.
speak;Saleh;Perfect.|I will be joining you and aid you in her protection.|I am from Caer Pelyn and you could say I am a guardian of Myrhh.
speak;Ephraim;A guardian you say?|I don't mind her having more protection.|Report to me later and we can talk more.
speak;Ephraim;Pardon me, but I noticed you were traveling with my sister.|I don't recognize you, have we met before?
speak;Saleh;....You must be Prince Ephraim.|I'm sorry, but I cannot speak to you right now...|I am in mourning right now over my disciple...|Please talk to me later, though.
speak;Ephraim;I see...|I'll leave you be then...
speak;Ephraim;Saleh, I wanted to thank you for your help this last battle.
speak;Saleh;Think nothing of it.|As long as Myrrh is safe, you have my strength.
speak;Ephraim;I promise that Myrrh's safety will be a top priority.
speak;Saleh;That brings me ease.|I know she isn't weak and insists on fighting, but it still is a concern.|Anything can happen in war.|It would be a disaster if anything happened to her.
speak;Ephraim;I understand.|Nothing will get past me.

name: Talk_Ewan
_source: if;game.check_alive("Saleh") and game.check_alive("Tethys") or game.current_mode.permadeath != True
speak;Eirika;Ewan!|I'm glad to see you are ok!
speak;Ewan;Of course!|I knew my master could take care of things!
speak;Eirika;Saleh has indeed been a big help with his magic.
speak;Ewan;He's the best!|I will be like him someday!|Just you wait, lady!
speak;Eirika;Oh my!|Saleh has quite the fan!
speak;Ewan;Go away!|I want to be alone...
speak;Eirika;You ok Ewan?|This was your first major battle since joining us officially.
speak;Ewan;Yes!|It was a lot longer than I thought it was gonna be!|But I did learn a lot!
speak;Eirika;You're doing pretty well for someone so young...
speak;Ewan;Of course!|I'm just putting to use what I learned from my master, Saleh!
speak;Ewan;Ha ha!|Become my student and I can teach you!
speak;Ewan;I'm trying a technique that master taught me...|But, it's hard to stay so still...
speak;Eirika;That must be hard for you indeed...
speak;Ewan;What is that supposed to mean?!
speak;Eirika;Ewan, you look so red...|Are you ok?
speak;Ewan;Darn...|I was trying to make an oasis using water magic...|But it didn't work...
speak;Eirika;Oh Ewan...|Try not to scare me like that again, ok?
speak;Ewan;Wow!|That sure was a big battle, Princess!
speak;Eirika;Indeed...|But it was worth it...|We're finally home...
speak;Ewan;Welcome home, Princess!|I bet you're happy to be back.
speak;Eirika;Yes, Ewan.|I'm very happy, it's almost like a dream...
speak;Ewan;Well, we ought to have a big celebration later!|I learned a new spell to make fireworks!
speak;Eirika;Ewan, what magic are you practicing there?
speak;Ewan;I'm trying to mimic what spell that Lyon guy was casting.|His dark magic was impressive!
speak;Eirika;Lyon...|His magic didn't use to be so...dark...|His magic was a lot more warm than that...
speak;Ewan;Oh really?|I couldn't sense any warmth in his magic at all...
speak;Ewan;It's soooooooo hot....Oh!|I know!|I could use a water spell!
speak;Ewan;I'm just gonna cool all of us down!|Here I go!
speak;Ewan;Maybe a little bit.....|We're a lot cooler now though!
speak;Eirika;Ok Ewan, you can go rest in the barracks now.
speak;Ewan;What?!|What about guard duty?|I can do it too!
speak;Eirika;Are you sure?|You look like you could use some sleep.
speak;Ewan;I don't need to sleep!|Plus I had a great idea!
speak;Ewan;I thought of a stink spell that would drive enemies away!|It'll make guard duty a breeze!
speak;Eirika;That's disgusting, Ewan.|You're going to bed.|Now.
speak;Ewan;Hey, Princess!|I've got to ask you.|Do you think I've gotten stronger?
speak;Eirika;I think you have, Ewan.|You have gotten stronger, though I would say you still have a lot to learn.
speak;Ewan;Aw man....|I had a feeling you would say that....|Though I guess you're right.|There is still a lot I can learn.|At least learning is fun!
speak;Eirika;That's a good way to put it, Ewan.|Who knows?|Maybe you'll make a great Sage someday!
speak;Ephraim;Hey you, kid.|What are you doing here?
speak;Ewan;Hey!|I am not a kid!|I am a mage-in-training!|I'm here on imporatant business!
speak;Ephraim;A pupil, huh?|You sure started young, then.
speak;Ewan;I may be young, but I am good with magic!|Let me show you!|I made up a spell that helps you find a person within short distances!
speak;Ewan;It will be!|I'm looking for a prince guy.|I just cast this and the light should guide me to the person.|Here I go!
speak;Ewan;Huh, that's weird.|The light went to you.|That can't be right.....|I'm looking for this Prince Ephraim guy.
speak;Ewan;Yeah.....|My spell that tracks down a person is a dud....|The light only goes about the length of three lances before it dissipates.
speak;Ewan;I was hoping this would be more helpful!
speak;Ewan;Yes, my master.|He is the best!
speak;Ephraim;I see.|Do you have any leads?
speak;Ewan;Yeah, though I want to know where he is now!|He is the best mage I know after all!
speak;Ephraim;Ewan...|He looks like he is mourning...
speak;Ewan;This sure is a big castle!|There is so much space!
speak;Ephraim;There is a lot of space, isn't there?|There are some things that have changed here and there.|Overall, it's mostly the same.
speak;Ewan;Yes.|Though I wish I didn't have to come back in such circumstances.
speak;Ewan;Why did you come here before?
speak;Ephraim;Ewan, you look so red.|Are you ok?
speak;Ewan;Darn...|I was trying to make an oasis using water magic...|But it didn't work...
speak;Ephraim;Ewan.|Don't startle me like that.|We could've gotten hurt.
speak;Ephraim;What happened to your master, Ewan?
speak;Ewan;He...|Didn't make it...|I thought he was invincible...
speak;Ewan;Wow!|That sure was a big battle, Prince Ephraim!
speak;Ephraim;Indeed...|But it was worth it.|We're finally home.
speak;Ewan;Welcome home!|I bet you're happy to be back.
speak;Ephraim;Yes, Ewan.|I'm very happy. It's almost like a dream.
