speak;Eirika;See?|The water accepts you.|You're not the monster you think you are.
speak;Eirika;Have you never seen the ocean before, {v:ZombieName}?
speak;Eirika;It's beautiful, isn't it?|The way the waves go on forever...|It reminds us that there's always something beyond our troubles.
speak;Eirika;Take all the time you need.|Everyone deserves moments of peace like this.
speak;Eirika;You want to stand watch with the others?
speak;Eirika;Your senses are different from ours, aren't they?|You can probably detect things we'd miss.|I trust your vigilance, {v:ZombieName}.
speak;Eirika;Thank you for protecting us all.
speak;Eirika;The monsters...|Does their deaths bother you?...
speak;Eirika;The darkness here must be bothering you.|Remember, you're not the same as them.|Stay strong.|The evil is gone now.
speak;Eirika;You might have shared the same fate as them...
speak;Eirika;{v:ZombieName}!|You took all of those arrows...|You're covered in them...
speak;Eirika;Is that... intentional?|Were you using your body as a shield so we could proceed?...
speak;Eirika;What are you doing digging up the debris, {v:ZombieName}?
speak;Eirika;You're helping us trying to find the queen too?|Thank you, let me know if you find anything.
speak;Eirika;Ok, I'll leave you to it then.|Let us know if you're alerted to anything.
speak;Eirika;This is my home, {v:ZombieName}.|Do you like it?
speak;Eirika;You can feel the history in these stones, can't you?|All the memories held here...|You're part of this place now too, you know.
speak;Eirika;Yes, you belong here.|You've earned your place.
speak;Eirika;The heat is affecting you badly, isn't it {v:ZombieName}?
speak;Eirika;Here, stay in the shade.|Your body is burning up...|We need to take extra care of you in this climate.
speak;Eirika;We look out for each other, remember?
speak;Eirika;The end?|What ever could that mean?...
speak;Eirika;{v:ZombieName}...we've come so far together.|You've shown me that appearances don't define who we truly are.
speak;Eirika;Your courage, your compassion, your loyalty...|You're everything a true friend should be.|I'm honored to fight alongside you.
speak;Eirika;Yes...together we'll face whatever evil awaits.|No matter what happens, you'll always be part of our family.
speak;Ephraim;So you're the...unique ally Eirika told me about.
speak;Ephraim;Can you not talk?|Well, I guess I won't have to worry about complaints from you then?
speak;Ephraim;Well, I'll put you to the test.|I'm more strict than my sister.
speak;Ephraim;We'll make a proper soilder of you yet.
speak;Ephraim;We are gonna be on the water for a while.|We'll both need to get used to it, huh?
speak;Ephraim;Keep your spirits up, it won't be forever.
speak;Ephraim;Seasick, {v:ZombieName}?|I didn't expect that from someone like you.
speak;Ephraim;Even the undead get motion sickness, huh?|Shows you're more human than you might think.|Try focusing on the horizon.
speak;Ephraim;There you go.|Maybe you could even be a salior one day if you keep this up!|Ha ha!
speak;Ephraim;Back to full strength now that we're on solid ground?
speak;Ephraim;Good. That's the fighting spirit I want to see.|Land suits you better than sea, clearly.|Ready to press our advantage?
speak;Ephraim;That's what I like to see.|Let's move out.
speak;Ephraim;I guess death means a lot more to you, huh?
speak;Ephraim;You're making quick work of that rubble.|Looking for clues on what happened here?
speak;Ephraim;Impressive.|Let me know if you find anything.
speak;Ephraim;Good work, {v:ZombieName}.|I'll leave this to you then.
speak;Ephraim;Ok, I'll leave you to it then.|Let us know if you're alerted to anything.
speak;Ephraim;This is my home, {v:ZombieName}.|Do you like it?
speak;Ephraim;You can feel the history in these stones, can't you?|All the memories held here...|You're part of this place now too, you know.
speak;Ephraim;Yes, you belong here.|You've earned your place.
speak;Ephraim;The heat is affecting you badly, isn't it {v:ZombieName}?
speak;Ephraim;Here, stay in the shade.|Your body is burning up...|We need to take extra care of you in this climate.
speak;Ephraim;We look out for each other, remember?
speak;Ephraim;The end?|What ever could that mean?...
speak;Ephraim;{v:ZombieName}...you've proven yourself in every battle.|You fight with honor and courage.
speak;Ephraim;Whatever you were before, you're a warrior now.|You've earned my respect and my trust.|Ready for the final battle?
speak;Ephraim;That's the fighting spirit that wins wars.|Let's finish this together, soldier.

name: Talk_EyeBoy
_source: speak;EyeBoy;Hmm...these medical supplies have magic in them.|Basic healing magic, but it works.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;You found those supplies?|That was so kind of you!
speak;EyeBoy;Don't get the wrong idea.|I was just studying the magic.|It's not my fault they can heal people too.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;But you still brought them over to help.
speak;EyeBoy;I need living test subjects.|Dead ones don't give good data.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;This manual labor is beneath me.|But I am learning interesting things how humans use tools...;;;noir;;white

speak;EyeBoy;That and I am studying how humans work all together.|Their reactions to each other are....Very interesting.|Especially when I see someone becoming happy from completing their tasks.|It makes for great research material.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Is that the only reason you're helping?
speak;EyeBoy;...Maybe.|I've noticed that when people are happy, they answer my questions better.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;Water carries magic really well.|This bridge repair gives me good research data.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;You've been helping with the bridge?
speak;EyeBoy;I've been checking the structure with magic.|Way better than your crude hammering.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;But you're still helping with the work.
speak;EyeBoy;My way is smarter.|Though I have to admit...seeing it work is kind of satisfying.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Do you actually like being helpful, {v:EyeBoyName}?
speak;EyeBoy;Don't be crazy!|This is all for my desire of knowledge!....;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;The ocean's magic flows are really complex.|The way the tides affect mana is fascinating.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;"Like" is an emotion.|I find it intellectually interesting.|The salt water and magic interaction is...captivating.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;You sound almost peaceful when you talk about it.
speak;EyeBoy;Peace just means no distractions.|Though I admit this place is good for research.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Maybe knowledge can be beautiful too.
speak;EyeBoy;I can see way farther than you can.|I've spotted seventeen threats you all missed.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;I'm doing surveillance research.|If it happens to protect you, that's just a side effect.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Your research seems to help us a lot.
speak;EyeBoy;Just a coincidence.|Though I guess keeping test subjects alive is important for... |Research reasons.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;I suppose I must be thankful then, {v:EyeBoyName}.
speak;EyeBoy;Ugh, the dark energy here is overwhelming.|My magic sense makes this place unbearable.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;I'm getting magical feedback from all the corruption.|It's... enlightening, but it hurts.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;The darkenss here is hurting you?...
speak;EyeBoy;Having better magical senses has downsides.|But the knowledge I'm getting from this pain is priceless.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Please be careful....|I don't want you to get hurt....
speak;EyeBoy;These bones have fascinating death magic residue.|Each one tells a story of corruption and decay.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;Death is just another form of magic change.|Though...these deaths seem unnecessarily sad.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Do you feel sorry for them?
speak;EyeBoy;I feel...disappointed by the waste.|They could have taught us so much more about magic.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;Bah, all these blasted ballistas!|They drive me mad!;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;You do make for an easy target for them...
speak;EyeBoy;Hmph!...|Oh the joy I get when I see them get blown away!;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Well, thank you for helping take care of them when you can.
speak;EyeBoy;You don't need to thank me.|Though...I guess it's nice that you notice my work.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;You do like being appreciated, don't you?
speak;EyeBoy;Hmph!|I'm just happy to see another ballista out of commision!;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;I'm checking the magic signatures under this rubble.|There are some interesting things hidden here.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;A few items with minor magic.|I suppose they might be useful for your non-magical needs too.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;I suppose Jehanna would have some hard to find trinkets.
speak;EyeBoy;Indeed, now leave me be.|I need to concentrate.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;What dreadful heat in this blasted desert...|I'm sweating so much...;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;Of course we do.|Though I guess you would call it "crying" for humans.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;So you cry when you sweat?|It does look like you are crying...
speak;EyeBoy;No!|Sweating looks like I'm crying!|I'm not crying at all!;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;So this is your home of Renais, huh?;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;From a research standpoint, it's quite impressive.|Your ancestors knew architecture, that's for sure.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Do you feel at home here too?
speak;EyeBoy;"Home" is a sentimental idea.|Though...this place is good for my studies.|Maybe... adequate for long-term research.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;I'm glad you feel welcome here.
speak;EyeBoy;The corruption in Lyon is fascinating from a magic perspective.|Such power, such waste...;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;...Yes.|Well, whatever magic has hold of him...|Is beyond comprehension.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;Would be shame to lose him...|I'll see what I can do to understand this magic.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;Bah, another place that irritates my eye...;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;The heat and smoke is hard on you too, {v:EyeBoyName}?
speak;EyeBoy;My magic needs good conditions.|This environment is terrible for thinking.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Here, stay in the shade with us.
speak;EyeBoy;That's logical.|I need to maintain peak research ability...|Thank you...;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;We all need to take care of each other.
speak;EyeBoy;I was processing all the research data I've collected.|You interrupted my analysis.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;Rest is for lesser minds.|I was doing deep thinking about our mission.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;That this journey is almost over.|The magic patterns suggest big revelations ahead.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;You sound almost ominous when you say that.
speak;Eirika;{v:EyeBoyName}...|I know we weren't too close, but...|I'm glad you were with us this whole journey.
speak;EyeBoy;Well...|Your expedition has been...adequate for my research.|Though you could have visited some places with more books.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Well, as long as you've learnt something.|It coudln't have been that bad, he he!
speak;EyeBoy;I did learn a thing or two.|If only I could take your lessons in book form...;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Is that your way of saying you'll miss me?
speak;EyeBoy;...Future research will be less...complete without you around.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;So you're the...floating eye creature Eirika mentioned.|Strange ally.
speak;EyeBoy;I'm {v:EyeBoyName}, and I'm doing extensive magical research.|Your sister has been a decent research assistant.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Research assistant? That's one way to put it.|What exactly are you researching?
speak;EyeBoy;Combat magic, tactical spells, battlefield magic theory...|Your military strategies make excellent case studies.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;At least you're studying something useful.|Carry on, then.
speak;EyeBoy;Obviously I'll continue.|I don't need permission for research.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;The ocean's magic currents are messing with my long-range detection.|Really inconvenient for surveillance research.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Can you still keep watch effectively?
speak;EyeBoy;I'm still better than your primitive senses.|Though I admit the sea environment has...challenges.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Just do your best.|We're all adapting to new conditions.
speak;EyeBoy;I don't do my "best."|I do optimal analysis given the parameters.|There's a difference.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;Bah, the ship's motion is disrupting my magic balance.|Really annoying for research.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Seasick, {v:EyeBoyName}?|I didn't expect that from a floating eyeball.
speak;EyeBoy;It's not "sickness."|It's environmental problems affecting my magic sense.|Big difference.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Whatever you call it, you look miserable.
speak;EyeBoy;I'm experiencing bad research conditions.|Misery is an emotion I don't...acknowledge.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Try focusing on the horizon.|Sometimes that helps.
speak;EyeBoy;Excellent.|Solid ground restores my balance.|My research abilities are fully back.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;I'm operating at peak efficiency.|The sea environment was terrible for thinking.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Good to have you back at full strength.
speak;EyeBoy;"Full strength" implies I was weak before.|I was just...temporarily limited by environment.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;This burial ground has fascinating death magic residue.|Mass death has interesting magic implications.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Do you have no respect for the dead, {v:EyeBoyName}?
speak;EyeBoy;Death is just a change in magic energy.|Though...unnecessary death is a waste of potential knowledge.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Well, that sounds a little more respectful.
speak;EyeBoy;I respect the research opportunities death provides.|The emotional stuff is less important for my studies.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Hopefully you still understand the seriousness of it at least.
speak;EyeBoy;I'm doing structural analysis of this damaged building.|Several magically important artifacts under the rubble.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Finding anything useful in all that debris?
speak;EyeBoy;Multiple items with strategic and research value.|My magic methods beat crude digging.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Your magical sight is definitely an advantage.
speak;EyeBoy;Obviously.|My abilities are way better than brute force.
speak;Ephraim;Just keep finding what we need, {v:EyeBoyName}.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;I'm monitoring multiple magic frequencies for threats.|My surveillance is way better than normal methods.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;I'm doing comprehensive area analysis.|If my research protects your tactical talk, that's just efficient.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Your research always seems to help us out.
speak;EyeBoy;Successful military operations give me better research opportunities.|Failed campaigns give no data.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Keep up the good work, then.
speak;EyeBoy;This fortress has remarkable architecture.|The stonework is quite sophisticated.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;This is Renais Castle, my family home.|What's your assessment?
speak;EyeBoy;From a strategic perspective, the defenses are impressive.|Your ancestors knew warfare.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;I only give accurate analysis.|Though I admit...this environment is good for advanced research.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Glad you approve of our family castle.
speak;EyeBoy;The magical corruption in Lyon is absolutely fascinating.|Such power, such tragic misuse of potential...;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Lyon was our childhood friend, {v:EyeBoyName}.|Show some respect.
speak;EyeBoy;I do respect that power he had.|So unknown, but so overwhelming...
speak;EyeBoy;I mourn the loss of potential knowledge.|He could have contributed so much to magical understanding.|Instead... this.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;Bah, another place that irritates my eye...;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;The heat and smoke is hard on you too, {v:EyeBoyName}?
speak;EyeBoy;My magic needs good conditions.|This environment is terrible for thinking.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Here, stay in the shade with us.
speak;EyeBoy;That's logical.|I need to maintain peak research ability...|Thank you...;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;We all need to take care of each other.
speak;EyeBoy;I was doing deep analysis of accumulated battlefield data.|You interrupted my calculations.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;I don't "rest."|I was processing complex magic patterns and strategic implications.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;And what did your analysis conclude?
speak;EyeBoy;That we're approaching a critical nexus of magical forces.|The final confrontation will be... theoretically significant.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Hopefully we're ready for whatever's coming.
speak;Ephraim;{v:EyeBoyName}...you've been studying this conflict for a long time.|What's your final assessment?
speak;EyeBoy;From a tactical perspective, your leadership has provided excellent research data.|The strategic applications have been...illuminating.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;That's high praise from someone as critical as you.
speak;EyeBoy;I only give accurate analysis.|Though I admit...this expedition has exceeded my research expectations.;;;noir;;white
speak;EyeBoy;I anticipate the ultimate magical confrontation will provide unprecedented research opportunities.|Most...satisfactory.;;;noir;;white

name: Talk_BoneBoy
_source: speak;BoneBoy;Those poor villagers...|They didn't deserve this.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Don't get all sentimental on me, Princess.|I just don't like seeing innocent people suffer.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;There's nothing wrong with caring about others.
speak;BoneBoy;Maybe not.|But I can't help wondering...|did I have people I cared about before?|A family?|Friends?;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;I'm sure you did.|And perhaps they're still out there, waiting for you.
speak;BoneBoy;Ha, wouldn't that be something.|A skeleton with a family reunion to attend.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Medical supplies, huh?|Good thing someone around here has a functioning brain.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;That was very thoughtful of you to search for them, {v:SkeletonName}.|
speak;BoneBoy;Well, being made of bones gives me a unique perspective on medical needs.|Trust me on that one.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Your knowledge of healing is impressive.|Were you perhaps a healer in your past life?
speak;BoneBoy;Who knows?|Maybe I was a doctor, maybe I was just accident-prone.|Hard to tell when your memories are as scattered as my bones used to be.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Either way, you're helping save lives now.|That's what matters.
speak;BoneBoy;I suppose you're right.|Just don't expect me to start wearing a white coat anytime soon.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Nothing like a bit of manual labor to keep the joints moving.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;You've been working tirelessly to help the villagers, {v:SkeletonName}.
speak;BoneBoy;What can I say?|I'm built for heavy lifting.|Literally.|No muscles to get tired.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Hey, someone's got to do the grunt work.|Might as well be the guy who doesn't need to worry about back pain.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;You make it sound so practical.
speak;BoneBoy;Everything's practical when you're a walking anatomy lesson.|But seriously, Princess, these people need all the help they can get.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Bridge repair duty.|Well, that's a first.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Were you helping with the construction, {v:SkeletonName}?
speak;BoneBoy;Turns out being waterproof has its advantages.|No rust, no rot, just good old-fashioned bone.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Princess, I don't have skin to wrinkle.|Though I do have to be careful not to lose any small pieces downstream.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;You'd be surprised how many problems you never think about until you're a skeleton.|But hey, the bridge is fixed, right?;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;So this is the ocean.|Can't say I remember seeing it before.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;It's...vast.|Makes you wonder what else is out there in the world.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Perhaps your past lies across these waters?
speak;BoneBoy;Maybe.|Or maybe I'm just a landlubber who never traveled.|Hard to tell when your memories are basically non-existent.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;The salt air seems to agree with you though.
speak;BoneBoy;Well, I don't have to worry about the salt corroding anything important.|Perks of being calcium-based, I suppose.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Night watch duty.|At least I don't need sleep.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;I guess that helps you stay vigilant, {v:SkeletonName}.
speak;BoneBoy;Someone has to keep an eye socket open.|Can't have monsters sneaking up on us.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;I have to give you my thanks for willing to protect us for so long.
speak;BoneBoy;Just doing my job, Princess.|Though I have to admit, the quiet gives me time to think.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Among other things.|Sometimes I wonder if I was a guard or soldier before.|This feels...natural.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;That place gave me the creeps.|And I'm literally a walking skeleton.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;You could sense the evil there too?
speak;BoneBoy;Something about it felt...wrong.|Like a memory I can't quite reach.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Perhaps you encountered such darkness before?
speak;BoneBoy;Maybe.|Or maybe being undead gives me a special sense for this stuff.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Either way, you fought bravely against them.
speak;BoneBoy;Well, evil doesn't usually respond to polite conversation.|Sometimes you just have to get your hands dirty.|Or bony, in my case.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Well, this is awkward.|Collecting bones when you ARE bones.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Nah, just makes me philosophical.|Could these have been someone like me once?;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Don't worry, Princess.|I'm not having an existential crisis.|Just wondering about the stories these bones could tell.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Your perspective is unique, that's certain.
speak;BoneBoy;Hey, someone's got to handle the bone-related tasks around here.|Might as well be the expert.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;You always find a way to make light of things.
speak;BoneBoy;Arrow dodging.|Now there's a skill I apparently have.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Your reflexes were incredible out there, {v:SkeletonName}.
speak;BoneBoy;Perks of not having vital organs to protect.|Makes you a bit more reckless.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;I'll take it.|Though I have to wonder if I was an archer in my past life.|Or maybe just someone who got shot at a lot.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Either way, we survived the tough battle.|Thank you for giving us a hand.
speak;BoneBoy;Just returning the favor, Princess.|You've given me a purpose when I had none.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Found something interesting in the rubble.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Yeah, when you don't have muscles to get tired, you can be pretty thorough.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Some old documents.|Can't read them all, but they might be important.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;We should have Seth look at them.
speak;BoneBoy;Good thinking.|Who knows?|Maybe they'll have clues about my past too.|A skeleton can dream, right?;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Strategy meetings.|The glamorous side of war.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Hey, someone's got to watch for eavesdroppers.|And I don't get bored easily.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Hard to get distracted when you don't have a stomach to growl or eyes to get tired.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Another advantage of your unique condition.
speak;BoneBoy;I'm starting to think being a skeleton isn't all downsides.|Though I still wouldn't recommend it as a lifestyle choice.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Yes.|It feels good to be back, even under these circumstances.
speak;BoneBoy;I can see why you'd fight so hard for it.|It's beautiful.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Do you think you had a homeland like this, {v:SkeletonName}?
speak;BoneBoy;Maybe.|Sometimes I wonder if there's a place where someone's still waiting for me to come home.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;I hope you find it someday.
speak;BoneBoy;Me too, Princess.|But until then, I'll help you protect yours.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;That wasn't Lyon out there.|Not the Lyon you knew.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;When you're undead yourself, you recognize the signs.|Whatever's controlling him...it's not natural.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;It's so hard to see him like this.
speak;BoneBoy;I'm sorry, Princess.|Losing someone to darkness...it's one of the worst kinds of loss.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;I...I'm not sure.|Maybe it's just intuition.|Or maybe it's a memory trying to surface.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Volcano warfare.|At least I don't sweat.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;The heat doesn't affect you I suppose, {v:SkeletonName}?
speak;BoneBoy;Nope.|No blood to boil, no skin to burn.|Just good old-fashioned bone.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;That's quite an advantage in this climate.
speak;BoneBoy;Every cloud has a silver lining, I suppose.|Even the cloud of being undead.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;You always find the positive side of things.
speak;BoneBoy;Well, when you're a walking skeleton, you have to find humor somewhere.|Otherwise you'd go mad.|Or madder.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Caught me in my downtime.|Well, this is embarrassing.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;I don't actually need sleep, but sometimes I like to just...think.|Or try to remember.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Fragments here and there.|Nothing concrete.|Just feelings, mostly.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;I suppose.|Though I was hoping for something more dramatic.|Like suddenly remembering I was a famous hero or something.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;{v:SkeletonName}...|We're approaching the end of our journey.
speak;BoneBoy;The final battle.|I can feel it.|Whatever's ahead, it's big.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;As ready as a skeleton can be.|Though I have to admit, I'm nervous.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;What if I don't survive this?|What if I never learn who I was?;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Then you'll be remembered for who you became.|A loyal friend and brave warrior.
speak;BoneBoy;Thanks, Princess.|That...that means more than you know.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;So you're the skeleton Eirika mentioned.|{v:SkeletonName}, right?
speak;BoneBoy;That's me.|Your friendly neighborhood undead warrior.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;I get that a lot.|Not many walking skeletons in your social circle, I'm guessing.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Can't say that I have.|But if you're fighting for Renais, you're welcome in my army.
speak;BoneBoy;Appreciate the warm welcome, Prince.|I'll try not to rattle too much during marches.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Keeping watch, Prince.|Someone's got to stay alert.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Good.|I like soldiers who take initiative.
speak;BoneBoy;Well, when you don't need sleep, night duty becomes pretty manageable.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;I aim to please.|Though I have to ask - does it bother you?|Having an undead in your ranks?;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;If you can fight and you're loyal, I don't care what you're made of.
speak;BoneBoy;Good to know.|I was worried you might want to exorcise me or something.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Sea travel.|Not as glamorous as the stories make it sound.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;The ocean doesn't agree with you?
speak;BoneBoy;Let's just say I discovered bones can rattle even when they're not scared.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Apparently being undead doesn't make you immune to everything.|Who knew?;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;At least you're honest about your weaknesses.
speak;BoneBoy;When you're held together by willpower and spite, honesty becomes a survival skill.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Awwww, we are on land already?;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Disappointed to be on land so soon?
speak;BoneBoy;I could have spent more days out there.|Maybe become a pirate?|Who know, maybe it was my destiny out there?;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;That's quite the impression the sea left on you.
speak;BoneBoy;Nah, I'm just messing with you.|Plus you guys are more fun.|I can always visit another time.|It's not like the sea is going anywhere anytime soon.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;That's one way to look at it.
speak;BoneBoy;It's rare to see you down like this, Prince.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;I just wonder if this fight could have been avoided?...
speak;BoneBoy;That Selena fellow seemed too stubborn, even for me.|I don't think we could convince her.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Hey, I'll tell you what.|If it makes you feel better, I'll tend to her grave every so often for you.|Hopefully that will give you peace of mind.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;...Are you sure?|That is a pretty big commitment.
speak;BoneBoy;I don't think I'll be going away anytime soon.|Will give me something to do over the years.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Such cramped passages.|Just the way I like it.|Nice and cool in here.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;No complaints about the cramped quarters?
speak;BoneBoy;Prince, when you're literally skin and bones,|well, just bones-|You learn to appreciate tight spaces.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;And the darkness doesn't affect your vision?
speak;BoneBoy;Empty eye sockets have their advantages.|Though I still don't understand how I can see anything.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;One of many.|But hey, mysterious undead vision beats stumbling around in the dark.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Reunion time.|Always interesting to see how these things play out.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;I will admit, it is nice to be back with my sister.|Have you been spying on us though?
speak;BoneBoy;Just observing.|Family dynamics are...complicated.|Even I can remember that much.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Not exactly.|More like an echo of what it felt like.|Warmth, I think.|Connection.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Perhaps those feelings will lead you back to your past.
speak;BoneBoy;Maybe.|Or maybe some feelings transcend memory.|Either way, I'm glad to see you and your sister together again.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;You can sense something wrong here too?
speak;BoneBoy;Like a chill in the air.|Though that might just be the undead in me talking.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Your instincts have been reliable so far.
speak;BoneBoy;Being dead apparently comes with a supernatural early warning system.|Who knew?;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Stay alert.|We'll need every advantage we can get.
speak;BoneBoy;Don't worry, Prince.|Death has made me very good at staying aware of my surroundings.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;That Lyon...|something's very wrong with him.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;You could tell he wasn't himself?
speak;BoneBoy;The dead recognize corruption, Prince.|Whatever's controlling him reeks of dark magic.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;I...|I wish I knew.|Sometimes the darkness goes too deep to pull someone back.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;You sound like you're speaking from experience.
speak;BoneBoy;Maybe I am.|Memory or intuition, something tells me I've seen this kind of loss before.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Volcano warfare.|At least I don't sweat.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;The heat doesn't affect you I suppose, {v:SkeletonName}?
speak;BoneBoy;Nope.|No blood to boil, no skin to burn.|Just good old-fashioned bone.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;That's quite an advantage in this climate.
speak;BoneBoy;Every cloud has a silver lining, I suppose.|Even the cloud of being undead.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;You always find the positive side of things.
speak;BoneBoy;Well, when you're a walking skeleton, you have to find humor somewhere.|Otherwise you'd go mad.|Or madder.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Caught me in my downtime.|Well, this is embarrassing.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;I don't actually need sleep, but sometimes I like to just...think.|Or try to remember.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Fragments here and there.|Nothing concrete.|Just feelings, mostly.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;I suppose.|Though I was hoping for something more dramatic.|Like suddenly remembering I was a famous hero or something.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;{v:SkeletonName}.|We're about to face the source of all this darkness.
speak;BoneBoy;The Demon King himself.|I can feel his presence from here.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Prince, I've been dead already.|What's the worst that could happen?;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Then I'll make sure to take some demons with me.|Been a pleasure serving under you, Prince.;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;The pleasure has been mine, {v:SkeletonName}.|You've proven that honor isn't limited to the living.
speak;BoneBoy;High praise from royalty.|Now let's go show this Demon King what Renais is made of.;;;noir;;white

name: Talk_SnakeGirl
_source: speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>La~ la~ la! First adventure with my pretty friends!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Oh, {v:SnakeGirlName}!|That's quite the lovely singing voice you have there!
speak;SnakeGirl;He he!|Many thanks!|Compliments make my tail wiggle!;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;He he!|Your tail is tickling me!|It's so wiggly!
speak;SnakeGirl;Slippery like a shiny scale?|Perfect for dancing!;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;he he, just don't fall in.
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Sky full of scaly wyverns, la la la~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;There were some Grado wyverns...|They are pretty dangerous.|We'll have to stay alert for them.
speak;Eirika;Spicy song?...|That's a strange way to put it...
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Spicy spicy song, pretty pretty scales~</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Why are you trying to sneak around, {v:SnakeGirlName}?
speak;Eirika;What in the world what you doing?
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Slither training, sneaky snake la la~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;The fort sure carries your singing far.
speak;SnakeGirl;Then everyone hears how beautiful I am!;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Hopefully it won't scare them hearing echoing singing...
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Echo echo all night long, echo echo with this song~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;There is a lot of bejewled furnishes here.|But keep you eye out for the queen.|We are still trying to find her.
speak;SnakeGirl;Pretty home of queen!|I'll sing it safe!;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;I hope she is safe too...
speak;Eirika;The sand sure is harsh.|Doesn't look like it bothers you though.
speak;SnakeGirl;Scales keep cool.|Sing keeps mood cool!;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;If only singing could keep us all of cool...
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Cool cool beauty me, pretty pretty song for all to see~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;It feels so nice to be home...
speak;Eirika;He he, I suppose you could call it a nest!|Yes, would you like to stay here and sing for us?
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Yes, so happy I could cry, a home is mine, is this no lie?!~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>River sings with me, la la flow~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;{v:SnakeGirlName}, how can you always be so cheerful?...
speak;SnakeGirl;Not always cheerful, but full of hope!|If {v:SnakeGirlName} feel down, {v:SnakeGirlName} sings louder!;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;I see...|I guess all I can do is try harder for Lyon...|Must not loose hope...
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Monsters go roar, I go la~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;{v:SnakeGirlName}, are you not sad?|Those could've been your sisters...
speak;SnakeGirl;Not my sisters!|My family here!|You and all others!;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;...Of course, I was silly.|We are your family in the end!
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Happy family win the day, hip hip horray~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Almost there, la la fight on~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;SnakeGirl;End of fight, start of party song!;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;It's a little early to party, {v:SnakeGirlName}...|Let's end this war first.
speak;Eirika;This part of the battle is over, but the final battle is up ahead...
speak;SnakeGirl;One more fight and battle end?;;;noir;;white
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Battle end, then peaceful days with my friends!~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>La~ la laaa~ First march with the mighty prince!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;You're full of energy, ummm...{v:SnakeGirlName}, right?
speak;Ephraim;Right...|Well, this one sure is full of spirit.
speak;Ephraim;The sea winds are blowing, hopefully good sailing condition for us.
speak;Ephraim;Yep, we will sail to our next destination.|I hope it will be a peaceful one.
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Boat go rocky up and down, as all listen to my sound~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Ghosty waves go swish swash la~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;These seas are treacherous.|It'll be rough, but we'll make it safe and sound.
speak;SnakeGirl;Then my brave prince keeps me safe!;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;What in the world are you doing, {v:SnakeGirlName}?
speak;Ephraim;Calm down!|Don't need to scream so loud...
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>{v:SnakeGirlName} hunting some prey, to give as a gift the next day~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Sorry, but can you please not sing right now...|I don't think now is the right time...
speak;SnakeGirl;No song?...|I understand...|I sing quiet song then...;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Sorry, I didn't mean to make you sad...|You can sing quietly to yourself, don't mind me...
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow>Quiet song I sing...Darkness, oh much you sting...</>;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;This is Grado Keep.|It's so run down compared to when I was here years ago....
speak;SnakeGirl;Then I sing bright up the mood!;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Your beautiful singing might be the first positive thing to happen here in a while...
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Brighten up these Grado walls, bring back this light, embrace us all~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;The sand sure is harsh.|Doesn't look like it bothers you though.
speak;SnakeGirl;Scales keep cool.|Sing keeps mood cool!;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;If only singing could keep us all of cool...
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Cool cool beauty me, pretty pretty song for all to see~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;It feels strange to be home...
speak;Ephraim;I suppose you could call it a nest.|Yes, would you like to stay here and sing for us?
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Yes, so happy I could cry, a home is mine, is this no lie?!~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>River sings with me, la la flow~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;{v:SnakeGirlName}, how can you always be so cheerful?.
speak;SnakeGirl;Not always cheerful, but full of hope!|If {v:SnakeGirlName} feel down, {v:SnakeGirlName} sings louder!;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;I see.|I cannot let myself get down over this.|Must not loose hope.
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Monsters go roar, I go la~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;{v:SnakeGirlName}, are you not sad?|Those could've been your sisters.
speak;SnakeGirl;Not my sisters!|My family here!|You and all others!;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;...Of course, I was silly.|We are your family in the end I suppose.
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Happy family win the day, hip hip horray~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Almost there, la la fight on~!</></>;;;noir;;white
speak;SnakeGirl;End of fight, start of party song!;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;It's a little early to party, {v:SnakeGirlName}.|Let's end this war first.
speak;Ephraim;This part of the battle is over, but the final battle is up ahead...
speak;SnakeGirl;One more fight and battle end?;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;I hope so.|For all of our sakes.
speak;SnakeGirl;<yellow><wave>Battle end, then peaceful days with my friends!~!</></>;;;noir;;white

name: Talk_CyclopsBoy
_source: speak;Eirika;Great work out there, {v:CyclopsBoyName}!|I can't believe how strong you are!|I'm glad you're on our side!
speak;Eirika;Do the mountains remind you of home?
speak;CyclopsBoy;Home yes.|All hills home though!|Live all hills!;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Oh, I see.|I wonder if Cyclops wonder from mountain to mountain?
speak;Eirika;The gargoyles?|They didn't stand a chance against you, {v:CyclopsBoyName}.
speak;CyclopsBoy;Protect friends from sky beasts!.|No hurt!;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;It is pretty quiet here now that the fighting is done...|No wonder the villagers want to protect this quietness.|It does feel safe and calming.
speak;Eirika;Your shout is startling the troops, {v:CyclopsBoyName}...|Maybe lower your voice a little bit...
speak;Eirika;Easy, {v:CyclopsBoyName}.|We stopped them.|We do need to find the queen though.|Keep your eyes, er-um, eye out for her.
speak;CyclopsBoy;Hot sand!|Feet burn but fight good!;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;I can't imagine fighting barefoot...|How in the world are you able to handle this hot sand?
speak;CyclopsBoy;Heat no stop {v:CyclopsBoyName}!|Don't think, just fight!;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;If only it was so easy to stop thinking...
speak;CyclopsBoy;A dark place nearby...smells bad.|{v:CyclopsBoyName} angry!|Wanna smash!;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Stay with me—we’re almost done.|This is my home, please don't wreck anything...
speak;Eirika;The river is flowing fast...|Did Lyon make an escape through it?
speak;CyclopsBoy;River fast, but dark guy faster...;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;You did...|Were you ok with that?...
speak;CyclopsBoy;Heehee!|Smash fun!|{v:CyclopsBoyName} smash monsters all the time when young!;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;I see...|Well, I suppose that answers that question...
speak;Eirika;Yes, the night is almost over.|Then we can sleep...
speak;Eirika;Not yet...|You see that building there.|Hopefully our last fight is there.
speak;CyclopsBoy;Got it!|Let's fight!|Then we big hug everyone!;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Indeed, now be careful.|Don't want to have pull you out if you fall in.
speak;Ephraim;{v:CyclopsBoyName}...Please don't smash the boat.|You can smash the monsters, but not the boat.|I don't want to die at sea becuase of that.
speak;Ephraim;It's pretty quiet now.|Hope these villagers won't be mixed in the war anymore.|They don't deserve any more of this pain.
speak;Ephraim;I share in your confusion.|But we must stay calm.|There might be clues somewhere nearby.
speak;CyclopsBoy;Hot sand!|Feet burn but fight good!;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;I can't imagine fighting barefoot...|How in the world are you able to handle this hot sand?
speak;CyclopsBoy;Heat no stop {v:CyclopsBoyName}!|Don't think, just fight!;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;If only it was so easy to stop thinking...
speak;CyclopsBoy;A dark place nearby...smells bad.|{v:CyclopsBoyName} angry!|Wanna smash!;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;Stay with me—we’re almost done.|This is my home, don't wreck anything.
speak;Ephraim;The river is flowing fast...|Did Lyon make an escape through it?
speak;CyclopsBoy;River fast, but dark guy faster...;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;You did.|Were you ok with that?...
speak;CyclopsBoy;Heehee!|Smash fun!|{v:CyclopsBoyName} smash monsters all the time when young!;;;noir;;white
speak;Ephraim;I see...|Well, I suppose that answers that question.
speak;Ephraim;Yes, the night is almost over.|Then we can sleep.
speak;Ephraim;Not yet...|You see that building there.|Hopefully our last fight is there.
speak;CyclopsBoy;Got it!|Let's fight!|Then we big hug everyone!;;;noir;;white

name: Talk_HorseyGirl
_source: speak;Ephraim;You're still getting used to fighting alongside us, aren't you?|That's perfectly fine.|Take all the time you need.
speak;Ephraim;I know this is strange, but you are a good healer.|...Keep up the good work.
speak;Eirika;Oh!|Did I scare you?|I'm sorry, I didn't mean any harm...
speak;Eirika;Oh, she went hiding...|I hope I don't scare her...
speak;Eirika;Hello.|Looking at the ocean?|The ocean breeze feels wonderful, doesn't it?
speak;Eirika;Look how excited you are!|Ephraim told me your name is {v:HorseyGirlName}, is that right?
speak;Eirika;It's a pretty name {v:HorseyGirlName}.|Glad to finally have a moment to talk with you!
speak;Eirika;You're looking happy, {v:HorseyGirlName}.|Do you like it here?
speak;Eirika;The mountain range here is beautiful.|It streches on for so long...
speak;Eirika;Oh, you want me to join you for a stroll?|How lovely!|Yes, I can join you for a moment.
speak;Eirika;Are you restless here?|Your whole body is shaking...
speak;Eirika;Stay close to us...|We'll get through this together...
speak;Eirika;These bones...|Those look like...The Tarvos bones...
speak;Eirika;I'm....so sorry.|This must be hard for you...
speak;Eirika;It's ok...|We don't think of you as a monster...
speak;Eirika;Look at you!|You're practically glowing with pride!|You should be.|The way you moved around the battlefield was amazing!
speak;Eirika;Oh!|Thank you for the hug, he he!|You're in high spirits today!
speak;Eirika;{v:HorseyGirlName}, I know this may be hard, but can you heal the servents?|They are some injured and we need all the help we can get.
speak;Eirika;You got this?|I know you can do it!|If you have any issues, I will help you out.
speak;Eirika;I don't know how we survived...|We are lucky to have survived that...
speak;Eirika;No, you're right.|We got through this because we all fought together.
speak;Eirika;If you want, you can stay here too if you would like?
speak;Eirika;He he!|I guess that says it all!|Friends and family are always welcome here.|Welcome home, {v:HorseyGirlName}.
speak;Eirika;This darkness...|Does it bring back bad memories?...
speak;Eirika;Don't worry, you're free now...|Stay strong...|We'll get through this together...
speak;Eirika;You look you can barely stand, {v:HorseyGirlName}.
speak;Eirika;Find some shade.|We need to keep you both cool and have plenty of water in this climate.
speak;Eirika;Take care of yourself, {v:HorseyGirlName}.|We need you healthy.
speak;Eirika;You've been hard at work healing...|Are you planning on getting any rest?
speak;Eirika;Well, I trust your judgment.|Just don't push yourself too hard...
speak;Eirika;{v:HorseyGirlName}...we've come so far together.|When we first met, you could barely look me in the eye.
speak;Eirika;Thank you for joining our journey.|We are happy to have you with us.|The troops have really come to love you.|Now we here we are all this way, into the final battle...
speak;Eirika;No matter what happens next, you'll always be family to us.|Ride with pride, my friend.
speak;Ephraim;Looks like we will be here for the night.|Will that be ok with you?
speak;Ephraim;...I guess I'll take that as a yes.
speak;Ephraim;Um...|Just tap on my shoulder if I'm reading you correctly.
speak;Ephraim;Will this be your first time on a ship, {v:HorseyGirlName}?
speak;Ephraim;It will be ok.|...At least I hope it will be...|I'm not sure how a Tarvos will do on the sea.
speak;Ephraim;Hey, don't get mad at me!|Not like I've seen a Tarvos ride on a boat before!
speak;Ephraim;Can you not heal seasickness away?
speak;Ephraim;Mad again?!|Does it look like I know healing magic?!
speak;Ephraim;Back to your old self now that we're on solid ground?
speak;Ephraim;I know that look...|You're planning on charging me, aren't you?!
speak;Ephraim;I gotta get out of here quick...
speak;Ephraim;.....{v:HorseyGirlName}.|Do you think I could learn how to use a staff?
speak;Ephraim;You're right...|I have no apptitude there...
speak;Ephraim;Ah!|Ugh, I appreciate the hug, but I'll be ok...|You're squeezing to tight...
speak;Ephraim;{v:HorseyGirlName}?!|What's wrong?!|You're thrashing around like crazy!
speak;Ephraim;What in the world happened to her?...|I hope she will be ok...
speak;Ephraim;Are you doing better, {v:HorseyGirlName}?...|Back at Grado castle...|Was that were you escaped from?....
speak;Ephraim;I see...|No wonder you were so upset...
speak;Ephraim;It's ok.|You're free with us now.|We won't let that happen to you ever again...
speak;Ephraim;The walls here are the finest in Renais.|It feels strange, but good to be back home after all this time.|Would you like to stay here with us?|We could use a good healer like you here.
speak;Ephraim;That enthusiasm says it all.|Welcome home, soldier.
speak;Ephraim;This darkness...|Does it bring back bad memories?...
speak;Ephraim;Don't worry, you're free now...|Stay strong...|We'll get through this together...
speak;Ephraim;You look you can barely stand, {v:HorseyGirlName}.
speak;Ephraim;Find some shade.|We need to keep you both cool and have plenty of water in this climate.
speak;Ephraim;Take care of yourself, {v:HorseyGirlName}.|We need you healthy.
speak;Ephraim;You've been hard at work healing.|Are you planning on getting any rest?
speak;Ephraim;Well, I trust your judgment.|Just don't push yourself too hard.
speak;Ephraim;{v:HorseyGirlName}...you've exceeded every expectation.|From that shy rider to this confident warrior.
speak;Ephraim;Your courage in battle, your tactical awareness...|You've earned your place among Renais' finest cavalry.
speak;Ephraim;Ready for the final charge?|Then let's ride to victory together, soldier.

name: Talk_HorseyBoy
_source: speak;HorseyBoy;So, the battle is over, huh?|Now that was quite the fight.
speak;Ephraim;{v:HorseyBoyName}, looks like your holding up well.|This battle could've been a lot worse without you.
speak;HorseyBoy;Well, It was for sure wise you brought us along then.|My sister and I can hold our weight in a battle.
speak;Ephraim;Given your condition, I'd say that's a lof of weight you can handle.
speak;HorseyBoy;Ha! I suppose so!|Needless to say, I may not remember my past, but I can still fight.|Now if you'll excuse me, I'm going to tend to my business.
speak;HorseyBoy;So you must be the Ephraim's sister he was talking about.
speak;Eirika;Oh my!|This Tarvos just spoke!|You know of my brother?
speak;HorseyBoy;Yes, I have been fighting with him for the past while.|I was lead here by a strange red headed merchant.
speak;Eirika;I see...|I can't believe I'm talking with a Tarvos...|I didn't know Tarvos could talk...
speak;HorseyBoy;Am I truely a Tarvos?...|I have no memories of my past.|All I remember is the dark magic of some dark robed men...|The things they did to me and my sister...
speak;Eirika;Dark robed men?...|Oh my...|Can you not remember anything at all?

speak;HorseyBoy;No.|But I remember is the experiments...|Then one day there was an incident.|The red headed merchant freed my sister and I.|We ran.|And ran.|And ran until the next day.|The red headed merchant said we have a purpose.|She wanted us to help you brother.|Why, we do not know.|But maybe it will lead us to the truth of our past.
speak;Eirika;I see...|Very strange indeed...|Well, until then you can stay with us.|We can use your strength.
speak;HorseyBoy;Thank you, I can tell why Ephraim wanted to reunite with you now.
speak;Eirika;Have you seen the ocean before, {v:HorseyBoyName}?
speak;HorseyBoy;Maybe?|My memories are...cloudy.|But this feels familiar.
speak;Eirika;It's peaceful, isn't it? The sound of the waves.
speak;HorseyBoy;Sister would love this.|I'd imagine she would tapped her hooves to rhythms.|Like the waves...
speak;Eirika;Then let's stay here a moment.|Savor the peaceful times.
speak;HorseyBoy;The mountain range here.|It's quite a long stretch.
speak;Eirika;Do you like stretches of land like this, {v:HorseyBoyName}?
speak;HorseyBoy;Yes, it's hard to stay still in this body.|So having a lot of land to move around in helps.
speak;Eirika;Interesting.|Can you run all day then?
speak;HorseyBoy;If needs be, yes.|Though, I would prefer to take a more quiet gallop.|My sister prefers a nice, cozy gallop.|It's nice to feel the wind when you go like that.
speak;Eirika;How lovely!|That sounds like a pleasant way to spend time together.
speak;HorseyBoy;I can smell the same evil.|The same pain.|From those nights of the past...
speak;Eirika;But you escaped that place.|You're free now.
speak;HorseyBoy;Am I?|Sometimes I wonder if I'm still just running.|If I'll ever find what I'm looking for.
speak;Eirika;Freedom isn't a destination, {v:HorseyBoyName}.|It's the roads you choose to your future.
speak;HorseyBoy;These Tarvos...|This could have been me and my sister.|Were these my siblings?
speak;HorseyBoy;...Don't worry Eirika.|I will not falter.|Fighting for you and my sister is what keeps me going.|No matter if my opposition is my own kin.
speak;HorseyBoy;Come on!|Let's get a move on!
speak;Eirika;{v:HorseyBoyName}, I'm impressed your not letting yourself get down...
speak;HorseyBoy;Now this is a nice wide, open area.
speak;Eirika;Yeah, looks like a great place to gallop!
speak;HorseyBoy;You remembered what I said about galloping?|That makes me happy you remembered something so little.
speak;Eirika;Of course I remember!|I though it was cute!|Like a herd of wild horses!
speak;HorseyBoy;A herd!|Bwah ha ha!|Now that is quite the thought when you put it that way!|I suppose it looks odd to see Tarvos galloping around!
speak;Eirika;Oh!|I didn't mean it like that!|Though I must admit it is an interesting thought...
speak;HorseyBoy;Ugh, it's hard to move around here.
speak;Eirika;I suppose it is hard for our horses to moved around these tight corridors.
speak;HorseyBoy;It is!|I imagine they want to get out as soon as they can!|It's so stuffy!
speak;Eirika;Well, hopefully we will find the queen soon.|That is our top priority.
speak;HorseyBoy;You're right.|My apologies, Eirika.|I will continue my search.
speak;HorseyBoy;This blasted sand...|Can't move around and it gets stuck in my hooves...
speak;Eirika;All this sand does make it hard to travel...|For some reason, our magic users don't have much of a struggle...
speak;HorseyBoy;Bah, I wonder if those blasted dark robes would fare the same?
speak;Eirika;I'd imagine they wouldn't have a hard time like us.
speak;HorseyBoy;Another reason I would love to strike them down if I find them...
speak;Eirika;This is my home, {v:HorseyBoyName}.|What do you think?
speak;HorseyBoy;I never had a real home.|Just cages and experiments.
speak;Eirika;Then let this be your home too.|You've earned your place here.
speak;HorseyBoy;A home...|Sister and I used to dream about that.
speak;Eirika;Well, let's make that dream come true then, he he!
speak;HorseyBoy;Something's wrong here.|The air tastes of corruption.
speak;HorseyBoy;Dark magic...experiments...|It smells like those blasted dark robes.
speak;HorseyBoy;Whoever he was, the darkness has claimed him.|Like it tried to claim us.
speak;Eirika;The heat is harsh on you too, isn't it {v:HorseyBoyName}?
speak;HorseyBoy;My body isn't used to this climate.|The cages were always cold.
speak;Eirika;Here, rest in whatever shade we can find.|We'll take care of you.
speak;HorseyBoy;Sister always helped me when I felt weak.|I wouldn't have made it without her...
speak;Eirika;We're your family now.|Let us help you as she would.
speak;HorseyBoy;Before the experiments.|When we were just...normal.
speak;HorseyBoy;Running.|Just running free with her.|That's...that's all.
speak;Eirika;Do you think you were...Human before?
speak;HorseyBoy;Maybe?|...Does it even matter at this point?|I don't think we can go back.
speak;Eirika;You're right, it doesn't matter.|Because we care about who you are now.|And there is nothing wrong with that.
speak;Eirika;{v:HorseyBoyName}...we've traveled so far together.|Yet, I'm sorry we haven't found out much about your past...
speak;HorseyBoy;It's ok, I did found something I thought I'd lost forever.
speak;HorseyBoy;Family.|People who see me, not just the experiment.
speak;Eirika;You were always more than what they made you.|Now you're exactly who you're meant to be.
speak;HorseyBoy;I'm proud of who I've become.|I know my sister is too.
speak;Eirika;I believe that.|Now, are you ready to finish this?
speak;HorseyBoy;I'll never be more ready.|Let's blast these weaklings to the heavens.
speak;Ephraim;Are you sure you want to keep traveling with us, {v:HorseyBoyName}?
speak;HorseyBoy;Do you have a suggestion of somewhere better I could be?
speak;HorseyBoy;Then there is your answer.|Plus, I'd rather be fighting with you.|You know how to win a fight from what I've seen.
speak;Ephraim;I never pick a fight I can't win.
speak;HorseyBoy;Ha!|I have a feeling that's not gonna be the last time we'll be hearing that.
speak;HorseyBoy;The ocean...it's vast.|The complete opposite of that blasted cage.
speak;HorseyBoy;Some.|But also...this freedom feels amazing...|I've never seen so much open space.
speak;Ephraim;Well, enjoy it while you can.|We'll be fighting in close quarters soon enough.
speak;HorseyBoy;I'm ready.|Don't think a little water is gonna take me out.
speak;Ephraim;That's what I like to hear.
speak;HorseyBoy;No, but these blasted waves won't stop.|At least I've got four legs to keep me stable.
speak;Ephraim;Well, hopefully we will be landing soon.|Then we'll be back to stable ground.
speak;HorseyBoy;It helps to know this is temporary.|Though I hope the waves don't stay this bad.
speak;Ephraim;Everything bad is temporary if you're strong enough to outlast it.
speak;HorseyBoy;Solid ground!|Glad to have my hooves back on the ground.
speak;HorseyBoy;Much better!|This is what my hooves were made for!
speak;Ephraim;Good, I'll need you to put those hooves to good use.|Can you handle a charge?
speak;HorseyBoy;Just point me at the enemy, Ephraim.
speak;HorseyBoy;...That woman was strong, wasn's she?
speak;HorseyBoy;At least she died in conviction.
speak;HorseyBoy;I know you are bothered, Ephraim.|But don't lose.|Don't let your enemies take your freedom.
speak;Ephraim;....Right.|We'll make sure of that we don't lose, {v:HorseyBoyName}.
speak;Ephraim;{v:HorseyBoyName}?!|What are you doing?!|You're smashing up the place!
speak;HorseyBoy;I remember!|This blasted place!|The dark robes were here!|This is were my sister and I suffered!
speak;Ephraim;Calm down!|You might make the place collapse!
speak;HorseyBoy;Good!|I'm making sure there are no more hidden laboratories!|No more cages!|I will smash them all!
speak;Ephraim;I understand, but we can't risk a collapse yet!|Stand down, that's an order!
speak;HorseyBoy;Hmph!|Fine!|But I can't guarentee what happens if I find those cursed dark robes.
speak;Ephraim;If we find them, we'll crush them together then.
speak;HorseyBoy;I finally found the hidden labratory...|It's finally destroyed...
speak;Ephraim;I see...|How do you feel?|Can you finally let it go?
speak;HorseyBoy;...Maybe...|I'm not sure yet...|I can't be sure if they are truly gone...
speak;HorseyBoy;This castle is impressive.|Built to last.
speak;Ephraim;This is my home, {v:HorseyBoyName}.|What do you think?
speak;HorseyBoy;I've never had a real home.|Just cold stone cells.
speak;Ephraim;Well, you've got one now.|You've earned your place here through battle.
speak;HorseyBoy;A place to belong...|My sister and I always dreamed of that.
speak;Ephraim;Dreams can become reality if you fight hard enough for them.
speak;HorseyBoy;Dark magic this powerful...it's what those dark robes were trying to create.
speak;Ephraim;Lyon...my friend, what have they done to you?
speak;HorseyBoy;Whatever he was, the darkness consumed him.|Like it tried to consume us.
speak;Ephraim;Then we stop it here.|No more victims.
speak;HorseyBoy;Agreed.|I know the final darkness I have to smash.
speak;Ephraim;The heat is harsh, isn't it {v:HorseyBoyName}?
speak;HorseyBoy;My body wasn't made for this climate.|The experiments...|They kept us in cold, controlled environments.
speak;Ephraim;Then we adapt.|A good soldier learns to fight in any condition.
speak;HorseyBoy;Those are wise words there, Ephraim.|I guess that's why you're in charge.
speak;Ephraim;I've still got a lot to learn.|But we got this far, didn't we?
speak;HorseyBoy;I was trying to remember...what we were before.
speak;HorseyBoy;Running together.|Racing the wind.|Nothing else mattered.
speak;Ephraim;I see...|Once this is over, let's see if we can get you back to normal?
speak;Ephraim;{v:HorseyBoyName}...The final battle is coming up.|Prepared to fight against this upcoming darkness?
speak;HorseyBoy;I'm ready to smash it to pieces!|I'm going to smash these chains that hold me down!
speak;Ephraim;Good, just remember you are not alone.
speak;HorseyBoy;Yes, Ephraim.|The dark robes tried to make me a weapon.|But you helped me become something much more.
speak;Ephraim;Exactly.|The final battle awaits.|I'll give the charge order when we're ready.
speak;HorseyBoy;Good, I'll be in the front, waiting for the order.

name: Talk_BaelBaby
_source: speak;Eirika;I guess were are still pretty young.|Take a small rest, but we'll be departing soon.
speak;Eirika;Now that's some spirit right there!
speak;Eirika;The waterways here make you anxious, doesn't it?
speak;Eirika;You're not used to such unnatrual streams?|Don't worry, your legs are perfect for this.|See how your legs are long enough to reach the bottom?
speak;Eirika;Just go for it!|I bet you'll be a natural!
speak;Eirika;Your first time seeing the ocean?
speak;Eirika;It's quite something, isn't it?|So much water, stretching beyond what we can see.|Even creatures like you deserve to witness such beauty.

speak;Eirika;Thank you, {v:BaelBabyName}.|I didn't think we would have a quite the...|Unique addition to our army.|But I imagine you will do well in the mountains.|Let me know if you spot anything unusual!
speak;Eirika;Does the darkness bother you at all, {v:BaelBabyName}?
speak;Eirika;Well, the place we found you was pretty dark...|I suppose this wouldn't bother that much then.
speak;Eirika;I wish I could have that same resiliance...
speak;Eirika;You're...spinning silk over the fallen monsters?
speak;Eirika;Like burial shrouds...|They are your kin in a way...|Your kindness runs deeper than I ever imagined...
speak;Eirika;{v:BaelBabyName}!|You threw yourself in front of those arrows!|Your carapace is cracked...
speak;Eirika;You used your body as a shield to protect us?|Such selfless bravery...|Thank you, our amazing guardian...
speak;Eirika;Clearing away the rubble with your webs?
speak;Eirika;What a creatuve at moving heavy stones!|Keep searching.|Let me know if you find anything important.
speak;Eirika;Keeping watch of this area during our meeting?
speak;Eirika;Ok, just make sure you get some water soon.|This heat is quite something...
speak;Eirika;Huh, I guess this heat doesn't quite bother you.
speak;Eirika;This is my home, {v:BaelBabyName}.|What do you think?
speak;Eirika;You can sense the history in these ancient stones, can't you?|Perhaps you'd like to make a web here someday?|You've certainly earned a place in our family.
speak;Eirika;You sense it too, don't you?
speak;Eirika;The darkness surrounding Lyon...|It's making you restless.|Me too...
speak;Eirika;Even this extreme heat doesn't bother you?...
speak;Eirika;How does a Bael handle this heat with all that fur?...|I'm getting jealous...
speak;Eirika;Resting, little one?|Or are you thinking about something?
speak;Eirika;Our battle is almost over...|A night that felt so long...
speak;Eirika;Thank you for your help.|I hope these night battles won't be for much longer...
speak;Eirika;We've traveled so far together, haven't we?|You've shown me that friendship comes in the most unexpected forms.
speak;Eirika;Your loyalty, your courage, your gentle heart...|You're proof that goodness exists in all creatures.|I'm proud to call you my friend.
speak;Eirika;Whatever comes next, we face it together.|You'll always have a home with us, {v:BaelBabyName}.
speak;Ephraim;So you're the...spider ally Eirika mentioned.
speak;Ephraim;Hmm.|You're smaller than I expected.|But I suppose size doesn't determine fighting spirit.|Let's see what you're made of.|Well, for whatever a Bael is made of...
speak;Ephraim;Will this be your first time on a ship, {v:BaelBabyName}?
speak;Ephraim;Ha!|Even Baels get seasick, huh?|Don't worry, you'll get your sea legs soon enough.|Or...sea appendages, in your case.
speak;Ephraim;Focus on the horizon, not the waves.|Your multiple eyes might be making it worse.|Try closing a few of them.
speak;Ephraim;There you go.|You're tougher than you look.
speak;Ephraim;Feeling better now that we're on solid ground?
speak;Ephraim;Good to see you moving smoothly again.|That's the fighting spirit we need.|Ready to show our enemies what you can do?
speak;Ephraim;{v:BaelBabyName}?|Does death affect you differently than us?
speak;Ephraim;I guess that was a silly question...|Death claims us all I suppose...
speak;Ephraim;Efficient work clearing that rubble, {v:BaelBabyName}.|Your web-slinging makes quick work of heavy debris.
speak;Ephraim;Keep it up.|Let me know if you uncover anything useful.|Your thoroughness is commendable.
speak;Ephraim;Keeping watch of this area during our meeting?
speak;Ephraim;Ok, just make sure you get some water soon.|This heat is quite something...
speak;Ephraim;Huh, I guess this heat doesn't quite bother you.
speak;Ephraim;This is my home, {v:BaelBabyName}.|What do you think?
speak;Ephraim;You can sense the history in these ancient stones, can't you?|Perhaps you'd like to make a web here someday?|You've certainly earned a place in our family.
speak;Ephraim;You sense it too, don't you?
speak;Ephraim;The darkness surrounding Lyon...|It's making you restless.|Me too...
speak;Ephraim;Even this extreme heat doesn't bother you?...
speak;Ephraim;How does a Bael handle this heat with all that fur?...|I can't believe it...
speak;Ephraim;Resting, {v:BaelBabyName}?|Or are you thinking about something?
speak;Ephraim;Our battle is almost over.|A long night for sure
speak;Ephraim;Thank you for your help.|I hope these night battles won't be for much longer.
speak;Ephraim;We've traveled so far together, haven't we?|You've shown me that friendship comes in the most unexpected forms.
speak;Ephraim;Your loyalty, your courage, your brave heart.|You're proof that goodness exists in all creatures.|I'm proud to have you in my army.
speak;Ephraim;Whatever comes next, we face it together.|You'll always have a home with us, {v:BaelBabyName}.

name: Talk_GargoyleGirl
_source: speak;Eirika;{v:GargoyleGirlName}, you've been carrying supplies for everyone...
speak;Eirika;Wow...|Can't believe we are getting help from a gargoyle.
speak;Eirika;Well, you'll get used to it.|Friends take care of each other, {v:GargoyleGirlName}.
speak;Eirika;Are you afraid of the water, {v:GargoyleGirlName}?
speak;Eirika;Oh!|You're worried your stone body will be too heavy?|Here, let me teach you how to move carefully near water.
speak;Eirika;Of course!|See? Just like flying, it's about balance.|You're much more graceful than you think.
speak;Eirika;Your first time seeing the ocean, {v:GargoyleGirlName}?
speak;Eirika;It is beautiful, isn't it?|The way the sunlight dances on the waves...
speak;Eirika;Maybe when this is all over, you can explore to your heart's content.|The world has so much beauty to offer you.
speak;Eirika;Your eyes are so sharp from up there.|You've spotted danger for us so many times.
speak;Eirika;You care so much about everyone's safety.|Thank you for watching over us, {v:GargoyleGirlName}.
speak;Eirika;You're nothing like them, {v:GargoyleGirlName}.|They chose darkness, but you chose to help others.|That makes all the difference.
speak;Eirika;I see...|I don't have much knowledge of monsters...|But I believe you.|You are...truly remarkable, {v:GargoyleGirlName}.
speak;Eirika;{v:GargoyleGirlName}!|You shielded that soldier with your wings!
speak;Eirika;But they could have damaged your wings!|You risked your ability to fly...
speak;Eirika;You protected him like a mother protects her child...|What amazing selflessness, {v:GargoyleGirlName}.
speak;Eirika;You're moving those heavy stones so easily.|Looking for survivors?
speak;Eirika;Good point.|Need to make sure the queen didn't get caught up in the fighting.|Keep searching, {v:GargoyleGirlName}.|We'll look together.
speak;Eirika;That's good then.|I suppose heat doesn't bother one with rock skin, right?
speak;Eirika;No!|You're not ugly at all!|Don't think of anything like that!
speak;Eirika;This is my home, {v:GargoyleGirlName}.|What do you think?
speak;Eirika;A mountain nest?|That's...one way to describe it.
speak;Eirika;I see.|Yes, this is where our family gathers.|And you're part of that family now, {v:GargoyleGirlName}.
speak;Eirika;Absolutely.|This is your home too now.
speak;Eirika;You can sense the darkness surrounding Lyon...
speak;Eirika;Poison...|That darkness must be poisoning him...
speak;Eirika;The heat isn't affecting you here either, {v:GargoyleGirlName}?
speak;Eirika;You're so lucky...|I can't help but sweat here...
speak;Eirika;I at least can still fight in this condition.
speak;Eirika;You look troubled, {v:GargoyleGirlName}.|What's on your mind?
speak;Eirika;You are kind of like a mother, arn't you?|How is it being a mother?
speak;Eirika;Oh, {v:GargoyleGirlName}...|I'm certain she is happy.|You are everything she wants you to be.
speak;Eirika;{v:GargoyleGirlName}...look how far you've come.|You're such a beautiful warrior now.
speak;Eirika;And I've learned so much from you too.|Your gentle strength, your maternal love...|You've shown us all what true beauty looks like.
speak;Eirika;Never.|You're our guardian angel, {v:GargoyleGirlName}.|Ready to face whatever evil awaits us?
speak;Eirika;And we'll protect you too.|That's what families do.
speak;Ephraim;So you're the...winged ally Eirika mentioned.
speak;Ephraim;Well, actions speak louder than words anyway.|Let's see what you're capable of in battle.
speak;Ephraim;That's the spirit.|Prove yourself, and you'll have my respect.
speak;Ephraim;We'll be crossing it soon.|Think you can handle flying over all that water?
speak;Ephraim;Good attitude.|Your aerial support will be valuable on the seas.
speak;Ephraim;Even flying creatures get seasick, huh?|Try to stay focused on the horizon.|It helps with balance.
speak;Ephraim;Ha!|That's right.|You're adapting well for someone with wings instead of sea legs.
speak;Ephraim;Better now that we're back on solid ground?
speak;Ephraim;Good to see you recovered quickly.|Your resilience is impressive, {v:GargoyleGirlName}.
speak;Ephraim;I do remember Eirika said you were a mother.|Strange, but this is already strange as it is.|However, we are winning, so I'm not going to question it.|Ready to press our advantage?
speak;Ephraim;I wish it didn't have to end this way...
speak;Ephraim;You're clearing that debris with ease.|Looking for clues about what happened here?
speak;Ephraim;Always thinking of others first.|Your strength serves a good purpose, {v:GargoyleGirlName}.
speak;Ephraim;Exactly.|Keep it up.|I'll coordinate our search from here.
speak;Ephraim;Smart thinking.|Your aerial view gives us the best security.|I trust your vigilance.
speak;Ephraim;Right.|Alert us to any threats.|We're counting on you.
speak;Ephraim;This is my home, {v:GargoyleGirlName}.|Impressive, isn't it?
speak;Ephraim;Ha! A good comparison.|These walls have protected my family for generations.
speak;Ephraim;Good. Because this is your home now too.|You've earned your place here through battle.
speak;Ephraim;Through loyalty, courage, and protecting those who matter.|You've proven all of that.
speak;Ephraim;What in the world is this blasted darkness?...
speak;Ephraim;Is this heat is brutal on you, {v:GargoyleGirlName}?
speak;Ephraim;I see...|Well, I'm glad to have another soldier that can fight in this heat.
speak;Ephraim;I know I can too.|It takes a lot more than this to take me down.|Now, let's press forward.
speak;Ephraim;You look lost in thought, {v:GargoyleGirlName}.|What's on your mind?
speak;Ephraim;That fear means you care.|Channel it into strength.|We fight together, we survive together.
speak;Ephraim;{v:GargoyleGirlName}...you've proven yourself a true warrior.|Your courage in battle is matched only by your loyalty.
speak;Ephraim;And I've learned from your protective instincts.|You fight not for glory, but for those you care about.|That's the mark of a true soldier.
speak;Ephraim;And we'll always protect you.|Ready for our final battle together?
speak;Ephraim;That's the fighting spirit!|Let's finish this war.

name: Talk_Moulder
_source: speak;Eirika;May I ask what you are doing, Father Moulder?
speak;Moulder;.....I am praying for the souls that were lost this day.
speak;Moulder;You are a kind soul, Princess.|I'm very thankful to be traveling with you.
speak;Eirika;I'm happy to be traveling with you, too...
speak;Eirika;Were you able to figure out anything about those odd wolves?
speak;Moulder;Not a thing...|I went to investigate their corpses, but they've seemed to turn to ash...|Ash and bones, that is.
speak;Moulder;Please be careful, Princess.|Dark things are afoot, here...
speak;Eirika;Father Moulder...|You don't think the last battle's wolves were monsters, do you?
speak;Moulder;I see no other explanation.|How those bandits were able to capture such beasts is beyond me...
speak;Eirika;You don't think...|If they could, who else could be weaponizing these horrors?...
speak;Moulder;I pray that no else has their hands on these abominations...|For the good of all Magvel...
speak;Eirika;Are there any injured civilians, Moulder?
speak;Moulder;A couple, but it's nothing I can't tend to.
speak;Eirika;That's good.|They don't deserve what we brought upon them...
speak;Moulder;It's hardly what we've brought, Princess.|And regardless, blame will do us no good.|We must focus on helping the innocent...
speak;Eirika;Yes...|Forgive me, Father, you are right.
speak;Moulder;I'll be fine.|I'm just appalled that Grado would stoop so low...|Taking innocent villagers hostage...
speak;Eirika;I'm shocked, too...|This isn't right at all...
speak;Eirika;Have you learned anything from the locals, Father Moulder?
speak;Moulder;Be of good cheer, Princess.|We still live, and that is the important part.
speak;Eirika;How does the water look here?
speak;Moulder;It looks like it doesn't need any purification.|It should be good to drink.
speak;Eirika;That's good news.|It'll help for setting up camp, won't it?.
speak;Moulder;Too true, Princess!|There's nothing like good water to keep up our spirits.
speak;Moulder;Oh, I just was thinking of old times...
speak;Moulder;King Hayden and I would have discussions by the sea back in Frelia.|It was so long ago. Time sure does fly by...
speak;Eirika;Well, I think you still have plenty more years behind you, Father!
speak;Moulder;Ha ha!|I hope you're right on that, Princess!
speak;Moulder;Nothing too bad, but it looks like they've been roughed up.|They are quite afraid for their futures...
speak;Eirika;I see...|I wonder... Can we do anything to bring them hope?...
speak;Moulder;Offering your smile and kindness is enough, Princess.|It's enough...
speak;Eirika;...I hope so.|Thank you, Father Moulder...
speak;Eirika;Is the area secure now, Father Moulder?
speak;Moulder;Yes, my wards should keep out any evil that might come our way.|We'll be able to get some sleep tonight.
speak;Eirika;That's good...|The last thing we need tonight is more monsters.|Thank you, Father.
speak;Moulder;You're always welcome, Princess.|Leave our safety to me.
speak;Eirika;Is anyone in the village injured?
speak;Moulder;Doesn't look like it.|Their houses had some protection wards on them.
speak;Eirika;That's a relief to hear.|Thank you, Father Moulder.
speak;Moulder;I'm just as thankful and relieved as you are, Princess.
speak;Eirika;Father Moulder, how are we looking for supplies?
speak;Moulder;We should last for a while.|Though, the troops ought to be getting hungry by now...
speak;Eirika;You're right!|I must admit, I'm getting pretty hungry myself...
speak;Moulder;You and everyone else!|I'll see to it we're well-fed, then!
speak;Eirika;How are the castle servants holding up, Father Moulder?
speak;Moulder;Fortunately, none of them were killed.|There are some that were injured.|I am tending to them now.
speak;Eirika;Did any of them see where the Queen was taken?
speak;Moulder;They did not...|They were all taken hostage beforehand.
speak;Eirika;I see...|Well, continue tending to them.|They deserve our care, too.
speak;Eirika;How is this village, Father Moulder?..
speak;Moulder;It was far too late for us to do anything...
speak;Moulder;That snake, Valter...|He was brutal. Heartless|These poor villagers...
speak;Eirika;Father Moulder, are any of the castle servants injured?
speak;Moulder;No, it looks like most of them were dismissed quite a while ago.|However, those that remain are in low spirits.
speak;Eirika;What kind of trials did Orson put them through?...
speak;Moulder;...They will not say.|I would say the scars are clear, however...
speak;Eirika;Moulder, I pray we've not burdened you too heavily, lately...

speak;Moulder;Princess...|It is my duty to heal others.|It will be my duty until the day I die.|And I will do it with no complaints.|Don't let your thoughts weigh you down.|I will do my best here, so you don't have to worry.
speak;Eirika;Thank you, Moulder.|I guess I'm overthinking things right now...
speak;Moulder;I understand, Princess.|Take things one at a time, don't let yourself be overwhelmed.
speak;Eirika;That's good advice, Moulder... I'll do just that.
speak;Eirika;Moulder, are you okay?|You look strained...
speak;Moulder;...I'll be fine...|I'm trying to repel the poisonous gas strewn about the area.|It takes some concentration to do so...
speak;Eirika;Wow...|That must be so difficult...|Thank you for keeping us safe, Moulder.
speak;Eirika;Are you ready to rest, Moulder?|You have been up for so long.
speak;Moulder;I will be alright, Princess.|When you get to my age, losing sleep doesn't affect you as much.|I can go on as long as I am needed.
speak;Eirika;You're not that old, Moulder...|You still have some spirit left in you, right?
speak;Moulder;I certainly hope so!|At least, for as long as you all depend on me.
speak;Eirika;I don't know where we would be without you, Father.
speak;Moulder;Yes, I'm praying for everyone's protection.|That building is flooded with a dark aura.|I want to make sure we come back safely.
speak;Eirika;Thank you, Moulder...|I feel safer with you in our army.|I think I should say a prayer as well.
speak;Moulder;You're welcome, Princess.|May the favor of the Divine Ones always be with us.|Till the end.
speak;Ephraim;Father Moulder, right?|Thank you for joining us.|I heard from the troops you're a great man of faith.
speak;Moulder;Prince Ephraim, it is an honor.|I only do as divine guidance leads me to do.|I hope that I can save the lives of those around me.
speak;Ephraim;Well, if you need anything to fulfill your duty, let me know.|My troops are in your hands.
speak;Moulder;Just a few, and it's largely shock from the battle.|Nothing I can't fix.
speak;Ephraim;Good, I'll let you see to them, then.|I trust they are in good hands.
speak;Ephraim;You're destroying the bones of the monsters, right?|What's your progress on that?
speak;Moulder;It'd be easier with fire, Prince...|But since we're on a boat, I've only my light magic to aid me.|It should take a couple more hours.
speak;Ephraim;Understood.|See that we get that taken care of.
speak;Ephraim;Moulder, I know we just landed, but may I ask a favor?
speak;Moulder;Yes, Prince Eprhaim.|I trust your task is very important.
speak;Ephraim;It is.|I need you to use any pure water we have, and bless the villages.|They've suffered enough, between the monsters, and Grado...
speak;Moulder;Understood.|I will see that peace is brought upon them quickly.
speak;Ephraim;...Moulder...|Could we have saved General Selena?|If we'd gotten to her sooner, then surely...
