speak;Myrrh;I'm....fine...|As long as I have my Dragonstone, I'll be ok...

name: Talk_Syrene
_source: speak;Syrene;Oh, you know of my sister?|I am Syrene, Vanessa's older sister.

speak;Eirika;Oh!|My apologies, you look so similar that I mistook you for your sister.|But, I am very happy to meet you!|I am Princess Eirika of Renais.|We appreciate having Vanessa with us.|She is a mighty and beautiful warrior.|I imagine you are the same!
speak;Syrene;Oh!|The Princess of Renais!|It's an honor to meet you!|I'm happy to hear that about my sister!|I hope to catch up with her and her journey.
speak;Eirika;I'm glad you two are finally reunited.|Please, go ahead and spend some time with her!|You both deserve it.
speak;Syrene;Thank you Princess!|I'm happy to work with you from now on!
speak;Syrene;Oh, you know of my sister?|I am Syrene, Vanessa's older sister.
speak;Eirika;I see...|I don't know how to tell you this...
speak;Syrene;It's ok, I can tell from your eyes...|We are in war...|I've prepared myself if this were to happen...
speak;Eirika;I see...|She was a fantastic warrior...|She died with honor...
speak;Syrene;Vanessa...|Thank you...|I can at least be in peace knowing she died with honor...
speak;Syrene;May you rest in peace, Vanessa...
speak;Syrene;Nothing much.|Just dirt, lava, and smoke.|Though, I would rather see that than monsters.
speak;Eirika;I agree.|Well, thank you for your assistance, Syrene.|I know it must take time getting used to fighting in a different army.
speak;Syrene;No worries there, Princess.|I will be able to fight with no issues.|I will be happy to demonstrate the might of Frelia!
speak;Eirika;He he!|I'll hold you to your word then!
speak;Eirika;Looks like your turn for guard duty is up, Syrene.
speak;Syrene;Understood.|I will make sure no one gets past my watchful eye.
speak;Eirika;Good.|You guarding the skies will bring our troops some reassurance.
speak;Syrene;The skies will be safe as long as I am up there.
speak;Eirika;I know we haven't fought together for too long, but I'm glad you have been with us, Syrene.|You've been a great soldier.
speak;Syrene;Thank you Princess.|I hope to give more than one hundred percent of my strength to make up for the fact that I haven't been fighting as long.
speak;Eirika;Don't push yourself too hard, Syrene.|I don't want to lose you so close to the end.
speak;Syrene;Don't worry, Princess.|We will win this, together!
speak;Syrene;Oh, you know of my sister?|I am Syrene, Vanessa's older sister.

_source: speak;Eirika;We've come to aid you.|You must be exhausted.|Please fall back and rest.|We'll take care of these dogs

speak;Eirika;If that's how you want it.|Let's go then.
speak;Innes;I would give you my thanks.|You, the princess of Renais, came to my aid...|...I am in your debt.

name: Talk_Civ1
_source: speak;Selena;Good job on clearing out those bandits, Erina.|If I didn't have to leave so soon, I would've made short work of them.
speak;Eirika;Thank you...|I don't want to see anymore innocent lives lost.
speak;Selena;I will take my leave now.|I hope I'm wrong, and I never see you again.
speak;Selena;Good job on clearing out those bandits...|Wait a moment. Who are you?|You aren't from one of the neighboring towns, are you?|And your weapons give you away...|You're no peasant.
speak;Eirika;I am Er...|My name is Erina.{br}I'm a mercenary.
speak;Selena;A mercenary named Erina, is it?|There's more to you than that, I feel.|But don't worry--it's none of my business.|I haven't told you who I am yet, have I?
speak;Selena;I am Selena, a general in Grado's army.
speak;Selena;Right. Well...|Again, good job.|The destruction would have been far worse without you.
speak;Eirika;Thank you...|I don't want to see anymore innocent lives lost.
speak;Selena;I will take my leave now.|I hope I'm wrong, and I never see you again.

name: Talk_Civ2
_source: speak;Woman2;Ohhh, if only I could see that man again...
speak;Eirika;That man?|If I may, what did this man look like?
speak;Woman2;Oh, he had the most beautiful red hair!|And such a stylish hat!|It looked so rough, but so regal!
speak;Woman2;Oh, only if we had an arena here...|He said he was looking for one.|Said something about needing some money to pay off a debt.
speak;Woman2;Yeah, said the elixir he gave me was gonna pay it off.|But he told me to give to someone else in need instead.
speak;Woman2;Ohhhh, I want to see him again!|Please come back soon!

name: Talk_Civ3
_source: speak;Man3;Thank you again for saving us!|We're forever in your debt!
speak;Eirika;No need for thanks, it was the right thing to do.
speak;Man3;You bring hope to this old man...|We will remember this good deed.

_source: speak;Bazba;Hmmmm....|They are tougher than I thought.|I might need to unleash the beasts on them...|Better get them ready.

name: T1_Tutorial
_source: speak;Anna;Keep your eye out for villages!

speak;Anna;They will need to be visited in order to protect them from bandits!|They may even give you rewards like items, weapons, or maybe someone will join your cause!|Get there quickly because Bandits can destroy the villages.|You'll then lose any reward you could've gotten from them!;;;;6

speak;Anna;Here are some tips to help make the most out of the pair up mechanic!|For this example we have poor Ross and Garcia just out of reach by normal walking means.|Fortunately, we have Vanessa here!;;;;6

speak;Anna;If we pair up Eirika with Vanessa we can get across the mountains!|Then you can switch to Eirika with the <red>"Switch"</> command and talk with Ross and recruit him Turn 1!|Here is just one example of what pair up can do to get units to places they normally can't.|See what you can come up with!;;;;6

name: T2_Tutorial
_source: speak;Anna;Also keep your eyes out for <red>Armories or Vendors!</>

speak;Anna;They will have weapons or items available to buy for your army!|They will cost Gold to buy them, so choose carefully!|Each Armory or Vendor has different items for sale, so keep your eye out for a new one.|After you beat the chapter, you can always shop from any Armory and Vendor that was in the chapter from the world map.|So don't be afraid because you'll never lose access to any shops!;;;;6

name: T3_Tutorial
_source: speak;Anna;Ross is a special type of unit.|He is a <red>"Trainee"</> unit.

speak;Anna;They start off very weak, but have great potential!|They promote at level 11 and cannot get BEXP until they promote at that point.|Fortunately, they are quick to level up!|They have a lot of potential promotion paths, so try and see what is fun to you!;;;;6

name: Colm_Select_Tutorial
_source: speak;Anna;Colm has a special item in his inventory called a <red>Magic Key.</>|It allows him to open chests from afar!|It restores uses between chapters, so don't be afraid to use it!|Also, one thing to note is that <red>units will unpair from their partner if they are paired up when opening a chest.</>|So keep that in mind!;;;;6

name: Talk_Civ1
_source: speak;OldMan1;...So our little Lute is finally leaving, huh?
speak;Eirika;Yes, she seems to want to go with Artur on our journey.|Her knowledge should hopefully be an asset to us.
speak;OldMan1;Of course she will be!|She is a genius, after all!|She was raised in the village of the most magically gifted in all Magvel!
speak;Eirika;I see...|Well we look forward to her efforts.
speak;OldMan1;Good!|As the most gifted old man in this village, I can't recommend her enough!|She will save Magvel in her sleep!
speak;Eirika;...Ok?|Well, thank you, and I will excuse myself now...
speak;OldMan1;Go Lute!|Show the world your knowledge!|You are the smartest!!!

name: Talk_Civ2
_source: speak;Man1;Were you able to knock down that snag?|I hope that tool was able to knock it down.
speak;Eirika;Thank you, though...|It is a little perplexing, trying to knock down a snag with a warhammer...
speak;Man1;What do you mean?|Just give it a good whack, and knock it clear down!
speak;Eirika;I suppose, but a warhammer is a little bit too much for me right now...

speak;Man1;Hmmmm...|You might have a point there...|Well, give it to someone big, then!|Ha ha ha!|I had a buddy who used to be a <red>Pirate</> that could use it well!|He also had a buddy who rode <red>dragons</> that could use it well too!
speak;Eirika;I will probably do that for now.|Maybe someday I can use it, but not right now.

name: Axe_Fairy
_source: speak;???;Oh, beautiful maiden...|Thank you so much for clearing out those vile monsters...|They were corrupting this area I love so much.;top
speak;Eirika;Oh my!|Umm...You're welcome?|We're glad those monsters are gone too...

speak;???;In return for your brave deed, I wish to give you a blessing.|But there is one more test, to make sure you are truly worthy.|Please answer my question...|Which one of these axes is yours?|This gold axe, or this silver axe?...|I will return to you whichever axe is yours...;top
choice;Axe;Which axe did you drop?;Gold Axe,Silver Axe,I didn't drop either axe
speak;???;Oh.....|How disappointing.|I hoped you were truly worthy of this blessing.|One must not tell lies...|You will be gravely punished for telling such a big lie.;top
speak;Eirika;Why did I lie?...|Ephraim would be so disappointed in me...
speak;???;Oh.....|How disappointing.|I hoped you were truly worthy of this blessing.|One must not tell lies...|You will be punished for telling a lie.;top
speak;Eirika;Why did I lie?...|Ephraim would be so disappointed in me...
speak;???;Oh!|You are as honest as you are beautiful!|This makes me so happy!|Let me reward you for your honesty!;top
speak;Eirika;Wow!|I feel so much stronger!|What a wonderful blessing I've stumbled upon!

name: Sketchy
_source: speak;Colm;Easy there, Princess!|He barely got two feet out before I got it back!
speak;Eirika;Oh, Colm!|Thank you so much!|We would have lost all our money if he got away!
speak;Colm;Heh!|That'd suck, wouldn't it?|Rather lucky that I was here, then!
speak;Eirika;Yeah, it's our lucky day indeed!|He he!
alert;Eirika and Colm's LCK growths has increased by 15%!
speak;Eirika;All of our money is gone...

name: Drain
_source: choice;PullLever;Pull the lever? (<red>Will skip most of chapter</>);Yes,No
speak;Narrator;{v:HorseyGirlName} points aggressively at a lever.;;;narration_top
speak;Narrator;{v:HorseyGirlName} aggressively motions to take cover.;;;narration_top
speak;{unit};Ok!|I found the lever!|Everyone take cover!
speak;Zonta;What in the world happened?!|Where did all that water come from?!|<red>Now this throne is all wet a mess!</>|You!|Ephraim, you did this, didn't you?!
speak;Ephraim;Correct.|We got some great info and now we are here to take over this castle.
speak;Zonta;Grrrrr!...|Well, I'm still here!|You'll have to get through me first!

name: Talk_Civ1
_source: speak;Villager Boy 1;Glad to see the fog cleared up!|It sure makes it hard to get stuff done with it around!
speak;Eirika;Indeed.|Does it get foggy around here often?
speak;Villager Boy 1;Yeah! It's been happening more and more lately, too.|I wonder if it has something to do how many spiders keep showing up here...
speak;Eirika;There are even more spiders?|That can't be a good sign...
speak;Villager Boy 1;Yeah, probably not...|We've got to do something about them soon.|They're becoming quite a problem.

name: Talk_101
_source: speak;Villager Man;I'm saved...|I can't believe it...
speak;Eirika;How did you end up in this situation?|Did Grado kidnap you?
speak;Villager Man;Please...|Just leave me alone.|I just want you to go away...

name: Talk_Anna
_source: speak;Anna;...Can you hear me, Dev?|Hello?|Is your communication stone working?|Dev, I can hear you now.|...This is Anna 8L, ready to give my status report.|I'm here in Magvel L and things are...Interesting...|How are things going on your end?|.....You're monitering adjustments?|Huh, I see.|No wonder things are very...different here.|.....Tell me about it...|Yeah, I got in contact with this world's Eirika.|Got her the Master Seal.|.....Uh huh, I'll keep my eye out.|I don't know why, but <red>something feels off</>.|.....Sure, this Magvel has a lot of power flowing through.|But it feels...<red>Unnatural...</>

speak;Anna;.....I'm not crazy!|You're the one who sent me to this weird Magvel!|I almost spilled some top secrets!|I could've changed <red>history</> thanks to your little prank!|Well, whatever.|I'll let you know if I notice anything dangerous.|....Alright, I understand.|Bye.
speak;Eirika;What was that red headed merchant doing here?

name: Talk_102
_source: speak;Woman2;Please, just give me a minute...|I was so scared.

name: Talk_103
_source: speak;Eirika;It's ok little one, everything will be ok...

name: Talk_Civ1
_source: speak;Man1;Aw, man...|I really wanted to catch that woman dancing before she left.|She was so beautiful...
speak;Man1;Yeah, didn't you see her?!|She had such a beautiful dance!|I could watch for hours!|Oh.... I pray she comes back again soon...

name: Talk_Civ2
_source: speak;Man2;Thanks for getting rid of those Grado soldiers!|I'll feel a lot better walking around town, knowing they won't bother me!
speak;Eirika;It makes me sad, knowing that things have gotten this bad...
speak;Man2;C'mon, lass, cheer up!|We're free now!|Now if we could just get rid of Grado forever...|Ha ha ha!|Maybe someday!

name: Talk_Civ3
_source: speak;OldMan1;Ohhh...|Please make sure to read that old book...|My techniques must not be lost...
speak;Eirika;Oh dear...|I'll be sure to give it a read soon, sir!
speak;OldMan1;Oh, thank you, young lass...|It soothes my worrysome heart to hear that...

name: Talk_Civ4
_source: speak;Woman1;Ugh...|That silly girl...|She left in a hurry again, didn't she?!
speak;Woman1;Yes, I am the owner of this house.|I have a tenant that I let stay, but she always leaves it in such a mess!|I can't stand it anymore!|She is such a klutz!
speak;Eirika;Huh...|I hope she will be ok, then...

name: Natasha_Multi_Target_Tutorial
_source: speak;Anna;There are certain weapons that can target multiple enemies.|For example, Natasha's Frost Wand here can <red>select up to 2 enemies.</>|An item will tell you in the description if you can select multiple targets.|There are some weapons that let you <red>select the same target multiple times.</>|So keep an eye out.|Also, another thing to note is that <red>enemies cannot retaliate against multi-target attacks.</>|So make most of it!;;;;6

name: Talk_Civ1
_source: speak;Villager Man 7;Here's another thing I've heard about Tirado.|I've heard that he hates to lose.|If things look dicey, he gets real desperate.|You should probably stop him as soon as you can, before he does anything bold.
speak;Eirika;I see...|Thank you for the information.

name: Talk_Civ2
_source: speak;Villager Old Woman 1;I'm so sorry I was asleep.|I wish I was there so I could give you more information...
speak;Villager Old Woman 1;If I hear anything else while you're around, I will let you know!

name: RecruitAmeliaEirika
_source: speak;Eirika;Are you from around here?|You should find someplace to hide.|These men are after me.|It's not safe.
speak;Amelia;I'm a Grado soldier.|I'm here to stop the princess of Renais...
speak;Amelia;And you're Princess Eirika?|But the commander said Eirika's a cruel and merciless fiend...
speak;Eirika;What?|No, I'm...|...I don't know what Grado's officers have been telling you, but...|Our two countries are at war, so I suppose they can say what they want.
speak;Amelia;...Mistress Eirika...|I, uh, I surrender.|I won't fight you.

speak;Amelia;I became a soldier because I admired General Duessel's sense of honor.|But the generals have been very opposed to this war from the beginning...|And now I see you, and you look so sad about all of this.|I don't know what's right anymore.|I'm just a soldier, but I want to decide for myself.|I want to understand the truth myself, to see it with my own eyes.
speak;Eirika;...I see.|So...does this mean you're coming with us?|I suppose I should ask your name then.

name: Talk_Civ1
_source: speak;Man1;Did that guy finally leave?|He paid me a pretty penny to hide in my house for a while.|I was afraid he was going to trash the place!
speak;Eirika;He... Paid you? To hide in your house?|What an odd thing to do...

speak;Man1;I agree, but he gave a lot of money...|He seemed really desperate to get away from someone.|There was a beautiful young lady yelling really loudly for a...|I believe she said Rennac...|I wonder?...

name: Talk_Civ2
_source: speak;Villager Man;Are you guys finally done?
speak;Villager Man;Good!|Now, get out of here!|Take your problems away from us normal folk!

name: Talk_Civ1
_source: speak;Man1;You might have saved Carcino for one more day...|But I fear for our future...|Klimt isn't going to live for that much longer, after all.|Are we just going to have another old, dying man lead us once he is dead?
speak;Man1;Well, we better get our stuff together, or I fear we're not long for this world...

name: Talk_Civ2
_source: speak;Woman2;Thank you so much for getting rid of Pablo!|Elder Klimt has treated us far better than he ever would...
speak;Eirika;Has he? What did Pablo do to you?
speak;Woman2;Oh, he was awful!|When the council voted for cruel and greedy laws, it was always his doing!|Why, they say he'd hire thugs to silence his critics through force...
speak;Eirika;How awful!|A man like that, ruling Carcino single-handedly...|I pray the council will flourish for lack of him.
speak;Woman2;Indeed!|I only hope we can undo the damage he wrought upon us...

name: Talk_Civ3
_source: speak;Villager Man;You saved that Prince Innes, didn't you?|He would be a valuable asset to your army.|That is, if you were worth his time to begin with.|Now, get out of here!|I've got a lot of work to do!

name: Ch.10ABaseConvo1
_source: speak;Natasha;Yes, I am Natasha.|Is there something I can do for you?
speak;Amelia;Yes, my name is Amelia.|Princess Eirika informed me that you're from Grado, too!
speak;Natasha;Oh!|You're from Grado too?!|Oh, how wonderful it is, to have another woman from Grado here!
speak;Amelia;Yay!|Everyone here has been so kind so far, but it's nice to have someone from home!|What part of Grado are you from?
speak;Natasha;I'm from Serafew, actually!|Although, I've served as a cleric in the Imperial Temple for the longest time...
speak;Amelia;Wow, you worked up there?...|No wonder you have such pretty robes!|Every time I've dropped by, I've always been helped by clerics like you!|So I've gotta thank you, really!
speak;Natasha;Oh! You're quite welcome, Amelia!|We worked so hard there to help the people...|...Before...
speak;Natasha;...Never you mind.|Your gratitude is appreciated, regardless!
speak;Amelia;Oh!|I just had a wonderful idea!|Why don't I cook us up a Grado dinner?|A little taste of home!
speak;Natasha;Goodness, are you certain?|It's awfully kind of you, but I feel as though I should handle it...

speak;Amelia;Well, I'm from up in the mountains! I can surprise you!|And I think you deserve to be treated, for being so nice!|...Though, it'd be lovely to cook with you...|So, hey, let's do it! Yeah!
speak;Natasha;He he! You're far too kind, Amelia. It would be lovely indeed...

name: Ch.10ABaseConvo2
_source: speak;Colm;Alright, now that the Princess is here, we can settle this.
speak;Eirika;So, what's so important that I have to be here?|We've got important things to do, you know!
speak;Joshua;This won't take long, don't worry.|I just want to prove to him that I'm faster.
speak;Colm;No way!|I'm totally faster than you!|Right, Princess?
speak;Colm;Well, we'll need to race, then!|That's why you're here!|Joshua and I will race, and we want you to be the judge!
speak;Joshua;Yep, even though we already know I'll win.|You ready, Colm?
speak;Colm;I'm ready to beat you and prove I'm the fastest!
speak;Eirika;Oh, all right...|On your marks....|Get set...|And.....Go!
speak;Colm;Nah, I totally won that one! Right?!
speak;Joshua;No, it was clearly me! Right?!
speak;Colm;Ha!|I told you I'm the fastest, Joshua!
speak;Joshua;Bah, you just caught me at a bad time.|I'll show you that I'm the fastest another day!
speak;Colm;Ha ha!|I'll take on your challenge, anytime, anywhere!
alert;Colm's SPD growth has increased by 15!
speak;Joshua;I told you I was the fastest, little man.
speak;Colm;Grrrr...|Just you wait, Joshua!|I'll be faster than you soon!
speak;Joshua;Ha!|I'd like to see you try!
alert;Joshua's SPD growth has increased by 15!

name: Ch.10ABaseConvo3
_source: speak;Gilliam;Good morning, Kyle.|Here for guard duty?
speak;Kyle;Correct.|Looks like we're both on guard duty this morning.
speak;Gilliam;Good to have you.|By the way, your armor looks rather shiny today.
speak;Kyle;Yeah, I had extra time to polish my armor this morning.|Your armor is looking quite shiny as well.
speak;Gilliam;Thank you.|I take pride in my armor.|I make sure it's good to go in any occasion.

speak;Kyle;That's very admirable, Gilliam.|Say, what do you do to try to mitigate magical attacks?|I have a hard time dealing with those, truthfully.|Even the most pristine armor doesn't do much against spells...
speak;Gilliam;I'll be honest, Kyle...|I have a hard time against magical attacks as well.
speak;Kyle;I see...|Maybe we can see if Lute can teach us anything?
speak;Gilliam;Hmm...|Yeah, she might be able to help.
speak;Kyle;Wait one minute.|I'll go get her.
speak;Lute;You two want to know how to resist the arcane?
speak;Gilliam;...Well, we want to resist magic attacks.|Anything that you could teach us would be very helpful.

speak;Lute;That's what I... Nevermind.|I have been wanting to test something recently...|Yes, it could work!|If one is shocked by the magical tentacles of a Mogall enough, then surely...|Wait right there, you two. I will retrieve them.
speak;Kyle;I think this may have been a mistake.
alert;Gilliam and Kyle's RES growths have increased by 15!

name: Ch.10ABaseConvo4
_source: speak;Forde;Heh, heh, heh...|Well, this is quite different from our usual marching routine.
speak;Forde;Princess Eirika's command is...|how should I put it?|Less rigid than Prince Ephraim's.
speak;Forde;Not at all.|Prince Ephraim would have us drilling from sunrise to sunset.|Princess Eirika seems to understand we're not just soldiers, but people.
speak;Forde;Prince Ephraim's orders were like his lance.|Sharp, precise, unrelenting.|Princess Eirika's are more like a gentle guide.
speak;Franz;You sound like you're starting to appreciate her leadership!
speak;Forde;Hah!|I've been in enough armies to know there's more than one way to lead.
speak;Franz;Prince Ephraim trusts her completely.|And she's proven herself in every battle.
speak;Forde;True enough.|Her strategy back in Renvall was quite impressive.
speak;Franz;That battle did go pretty smoothly, didn't it?|Battles aside, I'm just glad we're together again, brother.|Your experience means so much to me.
speak;Forde;I agree!|As your brother, someone has to keep you out of trouble.
speak;Franz;I feel like that's been more my job lately...
alert;Franz and Forde's support level has increased!

name: Ch.10ABaseConvo5
_source: speak;Tana;Father Moulder...|Look at the beauty of the ocean...|Oh, how I miss Frelia...|Do you miss Frelia as much as I do, Father Moulder?
speak;Moulder;The sea winds of our homeland are not easily forgotten, Princess.
speak;Tana;I can almost smell the salt from our coastline...|The morning mists over Castle Frelia....
speak;Moulder;Our kingdom may be far, but our hearts remain close to home.
speak;Tana;I wonder how Innes is managing...|I hope he is doing ok...|I bet he must be worried about our people as well.
speak;Moulder;Prince Innes is strong.|He understands our duty extends beyond our shores.
speak;Tana;That is true...|If there is anyone who can handle himself, it's my brother.|That aside, Princess Eirika needs us now!|Our friendship means more than our homesickness.
speak;Moulder;Precisely!|The bonds of friendship transcend borders.
speak;Tana;Though I must admit...|Sometimes, I dream of the lighthouse at Frelia's southern coast...|The way the waves crash against the rocks...
speak;Moulder;Ho ho ho!|Your imagination is as vivid as ever, Princess.
speak;Tana;But we're making a difference here!|Helping our friends is more important than missing home.
speak;Moulder;Your spirit gives me hope.|Princess Eirika is fortunate to have such loyal allies.|I feel like she could reunite all of Magvel, given enough time.

name: Talk_Civ1
_source: speak;Woman1;Thank you for taking care of those monsters...|We are in your debt.
speak;Eirika;Oh, no need to thank me.|I am just happy everyone is ok.|I don't want to see anyone else hurt...
speak;Woman1;Oh, what a wonderful young woman you are.|Your kindness will never be forgotten...

name: Talk_Civ_1
_source: speak;Villager Old Woman 1;So, it's finally over...|What will become of Jehanna?...
speak;Eirika;The army of Renais will not let Jehanna collapse.|We will help with rebuilding.
speak;Villager Old Woman 1;Oh, praise the heavens...|We may not be doomed after all...|
speak;Eirika;It will be ok, Jehanna will be restored...

name: Talk_Civ_2
_source: speak;Man1;The fighting is finally over...|Tell me girl...|Did you find anything...|Interesting, in the sand?
speak;Man1;Yes!|If you find anything, let me know!|I'm looking for something rare...|Oh very rare indeed...|Oh, if I found it...|Oh....

name: Talk_Civ_3
_source: speak;Villager Man;So you beat the Tiger Eye, and the Moonstone...|That's pretty impressive...|You're pretty strong, huh?
speak;Eirika;I suppose...|Who are you though?|How do you know so much?
speak;Villager Man;I have my ways.|We of Jehanna have ways of getting information...|But that's a secret.
speak;Eirika;A secret?|I have a feeling I shouldn't ask more about it though...

name: Talk_Civ1
_source: speak;OldMan1;Thank you so much for saving me...|I thought I was done for...
speak;Eirika;You're welcome.|It was a close call.|If we came any later, we might not have been able to rescue you...
speak;OldMan1;Well, I'm glad you did...|So thanks again...

name: Talk_Civ1
_source: speak;OldMan1;Thank you so much for saving me...|I thought I was done for...
speak;Ephraim;You're welcome.|It was a close call.|If we came any later, we might not have been able to rescue you.
speak;OldMan1;Well, I'm glad you did...|So thanks again...

name: Talk_Civ2
_source: speak;Woman2;Thank the heavens for your help!|My body couldn't stop trembling!
speak;Eirika;It's all ok now, you are safe.
speak;Woman2;I will remember this for the rest of my life!|My grandchildren will know of your valor!

name: Talk_Civ2
_source: speak;Woman2;Thank the heavens for your help!|My body couldn't stop trembling!
speak;Ephraim;It's all ok now, you are safe.
speak;Woman2;I will remember this for the rest of my life!|My grandchildren will know of your valor!

name: Talk_Civ3
_source: speak;Villager Girl;Thank you for saving me, pretty lady!
speak;Villager Girl;I hope I can be as strong and beautiful as you are someday!

name: Talk_Civ3
_source: speak;Villager Girl;Thank you for saving me, handsome man!
speak;Ephraim;You're welcome, I'm just glad you are safe.
speak;Villager Girl;I hope my husband will be as handsome and strong as you someday!

name: Talk_Civ4
_source: speak;Eirika;It's ok little one...|You are safe now...

name: Talk_Civ4
_source: speak;Ephraim;It's ok little one...|You are safe now...

name: DoggoJoin
_source: speak;Eirika;Hey...|Look over there!|That hound, it looks injured!
speak;Eirika;It looks like a Hellhound, but...|different...
speak;Neimi;Oh dear!|Those wounds look terrible...|Princess, is it still alive?
speak;Eirika;I'm not sure, let's see if we can treat the wounds.
speak;Neimi;It sounds like it's in pain...|I'll see if I can treat the poor dog...
speak;Eirika;Are you sure about that, Neimi?
speak;Neimi;I can, if you think it's ok, Princess?
speak;Neimi;Ok, that should be good for now...
speak;Neimi;My pleasure!|Say Princess...|Do you think we can keep this hound?
speak;Neimi;Yay!!!|Thank you!|I promise to be a good tamer!
speak;Neimi;I'm not sure...|But this hound seems more friendly now.|If I learn anything new, I'll let you know though.
speak;Eirika;Understood.|Now, what should we name the hound?...
speak;Eirika;I agree!|Now let's hope things don't get messy!
speak;Eirika;I don't think it's a good idea...|But I'm glad the hound is alive...
speak;Neimi;Awww...|Alright...|I understand...|I'm sorry, but you've got to go little doggy...
speak;Eirika;It's gone now...|Hopefully it will be ok...
speak;Seth;Those wounds look terrible...|Princess, is this hound still alive?
speak;Eirika;I'm not sure, let's get treatment started.
speak;Seth;It sounds in pain...|I'll see if I can treat the hound.
speak;Eirika;Are you sure about that, Seth?
speak;Seth;I can, if you desire, Princess?
speak;Seth;Ok, that should be good for now.
speak;Seth;No problem.|Princess...|Are you thinking of keeping this hound?
speak;Eirika;I think we should keep the hound.
speak;Seth;Understood, but what if the hound is under a spell?
speak;Eirika;A spell?|That is a good question...
speak;Seth;I'm not sure, though...|It seems friendly though.|If I learn anything new, I'll let you know though.
speak;Eirika;Understood.|Now, what should we name the hound?...
speak;Eirika;I agree!|Now let's hope things don't get messy!
speak;Eirika;I don't think it's a good idea...|But I'm glad the hound is alive...
speak;Seth;Understood, don't want to risk any danger.
speak;Eirika;It's gone now...|Hopefully it will be ok...

name: SkeletonJoin
_source: speak;Eirika;Ah!|There are still some monsters left!|Be still, fiends!
speak;BoneBoy;Wait a second!|We're not your enemies!;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;We can't remember...but we're not your enemies.|I know that much.|We have been wandering a long time, searching for...answers.;;;noir;;white
speak;BoneBoy;Yes...|My friend and I here woke up one day with no memories.|No idea how we got here, or why we're like... Well, this.|So, we've been trying to find all that out...;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;I see...|Does your friend there speak?
speak;Lute;I was right!|I knew I sensed some monsters!
speak;Eirika;Oh, Lute, right?|What are you doing here?

speak;Lute;I know we met but moments ago, but I just had to come.|My magic detected some more monsters, so I just had to investigate!|But you're not fighting, so I suppose...|Something else is going on here?
speak;BoneBoy;Yeah, the lady and I were having a chat.|Not your enemy, neither of us. So...|Uh, drop the book?;;;noir;;white
speak;Lute;The skeleton just spoke?|Fascinating!|I've never read of a skeleton that can communicate before!
speak;BoneBoy;I've had no trouble with communication, thanks.|Except for the whole thing about looking like a monster...;;;noir;;white
speak;Lute;I see, I see!|I simply must study you and your friend there.|Eirika, right?|Imagine all the things we can learn from them!
speak;Eirika;I don't know...|This might not be a good idea.|They could be... Spies? Or something?
speak;Lute;Leave them with me, then!|I won't let anything go awry with them..|<red>Were they to fall, I wager I could even revive them!.</>
speak;Eirika;Hmmm....|Are you two alright with that?
speak;BoneBoy;... I mean, she's weird, but...|If she can help us get our memories back, it's worth it.|Not like we have many other options, anyways.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Alright...|I'll leave them in your care, Lute.
speak;Lute;Perfect!|This is exciting!|I can't wait to start researching you.
speak;BoneBoy;I guess we'll follow your orders then, Master Lute!|Here's hoping you can help us find out what we are.;;;noir;;white
speak;Eirika;Oh, wait!|Last thing, what should we call you two?|I don't feel right, simply saying 'Skeleton'.
speak;BoneBoy;Anything is fine.|Not like we have names to give you as is.;;;noir;;white
speak;Lute;Ok, now let's hurry up and go!
speak;Eirika;That skeleton's armor...|I could have sworn it was of the knights of Renais.|Is he from Renais?...
speak;Eirika;I think it's too risky...|I'm sorry, but we do wish you the best.
speak;BoneBoy;...That is regrettable, but I understand...|We will take our leave, then.;;;noir;;white
speak;Lute;Ah...|Such a brilliant oportunity, wasted...|I hope we don't regret that...

name: EyeballJoin
_source: speak;Eirika;Alright, Lute...|You sensed some magic over here?
speak;Lute;Yes, it should be right over there.
speak;Lute;Yes, I believe so.|And it's talking!|
speak;EyeBoy;Ahhh, yes...Mogall.|That is what you humans call my species.
speak;Lute;You must be rather intelligent, fluent as you are in our language...
speak;EyeBoy;Knowledge is all I seek.|I would be out seeking more, if it wasn't for those blasted ruffians.
speak;EyeBoy;Yes, you see that Arena over there?|The blackguards that captured me are trying to sell me there.|I will most likely meet my end if I end up there...|Unless...
speak;EyeBoy;I can tell you two ladies are of high honor.|If you free me, I promise to lend you my aid.|My knowledge includes magic, after all...
speak;Lute;It seems quite a good deal, Princess.
speak;Bandit1;Alright, boys!|Let's get the eyeball and make some money!
speak;EyeBoy;Quickly!|Free me, I beg of you!
speak;EyeBoy;Thank you for freeing me!|Now let's get out of here!
speak;Lute;I look forward to hearing what knowledge you have!|I even have a great name for you!
speak;EyeBoy;Name? For me?|Hmm... yes, I suppose I don't have a name, in your parlance...|Alright, what is it?
text_entry;EyeBoyName;What did Lute name the Mogall?;force_entry
speak;Eirika;There is no time...|I'm sorry, but I don't know if I can trust you just yet...
speak;Lute;Quick!|They are almost here!|Maybe we can come back later?
speak;EyeBoy;...I fear it is too late for me.|Fine. Go...|I will face my fate with dignity...

name: BabyBaelJoin
_source: speak;Eirika;You felt another magic source here, Lute?
speak;Lute;Correct.|I think we found something good too.
speak;Lute;This is marvelous!|I've always wanted a pet Bael!
speak;Lute;Yes, it's said their webs make for great book binding!
speak;Eirika;It's a Gargoyle!|There was still one alive!
speak;Lute;I think that Gargoyle is protecting that baby Bael.
speak;Lute;Here, let me take care of this.
speak;Lute;That was a spell to let me commune with monsters.|I learned it just a few days ago.|It's already proving itself quite useful!.
speak;Lute;Excellent!|She says she will join us!;;;noir;;white

speak;Lute;Gargoyle screeches are quite efficient for communication.|As for her...She seems like a shy girl.|But quite a pleasant one.|She was just protecting the last baby of her best friend.|If we protect the baby, she'll help us.
speak;Eirika;I see...|So these monsters can have friends...
speak;Lute;Well, "friends" is a bit too loaded a term.|They'll still strike each other down rather quickly, if need be.
speak;Eirika;Should we really let these two join us?
speak;Eirika;Well, if you can talk with them, I'll let you deal with them.
speak;Lute;Excellent.|I've got two great names for these two already in mind.
speak;Lute;Now that we've settled that, onwards!
speak;Eirika;My, the odd ways in which this army grows!...
speak;Eirika;I...think it might be best to let these two rest.
speak;Lute;You think so?...|...Oh...Well...|If you say so...
speak;Eirika;Thank you, Lute.|I would feel bad, bringing a baby into battle...
speak;Lute;Well, Baels age fast, so I wouldn't feel that bad.

name: CyclopsBoyJoin
_source: speak;Eirika;It's so dark down here...|What on earth could be down here?|Lute, if this is something dangerous again...
speak;Lute;We'll be fine, Princess.|Don't fret so much.
speak;Eirika;Aah!|It's so massive... Oh, gods, it's a cyclops!|Retreat!
speak;Eirika;Oh...|It is...|Is the cyclops a prisoner?
speak;Lute;...He looks to be in rather poor condition.
speak;Eirika;...Oh. This poor thing...|Are we able to heal a Cyclops?
speak;Lute;I should be able to.|But... I think there's something of more immediate concern over there...
speak;Eirika;Oh!|There's an egg there!|Was the Cyclops protecting it, you think?
speak;Lute;What a sight to behold!|These are very rare!|And to witness one hatching...what good fortune!
speak;Eirika;...It looks like an adult woman.
speak;Eirika;Let me guess, you want to add these two to our army, Lute?
speak;Lute;Perfect.|Alright, now for the best part.|The names.
speak;Eirika;Heal the Cyclops, then set them free.|It's...Not fair to conscript them, after what they've endured.
speak;Lute;...You've no whimsy at all, have you, Princess?|Fine. There.

name: Talk_Anna

name: Outro
_source: alert;You have purged these ruins of evil!
speak;Eirika;Brother, I think that was the last of them.
speak;Ephraim;I think so too.|The air is starting to feel lighter.
speak;???;Oh Sacred Twins...|You have purged the evil from these ruins...|You have our eternal gratitude...;top
speak;Eirika;Why were there so many monsters here in the first place?

speak;???;The treasure that was located here...|Held a mysterious power that gave youth to those who drank it...|It never ran dry for many years, and would give its drinker unlimited potential...|There were those who desired it and used great evil magic to destroy our civilization...|We were able to seal the last of the water from that great evil, but it also sealed the forces that you have purged.|Thank you for doing what we could not...|You have proven yourself worthy of our final treasure...|There is just enough water to last for one year....;top
speak;Ephraim;We only did what would be good for the people of Magvel.|We will protect this land from any that would threaten to wreak havoc on it.
speak;Eirika;The forces that destroyed your civilization is gone forever...|Right?
speak;???;.....|That we are unsure of...|Our power wanes...|If it's still out there somewhere...|Please...|Destroy it...;top
music;13- Truth Despair and Hope Orchestral Cover;500
speak;Ephraim;It will be ok Eirika.|As long as we are together, we can handle any threat that may come our way.
speak;Eirika;...You're right, brother.|Let's get out of here.|The others must be waiting for us.

name: Ch14ABaseConvo2
_source: speak;Ross;Ugh...|It's so HOT out here!|How much longer do we have to march through this desert?
speak;Dozla;Gwah ha ha!|The desert sun feels magnificent, doesn't it, lad?|Nothing like a good scorching to get the blood pumping!
speak;Ross;Are you serious?|I'm practically melting here!|How are you not bothered by this heat?

speak;Dozla;Gwah ha ha!|When you've spent as many years adventuring as I have,|you learn to embrace the elements rather than fight them!|Heat, cold, rain, or shine—it's all part of the grand adventure!
speak;Ross;Well, I'm not "embracing" anything except the idea of finding some shade.|My axe handle is so hot I can barely hold it!|And my water supply is already half gone...
speak;Dozla;You youngsters today!|Always looking for the easy path!|In my day, we'd march through deserts twice as hot as this|with nothing but our axes and our laughter to keep us company!
speak;Ross;That doesn't sound very smart...|No offense.|I just think there has to be a better way to deal with this heat.
speak;Ross;Maybe I could wet my headband?|Or find some desert plants that hold water?|Dad once told me about fighters who would wear wet cloths under their armor in hot weather...
speak;Dozla;Gwah ha ha!|You're overthinking it, my boy!|The heat is only as bothersome as you allow it to be!|Mind over matter, as Lady L'Arachel would say!
speak;Ross;Easy for you to say!|You're not the one who's going to pass out from heatstroke!
speak;Dozla;Hmm...|You know, maybe I can help you after all!|I've been saving something special for an occasion just like this!
speak;Ross;Really?|What is it?|A magic potion that cools you down?|A special desert cloak?
speak;Ross;An... axe?|How is another axe supposed to help me with the heat?
speak;Dozla;Not just any axe!|This beauty is enchanted with water magic!|Lady L'Arachel had one of her clerics bless it after we rescued them from an oasis temple many moons ago!
speak;Ross;Water magic?|So it can cool me down?|That's amazing!|How does it work?
speak;Dozla;Simply activate the enchantment and a refreshing mist will surround you!|Cool as a mountain stream in the dead of summer!
speak;Ross;Activate it how?|Is there a command word or something?
speak;Dozla;GWAH HA HA!|Of course there is!|Though I can't quite remember what it was...
speak;Ross;What?|You don't remember?|Then how am I supposed to use it?
speak;Dozla;That's part of the adventure, lad!|Figure it out!|Try different words!|Swing it in different patterns!|The journey of discovery is half the fun!
speak;Ross;So you're giving me an axe that might help with the heat,|but I have to guess how to make it work?|While we're marching through this scorching desert?!
speak;Dozla;EXACTLY!|Gwah ha ha!|Nothing builds character like a good puzzle in trying circumstances!|Lady L'Arachel would be proud of my mentorship!
speak;Dozla;Gwag ha ha!|Keep trying, lad!|You're bound to get it eventually!|Or perhaps the axe responds to actions rather than words?|Try spinning it over your head!
speak;Ross;Nothing happened!|Gah!|This is even more frustrating than the heat!
speak;Dozla;Gwah ha ha!|Your father would be proud of your perseverance!|Keep at it!|The satisfaction when you finally activate it will be worth all the effort!
speak;Ross;Wait a minute...|Is this even really enchanted?|Or are you just having a laugh at my expense?
speak;Dozla;Of course it's enchanted!|I wouldn't joke about such a thing!|Though watching you dance around with that axe trying different words|is quite entertaining!|GWAH HA HA!
speak;Ross;I'm going to figure this out if it's the last thing I do!|And when I do,|you'll be sorry for laughing at me!
speak;Dozla;That's the spirit, lad!|GWAH HA HA!|Adventure! Challenge! Perseverance!|These are the things that forge a true warrior!
speak;Dozla;Gwah ha ha!|Keep trying, lad!|We've got many more miles of desert ahead of us!|Plenty of time to solve the mystery!

name: Ch14ABaseConvo3
_source: speak;Colm;Ughhh...|This desert feels like it goes on forever!|How much longer until we reach the next town?
speak;Colm;You're not much for conversation, are you?|I'm bored out of my mind here.
speak;Colm;Hey, I just had an idea!|I heard you're pretty fast...|How about a little race to pass the time?
speak;Colm;Yeah! First one to that big rock formation wins.|Unless you're scared I'll beat you?
speak;Colm;Alright!|On the count of three.|One... Two... Three!
speak;Colm;*pant*...*pant*...|How... did you...|I didn't even see you pass me!
speak;Colm;You're not even breaking a sweat!|That's impossible!
speak;Colm;That was just a warm-up!|Let's go again. Same distance, back to where we started.
speak;Colm;This time I'm ready for you.|Go!
speak;Colm;I'm supposed to be the quick one!|I'm a thief! Speed is my thing!
speak;Marisa;I train every day.|Speed is survival.
speak;Colm;Well, I know when I'm beaten.|You really are something, Marisa.
speak;Colm;Maybe you could give me some pointers sometime?|I could use that kind of speed for my... um... treasure hunting.
speak;Colm;Wait, really?|You'll actually train with me?
speak;Marisa;You have potential.|But you waste energy.|I can help.
speak;Colm;Well, what do you know?|I didn't expect that, but I'll take it!|It's a deal, Marisa!
speak;Colm;Hey, was that almost a smile I saw?|Wait up!

name: Ch14ABaseConvo4
_source: speak;Lute;Fascinating specimen...|The unique striped pattern on this desert scarab suggests it's a rare variant of the Jehanna beetle.
speak;Ewan;Whoa! What are you looking at?
speak;Lute;Oh!|I didn't hear you approach, Ewan.|I'm examining this rather unique specimen of Coleoptera.
speak;Lute;Coleoptera. Beetles.|This particular desert scarab is quite rare.|I've only read about it in my studies.
speak;Ewan;That's so cool!|I love learning about desert creatures!|Can you tell me more about it?
speak;Lute;Well, since you asked...|This beetle's carapace contains microscopic ridges that reflect heat,|allowing it to survive the harshest desert conditions.
speak;Ewan;It's amazing!|How do you know so much about bugs?
speak;Lute;I know everything about most subjects.|It's simply a matter of having a superior intellect and an eidetic memory.
speak;Lute;Eidetic. It means I can recall images with precision after only seeing them briefly.|Rather useful for studying magical tomes and, of course, entomology.
speak;Ewan;That's amazing!|So this beetle... does it have any special abilities?
speak;Lute;Indeed it does.|The powder under its shell has mild magical properties.|Mages in eastern Jehanna sometimes use it to enhance fire spells.
speak;Ewan;Really?! Could I use it in my magic?|Master Saleh has been teaching me some basic spells, but I'm still learning.
speak;Lute;You're studying to become a mage?|How interesting.|What spells have you mastered so far?
speak;Ewan;Just some small wind gusts and a tiny flame.|Nothing impressive yet.
speak;Ewan;There!|See that? It's small, but it's something!
speak;Lute;Not bad for a beginner.|Your magical aura is quite developed for someone your age.
speak;Ewan;Is this...a Fire tome?|Are you giving this to me?
speak;Lute;Consider it an investment.|You learn quickly and show promising aptitude.|This is a beginner's tome, but it's well-crafted.
speak;Ewan;Thank you so much!|Wait until I show Master Saleh!|He's going to be so surprised!

speak;Lute;Just be careful not to set the sands ablaze.|Start with small targets, like rocks or small mounds.|The incantation is on page four, but don't attempt it until you've read the theory in chapter one.
speak;Ewan;I promise I'll study it thoroughly!|Maybe I could become a sage like you someday!
speak;Lute;Perhaps.|The path of a sage requires dedication and natural talent.|You seem to have both.
speak;Ewan;Would you mind if I came to ask you questions sometimes?|About magic or bugs or anything really?
speak;Lute;I suppose that would be acceptable.|It's rare to find someone genuinely interested in knowledge.
speak;Ewan;Great!|Oh, I should go now. Master Saleh will be looking for me.|Thank you for the tome, Lute!
speak;Lute;You're welcome, Ewan.|I look forward to seeing your progress.
speak;Lute;Hmm...|Interesting young mage.|Now, back to this desert beetle...

name: Ch14ABaseConvo5
_source: speak;Tana;Look at how vast it is, Vanessa!|The desert stretches as far as the eye can see!
speak;Vanessa;It is quite the sight, Princess Tana.|I've never seen anything like it in Frelia.
speak;Tana;Oh, please just call me Tana!|We're friends, aren't we?
speak;Vanessa;Of course...Tana.|It's still taking some getting used to.
speak;Tana;Isn't it amazing how our pegasi can fly over such harsh terrain?|From up here, the desert almost looks like an ocean of sand!
speak;Vanessa;The view is certainly beautiful.|Though I must admit, I worry about how the heat affects our mounts.
speak;Tana;Oh! You're right.|I should have thought of that.|Do you think we should land and give them a rest?
speak;Vanessa;That would be wise.|I can see an oasis not far from here.|It would provide shade and water for them.
speak;Vanessa;Princess—I mean, Tana!|We shouldn't strain our pegasi unnecessarily...
speak;Tana;I'm just teasing!|Let's glide down gently.
speak;Tana;Wow!|The oasis is so much more beautiful up close!|Look at how blue the water is against all this sand!
speak;Vanessa;It is quite remarkable.|Nature finds a way to create beauty even in the harshest conditions.
speak;Tana;Just like people, wouldn't you say?|Some of the kindest souls come from the toughest circumstances.
speak;Vanessa;That's...quite insightful, Tana.|I hadn't thought of it that way.
speak;Tana;My brother always says I notice the strangest things.|But I think it's important to find meaning in what we see.
speak;Vanessa;I agree.|It's what makes you a good pegasus knight.|You observe details others might miss.
speak;Tana;Vanessa!|That might be the nicest thing you've ever said to me!
speak;Vanessa;I-I merely stated the truth.|You have natural talent as a flier.
speak;Tana;That means so much coming from you!|You're the best knight in all of Frelia!
speak;Vanessa;I wouldn't go that far...|But thank you.
speak;Tana;Oh! Look at those desert flowers!|I didn't know plants could bloom in such heat!
speak;Vanessa;Desert flora is remarkably resilient.|Those likely only bloom after the rare rainfall.
speak;Tana;We should pick some to bring back!|Wouldn't they make lovely decorations for the camp?
speak;Vanessa;I'm not sure we should disturb them...|They're rare and likely important to the desert ecosystem.
speak;Tana;You're right again.|We can just enjoy their beauty while we're here.
speak;Vanessa;We could sketch them if you'd like.|I always carry a small journal for mapping terrain.
speak;Tana;That's a wonderful idea!|I didn't know you could draw, Vanessa!
speak;Vanessa;It's nothing artistic.|Just basic field sketches for military reports.
speak;Tana;I'd still love to see!|Maybe you could teach me?
speak;Vanessa;I'd be happy to.|Though I warn you, I'm a strict teacher.
speak;Tana;I wouldn't expect anything less!|Oh, Vanessa, I'm so glad we got to do this together.|Seeing new places is so much better with a friend.
speak;Vanessa;I feel the same way...|Thank you for insisting I join you today.
speak;Tana;Always!|Now, let's get those sketches done before we head back!
speak;Vanessa;Yes, we shouldn't linger too long.|The others will be expecting us back soon.
speak;Tana;Just a little longer...|I want to remember this moment with my friend...
