name: Ch.11ABaseConvo1
_source: speak;Neimi;Oh!|P-Prince Innes...|I didn't know anyone else was here...
speak;Neimi;Y-yes... you remembered my name?...|I'm sorry for intruding on your practice.
speak;Innes;This forest doesn't belong to me.|Why are you crying?
speak;Neimi;I-I'm not crying!...|Well, maybe a little...|I always get nervous when I meet royalty.
speak;Innes;We've met before on the battlefield.|There's no need for such formality here. I'm as much a soldier as you, after all.
speak;Neimi;R-right! Uhm...|I noticed your quiver...|The arrows are perfectly fletched.
speak;Innes;You have a keen eye.|Most wouldn't notice such details.
speak;Neimi;My grandfather taught me that proper fletching is...|*sniff*... the difference between hitting your mark and missing entirely.
speak;Innes;Your grandfather sounds wise.|You're a village archer, if I recall correctly?
speak;Neimi;Yes...|Aah...|Sorry, I always get emotional when I think of Grandfather.
speak;Innes;Does archery bring you to tears as well?
speak;Neimi;No!|When I'm shooting, I feel...|I feel strong.
speak;Innes;I've observed few archers from Renais.|Tell me about your training methods.
speak;Neimi;I practice differently than most...|I, ah...|I shoot 100 arrows every morning, even in the rain.|Grandfather said consistency matters more than talent.
speak;Innes;A disciplined approach.|Not unlike my own methods.
speak;Innes;Precision under pressure.|I train with distractions, in adverse conditions.|A true archer must be unfailing regardless of circumstances.
speak;Neimi;That's incredible...|No wonder everyone speaks so highly of your skill.
speak;Innes;Your form is... promising.|Your draw is steady despite your emotional nature.
speak;Neimi;You've seen me shoot?|Oh... I hope I didn't embarrass myself!
speak;Innes;I make it a point to assess all allies.|Your potential exceeds your confidence.
speak;Neimi;That might be the nicest thing anyone's said to me!|Thank you, Prince Innes!
speak;Innes;It's hardly an issue.|Now, keep your chin up.|Don't let me interfere in honing your craft.|I might even join you in shooting practice one of these mornings.
speak;Neimi;Really?!|I'll do my best to keep up with you then!
alert;Neimi and Innes gained 30 Bow WEXP!

name: Ch.11ABaseConvo2
_source: speak;Lute;I've compiled a report on monster sightings in this area.|As our chief intellect, it's my duty to keep us informed.
speak;Lute;Obviously.|Keep your eyes open for unusual movement.|Particularly in the northeastern quadrant.
speak;Lute;Be especially aware of giant arachnids.|Baels have been spotted with increasing frequency.
speak;Lute;Yes, fascinating creatures.|Eight legs, keen armor, venomous fangs...|And the most remarkable fur, though that's besides the point.
speak;Lute;You've touched a Bael's fur?|How unexpected.
speak;Marisa;Killed one last month.|Its coat was like silk.
speak;Lute;Quite right!|The texture is similar to woven silk from the southern markets of Jehanna.|I've researched the material rather extensively, myself.
speak;Marisa;I kept some.|For my sword grip.
speak;Marisa;They move differently than humans.|Their legs have a pattern.|One set of four goes up, then the other.
speak;Lute;You've studied their movement?|I've documented their eight-step locomotion cycle in my bestiary!
speak;Lute;It's the most comprehensive text on magical creatures in existence.|I wrote it myself, obviously.
speak;Marisa;...I'd...|Like to see it.|They are kind of...|Cute...
speak;Lute;They are kind of cute!|In that case, I don't see why not.|From one monster appreciator to another, then!

name: Ch.11ABaseConvo3
_source: speak;Tethys;Sir Gilliam!|You've been watching my dance practice again, haven't you?
speak;Gilliam;Tethys!|I-I was merely passing by.|On patrol.
speak;Tethys;Three times in one hour?|That's quite the thorough patrol.
speak;Gilliam;A knight of Frelia must be vigilant.
speak;Tethys;Or... perhaps...|You wanted to ask me something?
speak;Tethys;Hah!|Come now, I've seen that look before.|On many men's faces.
speak;Gilliam;I don't know what you're implying.
speak;Tethys;Love advice, Sir Gilliam.|That's what you're seeking, isn't it?
speak;Tethys;There's no shame in it.|Even the strongest knights have hearts.
speak;Tethys;Only to someone who understands the language of longing.|So, who is this lucky woman?
speak;Gilliam;I'd rather not say.|But... I could use some counsel.
speak;Tethys;And I'd be delighted to help!|First lesson, women appreciate forthrightness.
speak;Gilliam;My armor and lance are straightforward enough.
speak;Tethys;Ha ha ha!|Oh, Sir Gilliam...|Women want to know the man beneath the armor.
speak;Gilliam;What would I even say to her?|My duties leave little time for....pleasantries.
speak;Tethys;Start with a compliment.|Something sincere, about more than just appearance.
speak;Tethys;That's a beginning!|Now, flowers wouldn't hurt either.
speak;Gilliam;Flowers...|I know nothing of such things.

speak;Tethys;Trust me.|A simple wildflower picked with thought means more than the finest roses bought without care.|A wing of a beautiful bird, so show how you feel.|If she is right for you, she will appreciate what you give her.
speak;Gilliam;I...see.|I think I might know where to find some flowers.|I think I can find some wings too nearby.|There should be some in the field nearby.|I can grab some on my patrol route.
speak;Tethys;Back to the patrol, then?|Tell me how it goes, won't you?

name: Ch.11ABaseConvo4
_source: speak;Gerik;Garcia, I've got to ask you something.
speak;Gerik;I know you got some battles underneath your belt.|I want you to tell me some of your stories on the battlefield.|A man of your caliber has a good story to tell.
speak;Garcia;Stories, huh?|You've got it then.|Just this last battle reminded me of the Battle of Western Keep.|Twenty soldiers surrounded me, and I was down to my last axe.
speak;Gerik;Twenty, you say?|Not bad for a forest villager.
speak;Garcia;Gah ha ha!|Former Renais Army General, mind you!|What's your best story, Desert Tiger?
speak;Gerik;Hmm...|I once faced thirty mercenaries in the Jehanna dunes.|With nothing but a broken sword, and an empty canteen.
speak;Gerik;Yep.|The desert sun is a harsh mistress.|Makes men desperate.
speak;Garcia;Well, there was this time in Grado...|Forty bandits had me cornered in a ravine.
speak;Garcia;Indeed!|And it was raining. Mud up to my knees.
speak;Gerik;That's impressive! Though...|I did once face fifty brigands while protecting a caravan.
speak;Garcia;Fifty?|Were you alone in this endeavor?
speak;Gerik;Completely alone.|My men were escorting the civilians to safety.
speak;Garcia;You know...|I remember a skirmish where sixty wyvern riders descended from the clouds...
speak;Gerik;Sixty wyvern riders?|Hah!|And I suppose you fought them off with a kitchen knife?
speak;Garcia;Hehe...|Well, it was a particularly sharp kitchen knife!
speak;Gerik;Ha ha ha ha!|Next you'll tell me you fought a hundred men with a wooden spoon!
speak;Garcia;GAH HA HA HA HA!!!|And you'll claim two hundred with nothing but a stern glare!
speak;Gerik;Ah... ah...|Thank you, Garcia...|It's good to share war stories with someone who understands.
speak;Garcia;Indeed it is, Gerik.|The young ones think we're just old men telling tall tales.

name: Ch.11ABaseConvo5
_source: speak;Vanessa;Did you see that?|The way Joshua held his utensils?
speak;Tana;I did!|Perfect etiquette, just like at the royal court.
speak;Joshua;You know I can hear you two, right?|I'm sitting right here.
speak;Vanessa;Joshua, no ordinary mercenary eats with such...refinement.
speak;Joshua;Eh...do they?|A man can't enjoy his meal with proper manners?
speak;Tana;And yesterday, I saw you reading that tome on past wars.|You were analyzing the battle tactics, weren't you?|Like a regular scholar...
speak;Joshua;I like to gamble.|Knowing history helps even the odds.
speak;Vanessa;There's more to your story than you're telling us.
speak;Joshua;Hmm, you think so?|Life's a gamble, and everyone has secrets.|Sorry, ladies.
speak;Tana;Secrets are one thing...|But I'm a princess, and I happen to recognize the manners of royalty!|They can't be faked, Joshua!
speak;Joshua;Oho...you are a princess, aren't you?|So you're an expert on royalty, then.|And you, Vanessa?
speak;Vanessa;I've served in the royal court my entire life.|There's no noble of the land I haven't seen, and you...|You act more than a bit like them.
speak;Joshua;Ah...just my luck...|Well then, I suppose you think I'm more than I apprear?|Care to wager on my true identity, then?
speak;Tana;Hah!|I know it!|But what noble family could you be from?
speak;Joshua;Hah!|You'd like to know, wouldn't you?|But if you were willing to bet on it...
speak;Vanessa;Stop deflecting, Joshua.|The way you carry yourself, your knowledge of politics...
speak;Joshua;My mother taught me well, that's all.
speak;Tana;Your mother, huh?|Hmmmm...Now that you say that you do look like...
speak;Joshua;Would you look at the time?
speak;Vanessa;You're not getting away that easily!|Who, exactly, are you?
speak;Joshua;Again, wouldn't you like to know?|The truth's boring, really.|However knowledge is power, especially at the gambling table.
speak;Tana;Wait...what's that on your coat?|That crest, I just noticed it!
speak;Joshua;Huh|This old thing?|Won it in a card game.|Thought it'd look nice, and it does!
speak;Tana;Look nice, my foot!|It's a crest of royalty, and you know it!|I just need to figure out which...
speak;Vanessa;We've got you cornered now.|Admit it!
speak;Joshua;Ladies, it's been delightful...|But I never gamble when the odds aren't in my favor.|...or perhaps...
speak;Joshua;Alright, fine. How about this?|If you can beat me in a game of chance...|I'll tell you everything.|If not, no more questions.
speak;Tana;Again with the wagers?|If you think we're going to stoop to-
speak;Joshua;That's a no, then?|I suppose I'll be leaving.
speak;Joshua;You know it!|Now, heads or tails?
speak;Joshua;Well, would you look at that.
speak;Vanessa;I...where'd he go?!|I was just looking at him!
speak;Tana;He...disappeared!|That coin flip must've been a distraction!
speak;Vanessa;Ugh...|Just like your brother, with the dramatic exits...
speak;Tana;...hmph!|Well, I found the coin.|If he wants it back, he better be ready to answer...

name: Ch.12ABaseConvo1
_source: speak;Larachel;Ah! Just the commoners I was seeking!|Greetings, humble subjects of the land!
speak;Larachel;I, the beautiful princess of peerless beauty,|Have decided to expand my understanding of the common folk!
speak;Larachel;Tell me, do you not find the price of turnips absolutely outrageous this season?
speak;Colm;Turnips?|I don't really keep track of...
speak;Larachel;Of course, of course!|You're a thief!|You simply steal your turnips!|How resourceful you commoners are!
speak;Colm;I don't steal turnips!|I'm not even a common thief anymore, I'm a-
speak;Larachel;And you, young lumberjack!|I'm sure you're concerned about the proper felling techniques for the winter oaks?
speak;Ross;Winter oaks?|I just chop firewood for the camp...
speak;Larachel;Precisely!|It's so refreshing to discuss the struggles of manual labor!|I find I'm quite adept at speaking your language!
speak;Colm;What exactly are you trying to-
speak;Larachel;I've also studied your cultural artifacts!|Observe!
speak;Larachel;I believe this is what you folk call a "pocket money collector?"
speak;Larachel;Oh!|How versatile your tools are!|Both for fish AND currency!|Your resourcefulness knows no bounds!
speak;Colm;Look, L'Arachel, we appreciate the...|Whatever this is,|But we were kind of in the middle of-
speak;Larachel;Say no more, my good man!|I understand that commoners are always pressed for time!|Working sunrise to sunset with your...|Common...things.
speak;Larachel;Which is why I've brought you these!|These two Goddess Statues
speak;Larachel;Indeed!|For praying to the Goddess for!|However you common folk utilize such things!
speak;Colm;These are worth more than everything I own...
speak;Larachel;Think nothing of it!|I've found our conversation most illuminating!|I truly understand the plight of the common man now!
speak;Larachel;Well, I must be off!|Divine duties call!|Farewell, my humble friends!
speak;Ross;Did she just give us statues?
speak;Colm;At least we got something valuable out of it.

name: Ch.12ABaseConvo2
_source: speak;Kyle;Your form has improved, Amelia.|But you're still leaving your left flank exposed.
speak;Amelia;I'm trying to be quicker on my feet!|Heavy armor slows me down too much, though...
speak;Kyle;In real combat, that speed won't matter if a lance finds that gap.
speak;Amelia;But...Sir Kyle...|I've noticed you take hits directly to your breastplate.
speak;Kyle;A knight must be the wall between danger and those he protects.|Direct confrontation is our duty.
speak;Amelia;Doesn't that...hurt?|Even with armor, the impact must be tremendous!
speak;Kyle;Pain is temporary.|Failing in your duty is permanent.
speak;Amelia;...though...|There's that thing you do with your armor, yeah?|The angle, I mean!|You deflect blows slightly, instead of taking them straight on.
speak;Kyle;You have a good eye.|It's a technique passed down through Renais knights.
speak;Amelia;Could you...show me?|Even if my armor's not that heavy...|Yeah, I can make it work!
speak;Kyle;Stand here.|Now, position your shoulder guard at this angle...
speak;Kyle;Better.|The impact distributes across the surface instead of concentrating in one spot.
speak;Amelia;I see!|And if I combine this with my footwork...
speak;Kyle;Interesting approach.|You wouldn't need to sacrifice mobility.
speak;Kyle;I usually do. But...|Your agility might serve you better than my methods.|Have you considered using that speed for positioning?
speak;Kyle;Anticipate the blow.|Shift your weight to guide the impact where your armor is strongest.
speak;Amelia;So instead of avoiding completely...|I direct where the hit lands!
speak;Kyle;Precisely.|It merges your style with traditional armor techniques.
speak;Amelia;Thank you, Sir Kyle!|I'll practice this right away.
speak;Kyle;And perhaps...|I could learn something from your footwork.
alert;Amelia's DEF Growth has increased by 20!
alert;Kyle's SPD Growth has increased by 20!

name: Ch.12ABaseConvo3
_source: speak;Natasha;Lady Tethys...|I've been meaning to speak with you.
speak;Tethys;Sister Natasha!|What a pleasant surprise.|I was just taking a moment to rest between performances.
speak;Natasha;I hope I'm not disturbing you.|I wanted to thank you for what you did yesterday.
speak;Tethys;Yesterday?|Oh, you mean dancing for the wounded soldiers?
speak;Natasha;Yes.|The change in their spirits was remarkable!|Even those with the gravest injuries seemed to find new strength.
speak;Tethys;That's very kind of you to say, but...|It's nothing compared to what you do with your healing staves.
speak;Natasha;That's not true at all.|Healing comes in many forms, Lady Tethys.|My staves may mend flesh and bone...|But your dancing mends the heart.
speak;Tethys;I've never thought of it that way before.|Do you really believe that?
speak;Natasha;I do.|I've studied healing arts my whole life in service to the Everlasting.|And I've learned that true recovery requires more than just physical healing.

speak;Tethys;That's a beautiful perspective! I'm glad my dancing does as much for others as it does for me!|Though, sometimes I wish I could do more...|My brother Ewan has such talent for magic, but I never had the gift.
speak;Natasha;We each have our own gifts.|The question is how we use them to help others.
speak;Moulder;Ah, there you are, Sister Natasha.|Oh, and Lady Tethys as well.|What a fortuitous meeting.
speak;Moulder;We've received word that more wounded are arriving from the eastern front.|I fear we'll need all hands available.
speak;Tethys;I should probably leave you to your work, then.
speak;Moulder;Actually, Lady Tethys...|Your presence would be most welcome as well.|Many of the soldiers have been speaking of your performances.|How they give them something to hope for.
speak;Natasha;Perhaps this is an opportunity, Lady Tethys.|Would you consider joining us?|We could work together - healing both body and spirit.
speak;Tethys;I would be honored.|Sister Natasha, might I ask something of you in return?
speak;Tethys;Would you be willing to teach me some of your healing techniques?|Not the magic, perhaps, but the words of comfort, the gentle touch...|The kindness you show to every patient.
speak;Natasha;I would be delighted.|And perhaps you could show me how you bring such joy through movement?|I fear I'm rather stiff in comparison.
speak;Tethys;It would be my pleasure!|We'll learn from each other.
speak;Moulder;It warms my heart to see such collaboration.|Now, shall we?
speak;Natasha;We should go.|The wounded will be arriving soon.
speak;Tethys;Together then!|Two different paths of healing, joined as one.

name: Ch.12ABaseConvo4
_source: speak;Dozla;GWAH HA HA!|A fine evening to you, gentlemen!|Nothing better than sharing a tankard after a hard day's battle!
speak;Garcia;Couldn't agree more, Dozla.|The young ones may have their energy, but they don't understand the simple pleasure of good company.
speak;Moulder;Indeed.|I must say, Garcia, your beard is looking particularly distinguished today.
speak;Garcia;Ha! Thank you, Father Moulder.|I've been maintaining it with a bit more care lately.|My son Ross keeps telling me I should shave it off.
speak;Dozla;WHAT?|Shave it off?|Why would the lad suggest such a terrible thing?
speak;Garcia;Says it makes me look "too old."|The boy doesn't understand that a warrior's beard is his pride!
speak;Moulder;The younger generation simply lacks appreciation for tradition.|Prince Ephraim once suggested I might look "more approachable" without my mustache.
speak;Dozla;GWAH HA HA!|Imagine Father Moulder without his magnificent mustache!|Why, you'd look like a fresh-faced acolyte!
speak;Moulder;Precisely my thought.|This mustache has guided many a troubled soul through difficult times.
speak;Garcia;It carries the wisdom of your counsel, Father Moulder.|Just as my beard carries the experience of many battles.
speak;Dozla;And my grand beard and mustache combo carries the ADVENTURE of a lifetime with Lady L'Arachel!|GWAH HA HA!
speak;Garcia;You know, Princess Tana actually asked me once if my beard gets in the way during combat.
speak;Garcia;I told her that my beard intimidates my enemies!|They see it and know they face a seasoned warrior!
speak;Dozla;EXACTLY!|Lady L'Arachel says my beard makes me look FEROCIOUS!|The perfect guardian for a noble on a sacred mission!
speak;Moulder;Lady Natasha once kindly offered to trim my mustache when it was singed after a battle.|I politely declined, of course.
speak;Garcia;Of course!|Battle damage only adds character!
speak;Seth;Pardon the interruption, gentlemen.|The war council will begin shortly.
speak;Moulder;Thank you, General Seth.|We'll be there momentarily.
speak;Seth;If I might ask...|What has you all in such good spirits?
speak;Dozla;We were discussing the MAGNIFICENT art of facial hair!|Something you might consider, young Seth!
speak;Seth;Me?|I'm afraid a full beard might be impractical for someone in my position.
speak;Seth;Perhaps when the war is over, I might consider it.|Good day, gentlemen.
speak;Moulder;You know, I believe we've touched on something profound here.|Our beards and mustaches are more than just hair.
speak;Dozla;They're symbols of our EXPERIENCE!|Of WISDOM!|Of ADVENTURE!
speak;Garcia;To facial hair, my friends!|May the younger generation one day understand its glory!
speak;Dozla;GWAH HA HA HA!|TO FACIAL HAIR AND GLORY!
speak;Garcia;Hahaha!|Couldn't have said it better myself!

name: Ch.12ABaseConvo5
_source: speak;Forde;Hmm...|No, that shade isn't quite right...|Maybe a touch more yellow ochre...
speak;Artur;Oh!|Sorry to disturb you, Forde. I was just passing by.
speak;Artur;Did you... just hide your painting?
speak;Forde;What? No!|Well, yes, but it's nothing, really.|Just a little sketch. Not worth looking at.
speak;Artur;I've heard your work is quite good.|Sir Kyle showed some of your landscapes to Brother Moulder and me.
speak;Forde;Kyle and his big mouth...|Those were just practice pieces.
speak;Artur;They were beautiful.|The way you captured the light on the mountains...|It reminded me of dawn prayers at the temple.
speak;Forde;You really think so?|I mean, thank you, but...|Wait, could you stand right there for a moment?
speak;Forde;Nothing's wrong at all!|Just... don't move for a second.
speak;Forde;Perfect!|The way the light is hitting your robes right now...
speak;Forde;Would you mind terribly if I... sketched you?|Just quickly! Nobody has to see it!
speak;Artur;Sketch me?|But why would you want to do that?

speak;Forde;To be honest, I've been struggling with drawing fabric.|Armor is easy - it's all rigid lines and reflections.|But those flowing robes of yours... they're a challenge I haven't mastered yet.
speak;Artur;I see...|I suppose I could stand here for a while, if it would help.
speak;Forde;You would?|That's fantastic!|But, um, could we keep this between us?
speak;Forde;The others... they don't exactly appreciate me "wasting time" with art.|Kyle especially gives me grief about not focusing on training.
speak;Artur;I understand.|Your secret is safe with me, Forde.
speak;Lute;Artur?|Why are you standing so unnaturally?
speak;Artur;Lute!|I was just... stretching?|Yes, stretching after morning meditation.
speak;Lute;That's anatomically inefficient for proper muscular elongation.|I've memorized seventeen stretching techniques from eastern Renais, and none look like that.
speak;Forde;I was just showing him a cavalry stance.|For self-defense purposes.
speak;Lute;Intriguing.|Though Artur's body type would be better suited to a different defensive posture, considering his muscle-to-height ratio.
speak;Artur;Thank you, Lute, but we were just finishing up.
speak;Lute;Very well.|I require your assistance with a tome translation in approximately 12 minutes.
speak;Artur;You don't know the half of it.|Shall we continue while we have the chance?
speak;Forde;That should do it!|Thank you for your patience, Artur.
speak;Artur;You're quite welcome.|Might I... see what you've created?
speak;Forde;Oh!|Well, it's not really finished yet...|It's just a rough sketch, really...
speak;Artur;I understand if you'd rather keep it private.|Art can be a personal matter, like prayer.
speak;Forde;No, it's just...|Fine, but remember, it's not my best work.
speak;Artur;Forde, this is...|This is remarkable.|You've made me look so... peaceful.
speak;Forde;It's how you appeared to me.|There's a certain calmness about you that I wanted to capture.
speak;Artur;I'm honored you would see me this way.|And that you would share your gift with me, despite wanting to keep it secret.
speak;Forde;Keep this between us?|If General Seth or Kyle found out I was "wasting time" painting during a war...
speak;Artur;It will be our secret.|But Forde, this isn't wasting time.|Beauty and art have their place, even in war.|Perhaps especially in war.
speak;Forde;Thanks, Artur.|Would you like to keep it?|Think of it as payment for your patience.
speak;Artur;I would treasure it.|And perhaps someday, when this conflict is over...|You won't need to hide your talents anymore.
speak;Forde;One can hope.|Until then, mum's the word, right?
speak;Artur;Your secret is safe with me.|May the divine continue to guide your hand, Forde.

name: Ch.13ABaseConvo1
_source: speak;Lute;Excuse me.|Saleh, correct?|I've been told to come talk to you.|I've been researching these ancient texts on monsters and told you might have some insight.|My findings are quite remarkable, as one would expect from a prodigy such as myself.
speak;Saleh;Interesting to hear.|I am willing to share my knowledge of monsters.|The monsters of Magvel do have a history as old as our continent itself.
speak;Lute;Naturally, I've already documented this.|My research indicates that monsters weren't always prevalent.|I've determined that something must have triggered their emergence in cycles.

speak;Saleh;Hmmmm....|In Caer Pelyn, we have tales of the Great Darkness.|A time when monsters roamed freely across all lands, before the Sacred Stones were created.|This could correlate with the cycles you mentioned.

speak;Lute;Not only cycles, but what kind of monsters populate.|I've catalogued precisely 47 distinct species of monsters thus far.|No one else has achieved such comprehensive classification.|Each species seems to be drawn to different types of magical energy.
speak;Saleh;Your work is thorough.|I've read scrolls suggesting that monsters are manifestations of dark magic.
speak;Lute;Of course they're manifestations of dark magic.|I determined that conclusion months ago.|Though I must admit, your mountain village might have texts I haven't yet encountered.
speak;Saleh;The texts speak of places where the veil between worlds is thin, drawing monsters to those locations.

speak;Lute;That would explain their congregation near ancient ruins and temples.|But what of the <red>Gorgons</>?|Their petrification abilities cannot be explained by simple dark magic.|Even I find them... puzzling.
speak;Saleh;The <red>Gorgons</> are indeed peculiar creatures.|Some believe they were once human mages who delved too deeply into forbidden arts.|Their transformation was the price of their hubris.
speak;Lute;Hubris, you say?|An interesting cautionary tale, though not applicable to me.|My superior intellect allows me to navigate magical research without such risks.
speak;Saleh;Even the most talented mages must exercise caution, Lute.|The line between brilliance and destruction can be thin.

speak;Lute;I am aware of risks, Saleh.|I simply happen to be better equipped than most to handle them.|I'm particularly interested in the <red>Draco Zombies</>.|Their existence suggests that even wyverns can be corrupted by dark magic.
speak;Saleh;The <red>Draco Zombies</> are troubling evidence of how far the corruption can spread.|Old stories speak of entire aerial legions transformed during the Demon King's first rise.
speak;Lute;The relationship between monsters and the Demon King is clear to me now.|I've developed a theory that monsters predate the Demon King.|He merely harnessed what already existed.
speak;Saleh;Your theory matches what I've heard before.|The monsters came first, then the Demon King united them.

speak;Lute;It's gratifying to know my independent research matches other findings.|Though not surprising, given my exceptional analytical abilities.|I must reconsider my taxonomic classifications now.
speak;Saleh;The natural order was disrupted when humans began to practice magic extensively.|People inadvertently strengthened the monsters by increasing magical energy in the world.
speak;Lute;So humanity nearly destroyed itself through pursuit of knowledge.|Even I can appreciate the irony, though it won't deter my research.|Some risks are necessary for significant advancement.
speak;Saleh;Knowledge itself is not the enemy.|It is how we use it that determines our fate.|That's why balance and restraint matter.

speak;Lute;A fair point, Saleh.|While I'm confident in my abilities, I acknowledge there's wisdom in that approach.|With my intellect and your perspective, we might better understand how to predict another monster resurgence.
speak;Saleh;That would be worthwhile.|Would you be interested in examining some of the texts I've collected?

speak;Lute;Yes, I would find that valuable.|I'll prepare my cataloguing materials immediately.|This will undoubtedly be the most significant magical research undertaken in centuries.|And I'll be the one to complete it.

name: Ch.13ABaseConvo2
_source: speak;Ewan;Hehe.|Prince Innes!|Can you come look at this strange bug I found?
speak;Innes;A bug?|What sort of insect would be of interest to me?
speak;Ewan;It's really neat!|It's right over here in this box.|You just need to look really closely...
speak;Innes;...|I see.|You've rigged a spring-loaded surprise in that box.|There's a small wire visible on the side, and your posture suggests anticipation.|You're not as subtle as you think, boy.
speak;Ewan;Wha-?|How did you know?!|I spent hours setting that up!
speak;Innes;I am Prince Innes of Frelia.|My tactical mind is unmatched.|Did you truly believe I would fall for such an elementary trap?
speak;Ewan;I really thought it would work...|It worked on everyone else...

speak;Innes;Your mistake was telegraphing your intent.|Your excessive enthusiasm signaled deception.|The slight tremor in your voice betrayed nervousness.|And I noticed you positioned yourself beyond the box's blast radius.
speak;Ewan;Really?|I didn't realize I gave away so many clues...

speak;Innes;Furthermore, you chose a location with too much foot traffic.|Anyone would question why a "rare bug" would be in such a common area.|Had you chosen a secluded garden area, maintained plausible ignorance in your demeanor, and controlled your breathing...|The trap might have had a chance of success.
speak;Ewan;Huh...|So if I were to try again, I should...|Wait, you're actually giving me tips?
speak;Innes;I'm explaining why your childish attempt failed.|To demonstrate the superiority of my observational skills.|Not to encourage further foolishness.
speak;Ewan;Right, right!|I totally understand.|So a secluded location works better...|And I need to control my breathing and act natural...|What about the design of the trap itself?

speak;Innes;The mechanism was rudimentary but functional.|However, the spring was too loud when compressed.|A proper ambush should be silent until the moment of activation.|Also, your paint choice was obvious against the box's color.|Subtlety is key.
speak;Ewan;I see!|So I should use materials that blend with the surroundings...|And find a quieter spring mechanism...
speak;Innes;I suppose—|Wait.|Why am I continuing this conversation?|I have important matters to attend to.|Good day.
speak;Ewan;Thank you, Prince Innes!|This has been very educational!|I can't wait to try out these new techniques...|Maybe on someone important...
speak;Innes;Hold a moment.|I did not give you permission to use this information.|Especially not on "someone important."

speak;Ewan;Oh, of course not!|I would never think of using your expert tactical advice to create the ultimate prank...|That would be wrong of me!|But hypothetically, a quieter spring and natural-colored paint would work better...
speak;Innes;Listen carefully, boy.|If I discover you've engineered any pranks based on my advice...|There will be consequences.|Is that understood?
speak;Ewan;Crystal clear, Prince Innes!|No pranks at all!|Especially not during the war meeting tomorrow...
speak;Innes;What war meeting?|There is no scheduled—|You're attempting to make me paranoid.|This is childish.
speak;Innes;No.|But I've clearly made a tactical error in this conversation.|Saleh will hear about this.
speak;Ewan;Oh come on!|I'm just having a little fun!|Besides, I learned so much from you!|You're really smart, Prince Innes.
speak;Innes;Your flattery doesn't work on me.|Just...|Stay out of trouble.|And stay away from me for the foreseeable future.
speak;Ewan;Secluded location...|Natural demeanor...|Silent mechanism...|This is going to be my masterpiece!

name: Ch.13ABaseConvo3
_source: speak;Gerik;Putting in the extra hours, I see.|That's the mark of a dedicated soldier.
speak;Franz;Gerik!|I didn't realize anyone was watching.|I was just finishing up my evening training.
speak;Gerik;Don't mind me.|But I couldn't help noticing your form with that sword.|It's a bit large for you, isn't it?
speak;Franz;Ah, well...|I thought training with a heavier blade might help me build strength.|My brother Forde says I need to work on my power strikes.
speak;Gerik;Not a bad idea in theory.|But your stance is all wrong for a sword that size.|You're fighting against the weapon instead of letting it work with you.
speak;Franz;Fighting against it?|I'm not sure I understand.
speak;Gerik;Here, let me show you.|May I?
speak;Gerik;See, with a heavier blade, you need to widen your stance.|Plant your feet more firmly.|Like this.
speak;Franz;Oh, I see.|So I should position my feet further apart?
speak;Gerik;Exactly.|And don't try to control the blade's full swing with just your wrists.|Use your shoulders and back to guide the momentum.|The weight of the sword should do most of the work.
speak;Franz;That makes sense.|I've been trying to handle it like my regular sword.|No wonder my arms are so sore.
speak;Gerik;A common mistake.|Try it now.|Feel the difference?
speak;Franz;Yes!|It's much easier to control this way.|The blade feels more balanced.
speak;Gerik;Good.|If you're serious about building up your frame, though, sword training alone won't cut it.
speak;Franz;What would you recommend?|I've noticed your...uh...build is quite impressive.
speak;Gerik;Ha!|No need to be shy about it.|This comes from years of training, not just swinging a sword.

speak;Gerik;For starters, find some heavy stones you can lift.|Do it every day, gradually increasing the weight.|Then there's tree climbing using just your arms.|And carrying a comrade in full armor up a hill never hurts.
speak;Franz;That sounds intense!|Do you still do all that training?
speak;Gerik;Every chance I get.|Though these days, battles keep me fit enough.|But when I was your age, I was doing this daily.
speak;Franz;I'll have to incorporate some of these into my routine.|Maybe not carrying someone in armor just yet, though.
speak;Gerik;Start small.|Even just doing push-ups with a rock on your back will make a difference.|The key is consistency.|Train every day, even if it's just a little.
speak;Franz;I can do that.|I'm usually up before dawn anyway.
speak;Gerik;That's the spirit.|And one more thing about that sword.
speak;Gerik;Try wrapping the grip with leather strips.|It'll give you better control and prevent blisters.|Your hands aren't calloused enough yet for extended training with a heavy blade.
speak;Franz;I'll do that!|Thank you for the advice, Gerik.|I really appreciate it.
speak;Gerik;Don't mention it.|We're all comrades here.|I like seeing young knights with dedication.
speak;Franz;Would you...maybe want to spar sometime?|I could learn a lot from someone with your experience.
speak;Gerik;Sure, why not?|Just don't expect me to go easy on you.|Even in practice, I fight to win.
speak;Franz;I wouldn't want it any other way!|I'll never improve if people hold back.
speak;Gerik;That's a good attitude.|Meet me here tomorrow at dawn.|We'll see what you're made of.
speak;Franz;I'll be here!|And I'll be ready!
speak;Franz;Wider stance...|Use my shoulders...|Let the momentum work for me...|I should practice this a bit more before tomorrow.

name: Ch.13ABaseConvo4
_source: speak;Tana;Gilliam!|There you are.|Still on guard duty, I see.
speak;Gilliam;Princess Tana.|Lady L'Arachel.|Is there something you need?
speak;Larachel;Oh, we were just passing by and noticed your unwavering dedication.|It's truly admirable how you stand guard no matter the hour!
speak;Tana;Don't be so modest, Gilliam!|You've been standing here since dawn.|Most knights would have asked for relief by now.
speak;Gilliam;A knight of Frelia does not abandon his post.|Especially not when protecting the royal family.
speak;Larachel;Such dedication!|The knights of Rausten could learn much from your example, Sir Gilliam.
speak;Gilliam;I...thank you, Lady L'Arachel.|But I'm just doing what any knight would do.
speak;Tana;That's not true and you know it.|You make us all feel so safe when you're on duty.|I've always admired that about you, Gilliam.
speak;Larachel;Indeed!|When monsters lurk and evil threatens, knowing a stalwart defender like yourself stands between us and harm is most reassuring!
speak;Gilliam;You honor me with your words.|But please, there's no need for such praise.
speak;Tana;We're not just saying it, Gilliam.|We truly mean it.|Without you, I'm not sure where we'd be.
speak;Larachel;The divine light of justice shines through your armor, Sir Gilliam!|Your dedication is a beacon to us all!
speak;Gilliam;I...thank you both.|Your words mean more than you know.
speak;Gilliam;Rest assured, I will continue to fulfill my duty.|Leave your protection to me.|No harm shall come to either of you while I stand guard.
speak;Tana;We know we can always count on you, Gilliam.
speak;Larachel;Indeed!|The forces of evil shall tremble before your steadfast vigilance!
speak;Gilliam;Now, if you'll excuse me.|I must return to my watch.|The eastern wall still needs checking.
speak;Tana;Of course.|Don't let us keep you.
speak;Larachel;Onward, brave knight!|May the sacred light guide your path!
speak;Tana;He's always so serious, isn't he?
speak;Larachel;Such is the burden of a true knight!|His dedication is truly inspiring!

name: Ch.13ABaseConvo5
_source: speak;Neimi;There you are...|Just stay still a little longer...
speak;Neimi;Oh!|I was tracking the same one.|I've been following it since dawn.
speak;Marisa;I saw it first.|By the river.
speak;Neimi;O-oh...|I'm sorry.|I didn't realize someone else was hunting here.
speak;Marisa;...|It's gone now.|Our talking scared it.
speak;Neimi;I'm so sorry!|I didn't mean to ruin your hunt!|I just...
speak;Marisa;Your bow stance.|It's good.|Where did you learn?
speak;Neimi;My grandfather taught me.|He was the best hunter in our village.|He always said patience was more important than strength.
speak;Marisa;He was right.|Your approach was silent.|I didn't hear you until the last moment.
speak;Neimi;Really?|Thank you!|Grandfather taught me to walk heel-to-toe when stalking.|And to always test each step before putting weight down.
speak;Marisa;Smart.|I was taught differently.|To move with the forest sounds.|Step when birds call.|Freeze when they quiet.
speak;Neimi;That's clever!|I never thought of using bird calls as cover.|Was it your father who taught you that?
speak;Marisa;Yes.|He was a mercenary.|But hunting came first.|Fighting came second.
speak;Neimi;My grandfather was the same way.|He said "A hunter feeds the village.|A soldier protects it.|Both are needed."
speak;Marisa;Your grandfather.|Wise man.|What else did he teach you?

speak;Neimi;Well...|He showed me how to use different arrows for different game.|Blunted tips for birds so you don't damage too much meat.|Barbed heads for larger animals that might run after being hit.
speak;Marisa;Practical.|My father taught tracking.|Reading broken twigs.|Identifying droppings.|Aging footprints.
speak;Neimi;That's amazing!|I'm still learning tracking.|I mostly follow game trails and look for fresh marks.
speak;Marisa;I can show you.|If you want.
speak;Marisa;Why not?|You could teach me bow techniques.|Fair trade.
speak;Neimi;I'd love that!|Oh!|Actually, I think I see our deer again.|Over there, behind that thicket.
speak;Marisa;I see it.|Too far for my sword.|Your range is better.
speak;Neimi;We could work together.|I can drive it toward you with a warning shot.|Then you can make the kill.
speak;Marisa;Good plan.|I'll circle around.|Give me thirty seconds.|Then shoot high.
speak;Neimi;Grandfather always said...|The best hunters know when to work together.|One, two, three...
speak;Neimi;Got it!|It's running right where Marisa should be!
speak;Neimi;We did it!|I've never hunted like that before!|It worked perfectly!
speak;Neimi;I'd like that!|And I can show you how my grandfather preserved meat for winter.|If you're interested...
speak;Marisa;I am.|My father had methods too.|We can compare.
speak;Marisa;Yes.|Now let's dress this deer.|Before dark.
speak;Neimi;Right!|I have my skinning knife right here.

name: Ch15ABaseConvo1
_source: speak;Gerik;There you are.|You shouldn't be wandering off alone right now.
speak;Joshua;I can still see the smoke.|Even from this far out in the desert...|Jehanna Hall is still burning.
speak;Gerik;I know.|I'm sorry about your mother, Joshua.|Queen Ismaire was a fine ruler.
speak;Joshua;And I wasn't there for her.|Not when it mattered.
speak;Gerik;Don't do that to yourself.|You couldn't have known what Grado was planning.
speak;Joshua;I abandoned my duties for years, Gerik.|Played at being a sellsword while she carried the burden alone.
speak;Joshua;And now...|My home is ash. My mother is gone.|And Caellach...
speak;Joshua;We were mercenaries together, once.|Worked for the same company before he joined Grado.|Never thought he'd go this far.
speak;Gerik;The Tiger Eye...|I know of him too.
speak;Gerik;Our paths crossed years back.|He was leading a band of mercenaries that competed with my company for jobs.|Things got... ugly.
speak;Gerik;He ambushed some of my men while I was away.|Three good fighters died that night.|One was just a kid, barely seventeen.
speak;Joshua;I... didn't know.|That sounds like him, though.|Always looking for the advantage, no matter the cost.
speak;Joshua;He's coming back, you know.|To finish us up in this trap.
speak;Gerik;Then we'll be waiting for him.
speak;Gerik;Listen, Joshua...|I know what it's like to lose people.|To want revenge.
speak;Gerik;Just remember—vengeance can consume you if you let it.|You're more than just your mother's son now.|You're Jehanna's king.
speak;Joshua;A king with no castle and no crown.|Some monarch I've turned out to be.
speak;Gerik;Castles can be rebuilt.|A true king is measured by his resolve, not his palace.
speak;Joshua;My resolve is clear.|Caellach will answer for what he's done.|To my mother. To Jehanna. To your men.
speak;Gerik;Then we're in agreement.|The Desert Tiger fights along Jehanna's crown prince.
speak;Joshua;Heh...|I suppose that's us.|When the time comes, I want to face him myself. You understand?
speak;Gerik;I understand the feeling.|But don't be a fool about it.|Pride gets men killed.
speak;Joshua;It's not pride.|It's duty.|A son's duty to his mother...|A king's duty to his kingdom.
speak;Gerik;Then I'll make sure you get your chance.|And I'll have your back when you do.
speak;Joshua;Let's rejoin the others.|We have a war to win before I can settle that score.
speak;Gerik;When you face him...|Make it count.|For all of us.
speak;Joshua;I will.|That's a promise even I won't gamble on.

name: Ch15ABaseConvo2
_source: speak;Tana;Cormag?|There you are.|Everyone's been looking for you.
speak;Cormag;Leave me be, Princess.|This doesn't concern you.
speak;Tana;What's wrong?|Your gripping your weapons so tightly...
speak;Cormag;Scouts reported Valter's forces nearby.|He's finally within my reach.
speak;Tana;Valter?|The man who killed your brother?
speak;Cormag;He didn't just kill Glen.|He butchered him like an animal!|Left him to rot in the sun!
speak;Cormag;I've waited too long already.|By dusk, either Valter dies by my hand,|or I join my brother.
speak;Tana;You can't be serious!|Facing him alone is suicide!
speak;Tana;Please, listen to me.|We can face him together, with the army.|There's no need for you to—
speak;Cormag;No!|This is between Valter and me.|No one else gets involved.
speak;Cormag;You don't understand what it's like.|To see your brother's body defiled.|To carry that image every waking moment!
speak;Tana;You're right. I don't understand that pain.
speak;Tana;But I do understand what it's like to fear for someone I care about!
speak;Cormag;Care?|You barely know me, Princess.|Save your concern for someone who wants it.
speak;Cormag;My mind is made up.|I leave now, while Valter's reach is within my grasp.
speak;Tana;This isn't justice!|This is blind rage!|Glen wouldn't want you to throw your life away!
speak;Cormag;Don't you dare speak of what my brother would want.|You didn't know him.
speak;Tana;I know he was a knight of honor.|And there's no honor in what you're planning.
speak;Cormag;Honor?|Honor died with Glen.|All that remains is vengeance.
speak;Tana;Please...|At least wait until morning.|Give yourself time to think clearly.
speak;Cormag;Every moment Valter draws breath is an insult to my brother's memory.|I've waited long enough.
speak;Tana;Then I'll tell Eirika!|She'll stop you from this madness!
speak;Cormag;By the time you reach him, I'll be gone.|Stay out of my way, Princess.|This isn't your fight.
speak;Tana;It becomes my fight when someone I... when a comrade rushes to his death!
speak;Cormag;My wyvern and I have faced worse odds.|Valter may be skilled, but his arrogance will be his undoing.
speak;Tana;And your anger will be yours!|Can't you see that?
speak;Tana;Fine!|Go get yourself killed!|See if I care!
speak;Tana;Just...|Just know that someone will mourn you.|Even if you're too stubborn to believe it.
speak;Tana;What do I do now?|If he faces Valter alone...|I can't just let him die.
speak;Tana;I need to find Eirika.|We have to stop him before it's too late.

name: Ch15ABaseConvo3
_source: speak;Rennac;Hmm, this desert must be hiding something valuable.|I heard there's ancient treasure buried in these sands...
speak;Saleh;Rennac?|What are you doing out here?|Enemy forces have set up an ambush in this area.
speak;Rennac;An ambush?|That's unfortunate timing.|But surely they wouldn't mind if I collected a few trinkets while we deal with them?
speak;Saleh;Are you serious?|We're about to be surrounded by enemies and you're concerned with treasure hunting?
speak;Rennac;My dear Saleh, opportunity waits for no one!|These desert sands have claimed many travelers... and their valuables.|It would be a waste to leave such prizes unclaimed, wouldn't it?
speak;Saleh;I cannot comprehend your priorities at times.|We need to focus on the imminent threat.
speak;Rennac;Yes, yes, the enemy and all that...|Actually, since you're here, I could use your assistance.
speak;Rennac;Your magic!|Walking through this sand is absolutely dreadful on my boots.|Could you perhaps cast something to make traversing this terrain easier?|A small favor between comrades?
speak;Saleh;You want me to use sacred magic...|so you can hunt for treasure more efficiently?|During an enemy ambush?
speak;Rennac;When you put it that way, it sounds quite reasonable!|I knew you'd understand.
speak;Saleh;*sigh*|Fine.|But only because we need to move quickly through this area.
speak;Rennac;Splendid!|I knew I could count on you.
speak;Saleh;...<green>Ancient winds of Caer Pelyn</>, grant this fool swift passage...
speak;Saleh;There. The spell is complete.|Now I must prepare our forces for the ambush.|Try not to get yourself killed while digging for trinkets.
speak;Rennac;Such concern! I'm touched!|Now, where was that glimmer I spotted earlier...

speak;Rennac;With this spell, I'll find twice the treasure in half the time!|My merchant will be impressed when I return with ancient relics!|...Though perhaps I'll neglect to mention how I acquired them.

name: Ch15ABaseConvo4
_source: speak;Seth;Garcia, enemy forces approaching from both sides.|The trap has been sprung, just as we feared.
speak;Garcia;Aye, I see them.|Sand's making it hard to count their numbers, but there's plenty of them.
speak;Garcia;Heh, reminds me of the fight at the Caer Peyln.|Remember that, Seth?|Outnumbered three to one, and we still sent those monsters running!
speak;Seth;I remember.|Though I recall you nearly getting an claw to the shoulder because you charged ahead too eagerly.
speak;Garcia;Ha! And I recall you lecturing our troops on proper military formation before cutting the monsters down down!|Even in battle, the Silver Knight stays proper!
speak;Seth;Old habits from training the recruits, I suppose.|But today's enemies won't be so easily defeated as those monsters.
speak;Seth;These desert sands give them the advantage.|They've likely been preparing this ambush for days.
speak;Garcia;Numbers and terrain don't win battles, Seth.|Skill and heart do.|And we've got plenty of both!
speak;Seth;Sound wisdom from a veteran warrior.|How do you propose we approach this?
speak;Garcia;I say we take the fight to them!|They expect us to defend, to be cautious.|Let's show them what happens when they corner two of Renais' finest!
speak;Seth;A direct assault...|Against conventional wisdom, but you may be right.|A bold charge might disrupt their formation enough for our forces to regroup.
speak;Garcia;That's the spirit!|My axe is sharp and my arm is strong!|How about you, Silver Knight? Still have some fight left in those bones?
speak;Seth;More than enough to keep pace with you, friend.
speak;Garcia;Ha!|Then it's settled!|Like the heroes in my son's stories, eh?|Two warriors against an army!
speak;Seth;Brothers in arms...|Just like in stories.
speak;Seth;If we fall today, Garcia...|It has been an honor serving alongside you.
speak;Garcia;Save the eulogies for another day, Seth!|We're not dying here.|We're winning here!
speak;Garcia;Ready your lance, Silver Knight!|Let's show these desert rats what happens when they challenge the warriors of Renais!
speak;Seth;Right beside you, Garcia!|For Renais and our comrades!

speak;Garcia;Ready your lance, Silver Knight!|Let's show these desert rats what happens when they challenge the warriors of Renais!
speak;Seth;Right beside you, Garcia!|For Renais and our comrades!

name: Ch15ABaseConvo5
_source: speak;Natasha;*cough*|The smoke... it's still in my lungs...
speak;Moulder;Take a moment to breathe, Sister Natasha.|You've been pushing yourself too hard.
speak;Natasha;Thank you, Father Moulder.|I... I don't think I've sat down since the fire began.
speak;Moulder;Nor have I.|So many wounded from the burning hall...|I fear my old bones aren't what they used to be.
speak;Natasha;Father, your hands are trembling.|You've expended too much of your healing energy.
speak;Moulder;As have you, my dear.|I can see the fatigue in your eyes.
speak;Moulder;Yet I fear our trials are not over.|Look to the horizon.
speak;Moulder;I'm afraid so.|It seems we've walked right into their trap.
speak;Natasha;*sigh*|Just when our allies need rest the most...|How can we possibly tend to more wounded?|My staff is nearly depleted, and I...
speak;Moulder;When you took up the healing staff, you made a promise to the divine.|To be a light in the darkness, to mend what is broken.|Even when your own strength fails.
speak;Natasha;You're right...|I just... I don't know if I have anything left to give.
speak;Moulder;Then we shall draw strength from each other.|I too took those vows, many years ago.|And in all my years of service, I have learned one truth:
speak;Moulder;The divine provides what we need, when we need it most.|Not before, not after.
speak;Natasha;I understand, Father.|Thank you for reminding me of my purpose.
speak;Moulder;Now, let us prepare our remaining staves and vulneraries.|The wounded will need us soon enough.
speak;Natasha;Yes.|While our friends fight, we shall be their shield.|Their comfort and their strength.
speak;Moulder;And remember, Sister Natasha...|We healers may not wield swords or lances,|but our role in this battle is no less vital.
speak;Natasha;I will not falter again, Father Moulder.|As long as one ally stands, I shall be there to mend their wounds.
speak;Moulder;Then let us make our preparations.|The battle approaches, and our friends will need every ounce of our skill.
speak;Natasha;Together, then.|May the divine light guide our hands.
speak;Moulder;Indeed.|Even in our exhaustion, we shall be the miracle our comrades need.
speak;Natasha;<green>Divine light, grant us strength...</>|<green>When our bodies fail, let our spirits endure...</>
speak;Moulder;<green>Guide our hands in the coming trial...</>|<green>Let no ally fall while we still draw breath...</>

name: Ch16ABaseConvo1
_source: speak;Duessel;Knoll, if I may ask...|What exactly was your position in Grado's court?|I've seen you studying those tomes at all hours.
speak;Knoll;I was a researcher in the imperial magic academy.|My focus was primarily on ancient magic and its applications.
speak;Knoll;His majesty, Vigarde allowed our research team certain... freedoms.|We explored magical frontiers that many would consider forbidden.
speak;Duessel;I see.|King Vigarde always did have a keen interest in scholarship.|Though I admit, the magical arts have always been somewhat mysterious to me.
speak;Duessel;Give me a good lance or axe, and I know exactly what to do.|But magic? Incantations and rituals?|I'm afraid I lack the talent entirely.
speak;Knoll;With respect, General Duessel, I don't believe that's true.|Magic isn't merely an innate talent one is born with.
speak;Knoll;Anyone can learn the fundamentals with proper study and practice.|It's a discipline, much like swordsmanship or tactics.
speak;Duessel;Is that so?|I've always been under the impression that one must have a certain... affinity for it.
speak;Knoll;That is a common misconception.|Though I should warn you, magic is not to be taken lightly.
speak;Knoll;The power to manipulate the fundamental forces of nature...|It can be intoxicating, even dangerous.|Many have been consumed by the very forces they sought to control.
speak;Duessel;A sobering warning.|But you truly believe that even an old warhorse like myself could learn?|After all these years wielding steel instead of spells?
speak;Knoll;Age brings wisdom, General.|And wisdom is the foundation of true magical mastery.
speak;Knoll;Here.|This is a beginner's tome on elemental manifestation.|It's where all mages begin their journey.
speak;Duessel;You would lend me such a book?|I'm not certain what use I would have for it, but...
speak;Knoll;Try reading the first chapter before you sleep tonight.|The basic exercises require little more than concentration and breath control.
speak;Knoll;You might be surprised at what you're capable of.
speak;Duessel;Well, I suppose there's no harm in trying.|Though I must admit, I'm still skeptical.|These old hands have held weapons for decades...|I'm not sure they remember how to do much else.
speak;Knoll;The mind is more adaptable than we give it credit for, General.|Even the oldest tree can grow new branches.
speak;Duessel;Ha! A poetic sentiment.|Very well, Knoll. I accept your challenge.|I'll attempt these exercises, though I make no promises about the results.
speak;Knoll;That's all I ask.|And should you have questions, I am at your disposal.
speak;Duessel;I appreciate that.|This old dog may not learn new tricks easily...|But I've never been one to shy away from a challenge.
speak;Duessel;Who knows?|Perhaps there's a mage hiding somewhere beneath all this armor.
alert;Duessel's MAG and MAG growths went up!

name: Ch16ABaseConvo2
_source: speak;Forde;Never thought I'd feel like a stranger approaching our own castle.|It looks different somehow... colder.
speak;Kyle;That's because it's in the hands of traitors and thieves.|But not for much longer.
speak;Kyle;By nightfall, our flag will fly over these walls again.|I swear it.
speak;Forde;Always so serious, Kyle.|But I can't disagree with you this time.
speak;Forde;Can you imagine how it will feel?|Sleeping in our own barracks again?|The training grounds, the kitchens...
speak;Kyle;The royal halls restored to their proper state...|It will be good to come home.
speak;Forde;Remember that chef who made those meat pies?|First thing I'm doing is checking if he's still there.|I've dreamed about those pies during every cold night on this campaign.
speak;Kyle;Ha!|Of course you're thinking about food at a time like this.
speak;Forde;A knight needs his strength!|Besides, we have to have something to look forward to after the battle, don't we?
speak;Kyle;Speaking of the battle...|Their forces are concentrated at the main gate and eastern wall.|It won't be easy.
speak;Forde;With you charging in like a madman?|I'd say their forces are the ones who'll have it rough.
speak;Kyle;I intend to fight with everything I have.|For Renais, for Prince Ephraim, and for those we've lost.
speak;Forde;For Franz and the others waiting for good news...|And for General Seth, who entrusted us with this vanguard position.
speak;Kyle;How many battles have we fought side by side, Forde?
speak;Forde;Too many to count.|Though I seem to remember saving your hide in most of them.
speak;Kyle;Your memory fails you, as usual.|I recall quite the opposite.
speak;Forde;Well, maybe we can settle it once and for all today.|How about a friendly wager?|Whoever takes down more enemies buys the drinks when we celebrate.
speak;Kyle;You're on.|Though I hope you brought enough gold.|Those tavern keepers in Renais know how to charge.
speak;Forde;Ha! Your confidence will be your downfall, Kyle!|I've been saving my energy this whole march.|You'll see my true skill today!
speak;Kyle;Just try to keep up with me.|And watch my back, as always.
speak;Forde;For Renais!|And for those meat pies!

name: Ch16ABaseConvo3
_source: speak;Ross;Hey everyone!|Glad to get everyone gathered together!|I know it's been long, but we have grown together a lot!|Remember when we first started fighting?|I could barely swing my axe without losing my balance!
speak;Franz;And now look at you, Ross.|Charging into battle like a seasoned warrior.
speak;Amelia;It's strange to think about...|How much we've all changed since this war began.
speak;Ewan;I used to just follow my sister around and play tricks.|Now I'm conjuring flames and thunder!|Master Saleh would be proud, I think.
speak;Ross;We've all had to grow up quickly.|Sometimes I wonder what my father thinks...|If he sees how much stronger I've become.
speak;Amelia;I still remember how terrified I was in my first battle.|My lance was shaking so badly...
speak;Franz;But you stood your ground, Amelia.|That takes real courage.
speak;Ewan;Do you ever think about what you'll do?|After the war, I mean.
speak;Ross;Keep training, of course!|I'm going to become the greatest warrior in all of Renais!|Just like my father.
speak;Franz;I'll continue serving as a knight.|There will be much to rebuild once peace returns.
speak;Amelia;I want to help protect the people who can't protect themselves.|No one should have to feel as helpless as I once did.
speak;Ewan;I want to keep learning magic!|There's so much more to discover!
speak;Ross;Hey, I have an idea!|Why don't we make a pact? To keep getting stronger together?
speak;Ross;Yeah! Let's each choose something to focus our training on!|Something that will make us better fighters!
speak;Amelia;That sounds like a wonderful idea, Ross!
speak;Ewan;I'm in!|What should we focus on?
choice;TraineeTogetherChoice;What will the young warriors focus on improving?;Strength,Speed,Defense,Magic,Skill;;;;;;;5,1
speak;Ross;Strength! That's what we need!|The stronger we are, the more damage we can deal!
speak;Franz;A knight must be strong to protect others.|I approve of this choice.
speak;Amelia;I'll need to work extra hard...|But I won't fall behind!
speak;Ewan;Hmm, physical strength isn't really my specialty...|But I could strengthen my magical output!
speak;Ross;That's the spirit!|Let's see who can lift the heaviest boulder by the end of the month!
speak;Amelia;Ross, not everything has to be a competition!
speak;Franz;My brother always says that proper form is as important as raw strength.|I could show you all some exercises he taught me.
speak;Ewan;And I found a spell that might help build muscle faster!|It's worth a try, right?
speak;Amelia;Speed would be most useful, I think!|If we're faster than our enemies, we can strike first!
speak;Franz;General Seth always emphasizes the importance of speed in cavalry.|The faster rider often decides the battle before it truly begins.
speak;Ross;My axe is pretty heavy though...|But I guess I could work on swinging it faster!
speak;Ewan;Speed would help me cast spells more quickly too!|Before the enemy can reach me!
speak;Amelia;We could race each other every morning!|Around the camp perimeter!
speak;Franz;I know some footwork drills that would help as well.|My brother taught them to me.
speak;Ross;Last one to finish runs an extra lap!|That'll motivate us!
speak;Ewan;I think I'm going to lose a lot of races...
speak;Franz;Defense should be our priority.|A warrior who cannot withstand enemy attacks won't survive long enough to win.
speak;Amelia;I agree!|My armor has saved me more times than I can count.
speak;Ross;Defense, huh?|My dad always said a good offense is the best defense...
speak;Ewan;I don't wear armor, but there are defensive spells I could learn!|Barriers and shields of magic!
speak;Franz;We could practice blocking techniques together.|Even without armor, proper positioning can save your life.
speak;Amelia;And I could show you how to maintain your armor!|There's a special oil that prevents rust and keeps joints moving smoothly.
speak;Ross;Fine, fine!|I'll work on defense too!|But I'm still going to hit things really hard!
speak;Ewan;Maybe I can find a spell to temporarily harden skin like stone!|That would be amazing!
speak;Ewan;Magic! That's what I vote for!|There's so much potential in the arcane arts!
speak;Amelia;Magic? But I've not sure in my spell casting ability...
speak;Ross;Me neither! I'm not sure my dad would approve...|He's always been about physical strength.
speak;Franz;Actually, understanding magic could be valuable for all of us.|Even if we don't cast spells, knowing how magic works could help us defend against it.
speak;Ewan;Exactly!|I could teach you the basics!|Everyone has at least some magical potential.
speak;Amelia;Could I really learn magic while wearing armor?|That would be incredible!
speak;Ross;Fire magic on my axe...|That would be pretty amazing...
speak;Ewan;We'll start with simple exercises tomorrow!|You'll be surprised what you can do!
speak;Franz;Skill is what separates a soldier from a true knight.|Precision and technique are everything in battle.
speak;Ross;Skill, huh?|I guess it doesn't matter how strong I am if I can't hit anything...
speak;Amelia;General Duessel always said that skill comes from repetition.|The more we practice, the more precise we become!
speak;Ewan;There's skill in magic too!|Focusing your mind, reciting incantations perfectly...|One small mistake and the spell fails!
speak;Franz;We could set up targets and practice hitting specific points.|It's how I trained when I first became a knight.
speak;Ross;I bet I can hit the bullseye more times than any of you!
speak;Amelia;There you go making everything a competition again, Ross!
speak;Ewan;I'm up for that challenge!|Magic can be pretty accurate too, you know!
speak;Ross;It's settled then!|We'll keep training together and become the strongest warriors in the army!
speak;Franz;My brother would be proud to see us taking our training so seriously.
speak;Amelia;We've all come so far from where we started...|But there's still so much more we can achieve!
speak;Ewan;Together!|No one can stop us when we work as a team!
speak;Franz;To protecting those we care about!

name: Ch16ABaseConvo4
_source: speak;Moulder;*sigh*|Another day goes by and the war still wages on....
speak;Saleh;The last few battles have been difficult.|Their forces were well-coordinated.
speak;Moulder;It wasn't just their warriors that troubled us.|Did you notice their staff wielders?|The precision of their hexes was... unsettling.
speak;Saleh;Yes.|The thunder staff they used on Sir Gilliam nearly led to disaster.
speak;Moulder;He was charging directly at the enemy and almost got hit.|And that fire staff they used on General Seth...|If Natasha hadn't been nearby with a healing staff...
speak;Saleh;Their range is concerning as well.|They can cast from positions we cannot easily reach.
speak;Moulder;In all my years serving Renais, I've never encountered magic users with such deadly efficiency.|It's as if they can sense our vulnerabilities from afar.
speak;Saleh;The ancient texts of Caer Pelyn speak of such practitioners.|Those who forge a connection with their targets across great distances.
speak;Moulder;Is there a way to counter such abilities?|Our healing staves help after the fact, but...|I would prefer to prevent these afflictions entirely.
speak;Saleh;There are methods.|Magical resistance can be cultivated through certain practices.
speak;Moulder;Truly?|Please, Master Saleh, any wisdom you could share would be invaluable.
speak;Saleh;The training would take years.|We don't have that luxury in our current circumstances.
speak;Moulder;I see.|Then we must continue to react rather than prevent.
speak;Saleh;When I departed from Caer Pelyn, my grandmother insisted I take this.
speak;Saleh;She foresaw that dark forces would attempt to control the minds of our allies.
speak;Moulder;What is it that she gave you?
speak;Moulder;A staff?|But it's unlike any I've seen before...|The crystal at its peak seems to shimmer with an inner light.
speak;Saleh;It is a barrier staff.|Ancient in design, crafted by the sages of Caer Pelyn centuries ago.
speak;Saleh;When activated, it creates a protective field around our allies.|It strengthens their resistance to magical influence.
speak;Moulder;Such a tool would be invaluable in our current struggles!|But surely you should be the one to wield it?|Your magical prowess far exceeds my own.
speak;Saleh;No.|My role is elsewhere on the battlefield.|You, Father Moulder, are always positioned to observe our forces.
speak;Saleh;You know better than anyone when our allies are most vulnerable.|When protection is most needed.
speak;Moulder;I'm honored by your trust, Master Saleh.|But are you certain?|Such a rare artifact...
speak;Saleh;I am certain.|Take it.|Use it to shield our companions from the enemy's influence.
speak;Moulder;Then I accept this responsibility with the utmost gravity.|I swear by the sacred light that I will use it wisely.
speak;Moulder;Thank you, Master Saleh.|Your generosity may well turn the tide of our coming battles.
speak;Saleh;It is not generosity that motivates me, but necessity.|The darkness that pursues us grows stronger each day.
speak;Saleh;We must use every tool at our disposal if we are to prevail.
speak;Moulder;Indeed.|And with this barrier staff, we shall ensure that our minds remain our own.|Our wills unbent by enemy magic.
speak;Saleh;The staff requires focus to use effectively.|I can show you the proper incantations before tomorrow's march.
speak;Moulder;I would be most grateful for your instruction, Master Saleh.|Together, we shall protect our comrades from these insidious attacks.

name: Ch16BBaseConvo4
_source: speak;Moulder;*sigh*|Another day goes by and the war still wages on....
speak;Saleh;The last few battles have been difficult.|Their forces were well-coordinated.
speak;Moulder;It wasn't just their warriors that troubled us.|Did you notice their staff wielders?|The precision of their hexes was... unsettling.
speak;Saleh;Yes.|The thunder staff they used on Sir Gilliam nearly led to disaster.
speak;Moulder;He was charging directly at the enemy and almost got hit.|And that fire staff they used on General Seth...|If Natasha hadn't been nearby with a healing staff...
speak;Saleh;Their range is concerning as well.|They can cast from positions we cannot easily reach.
speak;Moulder;In all my years serving Renais, I've never encountered magic users with such deadly efficiency.|It's as if they can sense our vulnerabilities from afar.
speak;Saleh;The ancient texts of Caer Pelyn speak of such practitioners.|Those who forge a connection with their targets across great distances.

name: Ch16ABaseConvo5
_source: speak;Larachel;The rumors were true...|Renais castle has fallen to darkness.|Such wickedness cannot be allowed to stand!
speak;Natasha;It pains me to see a once-proud kingdom reduced to this.|Orson's betrayal has brought nothing but suffering.
speak;Larachel;The traitor Orson must answer for his crimes!|As a servant of the divine, I cannot abide such evil.|His twisted obsession has corrupted these sacred halls!
speak;Natasha;But L'Arachel...|He was once a good man, a loyal knight.|Is there no redemption possible for him?
speak;Larachel;My dear Natasha, your compassion is admirable.|However, some darkness runs too deep.|Such desecration cannot be forgiven!
speak;Natasha;I...|I have heard what he has done, but I could not believe them to be true.
speak;Larachel;The light of righteousness must purge this castle of its taint!|I, L'Arachel, princess of the theocracy of Rausten, shall banish this wickedness!
speak;Natasha;I understand your zeal, but we must not lose our own humanity in the process.|Vengeance alone cannot restore what was lost.
speak;Larachel;This is not vengeance, my friend.|This is divine judgment!|The sacred light shall cleanse this corruption!
speak;Natasha;...|You are right.|His tyranny has brought too much suffering.|For the people of Renais, this must end.
speak;Larachel;Then we are of one mind at last!|Together, we shall return this castle to its rightful glory!
speak;Natasha;I have something that may help.|This <blue>Light tome</> contains powerful ancient magic.
speak;Larachel;Oh!|Is this truly for me?|How magnificent!
speak;Natasha;Use it wisely.|May the sacred light guide your hand against the darkness that Orson has wrought.
speak;Larachel;With this divine power and our righteous cause, we cannot fail!|The darkness shall be vanquished!|Evil shall be purged!|And I, L'Arachel, shall lead the charge!
speak;Natasha;May the gods watch over us all in the battle to come.
speak;Larachel;Fear not, citizens of Renais!|Your salvation is at hand!|The darkness shall soon be lifted from your fair kingdom!

name: Ch17ABaseConvo1
_source: speak;Dozla;Gwah ha ha!|Look at this, Lady Lute!|The sea teems with ships today!
speak;Lute;Indeed. And they're all maintaining a significant distance from the eastern waters.|That's consistent with my notes on <red>Lizardzerker</> territorial patterns.
speak;Dozla;Oh?|You know of the <red>Lizardzerkers</>, Lady Lute?

speak;Lute;Of course. I've compiled a preliminary thesis on reptilian humanoid anomalies.|My research indicates they're berserkers who've undergone partial lizard metamorphosis.|However, my notes lack firsthand observational data.
speak;Dozla;Gwah ha ha!|Well, you're in luck!|I've fought those scaly brutes myself!
speak;Lute;You have?|This is excellent!|My research has been limited to accounts from sailors and fragmentary texts.|You must tell me everything.
speak;Dozla;Fierce warriors, they are!|One nearly split my favorite axe with a single parry!|Strength that would make even General Duessel envious!
speak;Lute;Fascinating.|My texts suggest enhanced musculature but not to that degree.|Would you estimate their strength at 2.7 or 3.2 times that of a standard berserker?
speak;Dozla;Err... I'd say they're... very strong?|Gwah ha ha!|Numbers aren't my specialty, Lady Lute!

speak;Lute;My research is inconclusive regarding their transformation process.|The Bael Manuscript suggests dietary causation, while Elder Sages theorize a magical affliction.|What insights can you offer?
speak;Dozla;The old sea dogs claim it comes from eating weird magical fish guts and seaweed!|Others say they made blood pacts with sea serpents!|I'm not sure which is true!
speak;Lute;I suspected as much.|This confirms my hypothesis that multiple pathways to lizardification exist.|I must update my research immediately.
speak;Dozla;You truly are the superior mind Lady L'Arachel claims!|Tell me, what's the best way to defeat these creatures?|My standard axe barely scratched their scales!

speak;Lute;Based on my taxonomic classification, they would be vulnerable to thermal disruption.|My thesis suggests an ice-enchanted weapon would be optimal.|The cold would inhibit their movement while bypassing scale protection.
speak;Dozla;Gwah ha ha!|An ice axe!|Brilliant, Lady Lute!|That's why you're the prodigy!
speak;Lute;The theory is sound, but untested.|I'd be most interested in documenting the results of such an encounter.|For academic purposes, of course.
speak;Dozla;Well then, I'll head to the armory and commission an ice axe right away!|Lady L'Arachel would be most pleased if I brought her a <red>Lizardzerker</> scale as a trophy!
speak;Lute;Wait, I should accompany you to record the precise enchantment parameters...|I need to specify the optimal freezing coefficient...
speak;Lute;And he's gone.|Unfortunate.|I suppose I'll have to update my notes with estimated values.|Perhaps I can collect tissue samples once he returns.
speak;Lute;This will make an excellent addition to my monograph on maritime monstrosities.|I wonder if the transformation affects their cognitive functions...|So many variables to explore.

name: Ch17ABaseConvo2
_source: speak;Joshua;So, Rennac... care to try your luck?|I've heard you've been making quite a profit lately.
speak;Rennac;That depends.|What kind of game did you have in mind?|And more importantly, what are the stakes?
speak;Joshua;Simple enough.|I'll flip this coin.|You call it in the air.
speak;Rennac;A coin toss?|Really, Joshua?|I expected something more... sophisticated from the gambling prince.
speak;Joshua;Sometimes the simplest games are the most revealing.|Besides, I've got a special wager in mind.
speak;Joshua;If I win, you'll tell me where you've hidden that rare Jehanna gemstone|you've been so secretive about.
speak;Rennac;What?|How did you...?|I mean, what gemstone?
speak;Joshua;Come now, Rennac.|We both know what you took from the Jehanna treasure vaults.|I'm just curious where you've stashed it.
speak;Joshua;My mother's ring.|Pure Jehannan gold with a desert ruby.|Worth more than that gemstone, I'd wager.
speak;Rennac;Now that is interesting.|Very well, I accept.|But I choose the stakes.
speak;Rennac;Even.|I've always found balance brings good fortune.
speak;Joshua;Even!|Luck smiles upon me once again.
speak;Joshua;Be my guest.|You'll find nothing amiss.
speak;Rennac;This is ridiculous!|How do you always manage to win these bets?
speak;Joshua;Some call it luck.|Others call it fate.|Either way, I believe you owe me some information.
speak;Rennac;Fine.|The gemstone is hidden in the false bottom of my travel chest.|Satisfied?
speak;Joshua;Very.|Don't worry, your secret is safe with me.
speak;Rennac;I should have known better than to gamble with you.|What will it take to keep you quiet about this?
speak;Joshua;Buy me a drink and we'll call it even.|For now, at least.
speak;Joshua;So I've been told.|Barkeep! Your finest ale for two weary travelers!
speak;Rennac;I'll get you back for this, Joshua.|Mark my words.
speak;Joshua;I look forward to it.|Life's always more interesting with a challenge.
speak;Joshua;Odd!|Well, would you look at that...
speak;Rennac;Perhaps your legendary luck is finally running dry.|Now, about that ring...
speak;Rennac;My, my... it's even more beautiful up close.|The craftsmanship is exquisite.
speak;Joshua;It's been in my family for generations.|Take good care of it.
speak;Rennac;Oh, I intend to.|By selling it to the highest bidder!|Just kidding, just kidding!
speak;Rennac;Relax, gambling man.|I'm no fool.|I know better than to cross Jehanna royalty.
speak;Rennac;Tell you what—I'll hold onto this as collateral.|Win it back from me in our next game.
speak;Joshua;You're on.|Double or nothing next time.
speak;Rennac;I wouldn't have it any other way.|Drinks are on me tonight.|To celebrate my rare victory!
speak;Joshua;Enjoy it while it lasts.|Lady Luck is fickle, friend.
speak;Rennac;So are thieves and rogues, Joshua.|So are thieves and rogues.
