name: Ch17ABaseConvo3
_source: speak;Amelia;Oof!|I can't believe I tripped over my own lance again...|Some soldier I'm turning out to be.
speak;Tethys;My, my. That was quite the tumble you took there.|Are you alright, dear?
speak;Amelia;Oh!|T-Tethys! I didn't see you there.
speak;Tethys;I've been watching you for a little while now.|You seem to have some... coordination issues.
speak;Amelia;I-I know...|I've always been clumsy.|No matter how hard I try, I keep stumbling around.
speak;Tethys;Hmm...|You know, I think I might be able to help with that.
speak;Tethys;With dance, of course!|Dancing improves balance, coordination, and awareness of your body's movements.
speak;Amelia;D-Dancing?|But I'm even worse at dancing than I am at marching!
speak;Tethys;Everyone starts somewhere, dear.|Would you allow me to teach you some basic steps?
speak;Amelia;I don't know...|I'll probably just embarrass myself...
speak;Tethys;Nonsense!|There's no one around to see, and I promise I won't laugh.
speak;Amelia;Well...|Alright. I'll give it a try.|But don't say I didn't warn you!
speak;Tethys;Wonderful!|Now, let's start with something simple.|Follow my lead...
speak;Tethys;It's quite alright.|Let's try again, but slower this time.
speak;Amelia;I tripped again!|Maybe this isn't such a good idea after all...
speak;Tethys;Patience, dear Amelia.|Renais wasn't built in a day, and neither is a dancer.
speak;Amelia;I guess you're right...|Let me try once more.
speak;Tethys;There you go!|You're starting to get it!
speak;Amelia;I am?|I... I think I am!
speak;Tethys;Now add a little sway...|Yes, just like that!
speak;Amelia;This is actually... fun!|And I haven't fallen for at least a minute!
speak;Tethys;You're a natural once you find your rhythm.|Look how gracefully you're moving now!
speak;Amelia;I can't believe it!|I'm actually dancing!
speak;Tethys;You've done wonderfully, Amelia.|In fact, I have something for you.
speak;Tethys;For being such a dedicated student.|Wait right here.
speak;Amelia;I wonder what it could be...|I hope I didn't impose too much on her time.
speak;Tethys;Here they are!|A pair of dancing shoes.|They're lightweight and perfect for beginners.
speak;Tethys;They'll help you maintain your balance.|And they might just give you a bit more confidence too.
speak;Amelia;Thank you so much, Tethys!|This means more to me than you know.
speak;Tethys;It's my pleasure, dear.|Now, shall we continue our lesson?|We've only just begun!
speak;Amelia;Yes, please!|I want to learn everything you can teach me!
speak;Tethys;That's the spirit!|Now, let's try a spin...

name: Ch17BBaseConvo3
_source: speak;Amelia;Oof!|I can't believe I tripped over my own lance again...|Some soldier I'm turning out to be.
speak;Tethys;My, my. That was quite the tumble you took there.|Are you alright, dear?
speak;Amelia;Oh!|T-Tethys! I didn't see you there.
speak;Tethys;I've been watching you for a little while now.|You seem to have some... coordination issues.
speak;Amelia;I-I know...|I've always been clumsy.|No matter how hard I try, I keep stumbling around.
speak;Tethys;Hmm...|You know, I think I might be able to help with that.
speak;Tethys;With dance, of course!|Dancing improves balance, coordination, and awareness of your body's movements.
speak;Amelia;D-Dancing?|But I'm even worse at dancing than I am at marching!
speak;Tethys;Everyone starts somewhere, dear.|Would you allow me to teach you some basic steps?
speak;Amelia;I don't know...|I'll probably just embarrass myself...
speak;Tethys;Nonsense!|There's no one around to see, and I promise I won't laugh.
speak;Amelia;Well...|Alright. I'll give it a try.|But don't say I didn't warn you!
speak;Tethys;Wonderful!|Now, let's start with something simple.|Follow my lead...
speak;Tethys;It's quite alright.|Let's try again, but slower this time.
speak;Amelia;I tripped again!|Maybe this isn't such a good idea after all...
speak;Tethys;Patience, dear Amelia.|Renais wasn't built in a day, and neither is a dancer.
speak;Amelia;I guess you're right...|Let me try once more.
speak;Tethys;There you go!|You're starting to get it!
speak;Amelia;I am?|I... I think I am!
speak;Tethys;Now add a little sway...|Yes, just like that!
speak;Amelia;This is actually... fun!|And I haven't fallen for at least a minute!
speak;Tethys;You're a natural once you find your rhythm.|Look how gracefully you're moving now!
speak;Amelia;I can't believe it!|I'm actually dancing!
speak;Tethys;You've done wonderfully, Amelia.|In fact, I have something for you.
speak;Tethys;For being such a dedicated student.|Wait right here.
speak;Amelia;I wonder what it could be...|I hope I didn't impose too much on her time.
speak;Tethys;Here they are!|A pair of dancing shoes.|They're lightweight and perfect for beginners.
speak;Tethys;They'll help you maintain your balance.|And they might just give you a bit more confidence too.
speak;Amelia;Thank you so much, Tethys!|This means more to me than you know.
speak;Tethys;It's my pleasure, dear.|Now, shall we continue our lesson?|We've only just begun!
speak;Amelia;Yes, please!|I want to learn everything you can teach me!
speak;Tethys;That's the spirit!|Now, let's try a spin...

name: Ch17ABaseConvo4
_source: speak;Ross;The Narube River!|It's so vast!|The water's so clear you can see straight to the bottom!
speak;Tana;It's beautiful, isn't it?|The local villagers really depend on this river for their livelihood.
speak;Ross;Yeah, they do.|My father used to fish here when I was younger.|He would bring home the biggest catches!
speak;Tana;I can imagine!|The fish here are known to be quite plentiful.
speak;Ross;That's why I'm here!|I want to see if I can catch some myself!|Maybe even bigger than what my father caught!
speak;Tana;Ha ha! That's quite the ambition, Ross!|I'm sure you'll manage somehow.
speak;Ross;You bet I will!|Maybe I can even catch enough to share with everyone in camp!
speak;Tana;That would be wonderful.|Fresh fish would be a nice change from our usual rations.
speak;Tana;You know, Syrene should be stationed near here.|I wonder if she's patrolling this area...
speak;Ross;Syrene?|Isn't she one of the Pegasus Knights of Frelia?
speak;Tana;Yes, she is.|And she's also my dear friend.
speak;Tana;I haven't seen her in such a long time...|I hope she's doing alright.
speak;Ross;I'm sure she's fine!|She's a strong knight, isn't she?|Just like you!
speak;Tana;Thank you, Ross.|That's very kind of you to say.
speak;Ross;It's the truth!|Hey, maybe we can look for her after I catch some fish?
speak;Tana;That would be lovely.|I'd appreciate the company.
speak;Ross;Great!|It's decided then!|First fishing, then finding your friend!
speak;Tana;Perfect plan!|Just be careful not to fall in - the current can be strong here.
speak;Ross;Ha!|Don't worry about me!|The son of Garcia knows how to handle himself near water!
speak;Tana;I'm sure you do!|Come on then, let's find a good fishing spot.
speak;Tana;Ross, wait!|The fishing spots are the other way!

name: Ch17ABaseConvo5
_source: speak;Ewan;Watch this, Myrrh!|I've been practicing a new spell!
speak;Ewan;Master Saleh taught me this one just last week.|It's supposed to create a small whirlwind.
speak;Myrrh;Oh!|The leaves... they're dancing in the air.
speak;Ewan;Pretty cool, right?|I've been working on controlling the size of the gust.|Watch, I can make it bigger!
speak;Myrrh;It's wonderful, Ewan.|The way you command the wind...
speak;Ewan;Thanks!|I'm going to be as good as my master someday!|Maybe even better, but don't tell him I said that.
speak;Myrrh;Your magic is different from what I've seen before.|It feels... playful.
speak;Ewan;That's because magic should be fun!|At least that's what I think.
speak;Ewan;Say, Myrrh...|Do you know any magic?
speak;Myrrh;I...|I don't know if you could call it magic, exactly...
speak;Ewan;What do you mean?|Can you do something special?
speak;Ewan;Breathe fire?!|That's amazing!|Can you show me? Please?
speak;Myrrh;I'm not sure if I should...|People are often frightened when they see...
speak;Ewan;I won't be scared!|I promise!|Please, Myrrh? I showed you my magic!
speak;Myrrh;...Very well.|But please, step back a little.
speak;Ewan;AMAZING!|That was the coolest thing I've ever seen!|The fire was so bright and colorful!
speak;Ewan;Afraid? Why would I be afraid?|That was incredible!|Can you teach me how to do that?
speak;Myrrh;I'm afraid not...|It's something only my kind can do.
speak;Ewan;Aww, that's too bad.|But still, you're amazing, Myrrh!
speak;Myrrh;Thank you, Ewan.|Most humans are frightened when they see my dragon form.
speak;Ewan;Well, they're just silly then!|I think it's the most impressive magic I've ever seen!|Even better than what Master Saleh can do!
speak;Myrrh;You're very kind.|I'm glad... I'm glad I showed you.
speak;Ewan;We should practice magic together sometime!|You can show me more dragon stuff, and I'll show you more spells!
speak;Myrrh;I would like that very much.|I've never had a friend to practice with before.
speak;Ewan;Well, now you do!|We're friends now, Myrrh!|Dragon-human friendship pact, sealed by fire magic!
speak;Myrrh;Yes...|Friends.|I'm very happy to have met you, Ewan.
speak;Ewan;Me too, Myrrh!|Now come on, let's go find something else to set on fire!
speak;Myrrh;Ewan!|That's not what magic is for!

name: Ch18ABaseConvo1
_source: speak;Tana;Finally!|A moment of peace where we can all be together.
speak;Vanessa;It has been quite some time since the three of us could speak like this.|The war has kept us rather occupied.
speak;Syrene;Indeed.|I'm grateful for this brief respite from battle.|It's good to see both of you safe and well.
speak;Tana;Syrene!|I was so worried when I heard you were stationed near the Narube River.|We hadn't received word from you in so long!
speak;Syrene;My apologies, Princess Tana.|The enemy forces were preventing any messengers from getting through.
speak;Vanessa;Sister, we were all concerned.|But I knew if anyone could survive such an assignment, it would be you.
speak;Syrene;And look at you, Vanessa.|You've grown so much as a knight since we last flew together.
speak;Vanessa;I've only followed the example you set for me, Sister.
speak;Tana;You're both amazing!|The pride of Frelia's pegasus knights!|I only hope to be as skilled as you both someday.
speak;Syrene;Princess, you sell yourself short.|Your skills have improved tremendously.|King Hayden would be proud of your progress.
speak;Vanessa;It's true.|You've proven yourself on the battlefield many times over.
speak;Tana;Thank you, both of you.|I've had excellent teachers in you two.
speak;Tana;Speaking of Frelia...|Do you miss home as much as I do?
speak;Syrene;Every day.|The clear blue skies over Castle Frelia...|There's nothing quite like it.
speak;Vanessa;And the mountain ranges where we train.|I find myself dreaming of those peaks.
speak;Tana;The spring festival in the capital city...|The summer flowers in the royal gardens...|I can't wait to see it all again.
speak;Tana;But first, we must see this war through to the end.|Together.
speak;Vanessa;The three knights of Frelia, fighting as one.
speak;Tana;Oh!|That reminds me...|I have something for both of you.
speak;Vanessa;I wonder what the princess has prepared.
speak;Syrene;She's always been thoughtful, even as a child.
speak;Tana;Here they are!|One for each of us.
speak;Tana;They're trinkets of Fale, the wind god of Frelia.|I had them made before we left the castle.
speak;Tana;I've been saving them for when we could all be together again.
speak;Syrene;These are exquisite, Princess.|The craftsmanship is remarkable.
speak;Vanessa;A wind god for pegasus knights...|How fitting.
speak;Tana;Legend says that Fale watches over those who soar through his domain.|That he guides the winds to carry pegasi safely home.
speak;Tana;I thought...|I hoped these might protect us.|So that we never have to be separated again.
speak;Syrene;It's a wonderful gift, Princess Tana.|I shall treasure it always.
speak;Tana;Please, both of you, just call me Tana.|We're friends first, before princess and knights.
speak;Tana;Let's make a promise.|With these trinkets as our bond.|That we'll protect each other and return to Frelia together.
speak;Tana;No matter what happens in this war...|We three will fly home as one.
speak;Tana;Then it's settled!|May Fale's winds guide our wings and keep us safe!

name: Ch18ABaseConvo2
_source: speak;Knoll;Excuse me...|You are Saleh of Caer Pelyn, are you not?
speak;Saleh;I am.|And you are Knoll, a shaman of Grado.
speak;Knoll;Yes...|I hope I'm not intruding.|There is much I've read about the mountain village of Caer Pelyn.
speak;Knoll;The ancient wisdom preserved there...|The connection to the Great Dragon...
speak;Saleh;What is it you wish to know?
speak;Knoll;I was hoping to learn more about the sacred histories kept in your village.|The texts in Grado's libraries mention Caer Pelyn as a place of great knowledge.
speak;Saleh;Our knowledge is not shared lightly.|Particularly with those who hail from Grado.
speak;Saleh;Your empire's recent actions have given us reason for caution.
speak;Knoll;I... understand your hesitation.|What happened in Grado was not the will of its people.
speak;Knoll;The emperor was not himself.|Something changed him...
speak;Saleh;So I have heard.|Yet caution remains wisdom in these dark times.
speak;Knoll;Of course.|I apologize for my presumption.
speak;Knoll;If I may ask just one question, though...|Does Caer Pelyn's lore speak of the Demon King?
speak;Saleh;Why do you ask about such things?
speak;Knoll;My research in Grado...|Before everything went wrong...|We found references to ancient powers.
speak;Knoll;Powers that Prince Lyon sought to harness.|I fear it may have been connected to the Demon King's influence.
speak;Saleh;The Demon King is more than legend.|That much I can tell you.
speak;Saleh;Our elders speak of a darkness that once engulfed all the land.|A darkness that sought to destroy all life.
speak;Knoll;Then the stories are true...|Do your records tell of how such power might be unsealed?|Of what signs would herald his return?
speak;Saleh;Ancient evil does not rest easily.|It seeks vessels through which to return.
speak;Saleh;Those who seek power above all else...|Those who would disturb what must remain sealed...
speak;Saleh;They become the very doorways through which darkness enters.
speak;Knoll;Lyon...|Is that what happened to you?
speak;Saleh;I do not have all the answers you seek.|The Great Dragon might know more, but such knowledge is not mine to share.
speak;Saleh;What I can tell you is this:|When light and darkness wage war, it is within the hearts of men that the true battle is fought.
speak;Knoll;I see...|Thank you for even this much, Saleh.|It is more than I had before.
speak;Saleh;Knowledge is a double-edged blade, Knoll of Grado.|Be careful what you seek, lest you cut yourself on its edge.
speak;Knoll;You speak wisely.|Perhaps when this war is over...|If we survive...|Maybe then Caer Pelyn might be more open to sharing its wisdom.
speak;Saleh;Perhaps.|The future remains unwritten.|For now, we must focus on the threats before us.
speak;Knoll;Indeed.|Thank you for your time, Saleh of Caer Pelyn.
speak;Saleh;May the Great Dragon guide your path, Knoll of Grado.

name: Ch18ABaseConvo3
_source: speak;Knoll;Hmm...|The lava's flow here is particularly strong...|The ancient texts speak of drawing power from such places.
speak;Knoll;If I can just observe the pattern of the currents...
speak;Knoll;...|I feel as though I'm being watched...
speak;Lute;Subject continues to examine volcanic activity.|Hypothesis: attempting forbidden magical experimentation.
speak;Knoll;Gah!|How long have you been standing there?
speak;Lute;Precisely fourteen minutes and thirty-seven seconds.|I've been documenting your behavior.
speak;Knoll;Lute...|This is the third time I've caught you... observing me.
speak;Lute;Fourth, actually.|You failed to notice me yesterday by the river.
speak;Lute;What exactly are you attempting with the volcano?|Some type of Gradonian dark magic, I presume?
speak;Knoll;I'm simply conducting research.|There's nothing sinister about it.
speak;Lute;My superior intellect tells me otherwise.|You've been measuring the lava patterns and consulting that tome for days.
speak;Lute;You're clearly attempting to harness volcanic energy.
speak;Knoll;I've been studying an ancient technique to imbue magical tomes with elemental properties.
speak;Knoll;This volcano has unique qualities that could enhance fire magic.
speak;Lute;Imbuing tomes with elemental properties?|That's...|That's actually quite innovative.
speak;Lute;Wait a moment!|Are you attempting to create a spell that would surpass my magical genius?
speak;Knoll;I'm merely trying to preserve some knowledge from Grado's libraries before it's lost forever.
speak;Lute;Hmm.|A likely story.|My intellect is superior to all others in the army, you know.
speak;Knoll;I... have no doubt of your abilities, Miss Lute.|I've heard tales of your prodigious talents.
speak;Knoll;In fact, perhaps you would be interested in this research?|The tome itself could benefit from a fresh perspective.
speak;Lute;You would share your findings with me?|Even after I've been monitoring you?
speak;Knoll;Knowledge should be preserved and shared.|That's what Prince Lyon always believed...
speak;Knoll;Here.|I've made notes on the margins.
speak;Knoll;Yes.|I think you may understand it better than I do.|The volcanic energies seem to respond better to anima magic than dark magic.
speak;Lute;Well...|I suppose if anyone can perfect this technique, it would be me.
speak;Lute;There are indeed no better hands for a tome with the power of a volcano.|My genius will ensure its completion.
speak;Knoll;I have no doubt.|Perhaps you could share what you discover?|For academic purposes, of course.
speak;Lute;I shall document my process with exacting precision.|You may review my notes when I've finished.
speak;Lute;Though I doubt you'll comprehend the full depth of my magical theory.
speak;Lute;But I'll simplify it for you, as a courtesy.
speak;Lute;Now, if you'll excuse me.|I must begin my analysis immediately.
speak;Lute;This volcanic power will be a worthy addition to my unparalleled magical arsenal.
speak;Knoll;What an... unusual person.|Though I must admit, her confidence is rather impressive.
speak;Knoll;Perhaps giving her that tome was the wisest decision.|At least now she might stop following me...

speak;Knoll;Lute...|This is the third time I've caught you... observing me.
speak;Lute;Fourth, actually.|You failed to notice me yesterday by the river.
speak;Lute;What exactly are you attempting with the volcano?|Some type of Gradonian dark magic, I presume?
speak;Knoll;I'm simply conducting research.|There's nothing sinister about it.
speak;Lute;My superior intellect tells me otherwise.|You've been measuring the lava patterns and consulting that tome for days.
speak;Lute;You're clearly attempting to harness volcanic energy.
speak;Knoll;I've been studying an ancient technique to imbue magical tomes with elemental properties.
speak;Knoll;This volcano has unique qualities that could enhance fire magic.
speak;Lute;Imbuing tomes with elemental properties?|That's...|That's actually quite innovative.
speak;Lute;Wait a moment!|Are you attempting to create a spell that would surpass my magical genius?
speak;Knoll;I'm merely trying to preserve some knowledge from Grado's libraries before it's lost forever.
speak;Lute;Hmm.|A likely story.|My intellect is superior to all others in the army, you know.
speak;Knoll;I... have no doubt of your abilities, Miss Lute.|I've heard tales of your prodigious talents.
speak;Knoll;In fact, perhaps you would be interested in this research?|The tome itself could benefit from a fresh perspective.
speak;Lute;You would share your findings with me?|Even after I've been monitoring you?
speak;Knoll;Knowledge should be preserved and shared.|That's what Prince Lyon always believed...
speak;Knoll;Here.|I've made notes on the margins.
speak;Knoll;Yes.|I think you may understand it better than I do.|The volcanic energies seem to respond better to anima magic than dark magic.
speak;Lute;Well...|I suppose if anyone can perfect this technique, it would be me.
speak;Lute;There are indeed no better hands for a tome with the power of a volcano.|My genius will ensure its completion.
speak;Knoll;I have no doubt.|Perhaps you could share what you discover?|For academic purposes, of course.
speak;Lute;I shall document my process with exacting precision.|You may review my notes when I've finished.
speak;Lute;Though I doubt you'll comprehend the full depth of my magical theory.
speak;Lute;But I'll simplify it for you, as a courtesy.
speak;Lute;Now, if you'll excuse me.|I must begin my analysis immediately.
speak;Lute;This volcanic power will be a worthy addition to my unparalleled magical arsenal.
speak;Knoll;What an... unusual person.|Though I must admit, her confidence is rather impressive.
speak;Knoll;Perhaps giving her that tome was the wisest decision.|At least now she might stop following me...

name: Ch18ABaseConvo4
_source: speak;Dozla;Gwa ha ha!|Look at these mountains, Saleh!|Fire and stone as far as the eye can see!
speak;Saleh;The mountains of Neleras.|One of the most volcanic regions in all of Magvel.
speak;Dozla;Gwah ha!|Just the kind of place that gets the blood pumping!|Nothing like a bit of danger to make you feel alive!
speak;Saleh;You seem rather... enthusiastic about traversing such treacherous terrain.
speak;Dozla;Of course!|What's an adventure without a little risk?|Lady L'Arachel would expect nothing less than my full excitement!
speak;Saleh;I see.|I myself hope to find some historical sites within these mountains.
speak;Saleh;The ancient texts speak of ruins from the era of the Great Dragon.|They may contain knowledge that has been lost to time.
speak;Dozla;Historical ruins, you say?|Gwa ha ha!|Those always have the best treasures!|And the most dangerous traps!
speak;Saleh;Dozla, I feel I should warn you.|These mountains are home to many dangerous creatures.
speak;Saleh;Gorgons have been sighted with increasing frequency.
speak;Saleh;Their stone gaze can paralyze a man in seconds.
speak;Dozla;Gorgons, you say?|Gwa ha ha HA!|Excellent news!
speak;Saleh;Excellent?|I don't think you understand the danger, Dozla.
speak;Saleh;Gorgons are not the only threat.|There are reports of gargoyles, cyclopes, and other creatures born of darkness.
speak;Dozla;Even better!|I HOPE we encounter these foul beasts!|My axe has been thirsting for a good battle!
speak;Dozla;Gwa ha ha!|What's the point of an adventure if there aren't any monsters to vanquish?
speak;Saleh;Your enthusiasm for combat is... concerning.
speak;Saleh;These creatures are not to be taken lightly.|Many experienced warriors have fallen in these mountains.
speak;Dozla;Bah!|Those warriors didn't have the might of Dozla on their side!|Or the divine blessing of Lady L'Arachel!
speak;Dozla;Don't you worry, Saleh!|I'll protect you while you do your scholarly poking about in those ruins!
speak;Saleh;I appreciate the offer, but I am capable of defending myself.
speak;Saleh;The magic of Caer Pelyn has served me well against such threats before.
speak;Dozla;Gwa ha ha!|That's the spirit!|Between your magic and my axe, those monsters don't stand a chance!
speak;Dozla;Let them come!|I'll show them the might of Dozla, faithful servant to Lady L'Arachel!
speak;Saleh;Your confidence is... somewhat reassuring, I suppose.
speak;Saleh;Just remember to exercise caution.|The heat of these volcanic mountains can drain one's strength quickly.
speak;Dozla;Gwa ha ha!|A little heat never bothered me!|After fighting alongside Lady L'Arachel, nothing can quench my fighting spirit!
speak;Dozla;Now, which way to these ruins of yours?|I'm eager to start cracking some monster skulls!
speak;Saleh;According to my research, they should be beyond the next ridge.
speak;Saleh;But we should move quietly.|No need to announce our presence to every creature in the mountains.
speak;Dozla;Quietly? Me?|Gwa ha ha!|I'll try my best, but no promises!
speak;Dozla;Lead on, Saleh!|To adventure and glory!
speak;Saleh;*sigh*|This is going to be a long journey.

name: Ch18ABaseConvo5
_source: speak;Artur;It's so hot here...|This volcano is more intense than I expected.
speak;Artur;Good thing I can use my ice magic to cool down a bit.
speak;Artur;Ah, much better!|A little snow goes a long way in this heat.
speak;Marisa;That's a useful ability to have.
speak;Artur;Thank you, Marisa!|It's one of the benefits of my study of light magic.
speak;Artur;You look warm as well.|Would you like me to cool you down too?
speak;Artur;Are you sure?|It's really no trouble at all.
speak;Marisa;I said I'm fine.|I've trained in worse conditions.
speak;Artur;Very well.|I should check on the others.|Excuse me, Marisa.

name: Ch19ABaseConvo1
_source: speak;Larachel;Father Moulder!|How wonderful to find another devoted servant of the divine!
speak;Moulder;Lady L'Arachel.|Your enthusiasm for our faith is always refreshing.
speak;Moulder;How long have you been in service to the Goddess?
speak;Larachel;Since I was but a child!|As the princess of Rausten, it is my sacred duty to spread her divine light!
speak;Larachel;And you, Father Moulder?|How did you find your calling?
speak;Moulder;It was during the great drought in Renais.|I witnessed the suffering of the people, and prayed for guidance.
speak;Moulder;The Goddess answered by sending rain.|From that day, I dedicated my life to her service.
speak;Larachel;Marvelous!|Truly the Goddess works through all of us in different ways!
speak;Moulder;Indeed she does.|The joy I find in helping others through her teachings has sustained me all these years.
speak;Larachel;Oh yes!|There is no greater happiness than bringing the Goddess's light to those in darkness!
speak;Moulder;The restoration of body and spirit through faith...|It is the truest form of healing we can offer.
speak;Larachel;Father Moulder, we must continue to spread her divine teachings!|Together, we shall banish all evil from this land!
speak;Moulder;Your enthusiasm is commendable, Lady L'Arachel.|However, remember that faith grows best when nurtured gently.
speak;Larachel;Of course!|But a brilliant light such as mine cannot help but shine brightly!
speak;Moulder;Ha ha!|Your light certainly does shine, my lady.|May it continue to guide those in need.
speak;Larachel;And may your wisdom continue to strengthen the faithful!|The Goddess smiles upon our sacred work!

name: Ch19ABaseConvo2
_source: speak;Duessel;So we're agreed then?|Winner of this contest of strength claims the special reward?
speak;Garcia;Heh! I hope you two are prepared to lose.|These arms haven't failed me yet!
speak;Dozla;Gwa ha ha!|This will be a glorious contest!|I, Dozla, shall demonstrate the might that has served Lady L'Arachel!
speak;Duessel;Let's begin with something simple.|Those logs need splitting for the campfire.
speak;Duessel;...|There. Twenty logs split with a single strike of my axe.
speak;Garcia;...|Thirty logs, and I didn't even need to use a weapon.
speak;Dozla;Gwa ha ha!|A fine display!|But now it's Dozla's turn!
speak;Dozla;...|Forty logs, split and arranged into a perfect stack!
speak;Duessel;Well done.|But that was merely a warm-up.|Let's move to something more challenging.
speak;Garcia;See that boulder over there?|I bet I can lift it over my head.
speak;Garcia;HRAAAAGH!|There!|What do you say to that?
speak;Duessel;Good, but...|I'll lift two such boulders!
speak;Duessel;HRAAAAAH!|Witness the strength earned through decades of battle!
speak;Dozla;Gwa ha ha!|Most impressive!|But I, Dozla, shall not be outdone!
speak;Dozla;HROOOOAAAAH!|Three boulders and a tree trunk!|Is that not the height of strength?!
speak;Garcia;Hmm...|We seem to be running out of things to lift.
speak;Duessel;Indeed...|And we're all quite evenly matched.
speak;Garcia;What if we try to—|Wait, what was the reward again?
speak;Dozla;Gwa ha ha!|It was that last bottle of Rausten's finest spirits!
speak;Duessel;You know...|Perhaps we could simply share it.
speak;Garcia;Now that you mention it...|Three veterans enjoying a drink together sounds better than any contest.
speak;Dozla;Gwa ha ha!|A splendid idea!|We shall all be winners this day!
speak;Duessel;It's settled then.|To the mess tent, my friends!|Let us share tales of battle and glory!
speak;Dozla;Gwa ha ha!|This is why warriors like us understand each other so well!

name: Ch19ABaseConvo3
_source: speak;Gerik;Neimi, wait a moment.|Is that mirror what I think it is?
speak;Neimi;Huh?|Oh, this?|It's just something my grandfather gave me...
speak;Gerik;That craftsmanship!|Those engravings on the handle!|Only one person could have made that—the legendary archer Zethla!
speak;Gerik;What?!|Your grandfather was THE Zethla?|The Single Arrow Archer himself?!
speak;Neimi;Y-yes...|I didn't know he was so famous...
speak;Gerik;Famous?|His stories are legendary among mercenaries like me!|They say he could hit any target with just one arrow, no matter the distance.
speak;Gerik;He once took down an entire bandit gang with just one arrow...|And shot an apple off a tree from over three hundred paces!
speak;Neimi;That sounds like Grandpa...|But to me, he was just... Grandpa.|He taught me how to use a bow and told me stories before bed.
speak;Gerik;And he gave you this mirror?|Do you know why?
speak;Neimi;He just said I should always keep it with me...|That I should never lose it.
speak;Gerik;Ah, so he didn't tell you.|Zethla used a mirror like this in battle!|It wasn't just for checking his appearance.
speak;Gerik;He would use it to see around corners...|To spot enemies hiding in trees or behind rocks.|Even to signal his allies with reflected sunlight!
speak;Gerik;With a mirror and a bow, Zethla could control any battlefield.|No wonder he wanted you to keep it with you always.
speak;Neimi;I never knew...|So that's why he made me practice holding it at different angles!
speak;Gerik;Exactly!|You should try using it the way he did.|It might improve your archery even more.
speak;Neimi;I will!|Thank you for telling me about Grandpa, Gerik.|I miss him so much...
speak;Neimi;I-I'm sorry...|I promised myself I wouldn't cry anymore...
speak;Gerik;Don't apologize.|Those are tears worth shedding.|Your grandfather's legacy lives on in you, Neimi.

name: Ch19ABaseConvo4
_source: speak;Joshua;Come on, Gilliam!|You can't hit what you can't touch!|Speed and evasion win battles every time.
speak;Gilliam;Nonsense.|A strong defense is the foundation of any good military strategy.|Armor has saved my life countless times.
speak;Gilliam;What good is dodging if one mistake means death?|Better to withstand the blow and counter.
speak;Joshua;And what good is armor when you're too slow to reach the enemy?|I'd rather not get hit at all than rely on metal to save me.
speak;Gilliam;Your gambling mindset shows in your tactics, Joshua.|Defense is reliable. Dodging is a gamble.
speak;Joshua;Life is a gamble, my friend!|And I always bet on myself.
speak;Eirika;What are you two discussing so intensely?
speak;Gilliam;Your Highness, perhaps you can settle this debate.|We're discussing battle tactics.
speak;Gilliam;I maintain that a strong defense is the best approach.|To withstand attacks and protect one's allies.
speak;Joshua;While I say that avoiding attacks altogether is superior.|Why take damage when you can dodge it?
speak;Eirika;Well, both approaches have their merits...
speak;Joshua;But if you had to choose, Princess?|Which do you believe is more effective?
speak;Eirika;I believe there's wisdom in Gilliam's approach.|A strong defense protects not only yourself, but those around you.
speak;Gilliam;Well said, Your Highness.|Defense forms the backbone of Renais' military tradition.
speak;Joshua;Hmm, outnumbered I see.|Still, I'll stick to my ways.
speak;Eirika;That's what makes our group strong, Joshua.|Different approaches for different situations.
speak;Gilliam;I'll continue to be your shield, Princess.|You can count on my defense.
speak;Eirika;Thank you, Gilliam.|And Joshua, your skills are equally valuable to us.
speak;Joshua;Care to make a small wager on whose approach works better in the next battle?
speak;Eirika;I find myself agreeing with Joshua.|In my training, I've learned that avoiding a blow entirely is often the best option.
speak;Joshua;Ha! The princess has excellent taste in tactics!|Did you hear that, Gilliam?
speak;Gilliam;With respect, Your Highness...|Not everyone has your natural agility.
speak;Eirika;You make a valid point, Gilliam.|Perhaps the best approach depends on one's natural abilities.
speak;Gilliam;A diplomatic answer, Princess.|I can respect that.
speak;Joshua;Still, I think this calls for a celebration!|How about a friendly wager, Gilliam?
speak;Gilliam;Is gambling your answer to everything?
speak;Joshua;Only the important things!|Plus, the thrill of the bet makes victory that much sweeter!
speak;Eirika;Please try not to bet away all our funds, Joshua.|We still need to buy supplies.
speak;Joshua;Don't worry, Princess.|I only bet what I can afford to lose... usually.

_source: speak;Natasha;Isn't this cathedral magnificent, Knoll?|The sacred energy here is so pure, so divine!
speak;Knoll;It is... impressive architecture.|Though I find the abundance of light rather... overwhelming.
speak;Knoll;Rausten has never held much appeal for those of us who study elder magic.
speak;Natasha;That's because Rausten upholds the true teachings of the divine.|Dark magic corrupts the natural order established by the Goddess.
speak;Knoll;With respect, Sister Natasha, elder magic is merely another path to understanding the world's mysteries.
speak;Natasha;The path matters, Knoll.|Light magic heals and protects. Dark magic... it draws power from chaos and suffering.
speak;Knoll;And yet both serve their purpose in this war.|Your healing has saved us, as has my elder magic.
speak;Natasha;I cannot deny your magic has been... useful.|Though I pray for your soul whenever you cast those spells.
speak;Knoll;My soul is quite intact, I assure you.|In Grado, we believe that understanding darkness is necessary to truly appreciate light.
speak;Natasha;While in Rausten, we know that light must drive away all darkness.|It is the sacred duty of every cleric.
speak;Knoll;Perhaps we might learn from each other, rather than remain entrenched in our views?
speak;Natasha;Learn from dark magic?|The archbishop would consider that heresy...
speak;Natasha;And yet...|Our journey has forced me to reconsider many things I once held as absolute truth.
speak;Knoll;That is the beginning of wisdom.|Questioning, rather than blind acceptance.
speak;Natasha;I still believe in the sanctity of light magic, but...|Would you accept this?
speak;Natasha;It's a light tome from Rausten's library.|Perhaps by studying it, you might be drawn to a... purer path.
speak;Knoll;I understand your intentions.|And I appreciate the gesture, even if I don't share your hope for my conversion.
speak;Knoll;In that same spirit...|This is for you.
speak;Knoll;A tome of elder magic.|One of the gentler volumes from my collection.
speak;Natasha;Knoll!|I... I couldn't possibly... this goes against everything I've been taught!
speak;Knoll;You needn't cast from it.|But how can you condemn what you do not understand?
speak;Natasha;To even possess such a book...|The clerics here would be appalled.
speak;Knoll;Then keep it hidden.|Knowledge is never the enemy, Natasha, only ignorance.
speak;Natasha;I... I will consider reading it.|Though I make no promises about changing my views.
speak;Knoll;That's all I ask.|And I will study your light tome with equal consideration.
speak;Natasha;I should return to evening prayers soon.|The bishops will wonder where I've gone.
speak;Knoll;Of course.|Perhaps we can discuss what we've learned... later.
speak;Natasha;Yes... later.|May the sacred light guide your path, Knoll.
speak;Knoll;And may the wisdom of the ancients bring you clarity, Natasha.

name: Ch20ABaseConvo1
_source: speak;Larachel;Behold, my loyal companions!|Our quest to purge this world of evil is truly divine!|Bards shall sing of our exploits for generations to come!
speak;Dozla;Gwah ha ha!|Absolutely, Lady L'Arachel!|Our mighty deeds will echo through the ages!|None shall forget the name of L'Arachel, beautiful princess of peerless beauty!
speak;Rennac;*sigh*|All I'm wondering is if any of these "mighty deeds" will actually earn us some gold.
speak;Larachel;Gold?|Oh, Rennac, your mind is always fixated on such trivial matters!|The rewards of virtue are beyond any worldly treasure!
speak;Dozla;Gwah ha ha!|Well said, milady!|There is no greater reward than serving alongside the radiant L'Arachel!
speak;Rennac;I could think of several greater rewards.|Starting with proper compensation for risking my life daily.

speak;Larachel;Listen well!|When we vanquish the Demon King, all the world will shower us with praise!|Your name shall be etched in history as one of the <red>Heroes of Magvel</>!|Is that not payment enough?
speak;Rennac;I'd prefer payment in actual currency, if it's all the same to you.
speak;Dozla;Gwah ha ha!|Rennac, you jest!|To serve Lady L'Arachel is a privilege beyond measure!
speak;Rennac;A privilege I never actually signed up for, I might add.
speak;Larachel;Rennac!|Your persistent focus on material gain wounds me deeply!|As a noble servant of the divine, you should aspire to loftier ideals!
speak;Rennac;I'd settle for lofty amounts of gold.|Or just being allowed to leave your service.

speak;Larachel;Nonsense!|You are blessed to accompany me on this sacred mission!|When we triumph, and the <red>Light of Rausten</> shines upon all Magvel,|you will understand the true value of our quest!
speak;Dozla;Gwah ha ha!|Indeed, milady!|We shall be remembered as the greatest heroes of all time!
speak;Rennac;Just once I'd like to be remembered as "that rich merchant" instead of "that poor fool who follows L'Arachel around."
speak;Larachel;Come, my faithful companions!|Victory awaits us!|The forces of evil shall tremble before our righteous might!
speak;Rennac;Onward to an early grave, more likely...|*sigh*|At least let me negotiate for a percentage of any treasure we find!

name: Ch20ABaseConvo2
_source: music;22- Twisted Shadows A Orchestral Cover
speak;Knoll;Excuse me, Lady Myrrh.|I hope I'm not disturbing you.
speak;Knoll;I've been researching the ancient magical sites of Magvel.|The <red>Darkling Woods</> are of particular interest.
speak;Knoll;It's said that the woods contain magical energy unlike anywhere else.|As someone who lived there, perhaps you could share some insights?
speak;Myrrh;I...|I don't know much about that.
speak;Knoll;Even the smallest detail would be invaluable.|Our records in Grado are woefully incomplete on the subject.
speak;Knoll;There are mentions of ancient relics within the heart of the woods.|Were you familiar with such artifacts?
speak;Knoll;I understand this might be difficult.|The fall of Grado has shown how dangerous forgotten knowledge can be.|But perhaps with proper understanding, we could prevent such tragedies.
speak;Knoll;I see...|Something about this topic troubles you greatly.
speak;Knoll;My apologies, Lady Myrrh.|I didn't intend to cause you distress.|The pursuit of knowledge should never come at such a cost.
speak;Knoll;No, I can see that it isn't.|Some secrets are kept for good reason.|I of all people should understand that.
speak;Knoll;Please forgive my intrusion.|I'll continue my research through other means.
speak;Knoll;Of course.|We all have painful memories in these dark times.|I'll leave you in peace now.
speak;Myrrh;The woods are...|No one should go there now.

name: Ch20ABaseConvo3
_source: speak;Lute;According to my research, the <red>Cave Cleaver</> should be in this vicinity.|A fascinating specimen of Cyclops, by all accounts.
speak;Saleh;...I would advise against seeking out such a creature, Lute.|The elders of Caer Pelyn speak of it with great caution.
speak;Lute;Caution is for those without superior intellect.|I am a prodigy, after all.|The opportunity to document such a rare monster is too valuable to ignore.
speak;Saleh;The <red>Cave Cleaver</> is not merely a monster.|It is said to wield an axe forged from the bones of a dragon...|With each swing, it carves new tunnels through solid rock.

speak;Lute;Yes!|Precisely why it's of such scientific interest!|Can you imagine the magical properties of such a weapon?|I've theorized that it must utilize a form of dark magic to alter the molecular structure of stone.
speak;Saleh;It also utilizes that same power to alter the molecular structure of those unfortunate enough to encounter it.|There are no survivors in the stories for a reason.
speak;Lute;Survivors make for incomplete data.|I shall be the first to document it properly.|Unlike others, I've prepared extensively.

speak;Saleh;Even the most thorough preparation may be insufficient.|My grandmother once told me that the creature was sealed away by the Great Dragon herself.|Some things are meant to remain undisturbed.
speak;Lute;Myrrh's involvement is unexpected but makes perfect sense.|That would explain the residual magical signatures I detected earlier.|This discovery just became even more interesting!
speak;Saleh;Lute, please.|This is not an academic exercise.|If the <red>Cave Cleaver</> still lives, it poses a genuine threat to all of Magvel.
speak;Lute;All the more reason to study it.|Knowledge is the most effective weapon against any threat.|Besides, I've already mapped out its probable lair based on geological formations.
speak;Saleh;...As your senior in magical studies, I must insist that we exercise extreme caution.|If we do encounter this creature, we retreat immediately.
speak;Lute;Fine.|We'll retreat if necessary.|But first, I must collect at least some observational data.
speak;Saleh;That is... acceptable.|But we approach only close enough to confirm its existence.|Nothing more.
speak;Lute;Good!|Now, my calculations suggest we should proceed through that crevice.|The temperature drops in that direction, indicating a large subterranean chamber.
speak;Saleh;...May the Great Dragon protect us from your curiosity, Lute.
speak;Lute;Protection unnecessary.|Curiosity is what advances the field of magical study.|Now come along!|I've prepared seventeen different containment spells just in case!
speak;Saleh;.......|Grandmother Dara warned me about scholars like her.|I should have brought more elixirs.

name: Ch20ABaseConvo4
_source: speak;Colm;Hey Rennac!|Still haven't returned that gold bracelet to the merchant in Renais, huh?
speak;Rennac;Why would I?|That self-important fool was charging triple its worth.|And what about you?|Still wearing that nobleman's silk handkerchief you swiped in Frelia?
speak;Colm;Hey, it's good quality!|Besides, you're the one who showed me how to spot the real silk from the fake stuff.
speak;Rennac;One of my many talents I've generously shared with you.|So, what did you manage to "acquire" on our last excursion?
speak;Colm;Nothing too fancy.|Just a few gold pieces and a silver brooch.|But I did it without anyone noticing, unlike someone who knocked over that vase in Serafew.
speak;Rennac;That was one time!|And if you recall, I still managed to escape with the merchant's lockbox.
speak;Colm;True.|You've got nimble fingers for an old-timer.
speak;Rennac;Speaking of nimble fingers...|I've been saving this particular acquisition for a special occasion.
speak;Colm;Oh?|What did you manage to snag this time?
speak;Colm;No way!|That's a demon sword!|I thought that there was only one of those!|Are you sure it's real?
speak;Rennac;Very real, I assure you.|Notice how the blade seems to drink in the light around it?
speak;Colm;That's incredible!|This makes my heist from the Grado military storehouse look like child's play.|How did you even find it?|Last I heard, it was locked in some impenetrable vault.
speak;Rennac;Let's just say those Grado guards aren't as vigilant at dawn as they claim to be.|Especially after someone spikes their evening meal with sleeping herbs.
speak;Colm;You didn't!|Even I wouldn't have the guts to steal from Grado's elites!
speak;Rennac;Yes, well...|I may have slightly miscalculated the... repercussions.|There are now three villages in Grado where my face is posted at every inn.
speak;Colm;Only three?|That's actually better than your usual record.|Remember that incident with the duchess's necklace?
speak;Rennac;Don't remind me.|But this is different.|The head priest actually put a curse on whoever stole it.
speak;Colm;A curse?|Is that why you've been looking over your shoulder more than usual?
speak;Rennac;I've been thinking...|We've stolen from merchants, nobles, even military supplies.|But valued relics?|Are we just common criminals now?
speak;Colm;I've been wondering the same thing lately.|Neimi keeps asking where all my "gifts" come from.|I'm running out of excuses.
speak;Rennac;It used to be about surviving.|Then it became about skill.|Now I'm stealing cursed swords from temples and I don't even know why.
speak;Colm;Maybe we should return some of this stuff.|Starting with that sword before it turns your hair white or something.
speak;Rennac;sighs|Perhaps you're right.|Though I doubt the priests will welcome me with open arms.
speak;Colm;We could always leave it on their altar in the dead of night.|We're good at that part, at least.
speak;Rennac;Look at us.|The great thieves of Magvel, talking about returning stolen goods.|What's next?|Honest work?
speak;Colm;Let's not get carried away.|Maybe just... steal from people who deserve it?
speak;Rennac;Now that's a compromise I can live with.

name: Ch20ABaseConvo5
_source: speak;Joshua;The war is almost over.|Tomorrow we march into the heart of darkness itself.
speak;Gerik;Aye.|By this time tomorrow, we'll either be celebrating victory...|or we'll be dead.
speak;Joshua;I've been thinking.|The three best swordsmen in this army...|and we've never settled who's actually the best.
speak;Gerik;You choose now to worry about that?
speak;Joshua;What better time?|Tomorrow we face our destiny.|Tonight might be our last chance.
speak;Gerik;I suppose there's wisdom in it.|One last duel to remember each other by.
speak;Joshua;Exactly.|A memory to carry with us, whatever tomorrow brings.
speak;Marisa;...A fitting farewell.|Should fate separate us.
speak;Joshua;When this war began, I was just a wandering gambler.|Now I'm fighting alongside legends.
speak;Gerik;The <red>Desert Tiger</> and the <red>Crimson Flash</>...|and the Prince of Jehanna.|Who would have thought?
speak;Marisa;Our paths...converged for a reason.|This duel honors that.
speak;Gerik;In all my years as a mercenary...|you two are among the finest I've fought beside.
speak;Joshua;Which is why I need to know.|Before we face the Prince of Grado.|Which of us is truly the best?
speak;Marisa;The answer has always been clear.|It's me.
speak;Gerik;Ha!|Bold words from you, Marisa.|But experience trumps youth.
speak;Joshua;You're both forgetting...|fortune favors me.|And my blade is just as sharp as my luck.
speak;Gerik;Blunted weapons.|First to three solid hits wins.|And regardless of the outcome...
speak;Joshua;One last wager, then.|Winner gets first choice of weapons from the royal armory of Jehanna.|When I reclaim my throne.
speak;Gerik;Assuming we survive tomorrow.|I'll hold you to that, Prince.
speak;Marisa;Agreed.|But neither of you will survive our duel.
speak;Joshua;Tonight we test our steel against each other.|Tomorrow, against destiny itself.
speak;Gerik;Whatever happens tomorrow...|It's been an honor fighting alongside you both.
speak;Joshua;Now let's see which of us deserves to lead the charge against the Demon King!|Ready your blades!

speak;Marisa;Agreed.|But neither of you will survive our duel.
speak;Joshua;Tonight we test our steel against each other.|Tomorrow, against destiny itself.
speak;Gerik;Whatever happens tomorrow...|It's been an honor fighting alongside you both.
speak;Joshua;Now let's see which of us deserves to lead the charge against the Demon King!|Ready your blades!

name: Ch9BBaseConvo2
_source: speak;Gilliam;Fort Rigwald looms before us.|This won't be an easy assault.|What's your take on this, Garcia?
speak;Garcia;Hmm...reminds me of Castle Renvall.|That was a tough one.|We need to be more cautious this time.
speak;Gilliam;Castle Renvall didn't go smoothly?|Tell me what happened there.|We should learn from past mistakes.
speak;Garcia;Our initial approach was too direct.|We underestimated their defenses.
speak;Garcia;Ross nearly got himself killed charging ahead.
speak;Gilliam;That does sound concerning.|What would you suggest for Fort Rigwald?
speak;Garcia;We should split our forces.|One group to draw their attention to the main gate.|Another to distract the ballistas.
speak;Gilliam;The ballistas...|I think I can take their fire.|Simple, but effective.
speak;Seth;Gilliam, Garcia.|Prince Ephraim wants your assessment of the situation.
speak;Gilliam;We were just discussing that, Sir Seth.|Garcia has some valuable insights from Castle Renvall.
speak;Garcia;The direct approach cost us at Renvall.|Fort Rigwald has similar defenses, but with one weakness.|Their outside forces are more spread out.
speak;Seth;I see.|And you're confident of this assessment?
speak;Garcia;As confident as a warrior can be before battle.|Nothing is certain, but it's our best chance.
speak;Gilliam;I agree with Garcia.|We could use my knights in heavy armor as the frontal distraction.|While the main force takes the gate.
speak;Franz;Reporting in!|Scouts confirm the outside troops are scattered.|Just as Garcia suggested!
speak;Garcia;Ha! This old warrior still has his wits about him!|My axe is ready when you are.
speak;Seth;Well done.|I'll inform Prince Ephraim of your plan immediately.|Prepare your men.
speak;Gilliam;One more thing.|We should move at dawn.|Their forces should still be waking up.
speak;Garcia;Good thinking, Gilliam.|At Renvall, we attacked at midday.|The sun glinting off our armor gave away our position.
speak;Seth;Dawn it is, then.|Be ready by then.
speak;Gilliam;Garcia...|Thank you for sharing your experience.|It may save many lives today.
speak;Garcia;That's what veterans are for, my friend.|To ensure the mistakes of the past aren't repeated.|For our comrades, for Renais.
speak;Gilliam;For Renais.|Let's make this assault one for the history books.
speak;Garcia;Indeed!|My axe is hungry for battle!|And this time, I won't let Ross charge ahead alone!
speak;Gilliam;You've raised a fine warrior.|Impetuous, perhaps, but brave.|Much like his father.
speak;Garcia;Ha ha!|I'll take that as a compliment!|Now let's prepare.|Fort Rigwald awaits!

name: Ch9BBaseConvo3
_source: speak;Neimi;Um...Vanessa?|Have you gotten used to serving under Prince Ephraim yet?
speak;Vanessa;I'm still adjusting.|His command style is quite different from Princess Eirika's.|It took me some time to understand his approach.
speak;Neimi;I've noticed that too.|Princess Eirika was always so gentle with her instructions.|Prince Ephraim feels...|well, more intense.
speak;Vanessa;Indeed.|Princess Eirika leads with compassion and diplomacy.|Prince Ephraim is a battlefield commander to his core.
speak;Neimi;He can be a bit intimidating.|Sometimes I find myself hesitating when he gives orders.|Do you think he's disappointed in us?
speak;Vanessa;Not at all, Neimi.|That's simply his nature.|Where Eirika would explain, Ephraim expects immediate understanding.
speak;Neimi;Princess Eirika always walked us through her plans step by step.|Prince Ephraim seems to assume we'll catch on quickly.

speak;Vanessa;They may be twins, but their training couldn't have been more different.|Eirika was groomed for diplomacy and negotiation.|Ephraim was molded for military leadership and decisive action.
speak;Neimi;I've noticed how different they are.|Princess Eirika would always ask if everyone was alright after a battle.|Prince Ephraim checks our weapons and readiness first.
speak;Vanessa;A keen observation.|One focuses on the people, the other on the mission.
speak;Colm;Sounds like an interesting conversation.|Mind if I add my two coins?
speak;Colm;I prefer the term 'gathering intelligence'.|But yes, I couldn't help overhearing your discussion about our royal commanders.
speak;Neimi;Colm!|You shouldn't be listening to private conversations!
speak;Colm;Private?|In a military camp?|Besides, I've got my own perspective on their leadership.
speak;Colm;Under Princess Eirika, I had to account for every single item I...acquired.|Prince Ephraim, he just asks if the information was useful.
speak;Vanessa;Each leader has their strengths.|Princess Eirika's meticulous planning prevented many potential issues.|Prince Ephraim's boldness has saved us in critical moments.
speak;Neimi;I think I'm starting to understand Prince Ephraim better.|He might seem harsh, but...|I realize now that his directness comes from a place of care.
speak;Vanessa;Yesterday, he personally checked every archer's equipment before our march.|He knows how crucial each soldier's role is.
speak;Neimi;Really?|I thought he was just being strict.|He even complimented my archery skills during inspection.
speak;Vanessa;That's Prince Ephraim.|Direct, but never without purpose.|His orders might be blunt, but they're always calculated.
speak;Neimi;Maybe we need both of their leadership styles.|Eirika's compassion and Ephraim's decisiveness.
speak;Neimi;I'm going to be less intimidated from now on.|His directness isn't coldness-it's just how he leads.
speak;Vanessa;That's the right attitude, Neimi.|And remember, if you ever feel uncertain about an order, I'm here to help you navigate.
speak;Neimi;Thank you, Vanessa.|This conversation has helped me see things differently.
speak;Vanessa;We're comrades, after all.|Now, shall we prepare our equipment?|I'm certain Prince Ephraim's inspection is imminent.
speak;Neimi;Yes!|My bow will be in perfect condition.|And who knows? Maybe I'll even speak up during the next strategy meeting.

name: Ch9BBaseConvo4
_source: speak;Kyle;Joshua!|I know you're around here somewhere!|Show yourself!
speak;Joshua;Well, if it isn't my favorite knight.|Out for a stroll in town, Kyle?
speak;Kyle;Don't play innocent with me.|You were supposed to be on patrol duty two hours ago!
speak;Joshua;Was I?|Must have slipped my mind.|I was just testing the local tavern's luck.
speak;Kyle;This isn't a game, Joshua!|Prince Ephraim assigned you to the eastern perimeter.|Your gambling can wait!
speak;Joshua;Care to make a wager on that?|Heads I go on patrol now, tails I go tonight instead?
speak;Kyle;No more coin flips!|No more cards!|No more dice!|Just do your duty!
speak;Joshua;You know what they say...|All work and no play makes Kyle a dull knight.
speak;Kyle;And all play and no work gets soldiers killed.|Is that what you want?
speak;Joshua;...No.|You know that's not what I want.
speak;Kyle;Then why do I have to chase you through town every time you're assigned to patrol?
speak;Joshua;Maybe I enjoy the exercise?|Or maybe I enjoy watching you get all worked up.|Your face turns the most fascinating shade of red.
speak;Kyle;This isn't funny!|Forde is covering for you right now!|He's pulled a double shift because of you!
speak;Joshua;Forde is covering for me?|He didn't mention that when we played cards earlier...
speak;Kyle;FORDE!|You were playing cards with Joshua?!|You told me you would cover his patrol!
speak;Forde;Did I say that?|Must have slipped my mind.|We only played for an hour or so.
speak;Kyle;Not you too!|Am I the only one who takes our duties seriously?!
speak;Kyle;I'm surrounded by children...|What would Prince Ephraim say if he knew?
speak;Ephraim;He might say his knights could use some discipline.
speak;Kyle;P-Prince Ephraim!|I was just trying to get these two to-
speak;Ephraim;I heard everything, Kyle.|Your dedication is commendable.
speak;Joshua;Would Your Highness care to flip for it?|Heads we're forgiven, tails we take double patrol duty?
speak;Ephraim;A gamble, is it?|Very well, Joshua.|But I'll set the terms.
speak;Ephraim;If you win, you're forgiven.|If you lose, you AND Forde will patrol the perimeter for the next three days.|No breaks.
speak;Forde;Wait a minute!|Don't I get a say in this?
speak;Ephraim;A joke, Joshua.|But it seems I've found a way to get your attention.|Report for patrol duty in five minutes.|Both of you.
speak;Joshua;I can't believe it...|Outplayed by Prince Ephraim himself.
speak;Forde;Next time, Joshua...|Let's gamble on something that doesn't involve me.
speak;Joshua;Fair enough.|Kyle, care to join us on patrol?|I bet I can spot more enemies than you.
speak;Kyle;No bets.|But I'll join you.|Someone needs to keep you two in line.
speak;Joshua;One last wager before we go?|I bet tomorrow I'll report for duty without you having to find me.
speak;Kyle;...And what do I have to do if I lose?
speak;Joshua;Buy me a drink.|And admit I'm not as irresponsible as you think.
speak;Kyle;Deal.|But if I win, no more gambling for a week.
speak;Forde;Is the great gambler backing down from a bet?
speak;Joshua;Never.|It's a deal, Kyle.|Hope you've got coins for that drink!

name: Ch9BBaseConvo5
_source: speak;Forde;*yawn*|Another night, another nightmare...|I can barely keep my eyes open...
speak;Lute;Fascinating.|Your energy signature is most unusual today, Forde.
speak;Forde;Huh?|Oh, hello Lute.|What's unusual about my...whatever you said?
speak;Lute;Your energy signature.|The magical aura that surrounds all living beings.|Yours is fluctuating in a most peculiar pattern.
speak;Forde;Is that your way of saying I look tired?|Because I am.|These dreams won't let me sleep.
speak;Lute;Dreams?|Tell me about these dreams.|Be specific. The details matter.
speak;Forde;They're always the same.|I'm in a dark room...|There are whispers I can't quite understand...
speak;Forde;And there's this...feeling.|Like something's pulling at me.|Not physically, but... deeper.
speak;Lute;Just as I suspected!|Your symptoms align perfectly with nascent magical resonance.|Specifically, dark magic resonance.
speak;Forde;Dark magic?|But I'm a cavalier!|I don't have any magical ability!
speak;Lute;Incorrect.|Everyone has some magical potential.|Most never discover it.
speak;Forde;So you're saying...|I have dark magic inside me?|That's what's causing these dreams?
speak;Lute;Not just inside you.|You have an affinity for it.|Quite a strong one, I'd say.
speak;Forde;Is that...bad?|Am I cursed or something?

speak;Lute;Dark magic is neither good nor evil.|It's a tool, like any other magic.|The perpetual fatigue you experience is likely your body's attempt to conserve energy.|Energy that's being drained by untapped magical potential.
speak;Forde;Wait...|Are you saying that's why I'm always tired?|Not because I'm lazy?
speak;Lute;Precisely.|Your body is constantly fighting against uncontrolled magical leakage.|It's quite inefficient.
speak;Kyle;Forde?|Are you actually awake before noon?|This must be recorded in the annals of history.
speak;Forde;Very funny, Kyle.|Lute here says I have dark magic abilities.|That's why I'm always tired.
speak;Lute;I don't make errors in magical assessment, Sir Kyle.|Forde exhibits all the classic signs of untrained magical potential.|His constant fatigue is merely a symptom.
speak;Kyle;So you're saying all these years...|He wasn't just being lazy?
speak;Lute;Correct.|Though his chosen coping mechanisms may have been suboptimal.
speak;Forde;So what do I do about it, Lute?|I don't want these nightmares anymore.|And I'd like to actually feel rested for once.
speak;Lute;You have two options.|First, you could learn to suppress it.|But that would only lead to greater fatigue over time.
speak;Lute;Learn to channel it.|Learn to control the dark magic within you.|Use it rather than let it use you.
speak;Forde;Me?|Learning magic?|I can barely stay awake during sword practice!
speak;Lute;The alternative is continued nightmares and fatigue.|Eventually, it could manifest in more... problematic ways.
speak;Lute;Uncontrolled magical discharge.|Spontaneous shadow manifestations.|Possibly even attracting creatures from the void.
speak;Forde;That sounds...|Extremely bad.|You're serious about all this, aren't you?
speak;Lute;I'm always serious about magical phenomena.|It's my area of expertise.|I could... help you, if you wish.
speak;Forde;You'd do that?|I thought you were busy with your own studies.
speak;Lute;This is a rare opportunity to observe dark magic affinity development in real-time.|It would be academically irresponsible to pass it up.
speak;Forde;That's Lute-speak for "I want to help," isn't it?
speak;Lute;I...|simply recognize the potential research value.|And the tactical advantage of having another magic user in our ranks.|Even for one so...unusual...
speak;Forde;Well, I've always been unusual.|So, what now?|Do I have to give up being a cavalier?|Learn to use magic through my sword or something?
speak;Lute;Yes!|Precisely what I was thinking!|A fascinating case study in magical adaptation!
speak;Forde;So I could...|Use magic and still fight with Kyle and the others?
speak;Lute;With proper training, yes.|It won't be easy.|But it would resolve your nightmares.
speak;Forde;Then I'll do it.|No more nightmares.|No more unexplained exhaustion.
speak;Lute;Excellent.|We'll begin tomorrow at dawn.|The magical energies are strongest then.
speak;Forde;Dawn?|Can't we start at... noon?|Or later?
speak;Lute;Old habits die hard, I see.|Very well. Mid-morning.|But not a moment later.
speak;Forde;Thank you, Lute.|I never thought my constant sleepiness had a cause.|I just thought I was... you know... lazy.
speak;Lute;There's often a rational explanation for seemingly irrational behaviors.|Your body was conserving energy.|Now we'll teach it a better way.
speak;Forde;I can't wait to see Kyle's face when I cast my first spell.|He'll never believe it.
speak;Lute;I suggest we keep this between us for now.|Until you have better control.|Dark magic can be... unpredictable.
speak;Forde;Right.|Our secret then.|Until I can show off properly.
speak;Lute;Mid-morning tomorrow.|Don't be late.|We have much to discover about your abilities.
speak;Forde;I'll be there.|For once in my life, I'm actually looking forward to training!
alert;Forde's MAG/RES and MAG/RES growths went up!

name: Ch10BBaseConvo1
_source: speak;Vanessa;Amelia, isn't it?|I don't think we've had a proper chance to talk.|How are you settling in with our forces?
speak;Amelia;O-oh!|Miss Vanessa!|Yes, I'm Amelia.|Everyone has been very kind to me.
speak;Vanessa;That's good to hear.|It must be quite an adjustment.|Fighting alongside those you once faced in battle.
speak;Amelia;It is strange, yes.|But...|I think I made the right choice.
speak;Vanessa;What made you decide to change sides?|If you don't mind my asking.
speak;Amelia;When I saw how Prince Ephraim treated his soldiers...|How he fought alongside them instead of behind them...|It was nothing like what I was used to.
speak;Vanessa;Your previous commander was different, I take it?
speak;Amelia;Commander Gheb...|He was...|I'm sorry, but he was a terrible man.
speak;Vanessa;I've heard stories.|Was it as bad as they say?
speak;Amelia;Worse.|He treated female soldiers like...|Well, not like soldiers at all.
speak;Amelia;His eyes would always...|And he would say such things...
speak;Vanessa;I understand.|You don't need to elaborate.
speak;Amelia;He wouldn't even train with us!|He'd just sit there eating and...|watching.
speak;Vanessa;How did someone like that become a commander?|Surely not on merit.
speak;Amelia;That's the strange part.|There was this one battle...|Grado forces were being overwhelmed.
speak;Amelia;Everyone else retreated or fell...|But Gheb was hit by three arrows and kept fighting.|The arrows barely penetrated his... um...
speak;Amelia;He was so large that the arrows couldn't reach any vital organs.|He survived long enough for reinforcements to arrive.
speak;Vanessa;So his... girth... saved him?|That's certainly an unusual qualification for command.
speak;Amelia;I was told they gave him a command position after that.|Though I think it was just to get him away from the main army.
speak;Franz;Amelia!|Vanessa!|Sorry to interrupt.|Prince Ephraim asked me to let you know we'll be moving out at dawn.
speak;Franz;Has Vanessa been showing you the ropes?|Prince Ephraim speaks very highly of her tactics.
speak;Vanessa;We were just getting acquainted.|Amelia was telling me about her previous commander.
speak;Franz;Oh...|You mean that Gheb fellow?|I heard he met his end recently.
speak;Amelia;Yes...|And I can't say I mourn him.|Is that terrible of me?
speak;Vanessa;Not at all.|A commander who abuses their position doesn't deserve respect.
speak;Franz;Prince Ephraim always says a true leader earns respect through actions, not rank.|That's why we follow him so willingly.
speak;Amelia;It's still strange sometimes...|To be fighting under a different banner.
speak;Amelia;No.|None at all.|Prince Ephraim is everything a commander should be.
speak;Vanessa;He leads from the front.|Never asks his soldiers to take risks he wouldn't take himself.
speak;Amelia;And he treats everyone with respect.|Even a former enemy like me.
speak;Vanessa;You're one of us now, Amelia.|No one thinks of you as an enemy.
speak;Amelia;Thank you, Miss Vanessa.|That means a lot coming from you.
speak;Vanessa;Please, just Vanessa is fine.|We're comrades now.
speak;Amelia;Comrades...|I like the sound of that.
speak;Vanessa;Have you been assigned to a unit yet?|If not, you're welcome to join mine.|I could use another lance at my side.
speak;Amelia;R-really?|You'd want me in your unit?
speak;Vanessa;Of course.|I've seen you train.|You have potential, Amelia.
speak;Amelia;I... I would be honored!|I'll work hard not to disappoint you!
speak;Vanessa;I have no doubt of that.|Now, we should probably prepare for tomorrow's march.|Prince Ephraim doesn't tolerate tardiness.
speak;Amelia;Right!|I'll be ready before dawn!|Thank you again, Miss Vane-I mean, Vanessa!
speak;Vanessa;Until tomorrow then, Amelia.|And if you ever need to talk...|My tent is always open.

name: Ch10BBaseConvo2
_source: speak;Franz;Alright, we're here to get vulneraries and maybe a few whetstones.|That's it.|Prince Ephraim was very clear about the budget.
speak;Colm;Yeah, yeah, I heard him.|But look at that steel sword!|The craftsmanship is incredible.
speak;Franz;We don't need more weapons...|We've got a whole convoy full of them.
speak;Colm;Sure, but none as finely made as this one.|Feel the balance!|This isn't just any steel sword, Franz.
speak;Franz;Well, I suppose it is nice...|But it's not on our list.
speak;Colm;Lists are more like... suggestions.|Besides, what if we run into an armored knight?|Wouldn't you want the best blade possible?
speak;Franz;I mean, when you put it that way...|It would be irresponsible NOT to be prepared.
speak;Colm;Exactly!|Now you're thinking tactically.|Prince Ephraim would approve.
speak;Anna;Welcome to my shop!|I see you're admiring that steel sword.|Special price today, just for you handsome soldiers!
speak;Colm;We'll take it.|And those vulneraries we came for.
speak;Anna;Excellent choice!|While you're at it, these iron lances just came in.|Perfect weight for cavalry.
speak;Franz;Iron lances?|I have been meaning to replace mine...
speak;Colm;Get two.|One always breaks at the worst possible moment.
speak;Franz;That's... actually true.|I'll take two then.
speak;Anna;Wonderful!|And what about these lovely concoctions?|Much more potent than regular vulneraries!
speak;Franz;Those are a bit expensive...|And not on our list...
speak;Colm;Franz, Franz, Franz...|What if someone gets seriously injured?|What would Sir Seth say if we passed up something that could save lives?
speak;Franz;He would be disappointed...|You're right.|We should get a few.
speak;Colm;Smart man!|Oh, look at those leather pouches.|Perfect for carrying small items.
speak;Anna;Those are imported from Jehanna!|Very sturdy, water-resistant too!
speak;Franz;We could use those for the vulneraries...|Keep them from breaking in battle.
speak;Colm;Now you're getting it!|Practical thinking!|And look—elixirs on sale!
speak;Anna;Buy two, get one free!|Limited time offer!
speak;OldMan1;I see you gentlemen are finding everything you need?|We just got these fine whetstones from Frelia.
speak;Franz;Oh, whetstones were actually on our list!|I'll take... four.
speak;Colm;Make it six.|The knights go through them quickly.
speak;OldMan1;Excellent choice.|And perhaps some bowstrings for your archer friends?|Fresh silk, very durable.
speak;Colm;Neimi would love those!|Her old one's starting to fray.
speak;Franz;That's thoughtful of you, Colm.|We'll take three.
speak;OldMan1;Wonderful!|And how about some fine leather gloves?|Every cavalier needs proper grip.
speak;Franz;Those do look comfortable...|My old ones are pretty worn...
speak;Colm;Get them.|And I'll take that whetstone kit.|For... maintenance purposes.
speak;Shopkeeper;An excellent haul, gentlemen!|Shall I tally it up?
speak;Anna;While he's adding that up, can I interest you in these enchanted talismans?|They ward off dark magic!
speak;Colm;Hmm, Lute mentioned something about increased magical activity...|We should probably get a few, just in case.
speak;Franz;Well, if Lute said so...|I suppose it's better to be safe.
speak;Anna;Perfect!|I'll add them to your pile!|Anything else catch your eye?
speak;Franz;Those riding boots look sturdy!|Mine are falling apart after the last march.
speak;Colm;See? Now you're shopping!|Grab those boots and that saddle polish too.
speak;Anna;You boys have excellent taste!|That'll be... let's see...
speak;Franz;I feel good about this.|We got everything we needed and then some!
speak;Colm;Exactly!|Being prepared is half the battle!|That's what Sir Seth always says.
speak;OldMan1;Here's your total, gentlemen.|That comes to 12,780 gold.
speak;Colm;I... uh...|Wait, let me count our purchases again...

speak;Shopkeeper;One steel sword, two iron lances, six vulneraries, three concoctions, one elixir, six whetstones, three bowstrings, two pairs of leather gloves, one whetstone kit, two magic-warding pendants, one pair of riding boots, and saddle polish.
speak;Colm;When you list it all like that, it does sound like... a lot.
speak;Colm;Umm...|I think Prince Ephraim said...|Something about two thousand?
speak;Franz;Two thousand?!|We're more than double over budget!|Seth is going to kill us!
speak;Colm;Maybe we could...put some things back?
speak;Colm;The pendants?|No, Lute will lecture us about magical preparedness...
speak;Franz;The boots?|No, mine really are falling apart...
speak;Franz;No!|I mean, yes!|I mean...Colm, what do we do?!
speak;Colm;I have... an idea.|But you're not going to like it.
speak;Franz;Please tell me it doesn't involve stealing...
speak;Colm;Tell you what, good sir.|We'll take it all.|But could you split it into...multiple receipts?
speak;Franz;I can't believe we did that.|Seth will notice the multiple receipts for sure...
speak;Colm;Relax!|We'll just say different units needed different supplies.|It's technically true!
speak;Franz;Next time, I'm bringing a written list.|AND I'm not letting you convince me to deviate from it.
speak;Colm;Aw, come on.|You have to admit those are some fine purchases.|The sword alone is worth it!
speak;Franz;...The sword is nice.|And the boots are very comfortable.
speak;Colm;See?|And think how happy Neimi will be with her new bowstrings!
speak;Franz;That's true...|Maybe it's not so bad.
speak;Colm;That's the spirit!|Besides, what's the worst that could happen?
speak;Seth;Franz, Colm.|I've been looking for you two.|Did you complete the shopping assignment I gave you?
speak;Franz;S-Sir Seth!|We, uh...we got the supplies!|All of them! And, um...some extras?

name: Ch10BBaseConvo3
_source: speak;Ephraim;The eastern perimeter seems secure.|We should check the western wall next.|Stay alert, Tana.
speak;Tana;(Just the two of us, under the moonlight...|Could he have planned this?|Maybe guard duty was just an excuse...);;;thought_bubble
speak;Tana;It's a beautiful night, isn't it, Ephraim?|The moon is so bright and full.
speak;Ephraim;Indeed.|Good visibility is crucial for night watch.|We'll be able to spot any movement from quite a distance.
speak;Tana;Oh...|That's not exactly what I meant.
speak;Ephraim;Is something wrong with your pegasus?|You seem distracted.
speak;Tana;No, it's just...|It's rare that we get time alone like this.|Don't you think it's... nice?
speak;Ephraim;Having a skilled pegasus knight on patrol is certainly advantageous.|Your aerial view complements my ground surveillance.
speak;Tana;Ephraim, when was the last time you ate a proper meal?
speak;Ephraim;This morning, I believe.|Why do you ask?
speak;Tana;It's just that...|I packed some food.|I thought we might have a little...picnic while on watch.
speak;Ephraim;A picnic?|During guard duty?|That seems rather...irregular.
speak;Tana;Not a full picnic, just...|A small meal together.|Under the stars.
speak;Ephraim;I appreciate the thought, Tana, but we must remain vigilant.|Perhaps we could eat in shifts?|I'll take first watch while you eat.
speak;Tana;That's not...|That's not what I had in mind.
speak;Ephraim;Is something wrong with my suggestion?
speak;Tana;Ephraim, do you know why I volunteered for night patrol with you?
speak;Ephraim;Because you take your duties seriously.|As a princess of Frelia, your commitment to our cause is admirable.
speak;Tana;That's not why I volunteered!|Don't you get it?|I wanted to spend time with you!
speak;Ephraim;We are spending time together.|Right now, on patrol.
speak;Tana;Not like this!|Not just talking about patrol routes and enemy movements!|I meant... spending time together... personally.
speak;Ephraim;Personally?|I'm not sure I understand what you mean, Tana.
speak;Tana;I'm talking about us!|You and me!|Don't you ever think about...anything beyond the war?
speak;Ephraim;Of course I do.|I think about rebuilding Renais.|Restoring our kingdom to its former glory.
speak;Tana;And what about your personal life?|Your future?|Don't you think about that?
speak;Ephraim;My personal considerations must come second to my duties.|Until this war is won, I cannot afford distractions.
speak;Tana;Distractions?|Is that what you think I am?|A distraction?
speak;Ephraim;That's not what I said, Tana.
speak;Tana;But it's what you meant!|You're so...so...oblivious!
speak;Ephraim;Tana, I think there's been a misunderstanding.|I value your friendship and your contribution to our cause.
speak;Tana;Friendship...|Of course.|That's all it is to you, isn't it?
speak;Ephraim;Is there something else I should be aware of?
speak;Tana;I've had enough of this!|If you can't figure it out on your own, then I'm not going to explain it to you!
speak;Tana;Finish it yourself!|Clearly, your "duty" is more important than anything else!
speak;Ephraim;Tana!|Where are you going?|We haven't checked the western wall!
speak;Seth;Prince Ephraim?|Is everything alright?|I heard raised voices.
speak;Ephraim;Seth...|I think Princess Tana is upset with me.|But I'm not entirely sure why.
speak;Ephraim;What do you see?|She was talking about having a picnic during guard duty.|Then she got angry when I suggested we eat in shifts.
speak;Seth;My lord, if I may speak freely...|I believe Princess Tana may have had...different expectations for your time together.
speak;Seth;Sometimes, my lord, guard duty can be more than just guard duty.|Especially under a full moon, with shared food...
speak;Ephraim;Wait...|Are you suggesting that Tana thought this was...|Oh no.
speak;Seth;I believe she may have been attempting to create a...romantic setting, my lord.
speak;Ephraim;But I never...|I didn't intend to...|I've made a terrible mistake, haven't I?
speak;Seth;It's not irreparable, Prince Ephraim.|Princess Tana is understanding.|But perhaps an apology is in order.
speak;Ephraim;Yes, you're right.|Thank you, Seth.|I'll speak with her first thing tomorrow.
speak;Seth;Very good, my lord.|Shall I take over the remainder of your watch?|So you can...prepare what you'll say?
speak;Ephraim;No.|I'll complete my duty.|It seems I have much to think about while I patrol.
speak;Seth;As you wish, my lord.|And if I may offer one piece of advice...
speak;Seth;Sometimes, even in war...|It's worth making time for matters of the heart.|Even the greatest leaders need something to fight for.
speak;Ephraim;Matters of the heart...|How did I miss something so obvious?|Tana, I'm sorry...

name: Ch10BBaseConvo4
_source: speak;Moulder;Now, Artur, we move on to the ceremonial aspects of our duties.|A priest must be prepared to perform various rites and rituals for the community.
speak;Artur;Yes, Father Moulder.|I've been studying the prayer books diligently.|What shall we discuss next?
speak;Moulder;Today, we'll cover marriage ceremonies.|As servants of the divine, we are often called upon to join couples in holy matrimony.
speak;Artur;I've read the ceremonial texts, but I'm curious...|How many weddings have you performed, Father Moulder?
speak;Moulder;Ah, well...|That is to say...|I haven't actually performed any.
speak;Moulder;My duties to the crown have kept me rather busy.|And wartime isn't exactly conducive to matrimonial celebrations.
speak;Artur;Not even one?|I thought with your experience...
speak;Moulder;Knowledge of the rites and actually performing them are two different matters.|Perhaps we should seek wisdom from someone with firsthand experience.
speak;Artur;That's an excellent idea.|But who among our company has been married?
speak;Moulder;Garcia, the warrior.|He was married before joining our ranks.|Let's find him.
speak;Garcia;And that's how you maintain the proper tension in a bowstring.|My wife Risa taught me that trick.|She was quite the archer in her day.
speak;Neimi;Your wife sounds amazing, Sir Garcia!|I wish I could have met her.|She must have been very skilled.
speak;Garcia;She was indeed.|The best shot in our village.|And please, just Garcia is fine.
speak;Moulder;Pardon the interruption, Garcia.|Artur and I were hoping to speak with you.
speak;Artur;Good day, Garcia, Neimi.|We didn't mean to disturb you.
speak;Garcia;Not at all!|What can I do for Renais' finest holy men?
speak;Moulder;We were discussing marriage ceremonies.|As you've been married, we thought you might share your experience.
speak;Neimi;Oh!|Are you going to perform a wedding, Father Moulder?
speak;Moulder;Not exactly, child.|I'm teaching Artur the priestly duties, including marriage ceremonies.|But I've never actually performed one myself.
speak;Artur;We were hoping Garcia could tell us about his wedding.|Who ministered it? What was the ceremony like?
speak;Garcia;Ah, my wedding day...|It feels like another lifetime ago.|It was a simple affair in our village.
speak;Garcia;The village elder, Old Man Duran.|He wasn't a priest, but he knew the traditional vows.
speak;Moulder;In remote villages, it's not uncommon.|The sacred texts acknowledge that bonds blessed by the community are recognized in the eyes of the divine.
speak;Garcia;We stood beneath the old oak tree at sunset.|The whole village gathered around.|Risa wore a crown of wildflowers.
speak;Neimi;That sounds so romantic...|A sunset wedding under an oak tree...
speak;Garcia;Ross was just a baby then.|Risa held him during the entire ceremony.|He slept through the whole thing!
speak;Neimi;What were your vows like?|Did you write them yourselves?
speak;Garcia;Nothing fancy.|We promised to support each other through harvests good and bad.|To raise our children with love and strength.
speak;Moulder;Simple, but meaningful vows.|The best kind, I think.
speak;Artur;Did you exchange rings?|The texts mention ring ceremonies.
