speak;Garcia;We couldn't afford gold rings.|Instead, we exchanged wooden bands that we carved for each other.|Risa was much better at carving than I was!
speak;Neimi;That's so sweet...|Meaningful gifts from the heart...|I think I'm going to cry...
speak;Garcia;Risa would have liked you, Neimi.|She had a soft heart too.|Strong, but soft.
speak;Moulder;What advice would you give to a priest performing a wedding ceremony?
speak;Garcia;Remember that it's their day, not yours.|Keep the words simple and true.|And don't talk for too long!|The couple wants to celebrate!
speak;Artur;That's very practical advice.|Thank you, Garcia.
speak;Neimi;I hope I can get married someday...|When this war is over...|A simple ceremony like yours sounds perfect.
speak;Artur;I'm sure you will, Neimi.|When peace returns to our lands.
speak;Neimi;When I do...|Would you perform the ceremony, Artur?|Once you're fully trained, I mean.
speak;Artur;M-me?|I... I would be honored, Neimi.|That's very kind of you to ask.
speak;Moulder;You see, Artur?|This is why our duties matter.|We help mark the most important moments in people's lives.
speak;Artur;I understand better now.|It's not just about the words in the books.
speak;Garcia;That's right.|A good ceremony isn't about perfect words.|It's about capturing the meaning of the moment.
speak;Neimi;Do you think Risa would have liked your life now, Garcia?|Fighting alongside us?
speak;Garcia;She would have understood.|She always knew I had a warrior's heart.|But she'd be proud that I'm fighting for a better world.
speak;Neimi;I'm sure she would be.|And proud of Ross too.
speak;Moulder;Thank you for sharing your memories with us, Garcia.|They're more instructive than any book.
speak;Garcia;Anytime, Father Moulder.|It's good to remember the happy times.|Helps remind us what we're fighting for.
speak;Artur;I promise, when the time comes, I'll perform a beautiful ceremony for you, Neimi.|I'll practice hard.
speak;Neimi;Oh!|I didn't mean to presume...|I don't even have someone to marry yet!
speak;Moulder;All in good time, child.|When peace returns, many happy days await us all.
speak;Garcia;That's worth fighting for.|A world where young folks can have their oak tree weddings.|Without fear of war or invasion.
speak;Moulder;Indeed.|Shall we continue our lesson elsewhere, Artur?|I believe we've learned what we needed here.
speak;Artur;Yes, Father Moulder.|Thank you again, Garcia.|And you too, Neimi.
speak;Neimi;Garcia...|Would you tell me more about Risa?|If you don't mind talking about her...
speak;Garcia;I'd like that, Neimi.|I'd like that very much.

name: Ch10BBaseConvo5
_source: speak;Ross;Hey Forde!|Whatcha doing at this shop?|I didn't know you had errands too!
speak;Forde;Ross?!|I was just... uh...|Admiring the craftsmanship of these... tools.
speak;Ross;These look like art supplies to me.|Are you shopping for paintbrushes?
speak;Forde;Well...|I suppose there's no use hiding it now.|Yes, I was looking for some new brushes and paints.
speak;Ross;I didn't know knights had time for artsy stuff.|What do you even do with all this?
speak;Forde;I paint, Ross.|It's a way to express myself outside of battle.
speak;Ross;But why?|All these colors and shapes just look weird to me.|What's the point?
speak;Forde;The point?|There's beauty in creating something from nothing!|Art captures moments, feelings, experiences!
speak;Ross;I don't get it.|They're just blobs of color on paper.|How is that useful?
speak;Forde;Not everything has to be "useful" in the way you think!|Art feeds the soul, Ross!|It tells stories without words!
speak;Ross;Stories without words?|That doesn't make any sense.|If you want to tell a story, just use words!
speak;Forde;There are some things that can't be expressed with just words.|Colors, forms, light and shadow can convey feelings that speech cannot.
speak;Ross;I still don't get it.|It's just... weird shapes to me.|Maybe I'm just not smart enough for art.
speak;Forde;It's not about being smart.|It's about being open to seeing the world differently.|But I can see I'm wasting my breath here.
speak;Ross;Sorry, Forde.|I'm better with an axe than a paintbrush anyway.|That's what my dad always says!
speak;Forde;We all have our strengths, I suppose.|Just...don't tell the others about seeing me here, alright?
speak;Ross;Sure thing!|Your secret art hobby is safe with me!|Though I still think it's weird!

name: Ch11BBaseConvo1
_source: speak;Franz;So tomorrow's the big day, huh?|We finally set sail for Grado.
speak;Ross;Yeah! I can't wait!|My first real journey across the sea!
speak;Franz;Are you nervous at all?|The waters can get pretty rough this time of year.
speak;Ross;Well...maybe a little.|I've heard stories about seasickness.|My dad said it's worse than any battle wound!
speak;Franz;I've heard the same.|Apparently even the toughest warriors can be laid low by the rocking of the waves.
speak;Ross;Great...|Now I'm definitely worried.|What if I spend the whole trip hanging over the railing?
speak;Lute;Did I hear someone expressing concern about seasickness?|How fortuitous that I should be passing by at this exact moment.
speak;Franz;Oh, hello Lute.|Were you eavesdropping on us?
speak;Lute;I prefer the term "collecting conversational data."|But that's irrelevant now.|I have a solution to your maritime malady concerns!
speak;Lute;I've concocted a preventative elixir specifically designed to combat seasickness!|It's quite effective, based on my research.
speak;Lute;Of course.|I am a prodigy after all.|Here, I've brought samples for both of you.
speak;Ross;Wait a second...|What exactly is in this... stuff?|It smells weird.
speak;Lute;Oh, just some herbs, minerals, and...|Well, I suppose full disclosure is important in medical contexts...
speak;Lute;It contains precisely measured portions of powdered revenant bone,|gorgon scales,|some mogall eye fluid,|and a dash of bael venom for potency.
speak;Lute;The ingredients may sound unconventional,|but I assure you I've calculated the proportions with absolute precision.
speak;Lute;Of course!|I tested it on myself first.|I only experienced minor hallucinations and temporary numbness in my extremities.
speak;Ross;Um...|I think I'd rather take my chances with the seasickness!
speak;Lute;But the efficacy rate is nearly 82%!|That's remarkably high for an experimental compound!
speak;Franz;Thanks, but no thanks, Lute!|We should really get going now!|Right, Ross?
speak;Ross;Right!|Very right!|Gotta prepare for tomorrow!|Bye Lute!
speak;Lute;Wait!|You're making an irrational decision based on emotional response rather than scientific merit!|The monster parts are perfectly safe once processed correctly!
speak;Lute;Come back!|At least take it with you in case you change your minds!|I spent three days extracting that mogall fluid!

name: Ch11BBaseConvo2
_source: speak;Cormag;So, Vanessa.|I've been meaning to ask you about your pegasus.
speak;Vanessa;Oh?|What would you like to know?
speak;Cormag;How long have you been riding her?|The bond between a knight and their mount is important.
speak;Vanessa;Since I was a trainee in Frelia.|About five years now.|And yourself with your wyvern?
speak;Cormag;Seven years with Genarog.|He was a difficult one to tame at first.|Wyverns are naturally more aggressive than pegasi.
speak;Vanessa;I've heard that.|They're quite different creatures, aren't they?|Pegasi refuse to accept riders with malice in their hearts.
speak;Vanessa;That's why only women can ride them.|They sense purity of intention.
speak;Cormag;Interesting.|Wyverns are almost the opposite.|They respect strength and assertiveness.
speak;Cormag;A hesitant rider would be thrown off immediately.|Or worse.
speak;Vanessa;What about their care?|Pegasi require regular grooming and specific herbs in their feed.
speak;Vanessa;Their wings are particularly delicate.|We brush them daily with special combs.
speak;Cormag;Wyverns are hardier.|Their scales need occasional polishing to prevent infection,|but they can go days without proper care if necessary.
speak;Cormag;Though Genarog gets irritable if I skip our morning flight.|He's particular about his routine.
speak;Vanessa;That sounds familiar!|Titania won't let me mount her if I haven't brought her favorite treats.|They're intelligent creatures, aren't they?
speak;Cormag;More than most people realize.|Wyverns can remember faces for years.|And they never forget a slight.
speak;Vanessa;Pegasi are similar.|They remember kindness especially.|It's fascinating how different yet similar our mounts are.
speak;Cormag;Indeed.|Say, I have something for you actually.|In Grado, we make protective charms from shed wyvern scales.
speak;Cormag;Here.|It's meant to ward off arrows - a rider's greatest threat.|The scales are surprisingly lightweight but strong.
speak;Vanessa;It's beautiful!|Thank you, Cormag.|The craftsmanship is exquisite.
speak;Vanessa;I have something for you as well.|Though it's not as practical, perhaps.
speak;Vanessa;In Frelia, we preserve pegasus feathers from their molting.|This one is from Titania's wing.|It's said to bring good fortune on long journeys.
speak;Cormag;I'm honored.|Pegasus feathers are rare in Grado.|Thank you, Vanessa.
speak;Cormag;Perhaps our mounts aren't the only ones forming bonds across borders.
speak;Vanessa;I think you're right.|Maybe we could arrange a flight together sometime?|I'd love to learn more about wyvern riding techniques.
speak;Cormag;I'd like that.|And I could learn a thing or two about pegasus handling.
speak;Vanessa;It's settled then.|Until our next patrol?
speak;Cormag;Until then.|May your skies be clear, Vanessa.

name: Ch11BBaseConvo3
_source: speak;Duessel;Thank you both for accompanying me today.|Prince Ephraim speaks highly of your abilities.
speak;Kyle;It's an honor to serve alongside you, General Duessel.|Your reputation precedes you.
speak;Forde;Yeah, although I didn't expect "rebuilding village houses"|would be part of our duties today.
speak;Duessel;A knight's duty extends beyond the battlefield.|The people of this village have suffered enough.
speak;Kyle;Agreed.|And it gives us something productive to do while waiting for our ship to Grado.
speak;Duessel;That reminds me...|How do you two feel about heading to Grado?|It must be strange, given recent events.
speak;Forde;I'm just following Prince Ephraim's orders.|Though I am curious to see the homeland of our former enemies.
speak;Kyle;Actually, for me it's a bit different.|My grandfather was from Grado originally.
speak;Kyle;It never came up.|He was a wyvern knight in service to the Grado Empire before settling in Renais.
speak;Duessel;A wyvern knight, you say?|What was his name?
speak;Kyle;Riordan.|Riordan Vernais.|He served about forty years ago.
speak;Duessel;Riordan Vernais...|Wait!|I knew him!|Not well, but I certainly knew of him.
speak;Duessel;Indeed.|I was just a young soldier when he was serving.|He was part of the Eastern Aerial Guard, if I recall correctly.
speak;Kyle;Yes, that's right!|This is...unexpected.|He wasn't a high-ranking officer or anything special.
speak;Duessel;Perhaps not in rank, but he was known for his skill.|There was an incident with bandits near the border...|He saved an entire village with just two other knights.
speak;Duessel;I remember because they had us study the tactics they used.|Your grandfather had a reputation as a clever strategist.
speak;Kyle;I...had no idea.|He rarely spoke of his time in Grado's service.|I only know he left after meeting my grandmother in Renais.
speak;Forde;Well, this is quite the revelation!|All these years training together, and I never knew my stern partner had Grado blood!
speak;Forde;Suddenly your obsession with proper technique makes more sense.|That famous Grado military discipline!
speak;Kyle;I'm not obsessed with technique, I'm just thorough.|And my discipline comes from training, not bloodlines.
speak;Duessel;Your grandfather would be proud to see you now, Kyle.|A knight of Renais, upholding the values of both nations.
speak;Kyle;Thank you, General.|That...means a lot coming from you.
speak;Forde;No wonder you have such a way with wyverns!
speak;Kyle;Yes, they have come pretty naturally to me.
speak;Duessel;When we reach Grado, I could arrange for you to see the training grounds.|That's where your grandfather would have trained.|Some of the old records might still mention him.
speak;Kyle;I would appreciate that very much, General Duessel.|It would be an honor.
speak;Forde;Well, now I'm doubly intrigued about our journey to Grado!|Family history and rebuilding a nation!
speak;Duessel;For now, though, we have houses to rebuild.|Let's get back to work, shall we?
speak;Kyle;Of course.|Let's make Prince Ephraim proud.
speak;Forde;Right behind you...|Though I still think my talents are better used with a brush than a hammer.

name: Ch11BBaseConvo4
_source: speak;Joshua;Urgh...|Who knew the sea could be so...|unpleasant?
speak;Joshua;I'm fine, Father Moulder.|Just getting my sea legs, as they say.
speak;Moulder;You don't look well at all, my boy.|The complexion of your face reminds me of the time|Garcia ate those questionable mushrooms.
speak;Moulder;Perhaps I can offer some assistance?|My healing arts extend beyond battle wounds.
speak;Joshua;I wouldn't turn down help right now.|What did you have in mind?
speak;Moulder;A simple herbal remedy and a minor healing spell.|It won't cure seasickness entirely,|but it should ease your discomfort.
speak;Joshua;...Hmm, not as bitter as I expected.
speak;Joshua;I'm already feeling a bit better.|You're a lifesaver, Father Moulder.
speak;Moulder;Happy to help.|I take it you don't have much experience with ocean travel?
speak;Joshua;Let's just say I'm more accustomed to a different kind of sea.|One that doesn't move quite so...unpredictably.
speak;Moulder;A different kind of sea?|Ah, you mean the deserts.
speak;Moulder;Your complexion, for one.|Despite your current pallor, your skin bears the mark of someone|who has spent considerable time under a harsh sun.
speak;Moulder;And your clothing style has elements of the eastern regions.|Jehanna, perhaps?
speak;Joshua;You've got sharp eyes, Father.|Yes, I've spent time in...those parts.
speak;Moulder;The "Sea of Sand," they call it.|I visited once in my younger days.|Beautiful, but unforgiving.
speak;Joshua;That it is.|The desert demands respect.|Much like the ocean, it seems.
speak;Joshua;Though I think I prefer sand that stays in one place|to water that can't make up its mind.
speak;Moulder;Both can be treacherous in their own ways.|The desert hides its dangers beneath the surface,|while the sea flaunts them with every wave.
speak;Joshua;You know, I never thought of it that way.|The desert is deceptive, quiet in its danger.|The sea is honest about its threats.
speak;Moulder;Perhaps that's why you're struggling.|You're used to reading subtle signs of danger,|not confronting them so...viscerally.
speak;Joshua;Maybe you're right.|In the desert, you learn to read the wind, the sand patterns.|Here, I'm at the mercy of these waves.
speak;Moulder;Give it time.|A man who has mastered the desert|will find his footing on the sea eventually.
speak;Joshua;I hope so.|For now, I'm grateful for your remedy.|And your discretion.
speak;Joshua;Not everyone needs to know where I hail from.|A mercenary keeps some cards close to the chest, you know?
speak;Moulder;Of course.|Your secrets are safe with me, Joshua.|We all have parts of our past we choose to keep private.
speak;Moulder;The goddess sees all, but even she does not judge|the paths we walked before finding our way here.
speak;Joshua;Thanks, Father.|You know, you're all right.|For a man of the cloth.
speak;Moulder;And you're quite interesting.|For a simple "mercenary."
speak;Joshua;Ha!|Point taken.|I think I'll get some fresh air now.
speak;Moulder;A wise choice.|And if you need another dose of that remedy,|you know where to find me.

name: Ch11BBaseConvo5
_source: speak;Gilliam;The water is calm today.|Perfect conditions for fishing.
speak;Gilliam;Franz mentioned this spot was promising.|Now let's see if those rumors about the Golden Fin are true...
speak;Gilliam;The hook...|It's embedded in my hand.
speak;Natasha;Sir Gilliam?|I heard you cry out.|Are you injured?
speak;Gilliam;Sister Natasha.|It's nothing serious.|Just a fishing accident.
speak;Natasha;Let me see...|Oh! The hook is quite deep.
speak;Natasha;Please, allow me to help.|I have my staff with me.
speak;Gilliam;If you insist.|Though it's hardly a battle wound.
speak;Natasha;Hold still.|This may hurt a moment...
speak;Natasha;There.|The hook is out.|Now let me heal the wound.
speak;Natasha;May the sacred light close this wound...
speak;Gilliam;Thank you, Sister Natasha.|Your skills are as impressive as ever.
speak;Natasha;I'm glad I was nearby.|But I must admit, I'm surprised to see|one of Frelia's finest knights fishing.
speak;Gilliam;Even knights need moments of peace.|Franz and I come here when duties allow.
speak;Gilliam;Today I'm hoping to catch the Golden Fin.|A rare fish said to appear in these waters.
speak;Natasha;The Golden Fin?|I've heard tales of it.|Isn't it said to bring fortune and wealth to its captor?
speak;Gilliam;That's what the locals say.|One glimpse of its scales brings prosperity.
speak;Natasha;Do you...need money so badly, Sir Gilliam?
speak;Gilliam;Money?|No, that's not why I'm here.
speak;Gilliam;I simply enjoy the challenge of catching rare fish.|The legends are just stories that add to the experience.
speak;Natasha;I see.|So it's the pursuit itself that interests you,|not the promised reward.
speak;Natasha;That's...admirable.|Many would be tempted by tales of wealth.
speak;Gilliam;A knight's honor isn't measured in gold, Sister Natasha.|It's found in duty, discipline, and...
speak;Gilliam;It's strong!|Must be a large one!
speak;Gilliam;By the Sacred Stones...|It's the Golden Fin!
speak;Natasha;It's beautiful!|Its scales truly do shimmer like gold!
speak;Gilliam;Never thought I'd actually catch one.|Look at the markings on its fins.
speak;Natasha;What will you do with it?|Surely you won't...kill such a rare creature?
speak;Gilliam;A true knight respects all forms of life.|Even those beneath the waves.
speak;Gilliam;Here, would you like to touch it?|Carefully, so we don't damage its scales.
speak;Natasha;It's so smooth...|Thank you for sharing this moment.
speak;Gilliam;Now, back to where you belong, little one.
speak;Gilliam;There.|May you live long and bring others joy.
speak;Natasha;That was a wonderful thing to do, Sir Gilliam.|I'm glad to see such compassion.
speak;Gilliam;What's that in the water?|Something's floating to the surface.
speak;Natasha;Sir Gilliam...that looks like...|Is that gold?!
speak;Gilliam;Indeed it is.|A considerable amount too.
speak;Gilliam;The legend was true after all.|Though not quite in the way I expected.
speak;Natasha;This is incredible!|What will you do with it?
speak;Gilliam;This gold doesn't belong to me alone.|It would best serve our cause.
speak;Gilliam;War funds.|For supplies, weapons, and healing items.
speak;Natasha;You continue to impress me, Sir Gilliam.|Your honor truly isn't measured in gold.
speak;Gilliam;It's the right thing to do.|Besides, I already received my reward today.
speak;Gilliam;A rare fish, good company,|and a reminder that some legends have truth to them.
speak;Natasha;Indeed.|Shall we bring this to Prince Ephraim?
speak;Gilliam;After you, Sister Natasha.|Perhaps there's something to be said for fishing after all.

name: Ch12BBaseConvo1
_source: speak;Larachel;Oh my!|Would you look at that fine specimen over there, Tana!|Such strong shoulders!
speak;Tana;L'Arachel!|Please lower your voice.|People can hear you.
speak;Larachel;Why should I be quiet?|There's no shame in admiring the divine craftsmanship|that went into creating such magnificent men!
speak;Larachel;Look at that one loading crates!|And that mercenary by the tavern!|Oh!|And that sailor tying knots!
speak;Tana;I didn't realize you were so...|interested in men, L'Arachel.
speak;Larachel;A princess must always be aware of potential suitors!|One day, I shall need a consort worthy of Rausten's throne.
speak;Larachel;Tell me, Tana.|What sort of man catches your royal eye?|Tall?|Muscular?|Scholarly?|Rugged?
speak;Tana;I don't think this is an appropriate conversation to have|in the middle of a busy port!
speak;Larachel;Nonsense!|This is precisely the right place.|So many examples to reference!
speak;Larachel;Do you prefer a man of action like that sailor?|Or perhaps someone refined, like a noble merchant?
speak;Tana;I... well...|There's already someone I...|Never mind.
speak;Larachel;Oho!|So there IS someone!|You must tell me everything!
speak;Larachel;Is it someone in our army?|A knight perhaps?|Or maybe a certain prince?
speak;Tana;L'Arachel, please!|I'd rather not discuss this.
speak;Larachel;My dear Tana, you mustn't be shy about these matters!|How will you know he's the right one|if you haven't compared him to others?
speak;Larachel;Marriage is a divine covenant, blessed by the heavens themselves!|It must not be entered into without thorough consideration.
speak;Tana;I'm not thinking about marriage yet!|We're in the middle of a war!
speak;Larachel;Wars end, Tana.|And when peace comes, so do proposals!
speak;Larachel;Tell me, what qualities do you seek in a husband?|Is he brave?|Loyal?|Handsome?|Does he make your heart flutter?
speak;Tana;But mostly, he cares deeply for others.
speak;Tana;He puts others before himself, always.|Sometimes to a fault.
speak;Larachel;That's a fine start!|But what of his lineage?|His prospects?|His faith and devotion to the divine?
speak;Tana;I...haven't really thought about those things.|Does it matter so much?
speak;Larachel;Of course it matters!|A marriage is not just between two hearts,|but between two families, two legacies!
speak;Larachel;Take it from me, dear Tana.|There are many handsome, brave men in our army alone!|Don't settle on one without knowing what else awaits you.
speak;Tana;But when you know in your heart...
speak;Larachel;The heart can be fickle and easily swayed!|That's why we must test it!|See if it remains true when presented with alternatives.
speak;Larachel;I say this as your friend.|You deserve someone who makes you truly happy.|Someone worthy of Frelia's lovely princess.
speak;Tana;Perhaps you have a point.|I've been so focused on one person...
speak;Larachel;Exactly!|Open your eyes to the possibilities!|The divine works in mysterious ways.
speak;Larachel;Now, I must be off!|Uncle Mansel would want me to survey the port|for any signs of monsters or unholy creatures.
speak;Larachel;Think on what I've said, dear Tana!|And keep your royal eyes open!|You never know when the perfect match might appear!
speak;Tana;Could I be too focused?|Am I certain about what I want?|Who I want?
speak;Tana;*sighs*|L'Arachel certainly knows how to complicate things.|Even matters of the heart...

name: Ch12BBaseConvo2
_source: speak;Lute;Three Mogall eyeballs, intact...|Four ounces of revenants' bone marrow...|Seventeen gorgon scales, premium quality...
speak;Artur;Lute?|What are you doing with all of those... specimens?
speak;Lute;Cataloging my monster parts collection, of course.|I extracted these during our last encounter with the creatures of darkness.
speak;Lute;I've developed a highly efficient extraction method.|While everyone else was focusing on defeating the monsters,|I was securing these valuable research materials.
speak;Artur;I see...|And you collected all of these during battle?|While also fighting?
speak;Artur;Actually, I shouldn't be surprised.|Your capacity for multitasking is rather remarkable.
speak;Lute;Naturally.|It would be inefficient to let such rare specimens go to waste.|Do you know how difficult it is to find intact Mogall eyeballs?
speak;Artur;I can't say that I do.|Nor have I ever wondered about it, truth be told.
speak;Artur;But what exactly are you planning to do with all of these...|parts?
speak;Lute;I'm glad you asked!|The Mogall eyeballs contain a rare magical fluid|that, when properly extracted and processed,|can be used to create an enchanted ward.
speak;Lute;And these revenant claws?|When ground and mixed with the proper reagents,|they can be fashioned into a ring that enhances magical power.
speak;Artur;Lute...|Are you certain these crafting methods are... sanctioned?|The church tends to frown upon using dark creatures for magical items.
speak;Lute;The church frowns upon many things that advance magical knowledge.|Besides, I'm not using the parts for dark magic.|I'm repurposing them for beneficial applications.
speak;Lute;Think of it as purifying these tainted materials|and giving them a nobler purpose.
speak;Artur;When you put it that way...|It does sound somewhat reasonable.|Though I'm still not entirely comfortable with it.
speak;Lute;The process requires time and careful supervision.|One small error could result in a rather unpleasant magical backlash.
speak;Artur;That doesn't sound reassuring at all.
speak;Lute;Which is why I need assistance from someone|who understands magical theory and has steady hands.
speak;Lute;I've calculated that you're the only suitable candidate|within our current company.
speak;Artur;Me?|You want me to help you with this?
speak;Lute;Yes.|You're the only one I trust to maintain the necessary focus|and not disrupt the delicate magical balances involved.
speak;Artur;I'm...flattered by your confidence in me, Lute.|Though I'm not sure if I should be.
speak;Lute;It's not flattery, just statistical fact.|Your precision with light magic indicates fine control|that would be beneficial to this process.
speak;Lute;So, will you assist me?|Think of the knowledge we'll gain.|The magical items we'll create could help in our coming battles.
speak;Artur;*sigh*|I suppose someone should keep an eye on you|during these experiments.
speak;Artur;If only to ensure you don't accidentally|summon something unpleasant.
speak;Lute;Excellent!|I knew you would see the logical benefits.|We'll begin tonight after sunset.
speak;Lute;I've already prepared the necessary containment circles|and purification candles.
speak;Artur;Containment circles?|That doesn't sound ominous at all...
speak;Lute;Merely a precaution.|The probability of anything escaping is only 3.7%.|And if something does go wrong, you're quite proficient with holy magic.
speak;Artur;That's not as reassuring as you seem to think it is, Lute.
speak;Lute;Oh! I almost forgot.|You should wear these protective gloves.|Mogall eye fluid can cause some interesting skin reactions.
speak;Artur;Interesting... skin reactions?|What kind of reactions exactly?
speak;Lute;Nothing permanent.|Well, mostly not permanent.|The purple spots usually fade within a week.
speak;Artur;I suppose I did agree to help...|Though I'm already beginning to regret it.
speak;Lute;Don't worry, Artur.|This will be a fascinating learning experience for both of us.|And afterwards, I'll have new data for my monster compendium!
speak;Artur;Very well.|Just promise me we won't be creating anything|that Father Moulder would need to exorcise later.
speak;Lute;I make no promises.|But I calculate a 78.3% chance of complete success!
speak;Lute;Thank you, Artur.|You truly are an invaluable research assistant.
speak;Lute;Same difference!|Now, help me carry these jars.|And be careful with that one.|It blinks sometimes.

name: Ch12BBaseConvo3
_source: speak;Dozla;Gwah ha ha!|And then the poor lad couldn't hold his sword properly for a week!
speak;Duessel;Reminds me of when I was training the imperial recruits.|One boy was so nervous, he saluted me with the wrong hand|while holding a lance in the other!
speak;Duessel;Skewered his own helmet plume clean off.|Stood there stammering with feathers floating all around him.
speak;Dozla;Ah, youngsters.|They don't make them like they used to, do they?
speak;Dozla;Remember those campaigns in the northern mountains?|Back when we could march for days with full armor.|We would still have energy for battle!
speak;Duessel;Indeed.|The winter campaign against those bandits in Frelia.|What was that...thirty years ago now?
speak;Duessel;My men and I slept in the snow for a fortnight.|And we still routed them by sunrise.
speak;Dozla;30 years ago, huh?|By the gods, we're getting old, Duessel!
speak;Dozla;I noticed my back aching this morning.|Just from sleeping on these bedrolls.|Wouldn't have bothered me twenty years ago!
speak;Duessel;I know what you mean.|These days, my old war wound aches when rain approaches.
speak;Duessel;Makes me a fine weather predictor...|But reminds me I'm not the man I once was...
speak;Dozla;GWAH!|Don't say such things!|Lady L'Arachel still needs her trusty Dozla!
speak;Dozla;Though I admit, I tire more easily these days.|And these young knights move so quickly in battle...
speak;Duessel;I've noticed the same.|The other day, I was sparring with that boy Franz.|His speed was remarkable.
speak;Duessel;For a moment, I felt like a lumbering ox|trying to catch a hare.
speak;Dozla;Are we becoming liabilities on the battlefield, old friend?|Has time finally caught up with us?
speak;Duessel;No.|What we've lost in speed, we've gained in experience.|Every battle we've survived has taught us something valuable.
speak;Duessel;The young ones may dash about,|but they often leave themselves open to counterattack.
speak;Dozla;You know, you're right!|I've noticed that myself!|These youngsters often overextend.
speak;Dozla;And say what you will about aging!|But I can still swing my axe harder than any of them!|Gwah ha ha!
speak;Duessel;And my lance arm is as steady as ever.|Besides, there's something to be said for our size.
speak;Duessel;The enemy hesitates when facing a seasoned warrior.|That moment of doubt can be the difference between victory and defeat.
speak;Dozla;Size!|Yes, that's it!|We're bigger than these young twigs!
speak;Dozla;They may be quick, but can they stand their ground?|Are they unmoved when a charging enemy bears down on them?|We're like mountains on the battlefield!
speak;Duessel;Immovable, dependable.|The younger soldiers rally behind us,|knowing we won't break formation.
speak;Duessel;And our armor!|I've spent decades perfecting how to move efficiently in heavy plate.|These recruits clank around like cookware falling down stairs!
speak;Dozla;Gwah ha ha!|Well said!|We should use our bulk to our advantage!
speak;Dozla;What do you say to some practice?|Show these youngsters what experience looks like in action!
speak;Duessel;A fine idea, Dozla.|Perhaps we form a veteran vanguard,|leading the charge when the terrain is difficult.
speak;Duessel;Let the nimble ones handle the flanking,|while we create an unbreakable center.
speak;Dozla;I like that!|Two old war dogs, standing firm!|For Rausten and Grado!
speak;Duessel;For honor and duty.|Age brings wisdom to temper strength.
speak;Dozla;Gwah ha ha!|I feel younger already!|Come, let's find some decent ale and plan our strategy!
speak;Duessel;Lead on, my friend.|We may be weathered stones,|but stones become only more steadfast with time.

name: Ch12BBaseConvo4
_source: speak;Neimi;Oh!|F-finally back on land...|I was starting to worry we'd never get off that boat.
speak;Forde;*yawn*|I don't see what the rush was.|The boat was perfect for catching up on sleep.
speak;Neimi;Y-you were sleeping the whole time?|Even during your watch duty?
speak;Forde;Well, not the whole time.|Just... most of it.|The waves were so soothing.
speak;Neimi;B-but what if something had happened?|What if we were attacked?
speak;Forde;You worry too much, Neimi.|Nothing happened that we couldn't handle, right?|Besides, I sleep with one eye open.
speak;Forde;*yawn*|Now that we're on land, I should find a nice shady tree.|The grass looks perfect for a lengthy nap.
speak;Neimi;Forde!|Absolutely not!|You will not be taking another nap!
speak;Neimi;Do you have any idea how irresponsible you've been?|We all counted on you to keep watch and you were sleeping!|What kind of knight behaves this way?
speak;Neimi;No more excuses!|You're going to take your duties seriously from now on!|No more excessive napping, is that clear?
speak;Forde;Did...did you just raise your voice at me?|I've never seen you like this before.
speak;Neimi;Someone has to set you straight!|You're acting like a child who needs constant supervision!
speak;Forde;Haha!|Is this really the same timid Neimi I know?|You sound exactly like my mother used to!
speak;Neimi;I'm serious, Forde!|I expect you to check all our equipment when we make camp tonight.|And no sleeping until you've finished your patrol!
speak;Forde;You know what?|You'd make a scary, but good mother someday.
speak;Neimi;W-what?|Why would you s-say something like that?
speak;Forde;Just an observation.|Though I pity the poor man who ends up as your husband!|He'll never get to sleep in again!
speak;Forde;I'm going, I'm going!|No need to get angry again!
speak;Neimi;Me...acting like a m-mother?|I didn't realize I could sound so...commanding...

name: Ch12BBaseConvo5
_source: speak;Amelia;Do you think...Grado will ever return to how it was?|Before all of this happened?
speak;Cormag;It won't be easy.|Much has been destroyed, and many have been lost.
speak;Amelia;I know...|My village was one of the first to fall.
speak;Cormag;But the people of Grado are strong.|We've weathered hardships before.
speak;Amelia;You're right.|Once this war is over, we'll rebuild together!
speak;Cormag;Yes.|It will take time, but it can be done.
speak;Amelia;What about you, Cormag?|What will you do when the fighting is finished?
speak;Cormag;I've been giving that some thought lately.|One thing I'm considering is returning to the wyvern valleys.
speak;Cormag;Yes.|The wild wyverns of Grado need protection.|And the hatchlings will need guidance to grow strong.
speak;Amelia;I see...|So you'd be raising the next generation of wyverns?
speak;Cormag;That's part of it.|Genarog would appreciate the company of his own kind again.
speak;Amelia;Genarog is your wyvern, right?|He seems very loyal to you.
speak;Cormag;We've been through much together.|More than just a mount, he's been my closest companion.
speak;Cormag;A wyvern stone.|They're incredibly rare.|Formed from crystallized dragon breath.|Only the most bonded wyverns willingly part with them.
speak;Cormag;It's my duty to repay Genarog for his generosity.|Helping raise the next generation of wyverns seems fitting.
speak;Amelia;Wait a moment...|This might sound strange, but...
speak;Amelia;The stone set in my lance...|It looks very similar to what you're describing.
speak;Cormag;...This is remarkable.|Amelia, do you know what you have here?
speak;Amelia;I found it while training one day.|It seemed to glow whenever I practiced near the wyvern stables.
speak;Cormag;This is definitely a wyvern stone.|And a thunder elemental one at that.|They're even rarer than mine.
speak;Cormag;A wyvern stone bonds its carrier to the dragons.|With this, you could potentially fuse with a wyvern, just as I can with Genarog.
speak;Amelia;F-fuse?|You mean...become one with a wyvern?
speak;Cormag;In a manner of speaking, yes.|The stone has chosen you, Amelia.|It's an honor few receive.
speak;Amelia;I've always felt drawn to the wyverns...|Even as a child, I wasn't afraid of them like the other villagers.
speak;Cormag;That explains it.|The stone recognized that affinity within you.
speak;Amelia;After the war...|Maybe I could join you in the wyvern valleys?|I want to learn more about this connection.
speak;Amelia;Then it's decided!|Once we restore peace to Grado, we'll help restore the wyverns too!

name: Ch13BBaseConvo1
_source: speak;Gilliam;General Duessel.|May I have a word before we march?
speak;Duessel;Of course, Sir Gilliam.|What troubles you?
speak;Gilliam;I've heard our next opponent is General Selena of Grado.|You served alongside her, did you not?
speak;Duessel;Yes... Selena the Fluorspar.|One of the Imperial Three, just as I was.
speak;Gilliam;What manner of opponent should we expect?|I prefer to know what we're facing.
speak;Duessel;Selena is...|She's a woman of unwavering loyalty and formidable skill.
speak;Gilliam;You hold her in high regard.
speak;Duessel;Indeed.|She is honorable and just.|I strongly hope we can persuade her to join our cause.
speak;Duessel;Then we face one of Grado's finest.|And a dear friend...
speak;Duessel;Be warned, Sir Gilliam.|She commands powerful ice magic and wields Bolting—a formidable long-range spell.
speak;Gilliam;Bolting?|The thunder magic that strikes from afar?
speak;Duessel;Yes.|Many a soldier has fallen before even glimpsing her on the battlefield.
speak;Gilliam;I appreciate the warning, General.|But my armor has weathered many storms.
speak;Duessel;This is no ordinary storm, Sir Gilliam.|Tread cautiously.|Even your stalwart armor may not withstand her magic.
speak;Gilliam;I will not falter.|If it comes to battle, I shall stand firm against her bolts of lightning.
speak;Duessel;Ha!|You're either remarkably brave or remarkably foolish, Sir Gilliam.
speak;Gilliam;Perhaps both.|But which it is...|You'll have to wait until after the battle to learn.
speak;Duessel;Indeed.|Let us hope we both live to have that conversation.
speak;Gilliam;We shall.|And perhaps with Lady Selena among our ranks.
speak;Duessel;That would be my dearest wish.|Come then, let us march.

name: Ch13BBaseConvo2
_source: speak;Ewan;Hmm...I wonder what's in here.|People drop all sorts of stuff in the mud!
speak;Ewan;Oh!|Marisa! How long have you been standing there?
speak;Ewan;Aren't you going to ask what I'm doing?
speak;Ewan;Well, I'll tell you anyway!|I'm treasure hunting!|Master Saleh says valuable things often get lost in unlikely places.
speak;Ewan;Exactly!|Nobody looks in mud, so that's where treasures hide!
speak;Ewan;Look!|Look!|It's a ring!|See? I told you!
speak;Ewan;Not just any ring!|It could be magical!|It could be worth a fortune!
speak;Ewan;You're no fun, Marisa.|Don't you ever get excited about anything?
speak;Ewan;Well, maybe you should!|Let me show you how fun mud can be!
speak;Ewan;Wow!|You dodged that so fast!|I didn't even see you move!
speak;Ewan;Oh come on!|Just having a little fun!|One more try?
speak;Ewan;Wait a minute...|I'm stuck!|My boots won't come free!

name: Ch13BBaseConvo3
_source: speak;Joshua;What does it look like?|I'm searching for treasure!
speak;Marisa;Why do boys love playing in mud so much?|First Ewan, now you...
speak;Joshua;Ewan was here?|Did he find anything?
speak;Joshua;A ring!|So the rumors are true!
speak;Joshua;This marsh is said to contain a secret treasure.|A mystical ring and an ancient sword.
speak;Marisa;...Sounds like a tale for children.
speak;Joshua;Care to make a wager on it?|I bet we find something valuable in the next five minutes.
speak;Joshua;Hmm...|Where do you think it would be?|The deepest part of the marsh?|Or maybe under that fallen log?
speak;Marisa;*sigh*|Fine.|If I help, will you stop making noise?
speak;Joshua;That's the spirit!|Two pairs of eyes are better than one.
speak;Marisa;I'd check near the reeds.|Water flows there, bringing objects with it.
speak;Marisa;...An earth blade?|Those are quite rare.
speak;Joshua;Not just any earth sword!|Look at these markings.|This is a Terraform Blade!|It is a very powerful blade!
speak;Joshua;I've seen one before.|My mother had one in the roya-erm...|In her shop!
speak;Joshua;I can't wait to try it out!|This will give us an edge in the next battle.
speak;Marisa;This has been...|one of my stranger days.
speak;Joshua;But productive, right?|Who knew mud could be so rewarding?
speak;Marisa;...I'm leaving before you suggest we look for more.
speak;Joshua;Too late!|They say there might be a magic tome buried here too!
speak;Joshua;Was it something I said?|...Hey wait!|Don't you want your share of the treasure?

name: Ch13BBaseConvo4
_source: music;22- Twisted Shadows A Orchestral Cover
speak;Seth;Forde, there you are.|How goes your watch over Myrrh?|Is she adjusting well to being around so many people?
speak;Seth;Yes, your watch.|Don't tell me you've forgotten your duty.
speak;Forde;Oh!|That watch!|I thought it was Kyle's turn today.
speak;Seth;No, Forde.|Kyle was assigned to her yesterday.|Today was explicitly your responsibility.
speak;Forde;Are you certain?|I could have sworn that Kyle said...
speak;Forde;I may have...fallen asleep during my patrol.|When I woke up, she was gone.
speak;Seth;This is serious, Forde!|She's not familiar with this region!|And there have been reports of enemy scouts in the area!
speak;Forde;I know, Prince Seth.|I'm truly sorry.|I didn't mean to—
speak;Seth;Save your apologies.|Find her.|Now!|Grab Kyle and begin searching immediately.
speak;Seth;Myrrh...|Where could she have gone?|I don't like the look of this situation at all.
speak;Seth;If anything happens to her...|No, I mustn't think that way.|I must report to this to Prince Ephraim...

name: Ch13BBaseConvo5
_source: speak;Franz;I'm famished this morning!|Training with General Seth at dawn really works up an appetite.
speak;Joshua;You can say that again.|Nothing like the smell of breakfast after a night of keeping watch.
speak;Vanessa;Good morning, you two.|Breakfast is ready.
speak;Natasha;We have fresh bread and porridge today.|And some dried fruits from the last village.
speak;Franz;Sister Natasha and Vanessa!|You both prepared breakfast?
speak;Vanessa;It was my turn for kitchen duty.|Natasha offered to help.
speak;Natasha;I believe in caring for both body and spirit.|A nourishing meal helps with both.
speak;Joshua;This looks delicious!|Much better than what Kyle made yesterday.|Sorry Kyle, if you're listening.
speak;Franz;It smells wonderful!|Thank you both for your hard work.
speak;Vanessa;You're welcome.|As a pegasus knight, I understand the importance of proper nutrition.
speak;Vanessa;My pegasus needs the right feed to fly at her best.|The same applies to soldiers.
speak;Natasha;Indeed.|Your body is like a weapon that must be maintained.
speak;Franz;That's what my brother always says!|"A hungry knight is a sloppy knight."
speak;Joshua;Care to wager on who can finish their porridge first?
speak;Natasha;Joshua!|Food is not something to be rushed through.
speak;Joshua;Just trying to keep things lively!|All work and no play, you know?
speak;Vanessa;A well-fed army fights better.|And more importantly, stays healthier during long campaigns.
speak;Natasha;Prince Ephraim understands this.|He always ensures supplies are a priority.
speak;Franz;A happy army is a stronger army!|And right now, this porridge is making me very happy!
speak;Joshua;I'll second that!|Nothing improves morale like a good meal.
speak;Vanessa;There's plenty more if anyone wants seconds.|We made extra today.
speak;Natasha;We should eat quickly, though.|Commander Seth mentioned we'll be marching soon.
speak;Franz;Then we'd better fuel up!|Today's march is supposed to be a long one.
speak;Joshua;Best not to tempt fate by marching on an empty stomach.|I'd bet on that any day.

name: Ch14BBaseConvo1
_source: speak;Duessel;The time has come for us to face the truth about Grado.
speak;Duessel;I've served King Vigarde loyally for many years.|But the man who sits on the throne now...|He is not the king I knew.
speak;Natasha;I've noticed the same.|His Majesty was once a kind and just ruler.|But now...his ruling seems cruel and senseless.
speak;Duessel;Something has changed him.|He no longer listens to reason, shows no emotion...|It's as if he's become merely a shell of himself.
speak;Amelia;I joined the Grado army because I believed in our king.|I wanted to serve him...to protect our people.
speak;Amelia;But this war...|These senseless attacks...|This isn't what I signed up for.
speak;Cormag;We all feel the same way.|But what choice do we have now?|We can't simply abandon our homeland.
speak;Duessel;I believe there may be a way to stop him without bloodshed.|If we can reach him...speak to him directly...|Perhaps we can find what's causing this change.
speak;Natasha;Do you truly believe that's possible, General Duessel?
speak;Duessel;I have to believe it.|The Vigarde I knew would never order such atrocities.|Something else must be controlling his actions.
speak;Cormag;I'm willing to try.|But there's something else troubling me.
speak;Cormag;What of my brother, Glen?|He's still loyal to the crown.|What if we have to face him in battle?
speak;Duessel;Glen is a man of honor.|If he sees what we've seen...|Understands what we understand...|I believe he will join our cause.
speak;Cormag;But what if he doesn't?|What if he stands against us?|Could you raise your lance against your own student, General?
speak;Duessel;That is a bridge we must cross when we come to it.
speak;Duessel;For now, we focus on reaching the king.
speak;Amelia;I'll follow you, General Duessel.|If there's any chance to save our king...|To save Grado...|I want to be part of it.
speak;Natasha;The Everlasting watches over us.|I pray we can resolve this without further bloodshed.
speak;Duessel;Then it's settled.|We make for Castle Grado at dawn.|Our mission is clear.|Reach the king and try to reason with him.|We must discover what dark force has taken hold of him.
speak;Cormag;And if we can't reason with him?
speak;Duessel;Then we'll face that moment when it comes.|But for now, hold onto hope.|The Vigarde I know is still in there somewhere.
speak;Cormag;Very well.|For Grado's sake, I hope you're right.
speak;Natasha;May the light guide our path.
speak;Amelia;For a peaceful Grado.|For the true King Vigarde.

name: Ch14BBaseConvo2
_source: speak;Larachel;Might I have a moment of your time?
speak;Larachel;Allow me to introduce myself!|I am the beautiful princess of peerless beauty, L'Arachel!
speak;Colm;Yeah, I know who you are.|What do you want from me?
speak;Larachel;Well, you see...|I've been searching for a man named Rennac.|Have you perhaps encountered him in your travels?
speak;Larachel;Oh, how troubling!|He disappeared from my sight a few weeks ago.|Simply vanished without a trace!
speak;Colm;What does this guy do anyway?|Why are you looking for him?
speak;Larachel;Rennac possesses a most useful talent!|He excels at lockpicking and liberating valuable items from the clutches of evil men!
speak;Larachel;A most valuable skill in our sacred mission to vanquish darkness!
speak;Colm;Wait a minute...|That sounds exactly like what I do.
speak;Colm;I'm pretty good with locks and..."liberating" things myself.
speak;Larachel;Truly?!|The light of fortune shines upon us!|Could it be that the Everlasting has guided me to you in Rennac's absence?
speak;Larachel;Tell me, could you perhaps use this special staff?|Rennac would wield it from time to time on our righteous quests!
speak;Larachel;I never quite understood its purpose, but he seemed most insistent on carrying it!
speak;Colm;Is that...|Hold on, that's an Unlock Staff!
speak;Colm;I mean...|some kind of special staff. Yes.
speak;Colm;I could definitely try my hand at using it.|These things are...very specialized.
speak;Larachel;Wonderful!|You truly are a blessing!|Would you also be willing to help me locate Rennac?
speak;Colm;Sure, I can keep an eye out for him.|I'll let you know if I track him down.
speak;Colm;In the meantime, I'll take good care of this staff.|Very good care indeed.
speak;Larachel;Oh, thank you!|Your assistance brings joy to my noble heart!|The sacred mission continues unhindered!
speak;Larachel;I shall leave you to your task then!|May the light of justice guide your path!
speak;Colm;Heh.|This is perfect.|An Unlock Staff...|Think of all the chests I can open without picking a single lock!
speak;Colm;Sorry Rennac, but I'm not in any hurry to find you now.|Finders keepers!

name: Ch14BBaseConvo3
_source: speak;Garcia;Forde, what are you doing there?|Shouldn't you be preparing with the others?
speak;Forde;Ah, Garcia!|I was just admiring the architecture here in Grado.
speak;Forde;Have you noticed how different the buildings are compared to ours in Renais?
speak;Garcia;Can't say I've paid much attention to that.|We've been marching non-stop for days.
speak;Forde;That's exactly why we should take a moment to appreciate our surroundings!|Look at those arches and the stonework patterns.
speak;Forde;The way they use darker stones for accent pieces...|It's completely different from our architecture back home.
speak;Forde;And yet, there's something about it that's quite appealing to the eye.|The proportions, the way the light plays off the surfaces...
speak;Garcia;Hmm, now that you mention it...|I think I understand what you're getting at.
speak;Garcia;Back in Ide, I helped build quite a few structures in my time.|You develop an eye for balance and sturdy construction.
speak;Forde;Exactly!|I'm glad what I'm saying is getting across to you!
speak;Forde;Most of the knights just tell me to stop daydreaming and focus on battle.|But there's more to life than just fighting, don't you think?
speak;Garcia;Ha ha!|Indeed there is, lad!|A warrior should be aware of the world he's fighting to protect.
speak;Garcia;Though I doubt my son Ross would grasp our conversation right now.|He's still at that age where everything is about becoming stronger.
speak;Forde;Give the boy time.|He'll come around eventually.
speak;Forde;Perhaps I should sketch some of these buildings before we move on.|Would make for a nice painting once we return home.
speak;Garcia;If we return home, you mean.|But I like your optimism, Forde.
speak;Garcia;Maybe when this war is over, you can show Ross how to appreciate these finer things in life.|The boy could use some broader perspectives.
speak;Forde;It would be my pleasure.|And who knows? He might have a hidden talent for the arts!
speak;Garcia;Ha ha ha!|That would certainly be something to see!
speak;Garcia;Come on then, let's rejoin the others.|You can admire the architecture as we march.
speak;Forde;Right behind you!|Just let me commit this view to memory first...

name: Ch14BBaseConvo4
_source: speak;Gerik;And that's how we managed to complete the escort mission.|Even with those bandits ambushing us at every turn.
speak;Tethys;Chief makes it sound so simple!|I still remember how tense it was crossing that mountain pass.
speak;Marisa;The client paid well though.|Worth the trouble.
speak;Dozla;Gwa ha ha!|Is that mercenary talk I hear?|Mind if old Dozla joins your conversation?
speak;Gerik;Dozla!|Didn't see you there.|Of course, join us. We were just swapping old job stories.
speak;Tethys;I didn't realize you had experience as a mercenary, Dozla.
speak;Dozla;Gwa ha ha!|Indeed I do!|Before I pledged my axe to Lady L'Arachel, I wandered the continent taking all manner of jobs!
speak;Dozla;Everything from monster extermination to treasure hunting!|Once I even escorted a caravan through the Melkaen Coast!
speak;Gerik;The Melkaen Coast?|That's notorious monster territory.|Must have been quite the fight.
speak;Dozla;Gwa ha ha!|That it was!|Fifteen revenants surrounded us on the third night!
speak;Dozla;I stood guard while the merchants cowered in their wagons!|My axe arm was sore for days afterward!
speak;Tethys;That's incredible!|How did you end up in Lady L'Arachel's service after such adventures?
speak;Dozla;Ah, now that's a tale worth telling!|I was hired to clear monsters from the Rausten royal hunting grounds.
speak;Dozla;There I met a young L'Arachel, barely sixteen, fighting monsters on her own!|Such bravery! Such determination!
speak;Dozla;When the job was done, she asked me to join her crusade against evil!|Gwa ha ha!|How could I refuse?
speak;Gerik;You know, Dozla...|The Desert Tiger mercenary troupe could always use someone with your experience.
speak;Gerik;If you ever find yourself looking for work after this war, come find us.
speak;Tethys;Oh yes!|You'd fit right in with our band of misfits.
speak;Marisa;Agreed.|Would be good to have you.
speak;Dozla;Gwa ha ha!|You honor me with such an invitation!|I would love nothing more than to join your illustrious company!
speak;Dozla;But I've sworn to watch over Lady L'Arachel until these old bones give out!|A promise I intend to keep!
speak;Gerik;Loyalty like that is rare.|I respect a man who stands by his word.
speak;Tethys;Well, we can still enjoy swapping stories while we travel together.|There's much we could learn from each other.
speak;Dozla;Gwa ha ha!|Indeed! Let us make the most of our time as comrades in arms!
speak;Dozla;And perhaps when Lady L'Arachel visits Jehanna.|Old Dozla can join you for an adventure or two!
speak;Gerik;As am I.|Now, you must tell us about that time you mentioned fighting a cyclops!
speak;Dozla;Gwa ha ha!|Oh, that's a good one!|Picture this: a mountain cave, three treasure hunters, and the biggest cyclops you've ever seen!

name: Ch14BBaseConvo5
_source: speak;Cormag;The night before a battle isn't usually when I find rest.|This time feels different, though.
speak;Joshua;Yeah...|There's something in the air tonight.
speak;Joshua;Like the winds are carrying whispers of what's to come.
speak;Cormag;You feel it too then.|I thought it might just be my own doubts.
speak;Cormag;Tomorrow we march on Grado Castle.|The place I once called home.
speak;Joshua;That can't be easy.|Fighting against your own kingdom.
speak;Cormag;My loyalty was never to stones and flags.|It was to the people inside them.
speak;Cormag;My brother Glen is still in there somewhere.|Following orders, believing he's doing what's right.
speak;Joshua;Family makes things complicated.|I haven't been back home to Jehanna in...|Quite some time.
speak;Joshua;But sometimes I get this feeling...|Like I should have returned sooner.
speak;Joshua;My mother.|We didn't part on the best terms.
speak;Cormag;I hope you get to set things right with her.|When this is all over.
speak;Joshua;That's just it.|I can't shake this feeling that time is running short.
speak;Joshua;Like something's slipping through my fingers before I even know what I've lost.
speak;Cormag;I know that feeling well.|Been having dreams about Glen lately.
speak;Cormag;I see him flying away on his wyvern.|Calling something back to me that I can't quite hear.
speak;Joshua;Call it a mercenary's instinct, but...|Tomorrow's going to change everything, isn't it?
speak;Cormag;I think so.|But we still have to face it, whatever comes.
speak;Cormag;For my brother's sake.|For Grado's sake.
speak;Joshua;For the people waiting for us.|Whether they know we're coming or not.
speak;Joshua;Care to make a wager on who strikes the first blow tomorrow?
speak;Cormag;Trying to lighten the mood with gambling?|I see your reputation is well-earned.
speak;Joshua;Hey, nothing wrong with a friendly bet.|Helps take the mind off darker thoughts.
speak;Cormag;Fair enough.|First blow struck, then.|What are the stakes?
speak;Joshua;Winner buys the other a drink.|When this is all over.
speak;Joshua;It gives us both something to look forward to.|A promise we have to keep.
speak;Cormag;Deal.|I'll hold you to that, Joshua.
speak;Joshua;I never welch on a bet.|It's bad luck.
speak;Joshua;And I have a feeling...|We're going to need all the luck we can get.

name: Ch15BBaseConvo3
_source: speak;Rennac;Hmm, this desert must be hiding something valuable.|I heard there's ancient treasure buried in these sands...
speak;Knoll;Rennac.|This is not the time for treasure hunting.|Our scouts have reported enemy forces preparing an ambush in this area.
speak;Rennac;An ambush?|That's unfortunate timing.|But surely they wouldn't mind if I collected a few trinkets while we deal with them?
speak;Knoll;How... peculiar.|We face mortal danger, yet you concern yourself with material wealth.
speak;Rennac;My dear Knoll, opportunity waits for no one!|These desert sands have claimed many travelers... and their valuables.|It would be a waste to leave such prizes unclaimed, wouldn't it?
speak;Knoll;The desert claims all eventually. Even treasures.|Our immediate survival takes precedence.
speak;Rennac;Yes, yes, the enemy and all that...|Actually, since you're here, I could use your assistance.
speak;Rennac;Your magic!|Walking through this sand is absolutely dreadful on my boots.|Could you perhaps cast something to make traversing this terrain easier?|A small favor between comrades?
speak;Knoll;You wish me to employ the ancient arts of the Demon King...|for the sake of your footwear?|While death surrounds us?
speak;Rennac;When you put it that way, it sounds quite reasonable!|I knew you'd understand.
speak;Knoll;...|I suppose expediting our movement through this terrain is tactically sound.|Very well.
speak;Rennac;Splendid!|I knew I could count on you.
speak;Knoll;...<purple>By the shadowed veil of Grado's fallen</>, I command the sands to yield...
speak;Rennac;Hey! That incantation sounds rather... ominous.
speak;Knoll;It is done.|I must now prepare our defenses.|The desert is unforgiving to the unprepared, Rennac. Remember that.
speak;Rennac;Such doom and gloom! Always so serious!|Now, where was that glimmer I spotted earlier...

speak;Rennac;With this spell, I'll find twice the treasure in half the time!|My merchant will be impressed when I return with ancient relics!|...Though perhaps I'll neglect to mention how I acquired them.

name: Talk_Anna_Recruit
_source: speak;Anna;Welcome to the Community Recruit Hub!|I'm Anna, your friendly neighborhood merchant.|Here you can recruit special units created by the community to join your army!
speak;Anna;These fighters come from all walks of life and bring unique abilities to your forces.|Just speak with me whenever you want to add new allies to your ranks!
speak;Davius;I am Davius, mercenary of the eastern plains.|My blade seeks purpose, and I hear you lead a worthy cause.
speak;Eirika;We welcome your strength, Davius.|Our path is fraught with danger, but we fight for peace.
speak;Anna;Ooh, this one's got talent!|A skilled swordsman with impressive defense.|He'll be a valuable addition to your front lines, Eirika!
speak;Davius;I pledge my sword to your service.|My techniques may be unconventional, but they are effective.
speak;Eirika;Thank you, Davius.|We'll be counting on you in the battles ahead.
speak;Moze;My name is Moze, I hail from a Magvel, a bit different from yours.
speak;Anna;Oh really, I've heard of such possibilities with the Dragon's Gate.
speak;Moze;Yes, I came through the gate in search gaining strength.|Seeing what it was like on the other side.
speak;Eirika;Well we can use all the help we can get, I see you wield a lance Moze.
speak;Moze;Yes, it was my mother's.|I plan on helping you win this war, I can sense the darkness approaching.|If you'll allow it, I'll even use my full power as a dragon to defeat our enemies.
speak;Anna;Having a powerful ally support you in battle will be very helpful.|From what we know, dragons have strong defenses and can deliver devastating damage to foes.
speak;Eirika;I see, well Moze, would you be willing to lend us a hand?
speak;Moze;Of course, my lance is yours to command.
speak;ProTagonist;Hey there!|I'm Pro!|Just your average guy with extraordinary fighting abilities!
speak;ProTagonist;Well, you know how it is!|Living with fantastic powers is never simple!
speak;Anna;Oh my!|This one's special!|He has that protagonist aura about him!|Unnaturally spiky hair and all!
speak;ProTagonist;I may not look like much, but when my friends are in danger...|That's when my true power awakens!
speak;ProTagonist;I'm not fighting for glory or anything.|I just want to protect everyone's smiles and become stronger along the way!
speak;Anna;Classic protagonist material right here!|He'll probably grow exponentially stronger through the power of friendship!
speak;ProTagonist;So what do you say?|Can I join your party and help you defeat the forces of evil?|I promise I'll never give up, no matter how tough the enemy is!
speak;Eirika;Your enthusiasm is...refreshing.|Welcome to our ranks, Pro.
speak;ProTagonist;ALRIGHT!|Just watch me become the strongest bender ever!|This is the beginning of an amazing adventure!|I can use all 4 elements of bending!
speak;Cucara;Greetings!|My name is Cucara.|I am Lumberjack in my hometown.
speak;Cucara;Aye.|Chopping trees or enemies.|Makes little difference to my axe!
speak;Anna;Strong as an oak, this one!|With axe skills that are nothing to joke about.
speak;Cucara;I'll fight to protect what is important to me.|Simple as that.
speak;Eirika;Your directness is appreciated.|Welcome to our forces.
speak;Scintilla;Greetings from the skies!|I am Scintilla, harpy warrior of the western mountains.
speak;Eirika;A harpy warrior? That's quite rare to see in these lands.
speak;Scintilla;The winds carry me where I'm needed.|And they've guided me to your cause.
speak;Anna;Oh my!|A harpy healer with amazing aerial combat skills!|She can both mend wounds and create them!|She also can steal as well!|She can do it all!
speak;Scintilla;I may not look it, but my talons are sharp and my magic sharper.|Not to mention my lockpicking skills!|No enemy in the skies can match my speed.
speak;Scintilla;It's not confidence, merely truth.|Though I can soar through the clouds, I never lose sight of my allies below.|My magic can heal those who fight alongside me.
speak;Anna;A flying healer is incredibly valuable on the battlefield!|She can reach injured allies no matter where they are!
speak;Scintilla;I seek to be the greatest sky warrior in all the realms.|Fighting with you will test my limits and sharpen my skills.
speak;Eirika;We would be honored to have your talents, both in battle and healing.
speak;Scintilla;Then it's settled.|The winds of fate have brought us together.|I shall not disappoint you.
speak;Bart;...I am Bart.|From the ssssecret village of Ophidia.
speak;Bart;Yessss...|Wordsss are precious.|I ssspeak only when necessssary.
speak;Anna;This mysterious mage has incredible arcane knowledge of serpents!|With magic is as dangerous as the deadliest viper!
speak;Bart;The sssnakes taught me their sssecretsss.|Their wisdom flowsss through my veinsss.
speak;Eirika;Snake magic?|I've heard legends of such power, but never met a practitioner.
speak;Bart;Few outsssidersss have.|Our village remainsss hidden for a reassson.
speak;Anna;Earth elemental spells and snake arts!|A tactical advantage in any battle!
speak;Bart;I will ssserve your caussse.|The sssnakes have foretold it.
speak;Eirika;We welcome your unique abilities, Bart.
speak;Bart;My powersss are yoursss to command.|Sssso it isss written.
speak;Eirika;Ah!|I've never seen someone quite like you...
speak;Anna;Hmm, this one's curious!|A beastfolk soldier from another world...|And one with her own special magical abilities!
speak;Arno;Magic? S-soldier?|I... I have magic, I know that, but...|I can't remember anything.
speak;Anna;And an amnesiac! What a mystery!|Surely there's hidden potential to be unlocked?|Perhaps by honing her lance skills...
speak;Arno;...Um...F-focusing on, uh, not her.|...You require soldiers, miss?...|Y-you seem kind! And righteous...
speak;Eirika;I suppose you could say that.|We fight to secure the peace of this land.|You seem rather gentle, so you don't need to fight...|But we'd appreciate your aid.
speak;Arno;I...Well...|Y-you seem honest! I trust you!|If you need a lance, then...|I-I'll do my best!
speak;Eirika;Thank you...|Actually, do remember your name?
speak;Eirika;Thank you, Arno!|We'll be counting on you in the battles ahead.
speak;Anna;<red>Let me tell you a special trait of this unit!|She can use her other arsenal weapons regardless of weapon access!|It depends all on her lance rank!</>
speak;Lindsey;Salutations milady!|I am Lindsey, a genius shaman over yonder.
speak;Eirika;A female shaman. That's quite a rare profession in these lands.|Speaking of a self proclaim genius, you reminded me of a certain mage.
speak;Lindsey;Did I hear that right?|Another mage claiming to be a genius?|Let me see her and I will prove to you that I am the better spellcaster of all of Magvel!
speak;Anna;Oh my!|A peculiar shaman that also heals!|She has great potential on whatever path you want her to take. |Be it as a human or a monster|She has high aptitude for both species!

speak;Lindsey;Haha! Not only am I adept with ancient arts and the staff, but I am studying ways to transcend the human body!|Not to mention I am highly adaptative when I reach my peak!|Who knows, I might be able to learn ways to summon a sizeable force of fiends to fight for us!
speak;Eirika;Your gusto sure is admirable, Lindsey.
speak;Lindsey;But of course!|I am a genius after all!|A genius that is destined to master the ancient arts ahahahaaha!
speak;Anna;A healer that uses the dark arts offers opportunites as you push forward on your travels|She can patch up injured allies if she is not busy fighting armored or anima wielding enemies.
speak;Eirika;We would be honored to have your talents, both in battle and healing.
speak;Lindsey;Then it's settled.|I will show you the fruits of my research on the fiends.|I shall not disappoint you.
speak;Azuth;I am Ainz Ooal...|No, in this realm, I am known as Azuth.|Supreme ruler of the Great Tomb of Nazarick, though it seems quite far from here.
speak;Eirika;A ruler?|You certainly have an imposing presence.
speak;Azuth;When one commands legions of the undead, a certain aura of authority becomes second nature.
speak;Anna;Oh my!|This one's truly exceptional!|A dark mage of unparalleled power!|His necromancy skills could turn the tide of any battle!
speak;Azuth;Death is merely a tool at my disposal.|My magic extends far beyond what mortals typically comprehend.|Perhaps this world holds new knowledge I can add to my collection.
speak;Eirika;Your abilities sound...formidable.|But may I ask why you would join our cause?
speak;Azuth;A wise ruler never stops seeking new experiences.|This seems an intriguing diversion, and your goals appear reasonable enough.|Consider my power at your service...for now.
speak;Anna;His tactical brilliance combined with overwhelming magical might!|He'll be devastating against enemy formations!
speak;Azuth;I shall demonstrate what it truly means to face a Supreme Being.|Those who stand against us shall know despair.
speak;Eirika;We...appreciate your confidence, Azuth.|Please try to keep the despair focused on our enemies.
speak;Azuth;As you wish.|For the glory of Nazarick...|And your cause, of course.

speak;Anna;This my friend is a slime.|Slimes are usually low level creatures.|However this little one is unique.|It has a high magical aptitude, but more importantly, it has the capacity to evolve into a stronger specie.|Who knows, she might become a mighty warrior, or ascend as a slime queen herself!
speak;Anna;She might not speak well at the moment, but in time she will develop a more solid personality.
speak;Eirika;I see...|Is it just me, or does she looks like you?
speak;Anna;Ahahaha...|Well she was with me for a long time so she modeled herself after me.|Nonetheless, I entrust this little one to you now.
speak;Alexander;Alexander, master bowyer and hunter, at your service.|These crossbows? Built them with my own hands.
speak;Eirika;A craftsman as well as a fighter?|That's an unusual combination.
speak;Alexander;The bow that fits your hand perfectly is the one that never misses.|Why trust another's craftsmanship when I can perfect my own?
speak;Anna;This one's quite the find!|A skilled hunter with custom-built weapons!|His crossbows have modifications you won't see anywhere else!

speak;Alexander;Standard issue just doesn't cut it in the wilds.|I've added my own improvements - better range, faster reload, fine-tuned bolts.|When your life depends on your weapon, every detail matters.
speak;Eirika;Your dedication to your craft is impressive.

speak;Alexander;Been tracking game through forests and mountains since I was a boy.|Learned to spot weaknesses, predict movements.|Those skills work just as well against men as they do against beasts.
speak;Anna;A hunter's eye and an engineer's mind!|He can spot enemy vulnerabilities from incredible distances!
speak;Alexander;I joined this fight because sometimes the most dangerous predators walk on two legs.|Point me at your target, and consider it done.
speak;Eirika;We welcome your expertise, Alexander.|Your skills will be invaluable on our journey.
speak;Alexander;My bolts fly true, and my aim is steady.|You won't regret bringing me along.
speak;Diana;The name's Diana.|If something shiny catches my eye, don't blame me if it ends up in my pocket!
speak;Eirika;A thief?|I'm not sure that's the kind of reputation we wish to cultivate...
speak;Diana;Hey now, I've got standards!|I only take from those who won't miss it.|Besides, every coin I earn goes to the kids back home.
speak;Anna;This one's quite special!|Lightning-fast fingers and a knack for finding hidden treasures!|She can slip past enemies unnoticed and unlock even the most complicated mechanisms!
speak;Diana;Grew up on the streets, trained by the Shadowhand Guild.|Learned everything from picking locks to disarming enemies.|But that life's behind me...mostly.
speak;Eirika;You mentioned children?|What did you mean by that?
speak;Diana;There's an orphanage in the slums of Roseport.|Kids like I once was, with nowhere to go.|Every job I take gets them closer to a better life than I had.
speak;Anna;A noble cause behind those nimble fingers!|And those skills will be invaluable for accessing locked chests and doors during your journey!
speak;Diana;So, what do you say?|You need someone who can open doors that weren't meant to be opened?|I promise I won't steal from your allies...too much.
speak;Eirika;Your skills could indeed prove useful.|And your cause is honorable, despite your methods.
speak;Diana;Great!|You won't regret it!|Just keep an eye on your valuables until I learn everyone's names!|Old habits, you know?
speak;Eirika;Is that your name? You seem troubled.
speak;Jaffar;...I am the Angel of Death.|Or I was...|I don't remember how I came to be here.
speak;Anna;This one's quite the enigma!|A master assassin with unparalleled skill!|Though he seems to be missing some of his memories...
speak;Eirika;Whatever happened in your past, perhaps you can find a new purpose here.
speak;Jaffar;Death is all I know.|Perhaps redemption lies in a worthy death.

speak;Anna;Now, now!|Death isn't the only path to redemption!|Sometimes living is the harder challenge!|And worth noting - his full potential seems dormant for now.|He may grow stronger as he finds his purpose again!
speak;Jaffar;...You would trust me?|After what I've done?
speak;Eirika;I sense honesty in your words, despite your past.|Sometimes the most damaged souls are the ones most deserving of a second chance.
speak;Jaffar;...Then my blades are yours.|Until death claims me...or until I remember.
speak;Anna;<red>This unit's weapon takes a while to evolve, but becomes strong when it does!|Keep him alive long enough to see his true potential unleashed!</>
speak;Lyn;I am Lyn of the Lorca tribe.|Though I suppose I should say Lyndis of Caelin now.
speak;Eirika;You carry yourself like nobility, yet there's something untamed about you.
speak;Lyn;I was raised on the plains of Sacae by my tribe.|The wind and grasslands taught me how to move, how to fight.|Even with a noble title, the plains will always be my true home.
speak;Anna;Oh my!|A swordswoman of exceptional grace and speed!|Her blade work is as swift as the prairie winds!|And that bow technique - simply magnificent!
speak;Lyn;My grandfather's blood flows through my veins, but it's the lessons of the plains that made me strong.|Every battle taught me that hesitation means death.
speak;Eirika;Your heritage sounds quite complex.|What brings you to seek us out?

speak;Lyn;I've learned that sometimes you have to fight for what's right, even when the odds seem impossible.|Your cause reminds me of my own struggles.|Besides, I can't stand by when innocent people need protection.
speak;Anna;A natural leader with the heart of a warrior!|Her tactical instincts and lightning-fast strikes make her formidable against any foe!
speak;Lyn;I won't promise you an easy path, but I will promise you this:|My blade will never waver in defense of justice.|The spirit of Sacae rides with me.
speak;Eirika;Your conviction is admirable, Lyn.|We would be honored to have a warrior of your caliber join our cause.
speak;Lyn;Then it's settled.|May the wind guide our blades to victory.
speak;Eirika;You have quite an intimidating presence about you, Sir Tareon.
speak;Tareon;...Many have said so.|Fear is...useful.|Enemies hesitate when they look upon me.
speak;Anna;Oh my!|This one sends chills down my spine just standing here!|An armored knight who wields fear as effectively as his axe!|His very presence can shake enemy morale!
speak;Tareon;I carry...burdens.|Things I have done...|Things I cannot undo.|Perhaps serving a just cause will...balance the scales.
speak;Eirika;We all have shadows in our past, Sir Tareon.|What matters is what we choose to do going forward.
speak;Tareon;...You are not afraid?|Most cannot bear to look at me for long.
speak;Anna;A warrior who can terrify foes before the battle even begins!|That intimidating aura of his can make enemies falter just when they need courage most!
speak;Tareon;My axe has tasted much blood.|But if it can now serve to protect the innocent...|Perhaps there is still honor to be found.
speak;Eirika;Your willingness to fight for others despite your troubled past speaks well of your character.
speak;Tareon;...Then I pledge my axe to your cause.|May it find redemption in righteous battle.
speak;Anna;Having someone so imposing on our side will certainly make enemies think twice before attacking!
speak;Genji;I am Genji, former retainer of the House of the Rising Sun.|My master has fallen, and with him, my purpose.
speak;Eirika;A samurai?|Your clothing and bearing are quite distinctive.
speak;Genji;The way of the sword is all I have known.|Honor, duty, loyalty.|These were my guiding principles.|Now I drift like a leaf on the wind, seeking meaning.
speak;Anna;This one carries himself with incredible discipline!|A master swordsman trained in the ancient arts of the samurai!|His blade technique is poetry in motion!
speak;Genji;My katana thirsts for righteous battle.|In my homeland, we believed that a warrior's soul is reflected in his sword.|Perhaps in serving your cause, both blade and spirit can find peace.
speak;Eirika;Your dedication to honor is admirable, Genji.|We would welcome a warrior of your caliber.
speak;Genji;Then allow me to pledge my sword to your service.|Though my former master is gone, perhaps I can find new purpose in protecting what you hold dear.
speak;Anna;A disciplined knight with the heart of a warrior-poet!|His techniques blend grace with deadly precision!
speak;Genji;The cherry blossoms fall, but their beauty remains eternal.|So too shall my loyalty to this cause endure.
speak;Eirika;Your words carry great wisdom, Genji.|We are honored by your service.
speak;Anna;Oh, also to note Genji is a <red>T2 unit!</>|So he is gonna be stronger than most units if you just started!|So be careful with you EXP management!
speak;Atlas;I am Atlas, sworn protector of the innocent.|My sword exists to shield those who cannot shield themselves.
speak;Eirika;A noble calling.|What drives such dedication to protection?
speak;Atlas;I have seen what happens when the strong prey upon the weak.|Too many times have I arrived too late to prevent tragedy.|Never again, if I can help it.
speak;Anna;This one has the heart of a true guardian!|A sword knight whose defensive prowess is matched only by his unwavering resolve!|He'll stand firm against any threat!
speak;Atlas;My armor may be scarred and my sword worn from use, but my determination has never wavered.|Every battle I fight is for someone who cannot fight for themselves.
speak;Eirika;Your selflessness is remarkable, Atlas.|What made you choose this path?
speak;Atlas;A knight's true strength isn't measured by enemies defeated, but by lives saved.|I would rather take a hundred wounds than let harm come to an innocent.
speak;Anna;A stalwart defender who puts others before himself!|With him on the front lines, your allies can fight with confidence!
speak;Atlas;If your cause is just and your people in need of protection, then my blade is yours.|I swear by my honor as a knight.
speak;Eirika;We are fortunate to have someone so dedicated to justice join our ranks.
speak;Atlas;As long as there are those in need, I will be their shield.|This I promise.
speak;Oliver;I am Oliver, nice to meet you.|I'm not sure how I got here, I am still learning to control my magic you see.
speak;Eirika;Your magic...|It feels quite powerful, yet somehow familiar.
speak;Oliver;The people of my tribe say my magic resembles the Fell Dragon.|Oh I forgot to mention, my tribe worships the Fell Dragon, but don't worry they are good people.
speak;Anna;Oh my!|This is quite unexpected!|A mage wielding power similar to the legendary Fell Dragon!|Though he seems quite inexperienced with controlling it!
speak;Oliver;They raised me and my brother after we became orphans after all.|I know it sounds strange, but they taught me that power itself isn't evil.|It's how you choose to use it.
speak;Eirika;The Fell Dragon's power...that's quite concerning.|But you seem sincere in your intentions.
speak;Oliver;I understand your worry!|That's exactly why I need to learn proper control.|Maybe by fighting alongside good people like you,|I can prove that this power can be used for justice.
speak;Anna;Untrained but incredibly potent magical abilities!|With proper guidance, he could become a formidable ally!|Though he'll need careful instruction!
speak;Oliver;I promise I won't let this power hurt anyone who doesn't deserve it.|My tribe taught me that strength should protect, not destroy.
speak;Eirika;Your heart seems to be in the right place, Oliver.|We'll help you learn to control your abilities.
speak;Oliver;Thank you so much!|I won't let you down!|Together we can show that even the darkest power can serve the light!

speak;Anna;I see you have met with my tree friend right here.|Dryads are stalwart forest guardians. |As priestesses of mother nature, they serve as great support for your army.|Aside from healing, they also serve as rejuvinating dancers once they hit a certain milestone.|Nurture them well and you have a great support in later adventures.
speak;Tyrande;Oh you flatter me benefactor.| I' am but a mere servant.
speak;Eirika;A humble one too.|I like your demeanor.| Alright welcome to the our rag tag group.
speak;Jack;I am Jack, nice to meet you.|I'm an aspiring knight and my dream is to wield the ultimate weapon someday.
speak;Jack;That's right! I have heard stories that only true masters of the weapon triangle can wield it.
speak;Anna;Oh my!|This is quite unexpected!|An ultimate weapon that only masters of the weapon triangle can wield?|But he only seems to carry a sword for now...
speak;Jack;What was that? Oh! You're right! I must have forgotten my axe and lance somewhere...
speak;Jack;Yup!|This happens to me a lot. But don't worry I'll still be useful to you. I promise!
speak;Anna;A chaotic personality that shows potential.|He may seem like a lost cause right now but with proper training he might become a powerful ally.|Though he'll need careful instruction!
speak;Eirika;Your dream is inspiring, Jack.|We'll be glad to have you on our side and watch you make that dream a reality.
speak;Jack;Thank you so much!|You can count on me!|Uhh by the way... has anyone seen my horse?
speak;Anna;Princess, this man has come running here searching for you!
speak;Eirika;Jonathan?|Is that you?|It has been such a long time.

speak;Jonathan;True, I have not gone to the castle since my retirement.|Was a little busy taking care of my family and...|NO, FORGET THAT!|I need to know, Eirika, where is your father?|I heard that Renais was attacked and came here as fast as I could.
